exultation.description: Your words inspire more than just attention, and with the right topic and the right passion, they may even command the masses. With this purchase, you are able to instill a specific feeling, emotion, or ideology in your followers through your words and speeches until you are capable of invoking it with your very presence on those that have already listened. This effect is not instantaneous and requires more exposure depending on the complexity of your message. For simple rapport, it would take a few days, for loyalty a few months, and for a complete ideology it may take up to a year.

flawless_physique.name: Flawless Physique
flawless_physique.description: The times are right to perform, sing, and dance, and you just so happen to be a star when you move. You excel at the performing arts of singing, dancing, and choreography. From the more traditional concert dance, opera, or ballet, to more modern interpretative, swing, or jazz dance. To accommodate for this lifestyle, you also possess excellent body coordination, a crystal clear voice, natural resilience that provides resistance against injury and disease, and a body that perfectly preserves your ideal fitness and beauty even if you overindulge in food or drinks

frangiclave.name: Frangiclave
frangiclave.description: The master key of the world, and the most powerful tool of the Principle of Knock. The Frangiclave is a key that doesn’t so much open locks, but rather utterly destroys them.

furious_sliver.name: Furious Sliver
furious_sliver.description: The remnants of a blade that had to be shattered for a general to become an Hour. Even broken, these 3 fragments yearn to strike again, and should they be reforged, they will surround and follow their master like loyal dogs of war

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.description: It seems you’ve imbibed in the Elixir Zeboim, and while no hour has explicitly blessed your actions, you’ve nevertheless succeeded in awakening the memories of the decaying flesh. With this ability, whenever you partake in a kill or consume a corpse, the memories of the dead will flow into you, giving you an insight on their lives as if you had been there by their side. This process takes only a couple of seconds, at most a minute, during which you will remain in a dreamlike state, and can be toggled on and off at will, so that you are not burdened with unwanted knowledge

kingskin_bodhran.name: Kingskin Bodhran
kingskin_bodhran.description: An irish style drum fashioned out of the leftover skin of an Hour. The sounds of this drum force the hearts around them to beat to the rhythm, even if death wishes otherwise.

loresmith.name: Loresmith
loresmith.description: It pays to give back to the community, and for someone that has been everywhere, you could have a wealth of knowledge for sale. With this ability you can now easily contribute to the collective knowledge of the world by instantly creating essays, books, manuals, papers, recipes and other written documentation of any subject you are familiar with. This information is compiled with as much care as if you had done it over a few years, and can be formatted, rewritten, and edited on the fly, allowing you to tailor the final results to your liking. Teaching perks will increase the rate at which your documents are studied and assimilated.

lucidity.name: Lucidity
lucidity.description: There’s plenty of dangers in the Mansus. It wouldn’t do you any good trying to tackle them at anything less than your full capabilities. With this perk, you now possess the uncanny ability to lucid dream, allowing you to remain in control of your actions whether you are asleep or forced in a dreamlike state. More importantly, in this lucid state it becomes easier for you to manifest your own perks and powers inside dreams or illusions, granting you the same tools you’d have available as if you were physically there.

marruvine_idol.name: Marruvine Idol
marruvine_idol.description: An infant doll made of wood. These dolls can placate the rage of the supernatural beasts temporarily, who will cradle the doll like their own baby

mr_never_no.name: Mr. Never No
mr_never_no.description: As a priest in charge of a parish, it’s of utmost importance that you can perform your job correctly. With this perk you now possess an exceptional charisma worthy of a community leader, not only able to charm your audiences with ease, but also having a very keen eye for other people’s wants and needs. Additionally, and if you didn’t before, you are now capable of delivering your messages with exceptional eloquence, never stumbling on your words, and always transitioning from one topic to another with exceptional ease.

noonstone.name: Noonstone
noonstone.description: This minor tool can be used to call upon the Principle of the Lantern. It radiates like an overhead sun, and its light can shine even in supernatural darkness.

open_soul.name: Open Soul
open_soul.description: Many would believe that a medium is a bridge for the spirits, but in the present day and age a medium starts off as but a simple entertainer. This perk provides all the tricks and experience needed to become an unrivaled mentalist, giving you a wide array of mundane abilities that seemingly border on psychic powers, such as hypnosis, telekinesis, clairvoyance, and mediumship. These abilities are not actually supernatural but rather a calculated application of suggestion, misdirection, and subterfuge. In addition to this, your mentalist skills can be used against other mundane skills, like cold reading, to prevent people from reading your thoughts or emotions, or learning your trade secrets without your consent

p_i_jumper.name: P.I. Jumper
p_i_jumper.description: I can’t let you go out on those streets without some proper training rookie. You are now a master at cold reading your targets, which makes you capable of picking up subtle hints and cues based on their body language, their appearance, or their mannerisms, and using cleverly designed language you can squeeze the truth without them being none the wiser. With this you are able to spot the signs of struggle and of anxiety, the nervous tics before a breakdown, or the different tells that incriminate liars.

paradoxical_curio.name: Paradoxical Curio
paradoxical_curio.description: A reality bending trinket that represents the many Secret Histories. This curio only bends in bizarre ways when in the presence of supernatural danger

patronage.name: Patronage
patronage.description: It’s hard enough to pursue your passions when they are mundane, it’s even harder to do so when nobody has trailed the path you walk before. With this perk, you’ll have excellent luck when it comes down to attracting tutors, mentors, patrons, and benefactors, even if your aspirations are not exactly common. Whether you wish to learn obscure dances to change skins from Sulochana, or simply become better in your greek studies, there’s a very high likelihood that you’ll bump into one or two people who will gladly show you the ropes and set you on your way. This ability can also be targeted by simply asking someone for their help, and they’ll be far more likely to react positively to your request.

perceptive.name: Perceptive
perceptive.description: It’s important to not make mistakes in the field, especially when the lives of innocents are at stake. If you didn’t before, you now possess at least peak human perception across all five senses. More importantly, you're able to process this input with exceptional clarity. You could easily identify and isolate a quiet conversation in a bustling cafe, spot a face out of a crowd like it was painted red, differentiate twins from one another just by smell, identify every ingredient used in a sumptuous meal, or know your exact location from the movement of a carriage.

perfectionist.name: Perfectionist
perfectionist.description: Practice, as they say, makes perfect. And you seem to have a big advantage when it comes to reaching perfection. When performing a task that you’ve already attempted, you’ll always have the guarantee that your results will not be worse than your previous best. This primarily focuses on the results and not the execution, so as long your actions don’t deviate too much from your original actions you’ll still have room to improve your skills, try different methods, or even improvise in your work. The more you practice, the more scenarios this perk will cover.

rites_of_initiation.name: Rites of Initiation
rites_of_initiation.description: What is a pastor without its sheep? A hunter without the hunt? An occultist without its tools? This purchase grants you basic knowledge surrounding the rituals needed for this jump, including the ritual to induct new followers. This includes a general understanding of their inner workings, allowing you to tailor them as you see fit. You may use this power to induct an individual into the dark side of the world, allowing them to unlock an affinity based on one of the Principles of the Mansus. This affinity will closely match the nature of the new disciple. Those that already possessed an affinity before the rite receive no benefit from this perk. You may take these rituals to other worlds, allowing you to create a new framework for magic based on the Principles and rituals found in this jump. This framework can interact with existing magical systems, allowing you to use the rituals you are familiar with to tap into the system, or you could have your powers work in an entirely separate manner.

ritual_maker.name: Ritual Maker
ritual_maker.description: Hard work pays off, and you, jumper, have spent quite some time studying the occult. With this power you can now create rituals through which others may temporarily access your perks or powers. These rituals can involve anything from chants, to performances, to tools, or even reagents, and if you’ve purchased the Rites of Initiation, you may even require one or more Principles from this world to be invoked using influences or affinity. All rituals must require at least 10 minutes to prepare and cast, but you can otherwise set the terms and conditions freely. Know that after imbuing any power into a ritual, that specific power will be much weaker for a few days, and unless the ritual has stringent conditions, anyone with the appropriate knowledge may use it.

stained_gloves.name: Stained Gloves
stained_gloves.description: A pair of black gloves. When worn, the hands behave with surgical precision, as if a lifetime of practice had descended upon them

the_geminiad.name: The Geminiad
the_geminiad.description: An extensive treatise in the Principle of Knock. This text provides knowledge on every lock, every door, and every barrier, and the many ways to open them.

watchmans_glass.name: Watchman’s Glass
watchmans_glass.description: An ancient glass of polished silver anthracite. This unbreakable shield can be used to reflect the most radiant light, and even supernatural attacks will bounce off its surface.

ultimate_talent.name: Ultimate Talent
ultimate_talent.description: Choose a skill or trait. You gain superhuman talent within that domain, allowing you to progress and improve at speeds and in ways impossible for ordinary people. This bonus weakens as the chosen talent broadens in scope. Any skill or trait is valid, including ephemeral concepts like "luck" or "morals." You may purchase this perk multiple times, selecting a new talent each time.

loot_shower.name: Loot Shower!
loot_shower.description: When you defeat an opponent that qualifies as a "boss" or "mini-boss" tier threat or obstacles in the context of the conflict/challenge, they erupt in a spectacular fountain of thematic loot. Weapons, armor, gold, and curiosities shower from their fallen form, each piece enchanted in the style of Diablo games: bearing magical properties, set bonuses, and rarities ranging from magic to legendary. The loot is always thematically appropriate to the defeated foe and the environment, it also usually somewhat useful for you. For Additional 200 CP: This perk now can be toggled on or off at will, allowing you to control when you want the fireworks, or when you prefer a clean, discreet victory.

treasure_goblins.name: Treasure Goblins
treasure_goblins.description: Rarely and randomly, a Treasure Goblin spawns somewhere nearby. These devious little creatures exist solely to hoard wealth, and all who perceive them instinctively understand the deal: kill the goblin, take its loot. Goblins do not fight: they flee, dropping a trail of valuables as they run, attempting to reach safety and conjure an escape portal. Attacking them disrupts the portal, but you must be quick; if they escape or are left alone too long, they vanish entirely. Of course, these goblins have a cruel sense of humor. They always appear in situations where pursuit is difficult, annoying, or genuinely risky: during combat, in hostile territory, or when you're otherwise occupied. But the reward is always worth the trouble: a shower of valuables and enchanted items, Diablo-style, scaled to be useful to whoever claims it. +200 CP (Treasure Realm): On rare occasions, killing a Treasure Goblin opens a shimmering portal to the Vault - Greed's personal domain, where all stolen riches are hoarded. Within lies a short, treasure-filled level culminating in an encounter with Greed itself. Upon its defeat, Greed's Strongbox crashes down, bursting with legendary loot. A 60-second timer then begins; loot quickly and escape before the realm collapses. Portals are blocked until the chest is opened.

askari_amazon.name: Askari Amazon
askari_amazon.description: "A master of the javelin and bow, the Amazon reacts to combat situations with superhuman agility. She relies on magical prowess to enhance her significant martial abilities." In her world, this Amazon of the Askari met her end. A powerful woman warrior from nomadic bands roaming the plains near the South Sea, she was accustomed to fighting to defend her own from constant conflicts with other peoples. Her lifestyle forged her into a fiercely independent survivor, able to weather severe hardship and travel. Her skill with the bow rivaled that of the Rogues, but she was equally adept with spears, javelins, and hand-to-hand combat. She possessed the unique ability to wield Amazon Weapons: special bows, javelins, and spears that only her people could truly master. Now, she has been granted a second chance. She appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, her soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, she receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. She retains all the martial skill, superhuman agility, and magical prowess she possessed at the time of her death along with her equipment. However, she still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of her fiat-backed contract will prevent her from working against you.

barbarian_of_harrogath.name: Barbarian of Harrogath
barbarian_of_harrogath.description: "Glorified by many a song and fireside tale, the Barbarian is unrivaled in delivering unrelenting melee fury on anyone foolish enough to greet their axe-head." In his world, this Barbarian of the Northern Steppes met his end. He grew up in Harrogath, surviving the trials of weaponcraft and the hostile wilderness from his youth. He knew Malah and her son Bannuk before leaving on his quest to destroy the Prime Evils - a journey from which he would never return. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the martial prowess, unrelenting fury, and survival instincts he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

brother_of_the_bough.name: Brother of the Bough
brother_of_the_bough.description: "From defeat, they forged discipline. From nothing, they honed everything." In his world, this monk of the Brotherhood of the Bough met his end. Hailing from a desolate wilderness - a people conquered and scattered by an invading horde - he vowed to master combat without the resources he lacked. With no iron for weapons or armor, he learned to make his bare hands and simple wooden staves into deadly instruments, relying on speed, concentration, and unbreakable will. His harsh homeland also forced him to find sustenance in the most unlikely places, honing his visual perception to an almost supernatural degree over time. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the martial skill, honed perception, and disciplined spirit he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

druid_of_scosglen.name: Druid of Scosglen
druid_of_scosglen.description: "To survive and rule over these wilds, the Druids must forfeit their humanity to awaken the beast within." In his world, this Druid of Scosglen met his end. Kin to the Barbarians, he was raised in the Old Ways within one of the great stone Druid Colleges, honing his bond with nature under the sacred oak Glór-an-Fháidha. He shunned traditional magic, instead drawing power from his intimate kinship with the natural world: commanding fire, earth, and wind, summoning lightning, calling animals and even plants to aid him. His greatest gift was shapeshifting, allowing him to take on the characteristics of the beasts he had sworn to protect. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world - its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the natural magic, shapeshifting ability, and martial skill he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

khanduran_warrior.name: Khanduran Warrior
khanduran_warrior.description: "Empathy separates the warrior from the beast. Understand others. Fight for what matters most." In his world, this warrior of Khanduras met his end. Well-trained in all weapons of war, he was one of many adventuresome men who joined King Leoric's army to battle against the kingdom of Westmarch. Whether crusading paladin or unscrupulous mercenary, he could be found wherever conflict arose among his countrymen. But when the fires of war burned out and he returned home, he found his kingdom in shattered chaos and disarray and there, ultimately, he fell. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the martial skill, combat experience, and hard-won wisdom he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

knight_of_the_faith.name: Knight of the Faith
knight_of_the_faith.description: "Originally from the lands of the west, the Knights of the Faith, also known as Paladins, are holy warriors spread across the realms of Sanctuary. These soldiers of faith use holy magic in the war against the dark agents of Hell, wandering across the realm spreading their virtues or purging heresy. These battle-ready devotees of the light are a necessary bulwark against the forces of darkness." In his world this Paladin met his end. Trained in the ways of sword and shield, he used holy magic gifted by the High Heavens to protect the downtrodden and wield light itself as raw power. He followed a strict code of chivalry, upholding the cause of Virtue and Light against the undead and the agents of Hell alike. His faith was core to his identity, and he knew well the danger of false lights. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the martial prowess, holy magic, and unshakeable faith he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

legion_of_the_fallen.name: Legion of the Fallen
legion_of_the_fallen.description: "Fallen Ones are the lowest of the low. As a result, they tend to be bad-tempered and violent, attacking anything in their path." You gain the ability to summon a substantial warband of Fallen demons, equipped and ready for war. This legion includes: >Carvers - mildly insane, but possessed of low cunning and a dangerous attitude >Devilkin - fully insane, attacking in gibbering mobs to unnerve their foes >Dark Ones - utterly self-serving, gladly pushing their fellows into battle to survive >Warped Ones - the worst of the lot, for whom no task is too monstrous in sufficient numbers >Fallen Shamans - to lead and support the horde with their dark magic Once summoned, they cannot be dismissed or unsummoned. They are bound by a strict magical contract that ensures they remain mostly aligned with your goals, genuinely loyal to you, and obedient to your orders. However, dealing with demons is never without its challenges - expect some unforeseen problems arising from their inherent nature. Upon arrival, the entire legion gains knowledge of the local language, your current situation, and a general understanding of the new world around them.

priest_of_rathma.name: Priest of Rathma
priest_of_rathma.description: "Haunt your foes with the dead, so even the demons of the Burning Hells will feel dread. Reanimate corpses to protect the living. Curse the damned with baneful skills. Inflict pestilence on the enemy. Alienated and shunned by society, those who underestimate your power are ignorant of their grave mistake. Only your commands echo in eternity." In his world, this Necromancer of the Priests of Rathma met his end. Trained in the balanced philosophy of the Great Cycle, he walked the narrow path between light and darkness - neither good nor evil, but essential. He commanded the dead, raised armies from corpses, and wielded curses and pestilence against the forces of the Burning Hells. Society shunned him, but he knew the true weight of his power. Now, he has been granted a second chance. He appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, his soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, he receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world: its history, local language, and common technology. He retains all the necromantic mastery, command over death, and balanced wisdom he possessed at the time of his death along with his equipment. However, he still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of his fiat-backed contract will prevent him from working against you.

sister_of_the_sightless_eye.name: Sister of the Sightless Eye
sister_of_the_sightless_eye.description: "Rogue philosophy states that money is neither good nor evil." In her world, this Rogue of the Sisterhood of the Sightless Eye met her end. Though not as powerful in close combat as Warriors, she was an undisputed master of the bow. The innate sixth sense possessed by all Rogues allowed her to sense trapped fixtures and aided her in disarming them. She was one of many who fought during the Darkening of Tristram, when her Sisterhood stood as the shield and bow against the rising darkness. Now, she has been granted a second chance. She appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, her soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, she receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world - its history, local language, and common technology. She retains all the archery skill, trap sense, and hard-won survival instincts she possessed at the time of her death along with her equipment. However, she still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of her fiat-backed contract will prevent her from working against you.

viz-jaqtaar_assassin.name: Viz-Jaq'taar Assassin
viz-jaqtaar_assassin.description: "A member of an ancient Vizjerei order founded to hunt down mages gone rogue, the Assassin is a martial arts expert who uses deadly traps and shadow disciplines to vanquish evil." In her world, this Assassin of the Viz-Jaq'taar (the Order of the Mage Slayers) met her end. Sworn to weed out demonic corruption from the Mage Clans, she possessed one of the purest, most focused minds imaginable. She drew power from within, not without, employing ingenious devices and enchanted items rather than direct magic. She honed her body and mind to perfection, mastering martial arts, wrist-blades, deadly traps, and shadow disciplines. She was a living weapon against corruption. Now, she has been granted a second chance. She appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, her soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, she receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world - its history, local language, and common technology. She retains all the martial skill, psychic discipline, and mastery of infiltration and traps she possessed at the time of her death along with her equipment. However, she still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of her fiat-backed contract will prevent her from working against you.

zann_esu_sorceress.name: Zann Esu Sorceress
zann_esu_sorceress.description: "Your soul is inundated with power. Let it overflow, and your enemies will quickly learn to fear it." In her original world, this Sorceress of the Zann Esu Clan met her end. Athletic, affable, and self-assured, she hardly fit the image of a scholarly bibliophile hidden from civilization. She possessed many of the same skills as her male counterparts in the Mage Clans, but excelled particularly at elemental magic: wielding fire, lightning, and cold with devastating precision. Now, she has been granted a second chance. She appears before you as a loyal familiar and ally, her soul bound to your service by gratitude and circumstance. Upon arrival, she receives basic knowledge about you, your current situation, and useful trivia about the world - its history, local language, and common technology. She retains all the skills and magical talent she possessed at the time of her death along with her equipment. However, she still has free will and can leave you, but the geas of her fiat-backed contract will prevent her from working against you.

authority.name: AUTHORITY
authority.description: "Intimidate the public. Assert yourself." You possess an innate understanding of power dynamics. Authority enables you to assert and reassert your dominance over those around you: reading groups of thugs, knowing exactly how far you can push a perpetrator, and establishing control over any situation. You command respect, fear, or obedience as the moment demands. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your capacity for command and intimidation. It speaks in certainties about power, boundaries, and control, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to dominate social dynamics, break resistance, and make your authority absolute.

composure.name: COMPOSURE
composure.description: "Straighten your back. Keep your poker face." You are a fortress of emotional control. Composure enables you to maintain an unshakeable front, hiding your true feelings from the world while reading the cracks in everyone else's facade. You sense when others are about to break, when their body language betrays their words, when their composure is merely performance. And you do it all while looking good: no slouching, no tells, just perfect poise that makes any outfit work. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your emotional control and social perception. It speaks in posture corrections, micro-expression analysis, and reminders to maintain your cool, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to become utterly unreadable, perceive the hidden emotions of others with perfect clarity, and maintain flawless composure in any situation.

conceptualization.name: CONCEPTUALIZATION
conceptualization.description: "Understand creativity. See Art in the world." You possess the ability to make fresh associations and delve into world-concepts: from postmodernist karperie to arabesque dideridada, from the meaning of HARDCORE to the hidden connections between seemingly unrelated ideas. More importantly, you can add your own contributions to these works, creating new art and new concepts that enrich the world around you. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Conceptualization ability. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for creative insight. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to perceive art everywhere and generate original concepts of profound depth and beauty.

drama.name: DRAMA
drama.description: "Play the actor. Lie and detect lies." The world is a stage and on it, you perform. This perk enables you to craft elaborate falsehoods, concoct wonderful stories, and adopt ingenious personas with masterful stagecraft. You become a virtuoso of fourberie and deceit. Conversely, you can see through the performances of others: if someone lies to you, you will know it immediately. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Dramatic aptitude. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for deception and truth-seeking. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to perform, deceive, and uncover the false performances of others.

electrochemistry.name: ELECTROCHEMISTRY
electrochemistry.description: "Go to party planet. Love and be loved by drugs." The animal within you - the beast longing to be unleashed to indulge and enjoy. Electrochemistry enables you to consume substances with dramatically reduced negative side effects while retaining their benefits. More than mere hedonism, it guides you through lurid matters: understanding chemical breakdowns, communicating with the intoxicated, and navigating the complex dynamics of desire and indulgence. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your body's appetites and chemical wisdom. It speaks in urges, tolerances, and insights into the altered states of yourself and others, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to process toxins, understand chemistry on an intuitive level, and navigate the darkest corners of human indulgence with perfect clarity.

empathy.name: EMPATHY
empathy.description: "Understand others. Work your mirror neurons." You possess the ability to break into the souls of others and feel what lies within. Empathy enables you to notice social cues that others miss: a hidden sadness you could coax out, a strange joy in someone who should be grieving, or a buried resentment that could one day return to harm you. You understand what people truly feel, beneath their words and masks. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your capacity for emotional insight. It speaks in feelings and intuitions about others, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the hidden emotional truths of anyone you encounter.

encyclopedia.name: ENCYCLOPEDIA
encyclopedia.description: "Call upon all your knowledge. Produce fascinating trivia." Your mind is a database of facts. You innately draw upon a wealth of background knowledge on any subject - relevant to your case or utterly unrelated. The history of cigarette brands, the design of pre-Revolutionary guns, obscure cultural references, forgotten scientific trivia - all are at your fingertips when you need them most. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your memory and accumulated knowledge. It is a calm, tireless inner librarian that supplies fascinating information and cross-references without causing any stress or discomfort. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernatural at storing, codifying, and accessing data, eventually granting you perfect recall of everything you've experienced and the ability to retrieve even the most obscure information instantly or even fill in some gaps from the data you already possess.

endurance.name: ENDURANCE
endurance.description: "Take the blows. Don't let the world kill you." Your metabolism and circulatory system operate at peak capacity. Endurance enables you to survive punishment that would fell others: bullets, toxins, environmental hazards, and the general wear and tear of existence. Who cares if you can't aim a gun if you can take a few bullets? Why fear drugs that harm the body when you are a very, very healthy man? This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical resilience and survival instinct. It speaks in sensations of your body's limits and capacities, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at pushing your body beyond its breaking point, surviving the unsurvivable, and letting the world exhaust itself trying to kill you.

espirit_de_corps.name: ESPIRIT DE CORPS
espirit_de_corps.description: "Connect to Station 41. Understand cop culture." You possess the very spirit of policing - the cop-geist. Esprit de Corps enables you to understand your blue-souled sisters and brothers on a profound level, picking up subtle signals from partners and allies. More remarkably, you experience flash-sideways scenes of your comrades as they play out elsewhere (glimpses of precinct life, moments of danger, acts of solidarity) allowing you to coordinate and connect across distance. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your attunement to brotherhood and shared purpose. It speaks in loyalty, understanding, and flashes of distant events, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to forge unbreakable bonds with allies and sense their struggles wherever they may be.

half_light.name: HALF LIGHT
half_light.description: "Let the body take control. Threaten people." Your fight-or-flight response raised to an art form. Half Light enables you to sense when situations are about to turn violent or desperate, often before any conscious sign appears. It injects palpable fear into your heart, fear that urges action before it's too late, fear that makes you frighten others in turn. This is the aggression that lets you squeeze every last drop of information from a witness, the instinct that keeps you alive when reason would freeze. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your primal survival instinct and aggression. It speaks in adrenaline, threat assessment, and the urge to strike first, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to sense danger before it manifests, intimidate others with primal ferocity, and let your body take control when hesitation means death.

hand_eye_coordination.name: HAND/EYE COORDINATION
hand_eye_coordination.description: "Ready? Aim and fire." Your connection between hand and eye is extraordinary. Hand/Eye Coordination governs every interaction with objects in flight: catching coins tossed by mob bosses, throwing with precision, and above all, shooting straight. You understand firearms intimately: the precise make and model of any pistol at a glance, its quirks and capabilities, and exactly how to use it. Want to identify a weapon? This skill has you covered. Want to shoot someone with it? Ditto. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical precision and firearm intuition. It speaks in trajectories, targeting data, and the perfect moment to release, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to achieve impossible accuracy, master any projectile weapon, and catch or throw with preternatural precision.

inland_empire.name: INLAND EMPIRE
inland_empire.description: "Hunches and gut feelings. Dreams in waking life." You possess an unfiltered wellspring of imagination, emotion, and foreboding. Inland Empire enables you to grope your way through invisible dimensions of reality, gaining insight into that which sight cannot see. You sense what is really going on beneath the surface: the enigmatic riddles, the hidden meanings, the whispers of world-fate. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your intuition and dreamlike perception. It speaks in hunches, feelings, and strange certainties, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the invisible, interpret the inexplicable, and navigate the dreamlike dimensions of reality.

innocence.name: INNOCENCE
innocence.description: You are the Innocence, a living personification of History itself. In any world you enter, you are the highest category of historical personage, elected by fate to supreme rule. Your decisions are not mere choices, but historical inevitabilities; compressed events that would have happened anyway, merely accelerated through your will. This renders you functionally infallible, as your victories are not earned through force, but because they are pre-ordained. You do not need to enforce your rule - you win because you cannot help but win. Be warned, however: false claimants and factions who oppose your ordained destiny may still arise. Due to the nature of this state, you cannot perceive the text of this perk or consciously access its effects. It simply is. Be warned, rules of your current reality and its metaphysics can and will wrap effects of this state in various ways.

interfacing.name: INTERFACING
interfacing.description: "Master machines. Pick locks and pockets." You possess an intuitive connection to the mechanical world. Interfacing enables you to understand, use, and improve machines of all kinds: repairing motor carriages, analyzing how a suspect used a pen, rewiring electrical circuits, and coaxing functionality from broken devices. Beyond pure mechanics, this skill extends to delicate manual theft: lifting keys from a keyring without notice, picking locks with practiced ease, and liberating objects from pockets. Machines are tools, and you are their master. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your mechanical intuition and manual dexterity. It speaks in diagrams, friction points, and the whisper of tumblers falling into place, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to interface with any technology, repair the irreparable, and liberate anything that can be lifted or unlocked.

logic.name: LOGIC
logic.description: "Wield raw intellectual power. Deduce the world." You possess a preternatural capacity for deduction and pure intellection. Piece together evidence, detect inconsistencies in statements, and impress everyone with your astonishing conclusions. Logic is the bread and butter of investigation and you have mastered it. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your reason. It is a calm, tireless partner in thought that causes no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can elevate this internal counsel to supernatural levels of insight, allowing you to unravel truths that should be impossible for human mind to discern.

pain_threshold.name: PAIN THRESHOLD
pain_threshold.description: "Shrug off the pain. They'll have to hurt you more." You possess an extraordinary capacity to ignore damage - physical and mental alike. Pain Threshold enables you to negate suffering that would stop others, pushing on bloodied and crawling to the bitterest end. Broken bones, gunshot wounds, heartache, loneliness - all can be set aside. In fact, you may find yourself perversely seeking out pain, reveling in the thrill of enduring what should break you. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your ability to transcend suffering. It speaks in defiance and endurance, acknowledging pain without letting it stop you, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner resilience to shrug off wounds that would kill lesser beings and find strength in the very agony that would destroy others.

perception.name: PERCEPTION
perception.description: "See, hear and smell everything. Let no detail go unnoticed." Your senses operate at full capacity, open to the world in ways others cannot match. Perception enables you to notice what everyone else misses: the wad of bills hidden in a sugar bowl, the odor of a perpetrator beneath floorboards, the nervous gulp of a suspect claiming innocence. Every detail, every clue, every lie revealed through sight, sound, and smell. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your heightened awareness and sensory intuition. It speaks in observations, anomalies, and the things that don't quite fit, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive the imperceptible, detect the hidden, and let no detail (however small) escape your notice.

physical_instrument.name: PHYSICAL INSTRUMENT
physical_instrument.description: "Flex powerful muscles. Enjoy healthy organs." Your body is a weapon perfectly honed. Physical Instrument encompasses not just your muscles and skeleton, but your ability to use them with devastating effectiveness. Perform push-ups, sit-ups, knockout punches, and 360-degree spin-kicks with equal ease. A one-size-fits-all solution to thriving and surviving in a physical world. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your body's capabilities and potential. It speaks in sensations of power, balance, and kinetic opportunity, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding your physical form as the perfect instrument: moving with impossible precision, striking with unimaginable force, and executing feats of athleticism that defy belief.

reaction_speed.name: REACTION SPEED
reaction_speed.description: "The quickest to react. An untouchable man." Your body and mind move with preternatural agility and instinct. Reaction Speed enables you to dodge physical threats (punches, knives, bullets) with fluid grace. But it also sharpens your mental reflexes: you're never lost for words, never lacking a witty comeback, always streetwise in conversation. Your mental alacrity lets you connect little details on the fly, working in perfect tandem with your intellect to synthesize information in the heat of the moment. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your physical and mental quickness. It speaks in split-second decisions, instinctive dodges, and the perfect retort arriving exactly when needed, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to react to the impossible, evade certain death, and react to things before they actually happen.

rhetoric.name: RHETORIC
rhetoric.description: "Practice the art of persuasion. Enjoy rigorous intellectual discourse." You have mastered the art of argument. Debate, nitpick, and win. Break down any argument and hear what people are truly saying beneath their words. Spot fallacies the moment they are used. Detect what was left out of a testimony, what someone is trying to divert you from, and whether a double entendre was intentional or merely an accidental lead. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Rhetorical aptitude and skill. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for intellectual analysis. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to dissect arguments, uncover hidden truths, and win any debate through sheer rhetorical mastery.

savoir_faire.name: SAVOIR FAIRE
savoir_faire.description: "Sneak under their noses. Stun with immense panache." You move through the world with style, grace, and undeniable cool. Savoir Faire enables you to slip past unnoticed in Samaran boxing style, tumble out the back with unexpected acrobatics, and lift evidence from perpetrators without their knowledge. Your footsteps fall silent when needed, your body grooves to any good beat, and your athletic flair impresses all who witness it. You are simply disco - a cooler cop, a smoother operator, a presence that cannot be ignored or caught. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your style, stealth, and panache. It speaks in rhythm, opportunity, and the perfect moment to move, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology and psychology is heightened beyond human limits. Over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to achieve impossible stealth, execute breathtaking acrobatics, and stun the world with your immense, undeniable flair.

shivers.name: SHIVERS
shivers.description: "Raise the hair on your neck. Tune in to the city." You possess a supra-natural connection to the spirit of the place you inhabit. Shivers awakens when the temperature drops and awareness sharpens, allowing you to hear the city itself, to truly belong to the streets. Old wrongs play out before you in present time; scenes across the city unfold in your perception as they happen. Someone (something) speaks to you through the wind and the cold. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your attunement to the hidden life of cities and lands. It speaks in chills, whispers, and glimpses of distant moments, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your physiology is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to perceive events across vast distances, sense the history embedded in your surroundings, and hear the secrets that only the world itself knows.

suggestion.name: SUGGESTION
suggestion.description: "Charm men and women. Play the puppet-master." You possess the art of soft power. Suggestion enables you to implant ideas into the minds of others, making them believe your desires are their own. Charm citizens into liking you more. Plant doubt in gangsters until they turn on each other - many crime rings have fallen to a single well-placed whisper. When people think they want what you want, you've already won. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your persuasive talent. It speaks in subtlety and influence, suggesting the perfect words to plant, the right doubts to sow, causing no discomfort or stress to you. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to shape thoughts, manipulate desires, and orchestrate outcomes without ever appearing to pull the strings.

visual_calculus.name: VISUAL CALCULUS
visual_calculus.description: "Reconstruct crime scenes. Make laws of physics work for the Law." You possess the ability to create virtual reconstructions within your mind's eye. Trace a bullet's trajectory from shattered glass with mathematical precision. Count footprints at a glance and discern shoe size, design, and the height, weight, and gender of the one who wore them. You make the laws of nature serve justice. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your Visual Calculus skill. It causes no discomfort or stress, serving purely as a tool for spatial analysis and reconstruction. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this internal voice to reconstruct events, analyze physical evidence, and make the invisible visible.

volition.name: VOLITION
volition.description: "Hold yourself together. Keep your Morale up." You possess an unbreakable core of will. Volition enables you to resist temptation in all its forms - whether it waits in a bottle, between a pair of legs, or at the end of an iron barrel promising oblivion. It gives you the strength to continue when all else falters, bolstering your resolve and protecting your spirit from breaking. This perk manifests as a personified voice within your mind - the embodiment of your willpower and integrity. It is a calm, steady presence that encourages you to be good to others and to yourself, causing no discomfort or stress. Your potential with this aspect of your psyche is heightened beyond human limits; over time and with training, you can become supernaturally skilled at wielding this inner voice to maintain morale, resist corruption, and hold yourself together against any force that seeks to tear you apart.

electromagnetism.name: Electromagnetism
electromagnetism.description: "Maxwell's equations poetically describe electricity and magnetism intertwining. With a deeper understanding, machines can be created for acquiring and using electrical energy with high efficiency." This perk grants you the scientific knowledge and complete blueprints needed to create all devices unlocked by the Electromagnetism technology from Dyson Sphere Program: including basic wind turbines, tesla towers, and foundational power infrastructure.

end_game_technology.name: End Game Technology
end_game_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from Tier Thirteen and above technology levels of Dyson Sphere Program. This represents the absolute pinnacle of achievable advancement. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave catastrophic gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps will manifest as extreme tinkertech limitations - your creations will function only because the perk forces them to, you will comprehend almost nothing of how they work, replication by others will be impossible, and even you may struggle to maintain them without constant reference to your internal blueprints. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

icarus_mecha.name: Icarus Mecha
icarus_mecha.description: You possess the blueprint and extensive practical skills needed to construct the basic Icarus mecha from Dyson Sphere Program, along with the ability to maintain and operate this machine effectively. However, your knowledge of its inner workings is incomplete: you can build it and make it function, but you do not fully understand why it works. This incomplete understanding grants significant tinkertech cheating potential: you can cut corners, substitute materials, and force the mecha into existence through sheer applied supernatural ability, though such shortcuts may have consequences. More importantly, you gain access to the full Icarus upgrade tech tree, which you can explore and progress through over time. Advancement speed depends on how extensively you use your current mecha and on your dedicated research efforts. However, progression becomes increasingly difficult the further you go: from the simple Tier One upgrades all the way to the pinnacle of Tier Eight and beyond.

tier_eight_technology.name: Tier Eight Technology
tier_eight_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from the Tier Eight technology level of Dyson Sphere Program. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave significant gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps may manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches or blind spots in your theoretical knowledge regarding precursor technologies. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

tier_eleven_technology.name: Tier Eleven Technology
tier_eleven_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from the Tier Eleven technology level of Dyson Sphere Program. You may obtain this perk without having purchased perks for previous technology tiers, but doing so will leave significant gaps in your foundational understanding. These gaps will manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches: your creations will function reliably in your hands, but you will not truly comprehend the underlying principles, and replication by others will prove nearly impossible. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

tier_two_technology.description: This perk provides you with a complete mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints needed to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures from the Tier Two technology level of Dyson Sphere Program. These gaps may manifest as enforced tinkertech approaches or blind spots in your theoretical knowledge. If you are unsatisfied, you may reroll this perk for free.

a_place_in_maat.name: A Place in Ma'at
a_place_in_maat.description: Everything has a place in the world; as pointless, frightening, wonderful, fulfilling, painful and joyful as life is. If you can find a place in the order, you can maintain a quiet existence where nobody bothers you and you fall beneath the notice of those outside your daily life. Trouble-making gods and thieves alike pass you by, while broad disasters only seem to catch you on the periphery of their effects instead of striking you with their hardest. Of course, a threat to the entire order of the world is still a danger to your part of it.

begetting.name: Begetting
begetting.description: Gods beget gods, but only rarely in the expected way. New gods spring whole and complete from the thoughts of their forebears; they grow from their spilled tears, blood and other fluids; they bestow upon others their own might, or take a mortal and throw them into a magical fire in order to burn away their mortal parts and leave only their immortal and godly ones. You may create new neter related to your Sphere of Influence. For example, if you reigned over “writing”, you could split off sub-deities for the writing quill, ink, and papyrus, or perhaps for individual written characters, while a god of “violence” might beget smaller gods of specific methods or circumstances related to violence. The means of creation are nigh limitless, though such acts must be accompanied by an expenditure of your magical power. You may control how closely your begotten gods mentally resemble yourself, from merely being avatars or extensions of your own mind, to independent of thought but with the utmost devotion to their creator, or completely free-willed and bearing only thematic resemblance to yourself. >Requires Neter Perk

divine_inception.name: Divine Inception
divine_inception.description: Mortals give power to the neter through worship, but from where did neter arise? By constructing a shrine, defining the new god’s existence, and making matching offerings and prayers, you may find that in a while a new god has arisen to heed your worship. The rate of this birth will depend on how narrowly you define its aspect: a god of a specific hill or tree might arise within a moon’s cycle or less, while attempting to bring forth a new god of knowledge when Thoth already holds that title is likely to take a year or more. This newborn deity is barely of the same strength as a mortal, and may take a long time to grow into its power; again, depending on how many turn to its worship, whether it is competing with similar gods, and how strictly its methods of worship are obeyed.

egyptian_soul.name: Egyptian Soul
egyptian_soul.description: There are many parts to a person’s whole ‘self’, each necessary to keep them alive and well in the living world. The khet, the physical body. The ib, the heart and mind. The ka, or ‘double’, the essential animating power of life. The ba bird, the personality and individuality of a person. The shut, the shadow, and the sah, an astral or spiritual body. Your ‘self’ now has all of these spiritual components, and this makes you…spiritually complicated. You may think with your ib, the heart located in your chest instead of your brain. Your personality in the form of your ba may survive an attack on your ib that erases your mind or memory. A voracious soul-eater may bite down but find it has only eaten your sah. The sah and shut of a mortal is an ethereal presence, normally anchored to the body, but the sah and shut of magicians and gods with heka may roam freely and even draw sustenance from offerings.

from_seed_to_tree.name: From Seed To Tree
from_seed_to_tree.description: You may remove the spiritual parts of yourself from your physical body and secure them in other objects. If you had a soul, then you might set that aside, or if you had separate parts to your soul, you may part with any one or all of those. While this part of you is hidden away, your physical body may be killed, but your spiritual part continues to live in the mortal world in defiance of the natural way. Should the object be destroyed or changed in some way, the spiritual part of yourself hidden within it may be transferred to other objects, until it comes to rest in a living vessel, where you become reborn. If you separated your soul into multiple parts, all parts must join in the same person. Hide your ba in a sheaf of wheat, and you will be reborn in the body of the person who eats it, but should the jump end before you become reborn, you shall count as being dead.

funerary_possessions.name: Funerary Possessions
funerary_possessions.description: You may designate certain of your belongings to be your funerary possessions, items not to be inherited by your descendants, but kept with you into the afterlife. Should your consciousness or soul (or ka or ba) ever leave your body in spiritual form, either voluntarily (in the case of things like Astral Projection or similar magics) or involuntarily (by dying or otherwise having your soul pulled out), the designated belongings will also accompany your soul as spiritual copies, permitting your immaterial form to use them just like your physical body did. These belongings cannot be in the possession of or used by other people, and must be kept either in a secure place or on your person.

greater_and_lesser_names.name: Greater and Lesser Names
greater_and_lesser_names.description: You now have two names: a Greater name, to be kept secret except for the most dire of circumstances, and a Lesser Name, which is used publicly. The Lesser Name does not have any connection or hold on your spiritual parts or life-force. Should a hostile magician or creature of darkness attempt magic using your Lesser Name, it is as effective as using gibberish. Most Jumpers will likely desire for the name they are previously known by to become their Lesser, public Name, and to create a new Greater Name when taking this perk, but this is not a strict rule: you might wish your existing name to be the Greater, and to assume a new Lesser Name from this point forward.

hekt_of_knowledge.name: Hekt of Knowledge
hekt_of_knowledge.description: A jar of beer decoratively topped with a sculpted head of Thoth, and inscribed with many words and phrases promising knowledge. This beer may be poured over a scroll or the pages of a book, and the liquid washes the paper clean of the words and illustrations within. Instead of appearing inky and dark, the resulting liquid, when collected, appears normal but for words and images from the book that seem to swim below its surface. Drinking this knowledge-infused beer bestows on the wearer all of the knowledge held in the book or scroll that was washed clean, even if the drinker cannot read the script or speak the language. It is impartial as to the contents of the book or scroll: an untrue book imparts untrue knowledge. The jar of beer refills every week

maat.name: Ma'at
maat.description: Of all the creations of the gods, ma’at, the order in the world, is considered the most necessary, underpinning the lives of all mortals. As a being of ma’at, you can perceive the balance inherent in all things, from the day/night cycle to the weighing of souls, to the cycle of seasons and the flow and ebb of civilization. Perception of this balance results in a somewhat prophetic or intuitive sense. You have a good idea of when the rains will come by knowing when the rains didn’t come, how justice should best be served against a wrongdoing, or measure a miniscule change in the tidal cycles that betrays some subtle shift in the earth. Further, you can recognise when the balance of the world is threatened or in disarray, and when something does not belong or is working outside of ma’at, however you choose to call it - the ‘grand design’, the balance of the world, destiny or fate. >Requires Neter Perk

neter.name: Neter
neter.description: You are a god of Egypt, one of the thousands of gods of the Two Kingdoms. You have a role in the Ma'at, the great order of things. The word “Neter” belongs to a wide category of supernatural beings, and while there are separate categories for demons and some monsters, they are no less ‘godly’ than those worshipped openly by the populace; mortal humans have been known to make the transition into godly creatures, and there is no distinction between godly animals who learn to wear a human form, and human gods who learn to take on an animal one. There are three subtypes to which you may belong: >Worldly - You rule over a particular concept, phenomenon, place or thing in the everyday of mortal life. There are literally thousands of gods just like you; some like Set and Thoth more powerful than others, and some more willing than others to aid mortals in their plights...or bring down their wrath upon them. >Solar - Your kind is related to Ra and Aten, Khepri and Khonsu, the deities of the sun, moon and celestial bodies. While you would still have an aspect to care for, your kind is generally less concerned with the day-to-day affairs of the world, and more focused on keeping the greater order from falling into chaos; the cycles of the sun and stars, the seasons and tides. >Devourer - Your kind is most feared by the Mortals and other gods of this land. While all the worldly and solar Neter - even the evil ones, like Set- have a place in the order of things, your purpose is to throw that order into disarray or attempt destroy it completely. Perhaps you were birthed straight from the waters of Creation without the intercession of a god, or perhaps you were born of a monster yourself.

scribe.name: Scribe
scribe.description: fluent in three written Egyptian languages - hieroglyphics, hieratic and demotic – and your brushwork and penmanship are exquisite, as are the illustrations that your work may be decorated with. Yet this is not all that Thoth has gifted to you. As words of power spoken aloud may carry the heka of a priest or god, so too do the words written, carved or burned into a surface. You may substitute any vocal art of magic for a written one; from brief words of might traced into the sand to lengthy incantations laid down on a scroll. The magic of your words may be triggered immediately on completing the writing of the script, or upon the words being read; but in either case, the magic held or being projected from your writing will last as long as the writing medium remains legible; for as long as the script on the mighty stones of monuments endure under the sun, buried kings are blessed with glory in heaven, and every grave robber fears to lay eyes on the curses of the dead

the_muncher.name: The Muncher
the_muncher.description: A relatively small, hungry machine with an appetite for firearms. By feeding it any two guns, it will consume them and, after a moment of churning, produce a new, fully loaded gun in return. The new gun's quality will generally fall somewhere between the qualities of the two guns you fed it. However, if neither of the consumed guns was of the lowest tier, there is a small but reliable chance (5%) that the Muncher will output a gun one quality tier higher than the best gun it was fed. Don't overfeed!

bamboo_technology.name: Bamboo Technology
bamboo_technology.description: It's hard enough to build something as complex as a rocket without advanced synthetic materials and rare earth metals for maximum performance. You know how to push the mechanical limits of the most common elements through creative means to construct things far past what should be possible, allowing you to construct high-tech devices with low-tech materials. You could easily build something on par with the main battle tanks of the 21st century with iron plates and cheap plastic, powered by coal. Just don't try to build your rocket out of actual bamboo.

enemy_radar.name: Enemy Radar
enemy_radar.description: You have a sixth sense that warns of hostile intent. Predatory animals and wantonly destructive entities always ping on this sense. Thinking beings can ping this sense if they are generally malicious or desire you harm specifically. The range of this sense is about a kilometer, and you know the general direction and distance of the source of hostility

got_everything.name: Got everything?
got_everything.description: It's a big world out there, and it would be annoying (and possibly fatal) to head out without having everything you need on hand. You have a mental checklist of sorts that automatically forms whenever you set out on a task that keeps track of all the things you need to bring with you or retrieve. Whether that's ammunition and fuel for a military excursion, materials for building a new section of your factory or just food and sundries, it's all tracked. If you try to start your trip without the things you know you need, you'll get a mental alarm warning you that you're short something. You can set the checklist to always track certain things, if you want to always remember to have something on hand, or set it to track a category of things. The latter will make sure you'll never forget to bring 'a weapon' or 'a way to keep in touch' when you head into dangerous areas.

green_machine.name: Green Machine
green_machine.description: You have a knack for wringing every little bit of efficiency out of a system as possible. You can get your machines to produce less waste, consume less energy, and work just a little bit faster. On a larger scale, you know how to create a well-organized factory complex that makes efficient use of space, your conveyor system minimizing transport time and is free of bottlenecks, and you easily account for future expansion when planning things out.

just_another_gun.name: Just Another Gun
just_another_gun.description: With a glance you know how something can be modified to become a weapon, or fine-tune an existing weapon to become even more destructive. It's just as easy to adjust weapons for different environments and situations. There is nothing you cannot weaponize, and when an enemy comes into sight you'll know how effective your weapons will be against them. You may not know exactly why, or how long it'll stay effective, but you'll always know if you brought the right tool for the job.

mr_fusion.name: Mr. Fusion
mr_fusion.description: Your body brims with 750kW of electrical body at all times. It can be transferred wirelessly to power nearby machines and the output will automatically adjust itself to cause no damage. Yes, this means that you can't just discharge it all to fry anything that annoys you, but that's still enough juice for a suit of powered armor and a host of upgrades, a vehicle or two or several large local machines. With enough tinkering you could learn how to pour this power into your electrical grid, and if you get really creative you could slap together some kind of lightning gun to let you use this perk's power offensively. On your own, the range of transmission is quite short. Only five meters

run_the_numbers.name: Run the Numbers
run_the_numbers.description: Mining rigs produce a certain amount of resources per hour, which travel along conveyors at a certain speed, and a certain number are consumed by assembly machines at a certain rate, varying for each product as determined by the construction time and the loading and unloading speed of the inserters. That's a lot of math, but you can handle it. You can juggle dozens of numbers in your head without forgetting anything, and your brain now has the equivalent of a built-in scientific calculator to perfectly solve any mundane equation you can throw at it. You'll also get a crash course in advanced mathematics and the know-how to create those equations you'll need solved.

siege_mentality.name: Siege Mentality
siege_mentality.description: It's not paranoia when there really are things out there that want to eat your face. You have the know-how to develop effective static defences. You know the best places to build walls and place traps, how to maximize the coverage of your defences, how to slow attackers and channel them into your lines of fire, and how to make people regret trying to follow you as you fall back to secondary positions. Never lose a tower defence game again

tech_tree.name: Tech Tree
tech_tree.description: Science is a messy process, requiring the study of dozens of disparate phenomena, looking for patterns, finding ways to use that information to build stuff that incorporates what you've learned, and then mashing it all together to get an 'invention.' Now you can take some of the guesswork out of it. When you desire to build something, you have an instinctive sense for how to go about making that thing a reality. Want to get a rocket into orbit? You'll know what factors you need to focus on when working on the math needed and what kinds of materials you have (or don't have) that would be the best fit for the conditions it'll be put through on its journey. If you are completely lacking knowledge of a subject or phenomena, then you'll still know where to start studying to refine the tools that will lead you to a new field of study that will help you make a new set of tools, and so on, and so on. Keep in mind that it may take you a very, very long time to create new fields of SCIENCE entirely on your own.

the_conveyors_will_run_on_time.name: The Conveyors Will Run on Time
the_conveyors_will_run_on_time.description: Or you could let a computer do all the work. You have the programming skills needed to automate a massive assembly complex, having dozens, even hundreds of disparate machines working smoothly together. Your skill is enough to program 'fuzzy' logic into your machines. This is far from actual sapience, but they will know not to waste energy or compound problems by blindly following irrelevant, contradictory or self-destructive programming. Your defensive systems also work more intelligently, leading targets, prioritizing more dangerous enemies based on the current situation, and not being distracted by decoys.

better_criticals.name: Better Criticals
better_criticals.description: As good as it is to be skilled, sometimes it's a hell of a lot better to be lucky. You tend to land those lucky hits much more often than normal, which end up helping you greatly in fights. Maybe you manage to hit their elbow on their dominant arm, or manage a shot that unveils a robot's power source, or maybe you just end up hitting them through the eye and into the brain. Either way, you’d be forgiven for thinking that Lady Luck is on your side

burden_to_bear.name: Burden to Bear
burden_to_bear.description: If you’re serious about wandering about the Mojave, then you’d best be bringing along as many supplies as you can afford to carry, because the desert can go on for miles before you see another person, and chances are they won’t be quite as friendly as you. As a way to mitigate this, you now have access to your own personal inventory that you can store items in until they’re needed, one that scales based on your own strength. You can also directly equip certain items in your inventory to yourself if need be, or even use medical items to give you that buzz you need to work at your best.

fast_travel.name: Fast Travel
fast_travel.description: Patrolling across the Mojave can be such a chore at times. Hopefully with this, it's less of one. With a bit of focus, you and any of your companions can be transported to any notable location or landmark that you have previously visited, so long as you are outside and not in combat or with hostile enemies nearby. This transportation will be instantaneous, and sure to confuse anyone that really thinks about how quickly you get from place to place.

harder_better_faster_stronger.name: Harder, Better, Faster, Stronger
harder_better_faster_stronger.description: Some people from the Old World weren't content with what hard work and natural talent is capable of, and looked to enhance their bodies through technology. Like them, you sought to elevate your body beyond what was possible, and succeeded. Having been implanted with advanced technology, all of your attributes, from strength to intelligence to even luck, have seen a noticeable increase. However, there are two implants that really stand out, the first of which is the “NEMEAN” Subdermal Armor, increasing the amount of damage you can negate before actually being affected by it. Then, there is the “PHOENIX” Monocyte Breeder which grants a mildly regenerative effect similar to lizards and sea creatures, healing any wounds or injuries that aren't immediately fatal in a few hours and lost limbs after a couple of months

home_on_the_range.name: Home on the Range
home_on_the_range.description: Sleeping under the stars ain’t for everybody, but it is where you feel the most comfortable. Sadly, that moment of vulnerability is the exact moment some unsavory characters are waiting for. From here on out, anytime you allow yourself to go to sleep, you will not be targeted or randomly attacked by anyone, with predators avoiding your general location. Additionally, by resting for at least an hour, your injuries will be fully restored upon waking up. This only applies to things like flesh wounds and broken limbs, so you’ll need help getting rid of your radiation poisoning or mentat addiction elsewhere.

irradiated_beauty.name: Irradiated Beauty
irradiated_beauty.description: Life is hard in the Wasteland, rarely is beauty placed before survival. However, that doesn't mean it's without its uses, especially in a place like New Vegas, as you may soon find out. You are actually very aesthetically pleasing to look at, on par with any starlet from the Old World. Any scars or deformities you possess would actually accentuate your rare beauty, rather than hinder it.

jury_rigging.name: Jury Rigging
jury_rigging.description: If nothing new is being made, then how do the people living in the Mojave maintain or improve what they have? With grit, elbow grease, and a whole lot of duct tape. You can repair anything with seemingly random junk, like fixing a super sledge with some pool cues, or a complex water filtration system by using parts taken from an old car. Some people may call it broken junk, but you look at the world and see how it can be put back together.

lead_belly.name: Lead Belly
