You also have a corresponding degree of skill for someone, who got Outstanding on all their D.A.D.A exams. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

dark_arts_affinity.name: Dark Arts Affinity
dark_arts_affinity.description: A dark temptation for many, you have a specialized affinity for the dark arts. These are powerful and dangerous practices that exist for practically every field. The dark arts are more powerful than other types of magic, but are illegal, often deeply immoral, and it is difficult to find useful resources to learn them from.

defense_affinity.name: Defense Affinity
defense_affinity.description: You have a specialized affinity for defensive abilities; counter spells, shields, curse breaking, and more. This can extend to other types of magic, such as creating smoke screens or blocking mental intrusions, as well as employing a variety of magics to heal yourself and others of curses and harmful effects.

dhampir.name: Dhampir
dhampir.description: You have vampire heritage. You are graceful, very pale, and sunburn easily. You are very allergic to garlic. Drinking the blood of humanoid creatures gives you a 25% boost to your physical abilities for a few hours, heals your wounds, and if done regularly, can increase your lifespan by up to half.

divination_education.name: Divination Education
divination_education.description: You receive ten years in the art of divining information through magic. This could be focused solely on future telling - from tea leaves to oneiromancy to crystal balls to catching echos from the sands of time. It could also be the study of spells, methods and enchantments for getting and organizing actual information, from revelio to library charms to pattern discerning runic matrices to sending queries to the collective unconsciousness of the world. You have ten years of knowledge in total to allocate between these options. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

elf-blooded.name: Elf-blooded
elf-blooded.description: One of your recent ancestors mated with a house-elf, redcap, or similar creature. Best not to think about it too much. In any case, you have large pointy ears and are 25-50% shorter than normal (this stacks multiplicatively with similar effects.) Furthermore, your magic is tainted by that of your elvish ancestors. Your spells have a slightly easier time overcoming magical hindrances of all types. Depending on your heritage, you will find yourself to be intrinsically servile or bloodthirsty.

enchantment_affinity.name: Enchantment Affinity
enchantment_affinity.description: You have a greater affinity for enchanting, the practice of layering charms on an object to create magic items. Used in wand creation, broom crafting, and magical inventions. This magic can last for millennia. What you can create with this field of magic is heavily influenced by what other magics you know.

esoteric_lore.name: Esoteric Lore
esoteric_lore.description: Magic is often illogical or counterintuitive, but you have an aptitude for even its most esoteric forms. You grasp the nuance of symbolic properties and associations, the strange logic of rituals, or more mysterious concepts like death, sacrifice, love, and time. This is especially invaluable for magic which invokes these primordial, often dangerous forces, in particular powerful rituals, and you know how far you can push such forces without serious risk. You start with instinctive understanding of these obscure topics equivalent to a qualified unspeakable, which is also useful for disciplines like divination, theoretical potions, and even astronomy.

everlasting_enchantments.name: Everlasting Enchantments
everlasting_enchantments.description: With enough magical skill, spells and enchantments can be made to last forever; sometimes even increasing in strength over time. While most who use this style of magic will require high quality enchanting materials or reduced spell effects, you are an exception. By taking this you can cause any spells or enchantments you produce to last forever without having to sacrifice quality. It will also be half as difficult to create enchantments or spell effects that grow in power over time. You could inflict curses that grow worse with time, change someone's appearance permanently, or craft magical defenses that will stand the test of time. Spells and enchantments can still be reversed or dispelled by other witches and wizards, and only your enchantments will persist in the event that you are killed.

general_talents.name: General Talents
general_talents.description: Covers any inclination not present in Perks above. If it does exist above, the perks do not stack. This option only gives the talent without any other benefits - things like enhanced memory or reflexes are sold as separate talents. If you already possess a talent naturally, don't waste points buying it here. Can be cooking, kickboxing, driving, chemistry, singing, writing, lying ect ect. A specific field gives more talent than a broad one - like chess vs strategy. This Perk can be bought up for 20 times total, giving talent for different field of your choice each time.

goblin_heritage.name: Goblin Heritage
goblin_heritage.description: Someone in your family tree is a Goblin. You are smaller than you would otherwise be and are proportionally more clever. A quarter-goblin would be 25% shorter than normal and is more clever. This latter boost equates to roughly 25% of the "brilliant perk. A half-goblin would be 50% shorter than normal and their cleverness boost equates to roughly 50% of the "brilliant" perk. This boost does not stack with brilliant and does not apply to creativity.

great_ambition.name: Great Ambition
great_ambition.description: Your ambition acts as a foundation for your sense of self. You know what needs to be done to realize it. You naturally acquire power and know how to efficiently utilize it towards your goals. Pairs greatly with Perceptive and Charisma, incorporates other Slytherin perks into itself, strengthens those perks' effects while adding new ones. Completion Bonus: You quickly sense deceit and emotional manipulation, and readily grasp the wider implications of all you observe. Your eye for talent, superior planning skills, and air of competence help you lead and place others advantageously. You excel at gathering information, whether through mundane, obscure data sources or a network of largely unwitting informants.

great_loyalty.name: Great Loyalty
great_loyalty.description: Your ability to form strong mutual bonds is quite incredible. So long as you do your part at least somewhat well, you find that anyone you expect loyalty or service from is inspired to stay loyal and do their best as well. Pairs greatly with Witty, Funny and Cunning, incorporates other Hufflepuff perks into itself, strengthens those perks' effects while adding new ones. Completion Bonus: You can teach and inspire as you organise a group or direct it to act, soon producing other leaders you can delegate to. Your followers usually come out of trying circumstances stronger, rather than being worn down. You are also effective at instilling some of the mindset and skills from your perks through teaching and inspiration, making allies more capable of acting without your oversight.

great_valor.name: Great Valor
great_valor.description: At little more than a glance you can judge the strength, effectiveness, and corruption of a system, and know how best to improve, exploit, or sabotage it, as you will. You can always recognize injustice. Pairs greatly with Hard Work and Schemes, incorporates other Griffindor perks into itself, strengthens those perks' effects while adding new ones. Completion Bonus: You are extremely resilient to trauma, pressure, and mental compulsion, keeping your head where others are overwhelmed or disorientated. You can overcome the Imperius curse or the most severe trauma without further ill effects, and adapt to extreme states of being like extended lifespan or drastic physiological change without losing your sense of self.

great_wisdom.name: Great Wisdom
great_wisdom.description: You have something even more valuable than knowledge - the ability to use it well. You possess a well-developed common sense, insight and good judgement to apply your skills better. Pairs greatly with Reflexes and Best Match, incorporates other Ravenclaw perks into itself, strengthens those perks' effects while adding new ones. Completion Bonus: Your efforts to eliminate your cognitive biases have already pushed your mind beyond the human standard, disorienting legiliments with unusual thought patterns. As a result, your memory is now eidetic, with perfect recall and indexing. Your mind doesn't laze about sticking to trusted patterns, but constantly analyses your memories, searching for new approaches or solutions.

gryffindor_brave.name: Gryffindor: Brave
gryffindor_brave.description: A trait favored by most Gryffindors, your bravery is legendary. You will never freeze up in combat or during a stressful situation, and have the nerve and self-esteem to ignore peer pressure and threats. You can choose not to dwell too much on past mistakes, and have an almost limitless tolerance for pain. With Great Valor: You’re a resilient sort, resisting what should be traumatic and making sound decisions even under severe emotional stress. Your conviction remains steady despite public sentiment or even pressure from reputable organisations and institutional authority. You can swiftly take the measure of such groups, seeing corruption, falsehood and injustice for exactly what they are where others choose to look away or be cowed into repeating lies.

gryffindor_funny.name: Gryffindor: Funny
gryffindor_funny.description: The wizarding world tends to be much less serious than that of the non magic community. Now you can contribute to this good humor as well. This greatly improves your creative skills, outside-the-box thinking, and sense of timing and delivery in social and comedic settings. You know how to pull a proper prank, have an instinctive grasp of what you can get away with without taking things too far, and you are never at a loss for words when you decide to exercise your considerable wit. With Great Valor: You have a talent for capitalising on all manner of failings in your adversaries, and your wit can deftly expose them through devastating ridicule or inspire allies to laugh in the face of terrible odds. You thrive amid chaos; your creativity and aptitude for executing successful pranks also extends to a general talent for sabotage, delicate operations, and small-scale tactics.

gryffindor_reflexes.name: Gryffindor: Reflexes
gryffindor_reflexes.description: You gain the incredible reflexes of a trained auror or quidditch player, as well as the dexterity needed to cast and aim spells reliably in a fight. What's more, these skills will not decline even if you spend your days lazing around during times of peace. Even powerful wizards can lose duels against those with better speed or aim. You will also be naturally talented on a broomstick. With Great Valor: You don’t just move fast, you think fast. You adapt swiftly and keep exceptional awareness in all manner of high-pressure situations. Even without a plan, you excel at improvising your way out of predicaments, simply acting where others would panic or despair. It only takes a moment to grasp the situation and make a sound decision that would otherwise require a few minutes of careful deliberation.

herbology_affinity.name: Herbology Affinity
herbology_affinity.description: You have an affinity for herbology. This is the study of magical and mundane plants and fungi. Many of these plants produce magically viable ingredients for potion making and enchanting. Studying herbology can assist in collecting these resources and in using the unique and dangerous natures of these plants to your advantage. Taking this affinity will also cut in half the threat posed by magical flora and their byproducts. You can purchase this option second time for half the price (50 CP).

herbology_education.name: Herbology Education
herbology_education.description: You know the Herbology subject as well as you would have after studying it yourself for ten years. Includes all school years and independent research. You also have a corresponding degree of skill for someone, who got Outstanding on all their Herbology exams. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

hufflepuff_charisma.name: Hufflepuff: Charisma
hufflepuff_charisma.description: You have a natural inclination for winning hearts and influencing others. You can expect to make many friends during your time at Hogwarts, and if you are so inclined could even build a group of loyal followers. As the name suggests, you don't get any practical skills like manipulation or leadership, instead it improves your body language, manners, speech and generally makes you charming. With Great Loyalty: The sound of your voice can easily captivate a crowd, whether as an informal centre of attention, or when speaking before an audience. In more personal settings, your words give your followers, allies, and comrades strength and hope for a way forward. Diplomacy and fair conduct come naturally to you, making you a natural at managing people or speaking on behalf of a group.

hufflepuff_hard_work.name: Hufflepuff: Hard Work
hufflepuff_hard_work.description: You have something just as useful as natural talent - the dedication needed to study hard. You will find it easy to spend long periods of time reading about, practicing, and studying magic. This also extends to mundane pursuits, practically guaranteeing good grades in classes that don't require magic, like astronomy or history of magic. You will do well on most written tests. With Great Loyalty: The business of organising people from scratch takes considerable effort. You have an aptitude for this process and its requisite practical skills. Whether administration, logistics and finance, or simply setting fair, effective rules and policy, you know how to keep a group content, cohesive, and running smoothly. This also gives substance and support to your other leadership-related skills and Perks.

hufflepuff_well-adjusted.name: Hufflepuff: Well-Adjusted
hufflepuff_well-adjusted.description: You have the decisive advantage of emotionally healthy decision-making. This includes the good sense to avoid adopting self-destructive habits or inviting trouble for petty reasons. You see when a choice would ultimately make you unhappy, and are much more likely to overcome personal issues successfully. Even severe problems or lack of support simply mean you need more time and effort. With Great Loyalty: You’re a reassuring presence, inspiring trust and loyalty while building sound relationships. Your own emotional stability and insight can also help others face their problems and rebuild themselves as happier, stronger people. Even your Rivals are affected – while they’ll still cause you trouble, you can usually keep your relationship closer to healthy competition than an escalation to a lifelong grudge.

magical_animagus.name: Magical Animagus
magical_animagus.description: You have the potential to become a magical animagus. You're not limited to mundane animals and can become any one creature, from basilisks and phoenixes to blast-ended skrewts to flobberworms. You have all their inborn mundane and magical traits in animal form, keeping none of it in your human guise. This alone doesn't make you an animagus and it doesn't make the process of becoming one easier. You are still limited to one creature form and can't change it. While most of the wizarding world dismiss this as impossible, there are people like you across the world. I would recommend you look into Native Americans' shamanistic approach to animagi as opposed to transfiguration-based one of Britain.

magical_aura.name: Magical Aura
magical_aura.description: The control you possess over your magic is breath-taking, sometimes literally. It's presence is just beneath the skin and can be coached outwards. At will, you can expand your magic beyond the body - crackling with power, intimidating or suppressing other magicals. Those caught in your aura feel the difference in power as pressure or weight on their shoulders and minds. It can crack even innate mental defences and physical protections of those it supresses, giving you a hold over them. Those strong of will or magic can resist or overpower you, those skilled and knowledgeable can exploit the connection. Doesn't make you any more powerful than you already were.

magical_creature_affinity.name: Magical Creature Affinity
magical_creature_affinity.description: You have an affinity for magical creatures. They are more willing to work with you, and you are twice as effective at understanding how best to interact with them, or fighting them. Care of magical creatures is only an elective, rather than a main course at Hogwarts, meaning this will not necessarily impact your grade. It is a very good skill to have for those trained in defense against the dark arts, however. You can purchase this option second time for half the price (50 CP).

mental_charms_affinity.name: Mental Charms Affinity
mental_charms_affinity.description: You have a further affinity for mental charms. These spells read or alter a target's mental state. Memory charms, adding minds to magic objects, confounding others, or altering moods. This field is the primary reason the wizarding world has managed to remain a secret for so long. Also includes legilimency.

merrish.name: Merrish
merrish.description: One of your recent ancestors was a mer-person or something similar. As a result you have gills and can breathe underwater. Depending on the strength of your inheritance, you may also have somewhat enlarged webbed feet and hands that greatly increase your swimming speed. Your body is adapted in various ways to handle the pressure of extended deep dives.

metamorphmagus.name: Metamorphmagus
metamorphmagus.description: You were born with the ability to change your physical appearance without the need for a potion or spell. You can do this as often as you like at will, and can even change sex or take on inhuman traits like vibrantly colored hair and animal noses. Your forms will take no effort to maintain, but you will always have a 'default appearance in the case that your magic fails. You also cannot prevent aging by changing shape. This change in appearance will fool most magical detections.

natural_legilimens.name: Natural Legilimens
natural_legilimens.description: You are a natural-born legilimens. Legilimency is the art of probing minds to detect lies, gather info, and influence people's minds. Typically legilimency is a learnable, if difficult, style of magic. Unlike those who have learned this skill through practice, however, your legilimency is an instinctual part of your magic. Your power targets all people in an area around you unless blocked out, and you do not require line-of-sight or a spell to use it. This can be blocked or counterattacked with occlumency.

nonverbal_spells.name: Nonverbal Spells
nonverbal_spells.description: An advanced technique, most Hogwarts students don't begin to learn non-verbal magic before their sixth year. This is the practice of casting spells without need for verbally saying the incantations aloud. Magic cast in this way is especially useful in magical duels, as users will not telegraph their attacks beforehand. Typically spells cast in this way are less powerful than their spoken counterparts, and require more focus to cast. You have mastered the art of nonverbal magic, and can cast spells you know in this way with little to no extra focus, and at full power. What's more, spells you cast will be less likely to have visual or audio imperfections like loud noises or bright beams of light, and any enchantments or spell effects caused by you are much more difficult for others to detect.

not_so_accidental_magic.name: Not So Accidental Magic
not_so_accidental_magic.description: Typically, accidental magic is just that, it responds to a child's mental state and intense desires, producing feats of magic after reaching a critical point. Few possess enough will and motivation to consistently reenact these mental states to produce accidental magic semi-reliably. For those who do, magic begins to remember those specific feats until they can be performed on demand. However, those parlor tricks aren't wand magic, a structured spell would produce the same result with more depth, power, control and ease. It seems, you've been one such child in your early years and accidents just never stopped. Levitating your toys, summoning a bottle, things like these still come easy even after getting a proper wand. You'd still lose these abilities as you grow up unless you practice routinely. If you are eleven or older, choose up to three simple magical effects. If you are five, choose one and retain the ability to learn more.

occlumency.name: Occlumency
occlumency.description: You gain the fully-mastered ability to block the mental intrusions of others. This will allow you to provide false information to mind readers and break free of some mental charms such as the imperius curse. This ability can be learned normally with study and talent, but by taking this option you have mastered the skill from the start.

offense_affinity.name: Offense Affinity
offense_affinity.description: You have a specialized affinity for offensive abilities; curses, hexes, jinxes, and anything that will damage an opponent. This can overlap with other magic types, such as using charms to drown an enemy or transfiguration to turn them into an animal. This will not protect you from being harmed yourself, however.

parseltongue.name: Parseltongue
parseltongue.description: You were born with a rare skill typically associated with dark wizards: the ability to talk to snakes. Snakes that you talk to will be willing to obey most commands, and demonstrating this ability will be hard proof to most people that you are a pure-blood wizard, regardless of your origins. You can use this language with or without a snake being present. Depending on when you enter Hogwarts, there may or may not be a very large basilisk under the school primed to follow any orders you give it.

part-giant.name: Part-Giant
part-giant.description: Someone in your family tree is a giant (and someone else was very brave). You are larger than the average person, are stronger than a normal human could ever be, and can outright resist many forms of hostile magic. You can opt to be anywhere from one-eighth (-7ft. tall) to one-half (-12ft, tall) giant, with the overall potency of your abilities adjusted accordingly. Many part-giants face discrimination when their ancestry is revealed. If you chose 'muggle-born' as your origin, you were likely adopted by your family.

part-veela.name: Part-Veela
part-veela.description: Someone in your family tree was a Veela, a race of magical beings resembling exceptionally beautiful women. As a result, you are supernaturally attractive, and can leverage your good looks to entrance others for short periods of time. You can be anywhere from one-half to one-eighth veela, with the overall potency of your abilities adjusted accordingly. Part-veela can be of any gender and are often the targets of jealousy. If you chose 'muggle-born' as your origin, you were likely adopted by the family that raised you.

physical_charms_affinity.name: Physical Charms Affinity
physical_charms_affinity.description: You have a specialized affinity for physical charms. These spells are able to levitate and manipulate objects, create visual effects, unlock doors, clean areas, fix broken things, and more. These tend to be quality-of-life spells, but do not tend to be very long lasting unless used in enchanting. Semi-useful in combat.

potion_crafting.name: Potion Crafting
potion_crafting.description: You have a particular knack for creating entirely new recipes for potions. While most potioneers are capable of this skill, it is often prohibitively expensive and difficult to control the exact effects of what you create. With this you are able to slowly refine your recipes to have whatever effects you are looking to achieve as long as you can afford the ingredients you will need for your many attempts. This process is easier for skilled potioneers and those creating simpler potion effects, as well as those with the scientific knowledge typically used in alchemy. Creating new potions can be a profitable, if dangerous business. While not quite as dangerous as spell creation, those who do not employ rigorous safety measures can easily be seriously injured or killed during their experiments. As a result of this talent in developing potions, you can recollect some points spent on their modifiers.

potion_incident.name: Potion Incident
potion_incident.description: Like a certain Gaul, it seems you've fallen into a magic potion cauldron as a child. Thanks to a timely accidental magic you have survived, with potion's properties permanently infused into your body. Fortunately, the effects are benefitial in some way. Choose any one widespread potion, something you have a believable chance to encounter in your youth, to gain it's magic, from Fire Protection Potion to Strengthening Solution. Skele-Gro would not only keep your bones healthy, but might also increase your height.

potion_modifier_concentration.name: Potion Modifier: Concentration
potion_modifier_concentration.description: You may apply Concentration modifier to your Signature Potion. These modifiers may come about through alternate brewing methods, ingredients, or wandwork when making these potions. These modified potions can technically be taught to others, but are almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature potion you apply them to. You are also capable of brewing signature potions without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. It will be very difficult to modify potions in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Potion purchased. Concentration: You know how to brew a version of the potion that can be distilled from liquid into goo. This potion will take less space and have supercharged effects in return for shorter duration and minor damage to the body. You can buy this modifier again to get powder form, increasing its effects, and again to get crystal state. A well-made skele-grow crystal can regenerate your arm in a second, in return draining the calcium from your body. A Felix Felicis crystal will effectively give you Path to Victory for a few minutes, if you're ready for the Worst Day Ever to last a couple weeks afterwards.

potion_modifier_cost-effective.name: Potion Modifier: Cost-Effective
potion_modifier_cost-effective.description: You may apply Cost-Effective modifier to your Signature Potion. These modifiers may come about through alternate brewing methods, ingredients, or wandwork when making these potions. These modified potions can technically be taught to others, but are almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature potion you apply them to. You are also capable of brewing signature potions without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. It will be very difficult to modify potions in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Potion purchased. Cost-Effective: Many potions require expensive or scarce ingredients which can be draining of the maker's funds if brewed frequently or in large quantities. You have discovered several cheaper alternatives to the ingredients involved in creating any potion with this modifier. Crafting these potions will now only require pocket change, though you may still be limited by long brewing times, seasonal ingredients, or environmental factors like location or lunar cycles.

potion_modifier_permanent.name: Potion Modifier: Permanent
potion_modifier_permanent.description: You may apply Permanent modifier to your Signature Potion. These modifiers may come about through alternate brewing methods, ingredients, or wandwork when making these potions. These modified potions can technically be taught to others, but are almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature potion you apply them to. You are also capable of brewing signature potions without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. It will be very difficult to modify potions in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Potion purchased. Permanent: The potions brewed with this modifier will impart effects that never fade, simply enduring indefinitely in those who are exposed to a dose. This can be used to create everlasting love potions or to take on the appearances of others with polyjuice permanently, among other possibilities. These effects can still be dispelled by antidotes or advanced enchantments, and certain effects like felix felicis or some healing potions may become harmful if left active for too long.

potion_modifier_potency.name: Potion Modifier: Potency
potion_modifier_potency.description: You may apply Potency modifier to your Signature Potion. These modifiers may come about through alternate brewing methods, ingredients, or wandwork when making these potions. These modified potions can technically be taught to others, but are almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature potion you apply them to. You are also capable of brewing signature potions without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. It will be very difficult to modify potions in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Potion purchased. Potency: You know how to increase the potency of the potion along with the complexity of the recipe and the quality of ingredients. You can easily double the effect or the duration or reduce the side-effects by half and have a good hunch on how to proceed further. You may choose for the first purchase to give you the basic knowledge of this method instead of applying it to a particular potion.

potion_modifier_quickbrew.name: Potion Modifier: Quickbrew
potion_modifier_quickbrew.description: You may apply Quickbrew modifier to your Signature Potion. These modifiers may come about through alternate brewing methods, ingredients, or wandwork when making these potions. These modified potions can technically be taught to others, but are almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature potion you apply them to. You are also capable of brewing signature potions without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. It will be very difficult to modify potions in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Potion purchased. Quickbrew: Most potions take hours to brew at minimum, with complicated potions requiring months of advanced preparation, seasonal ingredients, or environmental factors. By attaching this modifier to a potion, you have discovered several shortcuts in the brewing process which allow you to bypass these limitations. As long as you can afford the materials required for your potion, you can brew simple potions in minutes, and complicated mixtures in less than a day.

potions_affinity.name: Potions Affinity
potions_affinity.description: You have an affinity for brewing potions. Potions have some of the strongest magical effects of any type of magic, but often require rare or expensive ingredients and a great deal of time to create. Potion making is almost more science than magic, but all potions still require some degree of magical ability to craft. By taking this option, you gain a talent in both alchemy and crafting potions, and may even be able to craft new recipes with time. You can purchase this option second time for half the price (100 CP).

potions_education.name: Potions Education
potions_education.description: You know the Potions subject as well as you would have after studying it yourself for ten years. Includes all school years and independent research. You also have a corresponding degree of skill for someone, who got Outstanding on all their Potions exams. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

prodigy.name: Prodigy
prodigy.description: This option also doesn't make you a genius. What it does is provide a learning boost to entry-level skills and knowledge, doubling the speed you learn, internalize and build upon when you begin to study something new. The low-hanging fruits will be easy to pick, building a sturdy foundation for later. Things like biology topics covered in middle school, with the boost petering out at high school material. Anything above entry level will be as difficult to advance in as usual.

ravenclaw_muggle_studies.name: Ravenclaw: Muggle Studies
ravenclaw_muggle_studies.description: This perk grants you intuitive understanding of mundane technology at the level of a muggle scientist, engineer, or similar profession. You will also have an easier time learning and understanding this tech. Useful for transfiguration or for adapting muggle technology to work in the wizarding world. Also very useful for blending magic together with technology through enchanting. With Great Wisdom: Magic is a powerful tool, but for other wizards, it allows the atrophy of mundane problem-solving and reasoning skills. You have an eye for clever, practical solutions to problems. Further, you understand the failings of human reason exposed by muggle psychology, and have applied the lessons to improve your own self-reflection and discipline. Finally, you have a better grasp of the long-term implications of your decisions.

ravenclaw_perceptive.name: Ravenclaw: Perceptive
ravenclaw_perceptive.description: You have a strong eye for details and a good intuition when it comes to mysteries. This is especially useful when piecing together the many plans of other wizards or when delving into some more esoteric branches of magic. Very useful for those who engage in adventurous pursuits. As a side bonus, you would likely make an excellent seeker in quidditch. With Great Wisdom: You have an uncanny instinct for the truth, often spotting trickery, deceit, and misinformation at a glance. Even with obscure or conflicting sources, you quickly deduce valuable information, gaining more insight the longer you observe and knowing exactly where to look next. Often, the flaws you expose in an obstacle give you a third approach to a hopeless dilemma.

ravenclaw_witty.name: Ravenclaw: Witty
ravenclaw_witty.description: You have a natural aptitude for academics. This perk increases your intelligence somewhat, and in particular ensures you excel in all kinds of theoretical, written, and research-based endeavours. Further, you are more adept with riddles, puzzles, and logic and debating. With Great Wisdom: The influence of the academic world does not prevent its occupation by fallible and sometimes dishonest people. You have the discernment needed to weigh scholarship according to its true merits, including finding trends of flawed or fraudulent research. You can also articulate these flaws effectively – you are no man’s fool in the arena of ideas.

reincarnation.name: Reincarnation+
reincarnation.description: Your previous life is fresh in your mind, the memories are distinct but detached. You won't suffer from existential or identity crisis, it's easy to let go of your unfinished business, say farewell to your friends and family and embrace your new life. If you had mental problems or even bad habits, they are gone now if you so wish. On the other hand, you won't suffer from culture shock, raise suspicion due to anachronisms or be confused by muggles because of your pure-blood origin. The new you keeps the best traits of both personalities, decided by your preferences. The baggage of old life won't drag you down. In case you go through the experience again, from now on this will happen during every type of mind transfer.

seer.name: Seer
seer.description: You were born with the gift of future sight. You will occasionally be capable of creating prophecies which are 100% reliable, though this occurrence happens randomly. When it does, you will remember exactly what your prophecy said with perfect accuracy. You also have a knack for other predictive skills such as reading star alignments for signs of the future, as centaurs do, or the more scientific practice of arithmancy; where users calculate the likelihood of events to surprising accuracy through numerology.

signature_potion.name: Signature Potion
signature_potion.description: You may choose to specialize in any of the potions listed below. As long as you have the correct ingredients, time, and space to work you will never fail to craft this potion, and the potions you craft with this will be more potent than they would otherwise be. You may improve your selected recipes with the Potion Modifiers from other perk. Perk can be purchased several times. Potions: Love Potion; Veritaserum; Polyjuice Potion; Felix Felicis; Invigoration Draught; Beautification Potion; Healing Potions (Any); Spell-Potion (Any Signature Spell you have).

signature_spell.name: Signature Spell
signature_spell.description: You have a knack for casting a specific spell. Choose any of the spells from the list below, you will learn this spell remarkably quickly and will be capable of casting it at a much higher level than other spells in the same field. You will never fail to cast this spell when attempting it, and can more easily learn it nonverbally or wandlessly. You are able to purchase multiple signature spells. Most spells produce beams of light or noise on their way to their targets, and can be detected and countered by those who know appropriate counter-spells. Perk can be purchased several times. Spell List: Expelliarmus; Wingardium Leviosa; Duro; Scourgify; Flippendo; Diffindo; Reparo; Lumos; Stupefy; Impervius; Incendio; Protego; Confundo; Avis; Expoximise; Accio; Reducio; Engorgio; Confrigo; Obliviate; Incarcerous; Expecto Patronum; Episkey; Revelio; Locomotor; Crucio; Sectumsempra; Evanesco; Finite Incantatem; Reducto; Gemino; Magnus Sensus; Legilimens; Apparition; Imperio; Avada Kedavra.

slytherin_best_match.name: Slytherin: Best Match
slytherin_best_match.description: You are the best possible combination of your parents. Despite any developmental issues from your background, you’ll usually be the best-looking person in the room, with excellent strength, stamina, disease resistance, and general health. A modest intelligence boost and favourable genetics shore up your other perks, and natural confidence and willpower help you assert yourself and keep moving forward. With Great Ambition: You were born with a great natural willpower, long-term awareness, and the confidence needed for social dominance and a strong command presence. You resist intimidation and bluster, and are never distracted from what truly matters you. Your determination and focus help you create opportunities and win greater victories, and also prevent you from shrinking from any distasteful or distressing reality.

slytherin_cunning.name: Slytherin: Cunning
slytherin_cunning.description: You’re a skilled manipulator, both in personal interactions and among large groups. You can quickly read any social situation and then manoeuvre advantageously – although this skill with social dynamics doesn’t actually make you more likeable. You have a deft talent for politics and a keen danger-sense, knowing just how far you can push things while keeping your hands clean and your neck safe. With Great Ambition: Your skills with acting, intrigue and spycraft improve. You have an intuitive grasp of how to manipulate through deceit or propaganda, including smearing an opponent or maintaining your own public image. You gain insight into the design of laws and procedures in large organisations, and a keen awareness of how one might exploit them.

slytherin_schemes.name: Slytherin: Schemes
slytherin_schemes.description: You’re a resourceful schemer and skilled implementer of plans, and instinctively grasp the results a particular course of action produces. Your typical long and short-term plans are both very unlikely to fail, and you can manage especially intricate, subtle, or large-scale schemes at greater risk. You’re skilled at using available information to anticipate variables which could endanger your plans, and your talents improve with intelligence, enabling more complex schemes with grander aims. With Great Ambition: More than a schemer, you’re an efficient and capable strategist. You know how to maintain a plan unnoticed for years, keep it adaptable when dealing with uncertainty, and adjust when the unexpected does arise. Your resourcefulness lets you develop methods of achieving your goals nobody else would consider, entirely evading predicaments that trap others.

spell_creation.name: Spell Creation
spell_creation.description: Perhaps the riskiest and most difficult magical practice of all; you have a talent for inventing new spells. You understand the process involved in doing so, and have a knack for controlling what the spells you create will actually do. This field requires a comprehensive knowledge of the magic type being attempted, and requires users to discover new combinations of incantations, wand movements, and spell theory. This practice can create some truly unique and singularly useful spells, which can even be taught to others. Spell creation is extremely dangerous, however. Individuals who experiment too recklessly could end up dead from a single miscast spell attempt, with more powerful spell attempts carrying greater dangers. Only the well prepared should attempt this. As a result of this talent in developing spells, you can recollect some points spent on their modifiers.

spell_modifier_appearance.name: Spell Modifier: Appearance
spell_modifier_appearance.description: You may apply Appearance spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Appearance: The spell is modified to look different. The Killing Curse could be made pink to confuse opponents. A beam could become a bolt or a sphere and vice versa. You can sacrifice speed to increase size. With this a Disarming charm could become a spreading cloud, spasming the arms of anyone inside so they drop whatever they hold. Doesn't make the spell stronger, can't make it invisible without 'Stealthy'.

spell_modifier_combination.name: Spell Modifier: Combination
spell_modifier_combination.description: You may apply Combination spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Combination: This combines two spells into one to create something new. A canon example would be 'Sectumsempra' that uses 'Seco' and 'Rictusempra' as a base. A healing torture spell (Episkey+Crucio), magic-nullifying shield (Finita+Protego), a tractor beam (Lumos+Accio) are also good examples. You can Combine chosen Signature Spell with any other you know for extra effects.

spell_modifier_enchantment.name: Spell Modifier: Enchantment
spell_modifier_enchantment.description: You may apply Enchantment spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Enchantment: Your spell is an enchantment. This means that you can tie the effects of your spell to magical items or greater magical workings. You could create a ring that disarms anyone who puts it on with expelliarmus, a shield that lasts in an area until broken, or an area that teleports anyone who steps into it somewhere else. These enchantments will last a long time without you, and will function better when made with better materials. These spells can still be detected or broken.

spell_modifier_homing.name: Spell Modifier: Homing
spell_modifier_homing.description: You may apply Homing spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Homing: Most spells simply launch outwards in a straight line before hitting their target, missing, or being blocked. With this modifier you gain the ability to control your spells after they have left your wand, though the process requires some focus. You can direct an attack spell to curve around cover, 'thread the needle' to hit a distant or obscured object, direct conjured beasts, change your pose mid-teleport, or use the legilimens spell with the natural legilimens' inborn trait.

spell_modifier_multicast.name: Spell Modifier: Multicast
spell_modifier_multicast.description: You may apply Multicast spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Multicast: Any spell cast with this modifier has its spell effects duplicated, as if it had been cast an extra time. This could be used to summon two patronuses at once, lift multiple objects with locomotor, or shotgun attack spells like expelliarmus or avada kedavra. You can purchase this option multiple times for a single spell, which will add one additional casting each time. This effect stacks linearly, not multiplicatively, meaning each purchase only adds one extra spell effect.

spell_modifier_piercing.name: Spell Modifier: Piercing
spell_modifier_piercing.description: You may apply Piercing spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Piercing: Your spell pierces through magical defenses like they aren't there. There are no effective counters to keep your magic from working, meaning most people will need to evade your spells or block them with physical objects. This does not increase a spell's raw power. If you wanted to apparate around Hogwarts, delve into the minds of an occlumens, or disarm someone through a shield, this option will allow you to. You'll still have to hit targets with your spell to use it.

spell_modifier_powerful.name: Spell Modifier: Powerful
spell_modifier_powerful.description: You may apply Powerful spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Powerful: Your spell has more raw power than it should. Spells like stupify or expelliarmus will strike with greater force, conjured animals will appear in greater numbers, shields will be practically unbreakable, mind control will be harder to resist, and you can control or lift more mass when using charms designed to do so. The strength of any spells you apply this modifier to are doubled when you cast them, and it increases slightly faster when the spell is trained.

spell_modifier_special_effect.name: Spell Modifier: Special Effect
spell_modifier_special_effect.description: You may apply Special Effect spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Special Effect: This either gives your spell some extra quality or breaks one of its limits. Spells like Gemino could be used on living beings. Conjured animals could explode upon demise instead of vanishing. Apparition could allow you to telefrag your enemies. A canon example of this is Protego Diabolica, a fire that only burns your enemies based on their intent, not your knowledge.

spell_modifier_stealthy.name: Spell Modifier: Stealthy
spell_modifier_stealthy.description: You may apply Stealthy spell modifier to your Signature Spell. The modified spell can technically be taught to others, but is almost impossibly difficult to master. You must purchase modifiers separately for each signature spell you apply them to. You are also capable of casting signature spells without any of the modifiers you purchase below whenever you choose. You will likely be unable to modify spells in this manner without purchasing them from this section. Any spell can only benefit from one modifier of each type unless specified otherwise. Perk can be purchased several times or rerolled for free, if you don't have any Signature Spell purchased. Stealthy: Adding this modifier to a spell makes it so the spell is redesigned for nonverbal casting. This means the spell is more easily cast wordlessly, and is at full power even if cast in such a way. This also removes any visual effects, such as beams of light or loud noises from the spell itself. Additionally, it is harder for others to detect this magic with their own magic, including the trace on underage magic or someone investigating an item enchanted with this spell's effects.

spiritualism_education.name: Spiritualism Education
spiritualism_education.description: This branch of magical study covers everything from ghouls and ghosts to infery to poltergeists. A comprehensive guide that allows one to become a real world ghost-buster: spells on how to weaken, banish, capture, exorcise a supernatural, as well as their abilities, weaknesses and habits. Some obscure knowledge here allows the truly gifted or fortunate to call a guardian spirit - from a departed loved one to a totem animal to an amalgamation of the ancestors. You can choose what topic to focus on, spreading the ten years of study. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

technomage.name: Technomage
technomage.description: ​There is so much more to magic than what these stuffy inbred old purebloods believe, and you can show them! You are an absolute master of the art of Techno-Magic. Making machines that run on magic, or just magical equivalents of Muggle technology, or something as simple as just making muggle devices work in magical environments is all child’s play for you. While you can translate flawlessly between technology and magic, doing something truly revolutionary requires extensive knowledge of both. Fortunately, there’s already a Perk here that can get you started.

transfiguration_affinity.name: Transfiguration Affinity
transfiguration_affinity.description: Transfiguration is the field of magic dedicated to altering the physical elements of the world. In its most basic form, this field allows users to transform one thing into another, such as turning a cup into a bird, switching traits between creatures, or changing the environment. Transfiguration typically involves conjuring or vanishing materials, or a mix of both practices when altering a target. This magic is more scientific than most fields, and requires a complex understanding of the materials being manipulated in order to be used effectively. Most of the changes in this field are temporary, and there are certain restrictions on what can be transfigured. Food, for example, can be summoned and multiplied, but cannot be created from nothing.

transfiguration_education.name: Transfiguration Education
transfiguration_education.description: You know the Transfiguration subject as well as you would have after studying it yourself for ten years. Includes all school years and independent research. You also have a corresponding degree of skill for someone, who got Outstanding on all their Transfiguration exams. Note: It doesn't turn you into a Witch/Wizard.

troll-blooded.name: Troll-blooded
troll-blooded.description: An ancestor of yours was a troll. Your body odor is especially unpleasant, your features are crude, and you have very aggressive impulses. On the other hand, you are 25% stronger and any wounds heal 10x faster.

vanishment_affinity.name: Vanishment Affinity
vanishment_affinity.description: You have a specialized affinity for vanishment. This is the practice of removing objects or creatures from existence entirely. Very complicated to use on living creatures, it is typically used to store, reduce, or remove magical and mundane objects. It can also be used for teleportation, such as through the skill of apparition.

visual_overhaul.name: Visual Overhaul
visual_overhaul.description: With this option you can choose for your appearance to stand out in some way. Glowing eyes or hair, unnatural colours, ect. You can also restrict its manifestations to circumstances like casting, focusing or feeling specific emotions. This is purely cosmetic and cannot be utilised in other way.

wandless_spells.name: Wandless Spells
wandless_spells.description: You are capable of learning wandless magic about as easily as a wizard would normally learn wand magic. Knowing this type of magic is exceptionally useful in the event that your wand is lost, broken, or stolen, and not requiring a wand can be very convenient. What's more, magic cast in this way is not channeled through a focus, meaning you can potentially cast multiple spells at once if you have the skill and power to do so. You can still learn this type of magic without this perk, but it will be significantly more difficult to do so. Note that it only concerns wand magic - the result of a semi-sentient artifact and its wielder acting together - performed wandlessly, solely by a wizard, which differs from inborn unstructured magic of wizards as locomotor spell differs from basic telekinesis. This perk helps with doing spells wandlessly by adapting your magic to mimic the end result, something that can happen naturally through decades of practice. It doesn't affect other ways of performing magic.

source_homonculus_starter_kit_cyoa.description: Perks from Homonculus Starter Kit CYOA.

bankruptcy_recipe.name: Bankruptcy Recipe
bankruptcy_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This recipe is focused on creating a supernatural homunculus. It excels at bringing out unusual or supernatural qualities from ingredients.The effects are random and while other recipes can also produce supernatural traits, this one is specifically focused on them. Its results are highly dependent on the quality of what it works with. Many ingredients are wasted and cannot be recovered. Most homunculi created this way are unlikely to be functional, but the rare survivors often display supernatural traits, both beneficial and harmful.

binding_sigils.name: Binding Sigils
binding_sigils.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. You can create binding sigils in your home to restrict movement or limit certain actions. These sigils can also be inscribed directly onto your homunculi. By activating a specific word, the creature can be rendered completely unable to move.

bonecrusher_recipe.name: Bonecrusher Recipe
bonecrusher_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This recipe is designed to create a true brute. The homunculus will be strong and larger than usual. Mistakes during growth can make it beastly or aggressive. Traditionally, it relies on various kinds of meats and bones, producing a homunculus built for raw power. It is primarily used for hunting and home defense. The biggest ones you can currently create may be able to fend of a cat.

classic_recipe.name: Classic Recipe
classic_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. You assume this is where it all started. The classic recipe for a homunculus. It is balanced and well-tested, producing a reliable and average homunculus. Traditionally, it combines blood, horse manure and the essence of a man.

command_words.name: Command Words
command_words.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. Magical words are instilled into the homunculus during its creation. They work regardless of the creature’s intelligence or understanding of language. When spoken, they trigger instant and absolute obedience. This method is limited to a set of simple commands, but they are highly reliable and precise.

conditioning_and_training.name: Conditioning and Training
conditioning_and_training.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. This method shapes a homunculus’s behavior over time through repetition, reinforcement, and guidance. Commands and routines are gradually taught, creating predictable responses. The process is reward-based and requires patience and consistency. Dumb, stubborn or chaotic homunculi may resist or take longer to learn.

cute_recipe.name: Cute Recipe
cute_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This recipe is designed to create an adorable homunculus. Most homunculi tend to look strange or unsettling, but this one focuses on charm. It may have soft fur, large expressive eyes or other features that are visually appealing. The focus of this recipe is purely on the aesthetics. It is not particularly useful for work and exists primarily as a pet or companion.

fast_growth.name: Fast Growth
fast_growth.description: After searching through your uncle’s belongings, you discover additional writings and items that offer further help. There are methods to make a homunculus grow faster using additional materials. The notes also describe ways to trigger explosive growth, but this comes at a cost, as the creature’s overall quality and stability will likely be reduced.

green_thumb_recipe.name: Green Thumb Recipe
green_thumb_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This homunculus is built to tend to plants and crops. It has average strength and a strong compulsion to care for anything that grows. It enjoys being outdoors making it perfect for maintaining gardens, farms or magical plants. However, it is constantly dirty and smelly, which can make working near the house unpleasant. While not particularly fast or intelligent, it is diligent and reliable in its work.

growth_method_incubation_jar.name: Growth Method: Incubation Jar
growth_method_incubation_jar.description: A sealed vessel is required to grow a homunculus. All necessary ingredients are placed inside. The vessel may contain no liquid, be partially submerged or filled completely with water. Fire can be used to control the temperature and additional ingredients may be carefully added. This method is very stable and popular. It allows for precise control over growth conditions. Because of its predictability and reproducibility, large and complex recipes can be created with great results. However, manipulation is difficult due to the enclosed nature of the jar and adjustments must be done with extreme care to avoid ruining the experiment.

growth_method_seed.name: Growth Method: Seed
growth_method_seed.description: Homunculi grown using the Seed Method develop like plants. They may be the plant itself or grow as a fruit on one. They require careful nurturing. Sunlight must be sufficient, and they must be watered regularly. The soil must be of good quality. Magical fertilizer may also be necessary. Once the initial setup is complete, they only need routine care. Growth follows natural cycles. It develops slowly, but predictably. Homunculi grown this way are plant-based. They may perform photosynthesis to reduce food needs. They are resilient, have good stamina and strength. However, they are often slower and less intelligent than other homunculi.

growth_method_spawning_pool.name: Growth Method: Spawning Pool
growth_method_spawning_pool.description: This method is similar to the Incubation Jar, but the vessel is not fully sealed. The cauldron is filled with nutrient-rich liquid, designed to mimic the primordial seas where life on Earth first emerged. Ingredients can be added freely and the liquid can be stirred or adjusted as needed. The open setup allows for larger batches or bigger homunculi. Growth requires regular supervision and careful adjustments. This method can produce multiple homunculi at once and makes it easier to grow larger specimens. Ingredients and the environment can be adjusted at any time. However, it is less stable than other methods. External factors may affect growth, and recipes are more like guidelines, not strict instructions. It is the most time-intensive method and requires regular attention to maintain proper conditions. Due to its flexible nature, it is also the most forgiving of errors, as long as you are willing to put in the work.

hierarchy.name: Hierarchy
hierarchy.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. This method relies on using other homunculi to enforce obedience. More dominant or trained homunculi act as leaders, guiding or correcting others through their presence and actions. It works only in groups, creating a natural chain of command. Creating a smarter and more disciplined leader is highly advised to maintain order and effectiveness.

leftover_recipe.name: Leftover Recipe
leftover_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. During your experiments, you will often have leftover ingredients. This recipe is designed to make use of them and create a functional homunculus, even if it is not perfect. It is the opposite of the Bankruptcy Recipe, focusing on efficiency. Meat may spoil, plants can rot and magical ingredients may lose potency, but this method ensures that nothing goes completely to waste. While the resulting homunculus may be simple or quirky, it is still usable and can serve basic purposes.

longer_lifespan.name: Longer Lifespan
longer_lifespan.description: After searching through your uncle’s belongings, you discover additional writings and items that offer further help. Normally, a homunculus lives for about half a year. Your uncle conducted research that can extend their lifespan, allowing them to live up to a full year under proper care.

mind_control.name: Mind Control
mind_control.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. You have made a deal with spirits who oversee and influence your homunculi. They assist in correcting any problems or disobedience that arises with your creations. In extreme situations, they can even take direct control of a homunculus to enforce your will. Their help is powerful and reliable, but it comes at a cost. You can always expect to pay for their service

obedience.name: Obedience
obedience.description: After searching through your uncle’s belongings, you discover additional writings and items that offer further help. Your uncle’s creations were often unruly, constantly playing pranks on him. To address this, he researched ways to improve control over homunculi. These insights slightly enhance the control methods you have chosen. For example if you have choosen "Command Words" you will have more commands or more complex instructions.

ox_recipe.name: Ox Recipe
ox_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This recipe produces a homunculus built for raw strength and endurance. It is strong, durable and has exceptional stamina, making it ideal for heavy labor and manual work. However, it is slow and not very intelligent, requiring careful supervision. It also has a huge appetite, consuming large amounts of food to maintain its power. Despite its limitations, it excels at tasks that demand consistent effort and brute force.

pain.name: Pain
pain.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. A magical device, equivalent to a shock collar, is placed on the homunculus. Even the dumbest or most primal creations quickly learn that disobedience causes pain. Continued use trains the creatures to fear resisting your commands. This method is particularly effective for keeping chaotic or unruly homunculi in line.

ritual_bond.name: Ritual Bond
ritual_bond.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. A ritual is performed to bind the homunculus to you. Once completed, the creature becomes absolutely obedient to its caster. The bond is not permanent and must be refreshed periodically, typically about once a year, to maintain full control.

screamer_recipe.name: Screamer Recipe
screamer_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This homunculus is designed to be vigilant and alert. Its body is made from an unusual combination of ingredients, including carrots, eyes, noses and ears. Its temperament is timid and paranoid, making it extremely sensitive to any disturbance. While it is physically weak and cannot defend itself, it excels at alerting you to intruders or unusual events around your home.

scrubby_recipe.name: Scrubby Recipe
scrubby_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This homunculus is designed to assist around the house. It has a humanoid form, or at least articulated fingers. It can carry items and clean surfaces. While it can handle simple chores, it is still quite dumb and cannot manage anything complex. It follows a rigid routine, performing tasks in a fixed order. It is clumsy and often drops items or bumps into furniture.

stockpiles.name: Stockpiles
stockpiles.description: After searching through your uncle’s belongings, you discover additional writings and items that offer further help. Your uncle has stored a variety of resources in his basement. You do not need to worry about starting materials for your creations. In addition, the stockpile also contains some food, enough to sustain your creatures for a while.

tinkerling_recipe.name: Tinkerling Recipe
tinkerling_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This homunculus is designed for simple crafting. It can make basic tools or devices for other homunculi, but nothing particularly impressive. Like a broom or a hammer made by attaching a stone to a stick. However, it is easily distracted and tends to make a mess while working.

trapper_recipe.name: Trapper Recipe
trapper_recipe.description: Recipes are instructions for cultivating a homunculus. They detail the methods, techniques and ingredients required for growth. Your uncle has already researched and discovered several of these recipes, providing a foundation for your work. As your experience grows, you may create new recipes, combine insights from different ones or improve existing recipes to achieve better results. This homunculus delights in building traps and setting up little tricks. It enjoys outsmarting its prey and toying with it. It seems to be the cleverest of your creations, but it rarely uses its intelligence responsibly. Following commands is not its strong suit, as it prefers doing things its own way. Despite its chaotic tendencies, it proves useful for hunting, pest control and home defense.

veil_talismans.name: Veil Talismans
veil_talismans.description: After searching through your uncle’s belongings, you discover additional writings and items that offer further help. Your uncle was particularly careful about hiding his magical creatures. He placed a non-refundable order for special talismans, which you only need to pick up. When attached to a homunculus, these talismans make them even more concealed from mundane eyes. This makes operating with your creations in cities or populated areas more feasible. The talismans are not consumable, but they can be damaged and may require repair or replacement.

will_of_the_creator.name: Will of the Creator
will_of_the_creator.description: You have to find a way to manage your creations. Some methods are more passive and long-term, while others take effect quickly. Even if most homunculi do not intend to harm you, they can still be dangerous. Just like the tamest pet tiger, a sudden misstep or accident can have serious consequences. This method imbues your homunculus with your will during its creation. The creature naturally seeks to fulfill the wishes of its creator. This is a special bond that cannot be removed or altered by any malicious forces. Control is subtle, relying on the homunculus’s own motivation rather than force. It works best for intelligent and obedient homunculi. Stubborn ones may ignore commands, rebellious ones can resist and more beastly types may forget your commands.

source_houseki_no_kuni_land_of_the_lustr.source: Houseki No Kuni (Land of the lustrous)
source_houseki_no_kuni_land_of_the_lustr.description: Perks from Houseki No Kuni (Land of the lustrous).

admirabilis_physiology.name: Admirabilis Physiology
admirabilis_physiology.description: You are the race of flesh: your strength and regeneration are a testament to this. Furthermore, you can freely switch between the form of an adorable shelled mollusk (of any size you choose) and a humanoid form while retaining all your stats, including those of your shell.

commander.name: Commander
commander.description: In combat, the Lunarians act in perfect synchrony, giving the impression of being a single being driven by a hive mind. That is certainly not the case, but you can do exactly that.

eat_to_grow_stronger.name: Eat to grow stronger
eat_to_grow_stronger.description: Eating is even more important for you: the more you eat, the smarter you become. You can also eat minerals to strengthen your shell and give it its unique features. Furthermore, if you smell an appetizing aroma, you regain your senses, breaking all mental control. >Requires Admirabilis Physiology

elite_warrior.name: Elite Warrior
elite_warrior.description: Your combat skills and total control over your appendages are overwhelming, allowing you to defeat groups of Lunarians without the slightest difficulty.

heir_to_humanitys_knowledge.name: Heir to humanity's knowledge
heir_to_humanitys_knowledge.description: The Lunarians inherited all this incredible technology, and where the Lustrous are content with little and, moreover, archaic technology, that is not your case! You possess the skill level of an average Lunarian engineer, and in the next few jumps, you will also gain access to world's equivalent technology.

lunarians_physiology.name: Lunarians Physiology
lunarians_physiology.description: As Lunarians, for better or worse, you are immortal: as long as your soul remains intact, ordinary attacks scatter rather than kill you, and you eventually reform, sooner or later.

lustrous_physiology.name: Lustrous Physiology
