lustrous_physiology.description: As a gem, you can sustain yourself simply by absorbing light. Furthermore, you cannot die as long as there are still pieces of your crystalline body remaining. However, you will need to be repaired and reassembled before you can move again.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.description: Just like Aechmea, you are a master of manipulation: Capable of making plans over centuries and easily finding the buttons, the weaknesses of your targets and exploiting them.

smarter_inclusions.name: Smarter Inclusions
smarter_inclusions.description: Just like Lapis, your inclusions are little things that work hard: they make you smarter, more analytical and help your memory retain information much better. Furthermore, all the life forms that make up your body are under your control, and you can assign subprograms to them. >Requires Lustrous Physiology

thats_my_task.name: That's my task
thats_my_task.description: Hardness and combat aren't everything on this island: there's plenty to do. Choose one task whether it's medicine, patrolling, or something else entirely, like giving a presentation on natural history, you'll excel at it.

alchemic_gold.name: Alchemic Gold
alchemic_gold.description: "Alchemic Gold is the color of experimentation and discovery." You may produce potions using mundane materials and infusing them with magic. Alchemic Gold will extract conceptual properties from the ingredients to produce a magical effect that can be used when the potion is drunk, applied like an ointment, splashed, breathed, etc... For example, you may make a potion starting from a few feathers to make anyone who drinks it incredibly light for a limited amount of time. Instead, by using entire wings, you may make functional wings sprout on the back of a target. Another one may require the color of a dye and gain the ability to change the color of an entire building if splashed on the walls. The more time you spend on making the potion and the more in quantity and the more expensive the materials, the stronger and longer lasting the effects will be. With enough experimentation and resources, you may achieve almost anything. Be careful not to hurt yourself with uncontrollable effects!

amplifier.name: Amplifier
amplifier.description: When held, this item will amply all of your Colors. They will shine brighter, will be more powerful and their usage will tire you out less. The Amplifier can be a wand, a book, a sword, a stone, or a phone... Any object you can hold with one or two hands. If broken or lost it will reappear after 24h. >Requires at least one Iridescent Souls CYOA Color perk.

astral_teal.name: Astral Teal
astral_teal.description: "Astral Teal is the color of the astral plane and the manipulation of souls." You may project your consciousness through Astral Teal as an Astral Projection. It moves at the speed of thought (just think of a place and your consciousness will be transported there) and enables you to perceive distant locations with all of your senses. You may not interact with matter or people, nor use other Colors while Astral Projecting. Your body is still vulnerable. You may push other people out of their bodies to travel with you and you may possess temporarily soul-less and living bodies, engaging in a battle of will with the owner for control. Your body cannot be possessed, since the other Colors (the majority of your Soul) will still be present. You may fragment Astral Teal and use it to possess objects and animate them. You can spend some time shaping personality and level of intelligence of these animated objects. The more, larger and more complex the personality/intelligence of the animated objects the harder it will be to maintain them. They count as enchantments and can be recipients of the Soul Fragments PERK. For short periods of time, you may shift entirely into the Astral Plane with your body too, becoming invisible and intangible and capable of flight. You may not move at the speed of thought when shifting the body, however, being limited to short bursts of flight in the vicinity. This is extremely tiring and usually considered an emergency move.

aura_pink.name: Aura Pink
aura_pink.description: "Aura Pink is the color of emotions and feelings." You have the ability to sense the emotions of those nearby by interpreting their colorful auras. Each color corresponds to an emotion and the more vibrant the more intense it will be. You know how to interpret them and how to manipulate them in a variety of ways: for example, you may make people share an emotion, you may remove it temporarily or totally, or, with a bit more difficulty, create new ones. This power can work at a distance if you take time to meditate and know the target well enough. Moreover, you gain the ability to craft Emotional Elementals, physical representations of emotions, from particularly strong ones (either yours or of others). Their mere presence will overpower most with their own emotions and they can have powers of their own themed powers. You may lose control of them if you summon too many. They are countered by an opposite, equally strong emotion or peace of mind. Examples: an Anger elemental will have fire and berserk-based abilities, its mere presence making people violent.

book_of_cantrips.name: Book of Cantrips
book_of_cantrips.description: The book is bound in black leather and shines in Color while it's being used. It contains cantrip-level spells for all Colors. You must hold the book in your hands to use the spells it contains. If the book is lost or broken it will reappear after 24h.

building_burgundy.name: Building Burgundy
building_burgundy.description: "Building Burgundy is the color of shapes and ideas." You have to power to generate and manipulate energy constructs. This power requires constant focus to work efficiently and can mimic any shape that comes to mind. Simple ones like disks, cubes, or spheres are much easier to produce, but with sufficient concentration, you can make much more complex ones like work utensils, weapons or animals, and so on. Making a phone will not make it function: it simply possesses the shape. Depending on how much time you invest in creating a construct you can make it as strong as to resist hundreds to thousands of pounds of force. You may enchant your constructs to function autonomously following simple commands.

chaotic_emerald.name: Chaotic Emerald
chaotic_emerald.description: "Chaotic Emerald is the color of chaos and probability." You can enchant creatures or locations with good or bad luck, increasing the probability of positive events or negative events to occur respectively. Of course, the greater the degree of good or bad luck "gifted" the more it will tire you out. Moreover, you may try to establish precisely what these events will be, costing you more the more improbable or impossible the event. Making something that would naturally occur is easier: let's say, a car mysteriously shutting down while moving. Instead, making a piano fall on the head of an enemy while in the middle of the desert will require much more of your energy. Finally, you may meditate to see how your choices may branch out in countless possible futures. This won't be a perfect prediction of what's to come, but it may give you an idea of what are the most probable outcomes of your decisions.

cloudy_azure.name: Cloudy Azure
cloudy_azure.description: "Cloudy Azure is the color of air and weather phenomena." You can manipulate natural air and electricity or produce magical replicas. Create tornadoes, lightning from your fingertips, or cutting winds, and use air to propel yourself freely in the sky. You gain weather-related enchantments that enable you to control weather phenomena happening in an area, and program them for up to a week (upkeep is possible). Make it rain, thunder, or hail. Call forth fog and mist or clear the area from pollution and let the sunshine. Finally, you are immune to the adverse effects of air and electricity and have no need for breathing.

deep_blue.name: Deep Blue
deep_blue.description: "Deep Blue is the color of water and cold." You have the ability to control natural water and ice and generate and manipulate magical replicas. The latter will disappear from existence after a few hours if not stabilized with an enchantment. You may turn water into ice and vice versa at will. With enough focus, you may manipulate hundreds to thousands of gallons of water, cause waves and tsunamis or generate ice constructs from moisture in the air. You gain water and ice-related enchantments, enabling you to encase targets in ice that doesn't melt or create floating rivers, for example. Finally, you are most comfortable in the water, enabling you to swim incredibly fast, breathe underwater, and resist water pressure. Moreover, you have a resistance to the adverse effects of cold.

dimensional_indigo.name: Dimensional Indigo
dimensional_indigo.description: "Dimensional Indigo is the color of dimensions and portals." You gain the power to generate and manipulate portals, which may be 2D or 3D. 2D portals can appear on surfaces or float in mid-air and enable objects to move through them in two directions, while 3D ones take the shape of the target and teleport it to another unoccupied location. You may generate portals and teleport within line of sight with ease. With an enchantment, you may instead create portals linking to different locations you can picture in your mind. The more time spent, the larger the portal. Moreover, you gain a personal dimension of near-limitless size you can access through specifically crafted portals. The dimension appears as Indigo all around, with a dark sky and a flat surface underneath. All objects are perfectly illuminated in all directions and project no shadow. You can create fake matter in the personal dimension, but you cannot carry it out of it. Transporting real matter in and out is more taxing, since you're moving it from one dimension to another.

disrupting_obsidian.name: Disrupting Obsidian
disrupting_obsidian.description: "Disprupting Obsidian is the color of antimagic and dispelling." You gain the ability to passively sense magic and other Iridescent Souls in the vicinity. You may dispel active magical effects with various degrees of difficulty: if you possess the matching Color it will be much easier, while if you don't it will take you much more time to undo it. A stronger effect, moreover, requires more time on your part to disable it. You may set up antimagic enchantments (called curses) on targets or areas that prevent any use of magic. They may be created following the same rule of thumb: the more time you spend creating these curses the longer-lasting and stronger they will be. An overcharge of magic may overcome them, however. You are immune to your own effects of antimagic.

dreamy_orchid.name: Dreamy Orchid
dreamy_orchid.description: "Dreamy Orchid is the color of dreams and fantasy." You have the ability to lucid dream and traverse the dreams of others. You may script dreams to your liking and to the finest detail, setting, characters, and plot. You may manipulate the flow of time in the dream to your liking, making thousands of years happen in a few real seconds if you so wish. While sleeping your body is vulnerable, however, your physiological processes halt keeping you in an immortal, unaging stasis where you do not need to eat, drink or go to the bathroom, etc... Moreover, you can induce drowsiness to outright blackout sleep to others in your vicinity (depending on how strong they are) and overwrite their dreams with your scripted ones. With an enchantment you may curse a target to sleep for up to a week without waking up - magically sleeping targets also have their physiological processes halted.

earthy_brown.name: Earthy Brown
earthy_brown.description: "Earthy Brown is the color of earth-related materials such as stones, minerals, sand, and the earth itself." You may control natural earth-related materials and generate and manipulate magical replicas. The latter will disappear from existence after a few hours. You may stabilize them for up to a week, however, if you expend enough time casting (upkeep to extend it) - counts as enchantment. Your control over earth-related material requires concentration - with enough focus you may hurl boulders worth hundreds to thousands of kgs, cause earthquakes, or make life-like sculptures. You also gain access to earth-related enchantments, for example, you may enchant objects to give them the same hardness as a diamond or make a rock magically crumble into sand in a few seconds. Finally, you may sense tremors through the earth and may consume natural earth-related materials as food. You are immune to the adverse effects of the element.

eldritch_midnight.name: Eldritch Midnight
eldritch_midnight.description: "Eldritch Midnight is the color of darkness, mystery, and the unknown. The Void and the creatures that inhabit it." You can conjure and manipulate magical darkness. It cannot interact with physical matter. You possess perfect dark vision and, while hidden in darkness, you may call forth beings of various power from the void. They require appropriate sacrifices to be summoned and comply with your requests, starting from food for weak creatures that may perform mundane tasks such as cleaning your house, while stronger ones may require blood, memories, or human lives for more esoteric tasks. If the sacrifice isn't enough they will simply go back to the void, losing power over reality. You may meditate in darkness to project your consciousness to safely visit the void and acknowledge or even befriend different beings. Be careful, your body might be safe, but you might not recover from the horrors you may witness. There are creatures far more powerful than you are, but if you are clever enough you may find ways to make them work for you.

ember_red.name: Ember Red
ember_red.description: "Ember Red is the color of flames and other sources of heat." You have the ability to produce and manipulate flames and heat. Create flamethrowers or walls of fire, melt metal with your hands, and shape it as if it was clay. You gain access to fire-related enchantments: for example, you may spend some time casting to make fire impossible to extinguish through normal means for up to a week or enchant targets to become completely heat-proof. You are immune to the adverse effects of fire and heat and in the presence of natural sources you are stronger and can regenerate from damage more quickly.

false_color.name: False Color
false_color.description: Choose a Color you do not possess. It will now tinge all of your abilities and you can use it as part of your Soul Title, though you will not possess any of the powers it describes. >Requires at least one Iridescent Souls CYOA Color perk.

familiar.name: Familiar
familiar.description: One of your Colors can take the form of an animal. It is a part of your Soul with its own personality and the two of you can communicate telepathically. It can be summoned at will, otherwise, it will reside within your Soul. While outside, it can cast magic of its Color independently from you, but you lose access to the Color for as long as the Familiar is manifested. In situations of dire need, it can summon itself to protect or aid you. Every time it is bought, you gain an additional Familiar with a different Color. >Requires at least one Iridescent Souls CYOA Color perk.

living_green.name: Living Green
living_green.description: "Living Green is the color of life, plant, animal, and fungi alike." You may manipulate nonsentient life: plants, fungi, and animals. Plants and fungi are the easiest to manipulate - make them move and bend to unnatural degrees or make the extend many times beyond their length. With an enchantment, you may accelerate their growth, making them sprout from seeds or spores in a matter of a few seconds. Moreover, you can mix and match plant and fungi traits, creating new species that would be impossible to exist otherwise. Control over animals is a little different - you may communicate with them and ask for aid or you may try to force control over their minds. The smaller and fewer the animals you attempt to control at a time, the easier it will be. Also, you may mix and match animal traits, creating new hybrid species, much like what you can do with plants and fungi. Be careful, however, not to let any of your newly created species run rampant.

luminous_yellow.name: Luminous Yellow
luminous_yellow.description: "Luminous Yellow is the color of light and illusion." You have the ability to generate and manipulate light. You may produce blinding flashes, bend light to become invisible, or produce convincing visual illusions. This power requires constant concentration to function correctly, especially if the generated illusions are complex or animated. If you spend time creating an illusion, you may make it run autonomously, make it cover entire towns, and add to it sound, temperature, touch, and scent (the more time you spend making it the more effects it can have/the larger the area it will cover - enchantments). Your illusions may never physically harm anyone.

moving_cyan.name: Moving Cyan
moving_cyan.description: "Moving Cyan is the color of movement and freedom." You gain telekinetic abilities over your surroundings, enabling you to move hundreds to thousands of kgs with ease. This power requires constant concentration to work effectively. With enough focus you may toss manipulated targets, apply force to break them, or stop a flying object in midair (if you can perceive it). You may even levitate passively up to a meter from the ground and move up to running speed, but with focus, you may launch yourself in a controlled flight at hundreds of km/h with a telekinetic shield sufficient to protect you from adverse flying conditions like temperature, lack of oxygen or impact with insects, but it won't protect you from a flying bullet or hitting a hard surface at full speed for example. By spending some time casting you may apply telekinesis-related enchantments to targets, removing the force of gravity from affecting them for example, locking them at a certain height, or programming flying trajectories.

necro_bone.name: Necro Bone
necro_bone.description: "Necro Bone is the color of death, bones, and ghosts." You may control dead matter and instill it with fake life. The more time you spend creating a servant, the more intelligent and or strong you may make it - this counts as an enchantment. They may even retain the knowledge of when they were alive. Your servants can also be created as an amalgamation of various body parts, though they take longer to make than simply reanimate a single body. Any servant you create this way can be a recipient for the PERK Soul Fragments. Finally, you have the ability to summon the souls of the dead in the form of roaming ghosts. The more recent the death and the closer you are to the location where they died or where their remains are, the easier it will be to call them forth. You have the power to decide when to send them back to the afterlife, though strong-willed ghosts may try to wrestle for it. A summoned ghost keeps all their memories, identity, and agency, they may decide to collaborate with you or not, even possessing one of your servants.

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: You can toggle on and off the flashy property of your Colors, meaning that you can, if you wish, cast magic without being noticed. This also makes you less noticeable to the Iridescent Soul sensing of Disrupting Obsidian. >Requires at least one Iridescent Souls CYOA Color perk.

powerful_crimson.name: Powerful Crimson
powerful_crimson.description: "Powerful Crimson is the color of power and destruction. The strongest in terms of pure offense, but it lacks versatility." You can shoot energetic projections in different shapes (missiles, waves, lasers, explosions, bolt barrages, lances, spikes, etc...). The more time you spend casting an attack the stronger, the quicker and the farther it will travel to hit/destroy the target. During casting, you can add esoteric properties to your attacks, making them self-hit a flying target for example, or appear all around a standing target before launching on it. Attacks cast on the fly make you as dangerous as an assault rifle and by spending some time casting you can create stronger projections. You are not immune to the damage you cause.

prophetic_fuchsia.name: Prophetic Fuchsia
prophetic_fuchsia.description: "Prophetic Fuchsia is the color of information collection and storage." You have the ability to gather information through esoteric means, such as using tarot cards, interpreting the stars in the sky, or tossing bones (for example). The information that can be gathered may be in the form of visions from the past or future or real-time viewing of a remote target/location. The visions may involve one or more of your senses and may range from being straightforward to cryptic. You may need objects related to the information you wish to gather in order for the visions to be clearer. Moreover, you may store information within objects/locations that can be transmitted as visions to anyone you choose who is in the vicinity/touching the storage. Finally, you gain perfect memory and hyper-awareness of your surroundings, nothing will ever catch you completely off guard. (You also gain sufficient mental fortitude to deal with all this information).

psychic_purple.name: Psychic Purple
psychic_purple.description: "Psychic Purple is the color of the mind, thoughts and memories." You may read surface thoughts of nearby creatures without them noticing and send telepathic messages that can carry words or mental images - if you're careful the target may think these are their own thoughts and act upon them as a form of suggestion. With some concentration, you may even share their senses, see through their eyes, hear through their ears, etc... While meditating you may instead reach a faraway target you know. The further away and the less acquainted you are the harder it will be. Moreover, by touching a target you may probe deeper into their mind reaching their own personal Mindscape, a dimension generated by the subconscious. If you learn to navigate it without getting lost, you may reach the target's memories and centers of personality and retrieve, delete, or modify information as you see fit. You may set up mental wards in your own Mindscape to prevent this and in general explore it and get to know yourself better.

restoring_honey.name: Restoring Honey
restoring_honey.description: "Restoring Honey is the color of healing and restoring." You have the power to heal wounds and diseases. Papercuts and other superficial wounds are much easier to treat, requiring a few seconds of concentration. Anything more complex requires a lengthy ritual to heal, the more complex the case the more time is required. While you are using your power on a patient, they will enter a stasis where they cannot die, nor worsen, until you have finished. Healing a mortal wound can take up to hours. You may repair broken objects, too, restoring them to functionality. The greater the damage and the larger the objects the more taxing it will be. Finally, you may cast protective enchantments called blessings. These will passively heal, regenerate and repair your targets, counteracting damage as soon as it happens. They act much more slowly than your active intervention, however.

sanguine_scarlet.name: Sanguine Scarlet
sanguine_scarlet.description: "Sanguine Scarlet is the color of blood and lifeforce." You can control and manipulate blood from open wounds or blood in general in contact with air. You may harden it and shape it in a variety of fragile constructs. Moreover, you may drink blood for sustenance and to increase your strength, agility, reflexes, and durability temporarily. The potency and duration of effects depend on how much blood you have consumed. If you completely drain someone, you may instead increase your lifespan by the number of years the victim would have naturally survived. An old person may give you less than 5, a healthy young adult more than 40.

soul_fragments.name: Soul Fragments
soul_fragments.description: You can split your Colors into fragments and bind them to other beings. This way you can lend a portion of your power to other people or creatures. You can get back your Soul Fragment whenever. You may produce an illimited number of fragments for each Color you possess, but you will become proportionally weaker in the Colors you have fragmented. >Requires at least one Iridescent Souls CYOA Color perk.

techno_lime.name: Techno Lime
techno_lime.description: "Techno Lime is the color of technology and advancement." You have the power to manipulate technology, aka anything manmade through the application of scientific knowledge. Computers, cars, complex machinery, cell phones, and the like all fall under this category. You may interface with them mentally to access their contents and control them. For example, you may activate and guide a car remotely, or project your consciousness into the internet to navigate it. Your mind is strong enough not to crack under the complexity or sheer load of information. If you have a blueprint in mind, you may telekinetically assemble the parts to create it. You have a natural propensity for learning the appropriate knowledge required to build any of your projects, but you still need to study and apply what you learned for the projects to be realized.

turning_orange.name: Turning Orange
turning_orange.description: "Turning Orange is the color of evolution and adaptation." You can turn partially or totally into other people, animals, plants, or fungi you know. Your transformation is easier when complete, while it's harder to maintain a chimeric form made up of different creatures together. The more creatures the harder. This power enables you to mimic the natural abilities of whatever you turn into. Elephant strength? Plant's photosynthesis? All on the table. Solely physical ones, though, which means you cannot turn into the Nobel Prize for Physics and get their intelligence. Be careful, you are not immune to an identity crisis.

warding_pearl.name: Warding Pearl
warding_pearl.description: "Warding Pearl is the color of protection, wards, and shields. The strongest in terms of pure defense." You have the ability to set up Wards protecting creatures, objects, or entire locations from harm. They can be created with certain rules in mind, for example, they may enable the entrance of an area only by a selected few or protect those they guard against poisonous gases. You may set up multiple wards on a target/location, each following a single rule (either general protection from harm or specific rules). You may also ward against specific Colors, making much more powerful wards for the Colors you possess. The more time you spend creating a ward the stronger and/or larger it will be, with no upper limit. A fraction of a second may protect from a bullet before dissipating, while a few hours may protect from tank explosions. Wards count as enchantments, needing weekly upkeep to keep on functioning or they will lose strength with time. Moreover, the longer they are under attack the quicker they will dissipate (unless they are actively maintained by you).

warping_mauve.name: Warping Mauve
warping_mauve.description: "Warping Mauve is the color of space, playing with the rules of physics." You have the ability to temporarily alter space in a location or on a target without damaging it. You may change the sizes of targets, turn a mouse the size of an elephant and vice versa, or zip the space between you and a faraway building you can see, effectively enabling you to move from one location to the next with a single step. You may enchant containers or rooms to increase their storage size without changing the exterior, for example enabling a water bottle to store an Olympic pool's worth of water. Finally, you may change the shape and physical properties of targets without affecting anything else - you may make an elephant as light as a feather or change the shape of your fingers into squishy flesh tentacles. The weirder and grander the effect, the more taxing it will be to realize.

source_kumo_desu_ga_nani_ka.description: Perks from Kumo Desu ga, Nani Ka?.

appraisal_sama.name: Appraisal Sama
appraisal_sama.description: If you want to live long in this brand new world, you’ll learn to bend a knee to the most important god of them all. Appraisal-Sama! The most vital of abilities has been unlocked within you, the ability to Appraise things on sight, and you’ve received it at max level within the system too! Appraisal grants the ability to receive a wealth of information on any subject you can see by activating it. Name, level, statistics, general and specific data on abilities, being and nature. It can even appraise items, locations or your own abilities to give you more detail. Even at maximum level it won’t give more than a few paragraphs worth of info at the absolute most but you’ll never be without knowing the generals of what something is and a fair few specifics on top

farming_commune.name: Farming Commune
farming_commune.description: Some of your fellow world travels are ‘lucky’ enough to be safely whisked away to live with the elves small community. Here they are kept to a simple exist, providing for themselves except when absolutely needed of outside intervention. And perhaps kept here by a bit of force too. Still, like them, you have developed a great deal of skill at keeping yourself self sufficient. You have a good deal of experience with farming, carpentry, weaving and knitting, smithing and even basic medicine. You find it easy to work alone even on things that normally require small teams to help with and can deal with extremely long stretches of boredom easily. You might not like it but you won’t go mad for sure.

hungry_bug.name: Hungry Bug
hungry_bug.description: Power is power and power left unattended is really just yours for the taking. You have the ‘power’ to feed off of any power source left open in any way, such as if it leaks or transmits out energy. You’re able to absorb that power slowly and take it into yourself, making it count as a natural part of you, though it can take time to acclimatize to the new power if it is far more than you previously had, even potentially weeks or months if it’s a truly staggering difference. Taking too much power too fast is dangerous after all, so you may even need to slow down the rate at which you eat if you don’t want to hurt yourself from the inside out. This method of feeding is slow enough that it can’t be used to defend against energy attacks.

hunters_way.name: Hunter’s Way
hunters_way.description: The path to power is long and filled with many struggles but at least the distance is not so long for you. When you search for it, you can easily find excellent prey of a suitable level for yourself or foes that are powerful enough to challenge you to a desired level. When you hunt for such things, be it weaker prey or stronger challenges, you won’t need to worry about overhunting and emptying your feeding grounds either, as these targets just seem to appear when needed. This hunting ability has also given you the skill to help avoid being hunted yourself, letting you easily evade notice from any being much stronger than yourself, sometimes even getting them to ignore your existence entirely should you stay still enough.

level_uno.name: Level Uno
level_uno.description: Life isn’t fair. It throws you in at the deep end, tells you nothing about how shit is going to go down and then expects you to swim or be eaten by some sort of horrible magic crocodile demon. Enough of that, we say, as you’ll at least get a bit of help at the start of anything. Similar to if you used Appraisal, you’ll now have short tutorials appear whenever you try to do something that will guide you on how it works and how to use it. Usually these will only give a few paragraphs of information and maybe a few pictures or short video. It’s a far cry from a few hours of lessons but it does give you a great way to start off learning almost anything, from how to walk to a specific spell you want to learn. You do actually need to have the potential and ability to possibly learn something to get a tutorial though.

like_a_living_factory.name: Like a Living Factory
like_a_living_factory.description: A spider without silk to spin their web is…still a terribly terrifying creature to have to fight at the size of a full grown human. But they’re not that effective without it, the same as any being that relies on a substance their body produces. You never seem to run out, as if you had some sort of skill that allowed you to endless produce anything that your body naturally makes. While this does not affect magical energy, at least not in this world, you will find that you never run out of blood or silk or spit or any other sort of biologically produced matter from your own body, even if you constantly use all your body should hold each second.

maze_crawler.name: Maze Crawler
maze_crawler.description: Life in the Great Elro Labyrinth is not for those faint of heart or short of skill. Filled with monsters and harsh environments, it’d take a natural talent to make your way through here safely. Guess who’s the lucky guy that has that talent? Not only are you brilliant at navigating mazes and surviving in almost any kind of environment, you also have a wide range of skills relating to survival, proper hunting methods, knowledge of the terrain, most of the common and even some rare plants and animals and so on. You could very well make a life in the upper parts of the Labyrinth if you were careful and certainly make your way to the surface even from the deepest depths

other_skin.name: Other Skin
other_skin.description: Being a spider just feels so natural, like it was meant to be. Maybe you were never supposed to be human in the first place? I guess some people that think they were born in the wrong skin were actually right! How about that. You were able to and will continue to be able to instantly adjust to any new form your body takes, understanding how to use any innate attributes of the body and any natural ability so very well. You’ll be an expert at using your new eight limbs, even more so than an actual creature like you, no matter if you’d been used to four before. This natural talent for adjusting to new forms expertly also sees you have a innate advantage against anyone of the same species as your current form, seeing you perform half again as well against them than normal from a mixture of instinctively knowing what actions they may take to just getting faster and stronger against them.

personal_data_sheet.name: Personal Data Sheet
personal_data_sheet.description: But when it comes to your own stuff, maybe it might be good to have the really nitty-gritty specifics down pat. Beyond the use of Appraisal, you now have a constant, in depth and accurate read out of every one of your abilities in your head. It tells you exactly what your body and powers can and can’t do, what they can eventually do and what it will never be able to do. It tells you exactly how to improve your abilities and all the different paths of improvement you can take with any one of your powers, along with what those paths can eventually lead to and how to walk upon them. Information is the best power of them all, since now you just need to put in the effort to reach the good stuff.

prodigy.name: Prodigy
prodigy.description: Not everyone is born equal and amongst those created with advantages, you’ve long since held the edge. You are what you are after all. You’ve been blessed with simply incredible starting statistics and skills for whatever kind of being you are. Your statistics are good enough that you could easily outmatch even a fully trained and above average adult of your species as a child only barely entering school ages. You’ve got at least half a dozen fairly useful skills as well, such as a range of small to moderate passive buffs to fighting or other skills and one or two innate magical spells that you can make use of such as a short ranged teleport or fireball. The real icing on the cake is the enormous amount of skill points you begin with, around twenty thousand. It’s enough to get dozens of different low to mid level skills or splurge for a few really big name powers.

self_medical_check.name: Self Medical Check
self_medical_check.description: And the final finale of the Appraisal series arrives! You’ve gotten Appraisal, you’ve seen all you can do, now it’s time to keep a watch on your body for good. With this, you receive information as if you were constantly self appraising without any effort or energy expenditure, allowing you to constantly see your Health Points, Mana Points and Stamina Points. More so again, you are constantly aware of every part of your body and being, with this constant appraisal allowing you to cover all of yourself with every sensory ability you have at once without any extra cost than normal. You’ll instantly notice anything that goes wrong, your body being like a holy temple where even the slightest taint is instantly obvious.

source_lisa_the_painful_rpg.description: Perks from LISA: The Painful RPG.

all-american_badas.name: All-American Badas
all-american_badas.description: As long as they go a few hours without being used, your arms and armor slowly regenerate material and effectiveness. After a day of rest, they’ll all be like new. Even better, your ranged weapons can be used without actual ammunition! Although they’re not as effective as the more traditional counterpart, by draining reserves of your own physical stamina, you can produce energy bullets for guns, energy arrows for bows, and so on. These energy projectiles look like the real thing, but they quickly dissipate on their own after being fired and don’t do as much damage.

chinese_fucking_voodoo.name: Chinese Fucking Voodoo
chinese_fucking_voodoo.description: Okay, so this technique is neither Chinese nor Voodoo, but it’s been called both by lesser men. This unlocks the genetic potential of the finger beam within you. “What’s a finger beam?,” you might ask. Have you ever pointed your finger at a person jokingly, as if it were a gun? Now you can shoot harmful lasers out of the tips of your pointer fingers when you do that. I’m not talking “sunburn” levels of hurt, either. I’m talking “seared flesh and boiling organs.” Finger beams are fuelled by a mixture of physical stamina and strong emotion towards the target- anything from hatred to annoyance to a general feeling of judgment will do

daylight_robbery.name: Daylight Robbery
daylight_robbery.description: Like any other person, you’ve got needs. Maybe you need a shiny new gun. Maybe you need a fix of Joy. Maybe you just need a stack of dirty magazines. Here’s the point: no more wasting time holding broke losers at knifepoint, alright? From now on, you know at a glance who has the goods you’re looking for. So shake ‘em down and take everything they’ve got! Be warned that this perk won’t help you figure out who’s a weak enough sheep to prey upon.

eccentric.name: Eccentric
eccentric.description: Being human isn’t about killing, stealing, raping… Animals do all of those things. What sets men apart from beasts is their capacity for creativity! You gain great motivation and creativity for an artistic craft- this can be anything from poetry, to storytelling, to playing the guitar, to drawing and painting, to… Writing hints? You might not be as tough as those meatheads out there, but they’re sure to keep you around after getting hit with a masterpiece of yours! Do note that I said “motivation.” Practice makes perfect, but you might start out… Not great at what you do.

educated.name: Educated
educated.description: You gain the equivalent of a doctorate degree’s worth of knowledge in genetics and one other STEM field. I’d suggest something a little more practical for day-to-day post-apocalyptic survival.

empowered.name: Empowered
empowered.description: You might have cool powers, but you probably have trouble using them in conjunction with traditional weapons. With this perk, you can kiss those troubles goodbye. As long as you focus on using a power, be it magic, psychic, or biological, while you use your weapon, you’ll find that your weapon naturally channels it. Poison people with bullets! Burn people with a sword! The possibilities are limitless! Be warned that this doesn’t work super well with powers that don’t cause harm. You can’t heal your friends with an axe.

false_gods_call.name: False God’s Call
false_gods_call.description: The men of Olathe are like sheep, and you will be their shepherd… There’s just the issue of getting them to obey. Thankfully, with this perk, you’ve gained a penchant for commanding formerly-sapient entities as long as they aren’t particularly bright- Joy mutants will gladly obey your commands, as will the average zombie. Vampires, on the other hand, might be less suggestible… With enough practice, you’ll find that even your music can control the hordes. Build your own future.

fire_ball_4.name: Fire Ball 4
fire_ball_4.description: What’s that? Gonna cry, bitch-tits? With this pansy-ass perk, you can harness your latent emotional angst to create powerful pyrokinetic attacks. Even a flabby, middle-aged man with no arms could use this to tear apart entire armies if he was emotionally unstable enough. Be warned- overusing these powers can in turn make your emotional state even more volatile, creating a feedback loop of fire and violence. On the upside, if you gain any other pyromantic techniques in the future (or have some already), this can bolster them and allow you to use your emotions as an alternative fuel.

flavor_text.name: Flavor Text
flavor_text.description: Huh, you’ve found a stick of dried meat, but you can’t really tell what it is. What if it’s poisoned? What if it’s human flesh? With this perk, you’ll get helpful, if odd, hints about the various useful items you find on your travels. Learn the alternative uses of cigarettes (curing poison with that smooth flavor!), the history of women’s basketball, and more as you journey through the multiverse!

healthy_coping_mechanisms.name: Healthy Coping Mechanisms
healthy_coping_mechanisms.description: The post-Flash world is a depressing, hopeless place, but that doesn’t mean you should have a shitty attitude! With this perk, you’ll be able to, at least for a little while, set aside the bad to see the good that remains. You don’t need Joy or booze- the world is enough of a drug for you. This perk cures any depression or suicidality you might have suffered from in the past.

jumper_style.name: Jumper Style
jumper_style.description: So you’ve learned like 20 different kickass martial arts styles that all do cool shit- too bad that you’re only able to really use one martial art at a time. Until now. Much like Brad Armstrong, you’ve learned how to combine your martial arts styles into something truly unique and special. As long as two fighting styles you know are at least tangentially related- boxing and karate both use fists, for example- they can be combined in new and exciting ways! What, is that not enough for you? Alright, alright. If your fighting styles have different methods of empowerment- say, one requires soul energy while another requires meditation- you can choose to simply use one or draw from your own physical endurance!

love.name: Love
love.description: Being a warrior isn’t all about theft and violence. Even the most hardened of cutthroats can lose someone important. As long as you believe that the person you’re fighting against harmed someone you loved, you will have a natural sense for where they are. No matter how far they run or where they hide, you will know exactly how to find them, how to break their heart over and over again until the pain they inflicted upon you and your friends is returned a thousandfold. You’ll gain a sense for their desires, their fears, and their fighting methods, too. All the better to strike them down. Make it slow. Make it painful.

martial_artist.name: MARTIAL ARTIST
martial_artist.description: Regardless of what you want out of life, you’ve honed your body into a deadly weapon of war. Through adherence to a traditional martial arts style, you’ve become incredibly agile and strong, capable of going toe-to-toe with the most well-armed of wasteland warriors and shattering bones with your fists. You are not the best at your art, but you are hardly a novice, either. Consider joining a dojo or gang- no matter how powerful you are, numbers are the best way to combat perverts and mutants. Your skills will revolve around being a tanky powerhouse able to persevere through the toughest of odds.

nostrodamus.name: Nostrodamus
nostrodamus.description: Much like Yado was able to predict the White Flash and prepare accordingly, you’re capable of telling what sorts of disasters will be coming to your general area. To be clear- a hurricane is a disaster. A traffic accident is not. A nuke is a disaster. A small thunderstorm is not. As long as the coming disaster qualifies as dangerous to you and the surrounding area, you’ll be able to predict its magnitude and location with pinpoint accuracy, with 3 months to make preparations. Don’t waste that time! Get yourself and your friends to safety, and prepare to capitalize on the opportunity.

one-armed_angel.name: One-Armed Angel
one-armed_angel.description: Oh no! Your arms were cut off/ your legs were bound/ your eyes were put out with a fire poker! Thankfully, you’re no quitter! You’re incredibly adaptable, capable of fighting through any physical hindrance or disability you might gain as if you’ve been dealing with it your entire life. This doesn’t mean that you’ll be exactly as effective with an arm missing as you were with both arms attached. It just means that you know how best to correct for your losses.

parkour.name: Parkour
parkour.description: Anybody could navigate the steep cliffs of Olathe, but you’ve turned a chore into an artform of agility. Leap gaps two meters across with minimal effort, sprint for hours on end, run along walls… You’re a master of getting from point A to point B! All the better for evading unsavory characters.

planner.name: Planner
planner.description: An animal lives its life day-to-day, spontaneously. You’re more than an animal, right? You gain a knack for creating elaborate plans, with the internal clock to match- an internal calendar and watch with nanosecond accuracy! Furthermore, you can easily memorize these plans and change them on the fly as situations arise and new information is learned. Perfect for robbing a bank, planning an assault, or something more… creative.

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.description: You’re not about to get your hands dirty. Thankfully, you’ve picked up an administrator’s dream- the ability to read everyone perfectly. This isn’t mind reading, but at a glance, you can see a potential recruit’s hidden potential- their strengths, their weaknesses, how loyal you could make them, what you could say to convince them to join your cause… The instant a person becomes actively hostile to you, this information is sealed off- you can’t recruit an active enemy! This also doesn’t work on those not gifted with sapience. Don’t bother trying to argue a dog or Joy mutant to your side.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.description: Everyone has to survive somehow, even if they can’t fight for their food. You’re great at peeking in corners, rifling through corpse piles, and finding that last bit of edible material. You also gain a natural resistance to foodborne illness that you might contract from ingesting your ill-gotten gains.

status_inflicter.name: Status Inflicter
status_inflicter.description: Remember how I said Touchy-Feely wasn’t magic? This perk is its magical counterpart. If the emotional intensity of your message is high enough, be it communicated through words, dance, or images, it can inflict dangerous status effects on your enemies. Deliver a sick burn to literally light someone on fire. Tell poisonous lies to someone to deliver a degenerative poison to their bloodstream. Show someone a dirty image you drew to give them a stomach bug and force them to puke. Play a song so bad that it causes blood to pour from the ears of your opponents. Nothing outright deadly, but debilitating and painful under the right circumstances. Can be combined with Chinese Fucking Voodoo to make your finger beams deliver status effects as well

thinker.name: THINKER
thinker.description: You’re a man of science. A man of… Higher power. That’s what you like to think, anyways. Truthfully, there’s not much room left in this world for the thinking man, or woman, or... Entity. I hope you have some friends who are capable of doing the dirty work for you. Your skills will revolve around executing your will far away from the bloody frontlines of those pointless gang wars.

touchy-feely.name: Touchy-Feely
touchy-feely.description: Maybe it’s not seen as traditionally “manly,” but there’s great benefits to getting in touch with your emotional side. There’s even greater benefits to getting in touch with the emotional side of your friends and foes alike! You know just the words to inspire rage, drive men to tears, and motivate your friends in battle. This isn’t necessarily magic, but you’d be surprised how much harder your friends will fight if you get them enraged at the enemy- or how poorly your enemy will fight when their eyes are filled with tears!

warrior.name: WARRIOR
warrior.description: You might’ve been an average Joe in your life before the Flash, but that all changed thanks to the apocalypse. You’re quite proficient with your weapon(s) of choice, capable of supernatural feats of prowess. Be warned that Olathian physics are pretty unusual- a gun isn’t necessarily a more effective choice of weapon than, say, a baseball bat. Olathian firearms don’t seem to need ammunition, though, so they’re both valid choices. Your skills will revolve around being a stealthy, cheaty cutthroat with a penchant for one-on-one combat.

weirdo.name: WEIRDO
weirdo.description: Well, that’s unusual. You’re not particularly good at anything. As far as I can tell, you’re actually pretty wimpy. On the upside, you get discounts on crazy-ass powers that will make people regret calling you useless. Or at the very least, they’ll help you support your friends who can actually dish out damage in a fight. Here’s a hint: stay in the back and let the actual fighters do their thing! Your skills will revolve around inflicting negative statuses in combat and providing support to allies through healing and encouragement

constanzes_knowledge.name: Constanze’s Knowledge
constanzes_knowledge.description: Like Constanze, you are an expert in magitech. You can customize any magical item by adding technology to it, combine several of them, and all your techno-magical inventions are guaranteed to work (fiat backed) and will be more effective than their purely magical versions.

language_expert.name: Language Expert
language_expert.description: You are a true language expert who can perfectly decipher even ancient dragon runes, as well as speak fish, raven, and any other strange, magical, and/or extinct language.

modern_witch.name: Modern Witch
modern_witch.description: You are a pioneer of magic who can transform any magic, no matter how ancient, into a version that can be industrialized and used with modern means. Whether it's drones, networks, or smartphones, you can easily manufacture them, and the magic becomes more effective. Just be careful to keep everything under control!

sleeping_jumper.name: Sleeping Jumper
sleeping_jumper.description: You can manifest a strange dream world in the real world, similar to Suci's, but representing yourself. This also allows you to transform into a powerful dragon, although in this state you are much more honest about your true feelings and lose all inhibitions!

sorcerers_stone.name: Sorcerer's Stone
sorcerers_stone.description: It’s a magical artifact with the capacity to absorb and store magical energy from the Ley Lines. To perform magic in this era, you need to be close to one of these stones or have a battery, although it draws its energy from ley lines, this one can operate at a lower level without them and can power about one magic academy with it.

specialty.name: Specialty
specialty.description: You are particularly skilled at a type of magic or something like mushrooms, just like Sucy, or something else like spirits, for example. This perk would also act as an amplifier for items, knowledge, perks and power related to the chosen theme.

unlikely_competence.name: Unlikely Competence
unlikely_competence.description: You automatically master any skill needed to operate your creations, whether you made them yourself or helped others make them. You start at an average level, but the more you create and the longer/more impressive your creations are, the faster you will progress. This includes knowing how to pilot a mech if you created one for example.

a_keen_nose_indeed.name: A Keen Nose Indeed
a_keen_nose_indeed.description: Your sense of smell is improved a whole lot. If something emits any smell at all, you can tell which way it is, and you can differentiate between different smells easily. This perk can be toggled on and off at will, mostly because you probably don't want the full-smell experience in any pre-hygiene settings.

chromatimancy.name: Chromatimancy
chromatimancy.description: Straybow is not as strong as Oersted - that much is apparent. But he’s still a damn good mage, and with this perk, you can follow in those footsteps. Your magical aptitude is increased - if you weren’t able to cast some basic spells before, you are now. You have also learned how to manipulate a spell’s color, changing its elemental class. A Silver Fireball, for example, will no longer burn its targets, but inflict chilling cold instead.

cosmic_coffeemaking.name: Cosmic Coffeemaking
cosmic_coffeemaking.description: You make great coffee. That’s it, that’s the whole perk! As a matter of fact, your coffee is so good that any given workplace will welcome you with open arms on that basis alone - during any kind of job interview, bringing a sample of your coffee is guaranteed to get you a foot in the door, and your coworkers will likely be glad to have you around.

dr_toeis_transhumanist_technological_tin.name: Dr. Toei’s Transhumanist Technological Tinkering
dr_toeis_transhumanist_technological_tin.description: Aside from the psionic powers, Akira’s chapter is also notable for the rather strange technological advancements humanity seems to have made in the near future, the most notable of which is Liquified Human technology. By liquifying a living person or animal, you can breathe life into machines, and in a certain sense, the person or animal can stay with you forever as part of that machine. Even if you can’t look past the obvious moral conflicts this leads to, there’s still a few cyborgs casually running about and the antique shop has an ambiguously functional teleporter, so this perk grants you extensive knowledge of all the interesting technology featured in the chapter, allowing you to replicate it if you want.

find_the_wicked.name: Find the Wicked
find_the_wicked.description: It can be difficult, dealing with all the yokai and other supernatural beings running rampant, particularly in Japan-centric settings like this one. You’re always putting yourself at risk - some spirits are mischievous, but ultimately benign, and others will kill you for touching a sword. To deal with that kind of problem, this perk grants you a good sense of any spirit-like being’s intents and morality. Anything that has a body count will immediately be obvious, for instance.

first_rule_of_the_shinobi.name: First Rule of the Shinobi
first_rule_of_the_shinobi.description: Stealth. The most important thing to a ninja is being stealthy. You now know how to move silently and remain unseen, and your abilities are rather impressive. You are ultimately still subject to human limits, but sneaking into a well-guarded building is more or less a cakewalk for you

gifted_gunslinger.name: Gifted Gunslinger
gifted_gunslinger.description: While perhaps not quite as effective as their modern-day equivalents, there’s no denying that the firearms of the Old West are one of the era’s most recognizable features. As such, you’ll want to know how to handle a gun, which is what this perk is for. Not only do you have great aim, you’re also capable of drawing your gun rather quickly - maybe you’re not the fastest gun arm in the west, but you’re definitely not slow.

grappling_genius.name: Grappling Genius
grappling_genius.description: Can’t exactly be a wrestler if you don’t know how to wrestle, now, can you? This perk increases your general physical fitness and grants you the knowledge and technical prowess associated with a wrestling style of your choice. This can also be a more general martial art, as long as it involves grappling to some extent.

hurricane_shot.name: Hurricane Shot
hurricane_shot.description: Your abilities as a gunslinger have ascended to a level that shouldn't even be possible. Whenever you're using a gun of any kind, you may use this technique to multiply your weapon's rate of fire and clip size by a randomized one of the following values: x0.5, x1, x2, x4, x8, x20. Round down if necessary. Your ammo consumption does not increase from using this ability; your gun just shoots more bullets than you actually put in.

incognito_mode.name: Incognito Mode
incognito_mode.description: Malevolent AIs are incapable of detecting you. Whether you’re hacking your way into the haywire supercomputer or just shooting the killer robot, they will never detect your presence on its own - they may deduce it using other information, such as the fact that they’re taking damage, but you’re effectively invisible until something gives you away.

lucretian_swordsmanship.name: Lucretian Swordsmanship
lucretian_swordsmanship.description: Look, it’s a fantasy world. Without any combat training, living here would suck. Pick two nonmagical weapons appropriate to the age; swords, polearms, axes, bows, anything you want. You are now trained in using the weapons in question, and while wielding either of them, you gain a bit of protection from unholy influences.

master_of_rigging.name: Master of Rigging
master_of_rigging.description: Be it regular rigging or jury-rigging, you really know your stuff. You are an expert at setting up traps and ambushes, and your ability to find creative uses for common household objects rivals the likes of MacGyver. With your knowledge, you could stop a large gang of armed criminals using nothing but the sparse belongings of a small town and the good will of its inhabitants. The Old West is unpredictable, and now, so are you.

mystical_ninjutsu.name: Mystical Ninjutsu
mystical_ninjutsu.description: Any self-respecting ninja needs to know at least one secret technique. That’s just common sense. The ninja of the Enma-clan in particular seem to have amassed quite the collection, from clearly supernatural stratagems such as Blazing Firefly, Sand Arts and Chill Wind, to more straightforward attacks such as the aptly named Shuriken Storm or the powerful sword technique Bronze Leaf. Now, not only are you capable of using these techniques, you could probably come up with ninja techniques of your own, too - after all, what technique could possibly be more secret than one you thought of yourself?

oo_-burp-.name: Oo -Burp-
oo_-burp-.description: You now have the power of farts on your side. No, wait, please don't go! Basically, this perk allows you to release a toxic gas (which you are immune to) on-command. I'll leave it at that, okay? It doesn't HAVE to be a fart joke. It could be, like, a breath weapon or something. See? Compromise!

power_jacking.name: Power Jacking
power_jacking.description: You have gained the ability to hack your way into devices via their power source. Any device that relies on a public power supply is pretty easy to put under your control, and even with private power supplies, it’s only a matter of connecting to that power supply yourself. Battery-powered devices might be trouble, though. This also allows you to hack devices that should by all means be too simple to hack. Light switches, for example. You’re also granted some decent hacking skills, if you didn’t possess them already.

psychic_powers.name: Psychic Powers
psychic_powers.description: You have some basic psychic abilities. You’re a rather talented mindreader, although you’re only capable of reading the minds of humans and former humans. You’re also pretty good at manipulating senses, and you specialize in manipulating pain. The offensive capabilities of this are obvious, but temporarily dulling someone’s pain can also be quite useful as a support ability. Lastly, your telekinesis isn’t that strong, but it’s there, and that means you can pilot Buriki Daioh if you put in the work.

sticks_and_stones.name: Sticks and Stones
sticks_and_stones.description: You have developed a rather... unique method of craftsmanship. Here's how it works: By crudely smashing two material items into one another, you can force them to stick together via cartoon physics. It doesn't make a whole lot of sense and it looks very peculiar, but it does the job and it's easy to do in a pinch. Of course, you have to apply a large amount of force for this to work as intended, so it's unsuited for precision work.

strength_of_the_humble.name: Strength of the Humble
strength_of_the_humble.description: Respect is a major theme in Masaru’s story, and as such, Masaru’s respect for his opponents is a major source of his power. From now on, you gain an intuitive understanding of the techniques of anyone you consider a worthy opponent. This doesn’t necessarily mean you’ll be able to use the technique, but it does grant you knowledge of the training or features you would require. Your understanding will not fade as long as you retain your respect for the opponent in question.

students_potential.name: Student’s Potential
students_potential.description: No one is born a master. Even you probably started out as a novice. But you have something most people don’t have: Potential. With this perk, tutelage from a competent master will always result in some kind of useful lesson for you, so you’ll never find yourself completely unable to improve. Any teachers you trust will also gain an intuitive understanding of how they should adjust their teaching style in order to play to your strengths.

teachers_legacy.name: Teacher’s Legacy
teachers_legacy.description: The old Xin Shan Quan master passed on the same techniques to all of his students, yet each of them ended up with different abilities - how could this be? The answer is that each of the students developed their own style based on their master’s teachings. With this perk, you can develop the same kind of legacy for your abilities. Not only do you gain better teaching skills, you also develop an intuitive understanding of who could put their own spin on which of your skillsets - after all, any field can benefit from some new blood!

the_eternal_sentiment.name: The Eternal Sentiment
the_eternal_sentiment.description: Choose an emotion. You can now tap into humanity’s supply of that emotion to power up your own abilities. The more humans feel your selected emotion, the stronger you become, and any abilities that rely on your own emotions can now be powered using all of humanity’s emotions instead. You also cannot be killed by anyone fueled by the selected emotion - anything that would normally kill you just bounces right off instead.

adaptation.name: Adaptation
adaptation.description: You have the ability to adapt to the magic of whatever world you go to. It takes time for this adaptation to take place, generally in the range of 3-6 months and it is dependent on a variety of factors such as the complexity of the magic, how common it is, and it's strength. If that world has multiple magic systems, then you adapt to them simultaneously. You can choose to reject magic systems you don't want.

alchemist_atelier.name: Alchemist (Atelier)
alchemist_atelier.description: You're an Alchemist - someone capable of using Alchemy to synthesize various different useful items out of otherwise useless seeming materials. While this requires discovering and creating various recipies and is highly dependent on the materials you have access to, the tools an alchemist can create are varied and surprising, ranging from simple things such as bombs and magically restorative foods to exotic magic items like needles which can pin the soul in place, paintings which can be entered and exited freely, flutes which can conjure monsters to destroy your foes, tents which are full fledged ateliers on the inside, potions that can damage the barriers between dimensions, and other such strange devices. While the recipes can shift to some degree based on the region you're in, you have an immense talent at Alchemy, allowing you to quickly figure out substitutions for missing materials, alternate recipies for the same ends, and methods of replicating or refining items which you've already created.

aondor_cosmere.name: AonDor (Cosmere)
aondor_cosmere.description: You are an Elantrian, a being that is ageless, has enhanced physical and mental attributes, and has the ability to use AonDor. AonDor requires Elantrians to draw the symbols known as Aons in light. These can have modifiers added to them and can be used in a variety of ways to heal, teleport and produce light.

archon_tyranny.name: Archon (Tyranny)
archon_tyranny.description: Archons are individuals who wield immense arcane power. No one knows how the Archons gain their arcane strength. Some Archons are born into power and privilege. Others were beggars in the street before their powers manifested. The true measure of an Archon is not some sort of birthright, but their life and achievements: An Archon becomes one through belief. As the future Archon grows confident in their power and more importantly, the people who surround them start to believe in their power, it increases organically. While all Archons possess magical powers, there is no other common thread between these women and men. An Archon might be made of fire, capable of conjuring storms, or able to heal with a touch - the only defining trait of an Archon is that this magic power originates from within. It is unclear how Archons come into their powers, but it is generally understood that most grow into or develop magical power throughout their lives, with only a few notable exceptions (such as Sirin, Archon of Song) having shown powers seemingly from birth. You are an Archon at roughly the same level of power as the Voices of Nerat or Graven Ashe, with a focus of similar breadth and depth to them.

boundary_manipulation_touhou.name: Boundary Manipulation (Touhou)
boundary_manipulation_touhou.description: Boundary Manipulation, as the name suggests, is the ability to manipulate the conceptual boundaries of things. This can be used to accomplish such things as manipulating the boundary of life and death, the boundary between night and day, or the boundary between one object and another, and so much more. In fact, it can be said that everything that exists is built upon boundaries, for if there were no boundaries, all things would simply be one large object. In this way, it can be said that the manipulation of boundaries is a power of both creation and destruction. As such, logically speaking, it can affect just about anything. Furthermore, it can be used to create a "gap" connecting two locations.

core_matrix.name: Core Matrix
core_matrix.description: You are able to create 'Cores' of Magic, that are constructs that functionally act as spellcasters in their own right that reside within your soul. It takes time for a full 'Core' to be created, and it will start at a level far below your own. Eventually, it will grow to reach your level of strength, complexity and finesse. Each 'Core' allows for it's own instance of spellcasting, increasing the number of spells you can cast simultaneously. You can cast spells and grant rituals that require multiple people on your own by using linked cores as a fill-in for another person. You can also combine the 'Cores' to use all of their power to cast as a singular entity if you wish, but this is incredibly difficult. You can also create cores focused specifically only on one type of magic, or one only one of the magic systems you have for even greater results. The specialization can be something as broad as Conjuration, or something as niche as Repair of Small Objects, though the broader it is, the lesser the boost it provides.

dawnshard_cosmere.name: Dawnshard (Cosmere)
dawnshard_cosmere.description: You have a Dawnshard, a primal Command used by Adonalsium to create all things once. Each Dawnshard grants separate abilities, as well as powers accessible via any Dawnshard, and can supercharge Invested Arts, allowing for acts of magic that transcend what is normally possible. An example of this is turning surgebinding into a power that destroyed the world Ashyn.

drafting_lightbringer.name: Drafting (Lightbringer)
drafting_lightbringer.description: Drafting is the act of harnessing and shaping light into a physical form, known as luxin. People who have this ability are known as drafters. You start off as a Monochrome, who can only draft one standard color, and a superchromat. You will not have to worry about losing your powers or your halo breaking.

elemental_manipulation.name: Elemental Manipulation
elemental_manipulation.description: You can manipulate elements such as fire or earth with ease, and don't require any structured spells to aid you. >Requires Magic (Mother of Learning)

empathy.name: Empathy
empathy.description: You have empathy, which is a side effect of being what the Aranea (race of sentient telepathic spiders) would call being Open. It means that you are a psychic, and a natural mind mage. When untrained, this manifests as an ability to sense the emotions of others. >Requires Magic (Mother of Learning)

faerie_mantle.name: Faerie Mantle
faerie_mantle.description: You have some sort of Faerie Mantle, such as Winter/Summer Knight or even some other title. This will grant you enhanced power and abilities associated with the mantle, but will have an effect on your mind the more you use this. It is not insurmountable, however. >Requires Magic (Dresden Files)

gate_spell.name: Gate Spell
gate_spell.description: Through some means, you are capable of creating a Gate or a Portal to another world. The specific means and limitations of such a spell are dependent on what type of magic you use, and how much power you have.

kaleidoscope_type-moon.name: Kaleidoscope (Type-Moon)
kaleidoscope_type-moon.description: The Second Magic, known as Zelretch or Kaleidoscope, is one of five remaining Magics in the modern Nasuverse. Its domain is the Operation of Parallel Worlds. It can be used to observe parallel worlds, gather magical energy from them, and to travel them.

limitless.name: Limitless
limitless.description: You can now break the hard limits of the function of a system with enough research and exposure to esoteric elements within that system. It will not be by any means easy but there will be few horizons beyond your reach now. This does not however have an effect on the mechanism of how the magic system is wielded.

magic_dresden_files.name: Magic (Dresden Files)
magic_dresden_files.description: The term Magic has two related meanings. First, it refers to a supernatural force or energy described as "the essence of life and creation". This energy is known by many names, some of which are mana, juju, totem, chi, bioethereal power, The Force, and the soul. Second, it refers to the practice of harnessing this force to produce changes in reality. This practice is sometimes also referred to as sorcery and the Art. An act of magic is called a spell, and the act of performing a spell is referred to as casting. Most supernatural beings are capable of performing magic, as are some mortals, who are referred to as practitioners. You start as a practitioner with enough talent to easily qualify for the White Council, and knowledge of the basics.

magic_mother_of_learning.name: Magic (Mother of Learning)
magic_mother_of_learning.description: Magic refers to the process of manipulating mana to achieve a desired result. Mana comes in two forms. Mana that is created by living beings, their own personal 'well', and ambient mana. Amvient mana must be assimilated safely before it can be used, otherwise it is dangerously poisonous. There are two forms of controlling mana. Unstructured and Structured magic. Unstructured magic generally takes the form of shaping exercises, where mages shape mana without the assistance of a spell boundary to improve their shaping skills. Structured magic involves spell boundaries that set hard limits for spells. It disallows the mana within from being freely and flexibly controlled as with Unstructured magic, but allows for extreme complexity in the spell created. Magic is divided in fifteen major disciplines, and two 'support' fields. You start with knowledge of the basics, and a random but below average level of magical potential.

nalka.name: Nälkä
nalka.description: Nälkä is a religious/philosophical system proning the use of organic manipulation (ex: blood magic, biomancy, plague crafting, etc...) to transcend the physical limitations of baseline humans. You have the potential of their messiah, the Grand Karcist Ion, but only the abilities of a regular Karcist: complete knowledge of animal biology, regenerative immortality, touched-based flesh manipulation, shapeshifting, bacterial and viral manipulation, pheromone-based hivemind, ect... While your starting abilities are limited by biology and physics, these limits will fade as you grow in power, developping abilities such as ex-nihilo regeneration, telepathy, the creation of organisms free from the conservation of mass, etc...

occultist_real_life.name: Occultist (Real Life)
occultist_real_life.description: A bunch of real world occult practices and whatnot you can pick up which actually works. This encompasses real practices like Kabbalah, and black magic. Not based on any setting in particular, more something you can take so that you can practice magic without having to link it to a specific book, anime, show, movie, or whatever.

path_finding_otherverse.name: Path Finding (Otherverse)
path_finding_otherverse.description: You can Find Paths like Practitioners in the Otherverse, except you have the ability to traverse Paths that lead to other worlds/universes. You gain rewards at the end of the Path, and you can find various Others and other beings on these Paths that may obstruct you.

ritual_path_magic_gurps_monster_hunters.name: Ritual Path Magic (GURPS Monster Hunters)
ritual_path_magic_gurps_monster_hunters.description: You're trained in thaumaturgy - the science of magic. By calling upon your occult knowledge, you're able to draw in the mana from your environment and use it to enact rituals to change the world near-arbitrarily in accordance with your will. While such rituals are slow, finicky, and dangerous if miscast, you're also able to store them in a limited number mystical charms in order to unleash them for later use. Considering the large amount of time, the purified spaces, and the sympathetic connections required to cast all but the least of rituals, it may be wise to take advantage of this methodology.

sand_mastery_cosmere.name: Sand Mastery (Cosmere)
sand_mastery_cosmere.description: Sand Mastery involves manipulation of white sand at the cost of the user's internal water supply. In addition, white sand that has been manipulated will turn black, becoming unresponsive. Black sand turns white again after four hours of sun exposure. You start off with a gourd full of White Sand.

savant_syndrome.name: Savant Syndrome
savant_syndrome.description: You are now a Savant at wielding magic. Magic is something that will intuitively make sense to you on levels that will make you easily on par with the most intelligent of geniuses, though only in Magical Fields. Everything just comes easier to you, and you can just... figure things out with magic sometimes. You can on the fly come up with magical formulae and spells to solve your problems.

shadow_magic_elder_scrolls.name: Shadow Magic (Elder Scrolls)
shadow_magic_elder_scrolls.description: Shadow Magic is an obscure but powerful form of magic. It was first harnessed by Azra Nightwielder, who was the first to discover that shadow was not simply an absence of light, but a reflection of possible worlds created by forces in conflict. Shadows can be produced by mundane forces such as light hitting a rock, or by more powerful forces such as nations at war. Shadow Magic involves the manipulation of shadows to affect the forces creating it. In this way, Shadow Magic rivals even the power of the Elder Scrolls themselves, having the power to potentially change the past, present, and future through the manipulation of shadow. At its strongest, it even has the capabilities of reaching into and affecting the multiverse. Shadow magic has the potential to carry a high price for its usage, for its nature is to turn on their casters, and shadowmages are often distrusted because of this.

shifter.name: Shifter
shifter.description: Being a Shifter means that you have the ability to transform into an animal of some sort. You gain instincts of the animal with this. Choose any animal. If you choose a magical one, you are liable to go insane. >Requires Magic (Mother of Learning)

soul_perception.name: Soul Perception
soul_perception.description: Soul perception is the ability to see and sense other people's souls, also known as soul sight. It is needed to perform most soul magic spells, although it is not strictly necessary as there are meditation exercises capable of giving a similar extent of soul perception, although only in regards to one's own soul. >Requires Magic (Mother of Learning)

soulfire.name: Soulfire
soulfire.description: You have been blessed with a spark of Soulfire. This allows you to use part of your spiritual energy to reinforce your magic, making it more "real." This can be used for any kinds of spells, but especially is appropriate for acts of creation (i.e. summoning, illusions). Be warned, as this does drain your life force temporarily; overuse can potentially kill you. >Requires Magic (Dresden Files)

the_practice_otherverse.name: The Practice (Otherverse)
the_practice_otherverse.description: You are a practitioner. A practitioner is a human who has "Awakened" and thus become involved in the world of Others and the supernatural. Doing so enables them to interact with the world in a different manner than normal people can at a cost. The typical means of doing so is a ritual where the person makes a contract with spirits that gives them the ability to tangle with supernatural elements at the cost of being unable to lie freely. You start as a freshly Awakened Practitioner with knowledge of the basics.
