alpha_genes.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of every genetic sequence, xenotype, and gene variant introduced in the Alpha Genes mod for RimWorld. This knowledge includes detailed instructions on how to extract, synthesize, stabilize, and implant these genes effectively. However, this perk grants only the knowledge - it does not provide the laboratory equipment, sophisticated machinery, or practical skills required to perform the genetic manipulation itself. To make use of these blueprints, you must possess the necessary tools and expertise, such as the Biotech perk from a RimWorld or similar gene-engineering capabilities from another setting. Without those, this compendium remains purely theoretical.

auto_dissector.name: Auto Dissector
auto_dissector.description: "An automated surgical device has been added to your arsenal. This machine can precisely remove diseased organs, detach bionic implants you deem unnecessary, or (for those with less ethical inclinations) process prisoners efficiently for bulk extraction of desired body parts." You receive one fully functional Auto Dissector from the mod of the same name. This sophisticated piece of medical machinery handles delicate surgical extraction with robotic precision, minimizing tissue damage and maximizing organ viability. Whether you need to harvest implants from traitors, remove cancerous organs for replacement, or simply process a prison population for valuable components, this machine does the job quickly and cleanly. Along with the unit itself, you receive a thick, detailed technical manual containing comprehensive instructions on how to operate the machine, perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot common issues, and (with sufficient study) construct additional units from scratch. Good luck figuring it out! (The machine's ethical subroutines are optional. Your conscience is your own.)

gene_fabrication.name: Gene Fabrication
gene_fabrication.description: "Are you tired of spending hours grinding quests, extracting prisoners, and trading across the galaxy just to find one specific gene? When your mod list includes hundreds of new xenotypes and genetic variants, is it really worth losing your sanity over the grind? Now there is a solution." With the Gene Fabrication bench, you can synthesize any gene you have encountered or possess a sample of, eliminating the need for endless searching and random chance. You receive one fully functional Gene Fabrication bench from the mod of the same name, along with a thick, detailed technical manual. This manual contains comprehensive instructions on how to operate the machine, perform routine maintenance, troubleshoot common issues, and (with sufficient study) construct additional units from scratch. Good luck figuring it out! (The knowledge is in the manual. Probably. You did read the manual, right?)

glittertech_expansion.name: Glittertech Expansion
glittertech_expansion.description: The pinnacle of glitterworld science is now within your reach. You gain the ability to manufacture a wide array of advanced devices from the Glittertech Expansion mod for RimWorld. This perk provides you with a basic understanding of the underlying principles behind this technology. From luxury goods to high-performance equipment, the marvels of glitterworld engineering are yours to command.

hacking_expansion.name: Hacking Expansion
hacking_expansion.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every device, tool, and system introduced in the Hacking Expansion mod for RimWorld. This knowledge encompasses everything from cryptographic analyzers and hacking tools to mainframe interfaces and security override modules. Unlike mere theoretical understanding, this perk also grants you the practical skills and technical expertise required to actually construct, deploy, and operate these devices effectively. You know how to interface with various computer systems, bypass security protocols, and utilize your crafted tools to their fullest potential.

integrated_implants.name: Integrated Implants
integrated_implants.description: You possess a complete mental compendium of every cybernetic implant, bionic prosthetic, and neural interface introduced in the Integrated Implants mod for RimWorld. This knowledge includes detailed schematics, component lists, and precise surgical instructions for fabricating and installing each augmentation effectively. Unlike purely theoretical knowledge, this perk also grants you the practical skills and technical expertise required to perform the delicate work of implant construction and surgical implantation. Your hands know the techniques, your eyes recognize the proper tolerances, and your mind understands the biological and cybernetic principles at play. However, knowledge and skill are worthless without the proper tools. This perk provides no equipment, no fabrication benches, no surgical tools, and no sterile facilities or skills to manufacture them. To actually produce and install these implants, you must acquire the necessary machinery and medical equipment through other means.

lost_factory_mechanoids.name: Lost Factory Mechanoids
lost_factory_mechanoids.description: You possess the knowledge and capability to establish a small-scale production facility dedicated to crafting the advanced machines and devices featured in the Lost Factory Mechanoids and Mechanoid Upgrades mods for RimWorld. This perk provides you with a comprehensive mental compendium of technical knowledge, granting you a perfect understanding of the schematics, construction processes, and underlying principles for all items within these mods. You know how to build, maintain, and repair everything from autonomous worker drones to formidable combat mechanoids and their powerful upgrades.

rimsenal_pack.name: Rimsenal Pack
rimsenal_pack.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for items, structures, and even some creatures from the Rimsenal Pack of mods for RimWorld. This includes the full range of faction-specific weapons, armors, apparel, turrets, production facilities, and unique biological entities introduced across the Rimsenal series. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items using available materials. Additionally, you gain an incredible natural talent for employing weapons for their intended purpose, allowing you to wield even unfamiliar firearms and armaments with surprising effectiveness. This perk provides only basic background scientific knowledge. Without deeper foundational understanding, your creations will easily default to tinkertech status: reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and difficult for others to replicate or maintain.

vanilla_furniture_expanded.name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded
vanilla_furniture_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Furniture Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes all variants of production benches, decorative furnishings, storage solutions, and specialized structures introduced across the entire furniture expansion suite. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively construct and utilize these items using available materials.

vanilla_genetics_expanded.name: Vanilla Genetics Expanded
vanilla_genetics_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Genetics Expanded mod for RimWorld. This includes genetic labs, gene extractors, mutagens, and all equipment needed for animal hybridization and genetic manipulation. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively utilize and create these items. However, this perk provides no in-depth scientific knowledge. If you do not also possess the Biotech perk from the RimWorld category, your genetic creations will function as tinkertech - reliable in your hands but poorly understood, and nearly impossible for others to replicate or maintain.

vanilla_vehicles_expande.name: Vanilla Vehicles Expande
vanilla_vehicles_expande.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable item from the Vanilla Vehicles Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes all vehicle chassis, engines, weapon mounts, utility modules, and specialized transport options across the entire expanded vehicle lineup. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills needed to effectively construct, maintain, and operate these vehicles. Additionally, you gain a significant degree of natural talent for any vehicle-related mechanical fields (including repair, customization, and performance optimization) allowing you to coax maximum capability from any wheeled or tracked conveyance.

vanilla_weapons_expanded.name: Vanilla Weapons Expanded
vanilla_weapons_expanded.description: You gain a complete mental compendium of blueprints for every craftable weapon from the Vanilla Weapons Expanded series of mods for RimWorld. This includes the full range of ballistic firearms, melee armaments, grenades, heavy weapons, and specialized munitions introduced across the entire expanded arsenal. Alongside these blueprints, you receive the practical skills and working knowledge needed to effectively utilize, maintain, and create these weapons using available materials and facilities.

calamity_expansion.name: Calamity Expansion
calamity_expansion.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Calamity mod and its various addons for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including legendary effects, unique abilities, and devastating power, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Calamity item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and god-slaying properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Redemption mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including holy abilities, corrupted powers, and unique mechanical functions, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Redemption item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and redemption-forged properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

spirit_expansion.name: Spirit Expansion
spirit_expansion.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the various versions of the Spirit mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including ethereal abilities, spirit-infused powers, and unique class mechanics, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Spirit mod item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech - unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and spiritual essence of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical properties from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

starlight_river.name: Starlight River
starlight_river.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Starlight River mod for Terraria, including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants. Their special properties, including unique effects, celestial abilities, and luminous qualities, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Starlight River item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and starlight-infused properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

thorium.name: Thorium
thorium.description: You gain the ability to craft all types of items from the Thorium mod for Terraria (including unobtainable and hardmode-exclusive variants). Their special properties, including class-defining abilities, unique set bonuses, and powerful effects, are preserved due to the supernatural component of this perk. You possess a complete mental compendium of every Thorium item recipe, along with the enhanced skill needed to produce them. You may attempt to craft these items using normal, non-Terraria materials, but doing so will cause the resulting creations to function as tinkertech: unreliable, prone to malfunction, and lacking the full potency and thorium-infused properties of a properly made item. For best results, you should use materials sourced directly from Terraria or resources sufficiently similar in nature, rarity, and magical essence from other worlds. This perk provides a significant boost to your skills only while you are actively working on items included within its scope. However, through repeated exposure to the crafting process, you may slowly learn some mundane, non-magical techniques that can be applied more broadly.

akhlut.name: Akhlut
akhlut.description: You gain the companionship of an Akhlut - a legendary apex predator of the ocean depths, once called "killer of whales" by ancient sailors. Beyond its status as an unstoppable hunter, it carries a profound connection to the afterworld. When overhunting emptied the seas, Akhlut learned to walk upon land and preyed upon humanity itself. No weapon could harm them. Only through ancient rituals could shamans link their spirits with these beasts, taming them through spiritual communion rather than force. Your Akhlut arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within the limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity - a spirit-bound predator that walks between worlds at your side.

gryphonix.name: Gryphonix
gryphonix.description: You gain the companionship of a Gryphonix - a stout, fiery hybrid with the body of a lion and wings and head of an eagle. Despite its rarity, it remains one of the most celebrated monsters, depicted across the Old World as loyal defenders of rulers, tombs, and gold. Its mere symbol was believed to ward off evil. Created two thousand years ago by the sun god (likely the Spectral Eagle) as a gift to the Aztor kingdom. Beyond its noble lineage, your Gryphonix is the cutest puppy and exceptionally adept at carrying you across any land with grace and speed. Your Gryphonix arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within the limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity: a sun-touched guardian and loyal mount rolled into one impossibly adorable package.

kanko_-_the_pipe_fox.name: Kanko - the Pipe Fox
kanko_-_the_pipe_fox.description: You gain the companionship of a Kanko - an aerial spirit beast summoned through pipe embers and smoke, known as "pipe foxes" to the initiated. They exude a protective aura against evil spirits and defend their master with ferocious dedication, formidable even against the largest of otherworldly foes. The last remnant of a solitary mountain village brought this ancient summoning art to the Monster Sanctuary, preserving mystic arts that would otherwise have vanished. Your Kanko arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within the limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity: a spirit guardian bound to you through smoke and ancient rite.

megataur.name: Megataur
megataur.description: You gain the companionship of a Megataur - a colossal beast-man of the frozen peaks, evolved from ancient Minotaur stock through generations of adaptation to the harshest mountain conditions. Its strength, endurance, and sturdiness are unparalleled, a living fortress of muscle and elemental control. Mild-tempered by nature, your Megataur is a gentle guardian within lands it considers its own. But should anger be ignited, there is no force in the peaks that can stand against its wrath - only flight remains. It commands both brute power and the elements themselves, a fusion of raw might and frozen fury. Your Megataur arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity, standing as an immovable shield and an unstoppable hammer when the need arises.

raduga.name: Raduga
raduga.description: You gain the companionship of a Raduga - the most majestic of all bird-like monsters, save perhaps the Spectral Eagle. While the Eagle commands storm and sun, the Raduga symbolizes universal balance. Its distinct long tail feathers represent the four elements, and its mere presence fills all beings with hope and vigor. For centuries, keepers sought this mythical being across the Old World. Legends claimed it appears only in lands of complete peace. In 400 AC, on the Sanctuary's anniversary, the Raduga finally revealed itself soaring above - a moment of unprecedented celebration. Your Raduga arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within the limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity: a living symbol of elemental balance.

spectral_eagle.name: Spectral Eagle
spectral_eagle.description: You gain the companionship of the Spectral Eagle, the bravest of the ancient familiars. Once revered as an embodiment of the sun with dominion over winds and weather, this majestic creature was patron to sailors, traders, and desert peoples, and is honored still by pirate captains who keep colorful birds in tribute. The Spectral Eagle arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within certain limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity. Fiercely loyal and bound to you by bonds stronger than death itself, this companion grants you a watchful eye from above and swift passage when winds obey its call.

spectral_lion.name: Spectral Lion
spectral_lion.description: You gain the companionship of the Spectral Lion, the noblest and most heroic of the ancient familiars. Once revered as a guardian of prairies and jungles, this majestic beast was said to hunt demons, shield the pure of heart, and command a wrath that wise folk never provoked. The Spectral Lion arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within certain limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity. As a natural leader and protector, its presence grants you unwavering courage and guards against perils.

spectral_toad.name: Spectral Toad
spectral_toad.description: You gain the companionship of the Spectral Toad, the wisest and most generous of the ancient familiars. Once revered in coastal lands and misty swamps, this enigmatic creature was sought by aspiring wizards for the arcane secrets it guards - a perilous journey that rewards the worthy with profound knowledge. The Spectral Toad arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within certain limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity. As a natural teacher and keeper of wisdom, it enhances your studies, sharpens your recollection, and may occasionally reveal secrets that others would miss.

spectral_wolf.name: Spectral Wolf
spectral_wolf.description: You gain the companionship of the Spectral Wolf, one of the ancient and legendary familiars from the Old World. Cunning, perceptive, and fiercely loyal, this ethereal wolf was once the guardian of snowy mountains and dark forests - a friend to those who prefer the wilds over civilization. The Spectral Wolf arrives at a level of power proportional to your own, growing alongside you within certain limits of its nature. Through your soul-deep connection, it understands your commands, desires, and goals with preternatural clarity, acting as both trusted companion and keen-eyed judge of character. Its presence grants you sharper instincts and a faithful ally who will never abandon you to the dark.

source_nausicaa_of_the_valley_of_the_win.source: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
source_nausicaa_of_the_valley_of_the_win.description: Perks from Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind.

nausicaa_engineering.name: Nausicaä Engineering
nausicaa_engineering.description: You possess the technological knowledge of the world after the Seven Days of Fire. Your knowledge is practical and rooted in remnant-based engineering - making do with what remains while reaching toward what was lost. This covers two distinct fields: >Mechanical: You can build machines from exotic and simple materials alike, including aircraft technology ranging from Eftal's flying ships to Dorok's hovering wooden constructs, with foundational knowledge that points toward true spacecraft. >Biotechnology: You understand cloning, the creation of consuming molds, biological enhancements for survivability and lifespan, and even the transfer of minds between bodies.

academy-educated.name: “Academy-Educated”
academy-educated.description: Suspicion of technology came to a peak in the Origin Era, but you were never one to distrust it. Instead, you worked hard and studied the sciences of Penglai, managing to attain a passable understanding of most Solarian machinery. In addition to this, you’re educated in the basic principles of telelurgy, their form of programming, and can use the tools of a craftsman well enough to make decent-quality items with them.

avian.name: Avian
avian.description: The Yumin Kingdom of Penglai was one of the poorest, most resource-starved places on the planet. To counteract these problems, crops were widely genetically modified and vertical farms and cities developed. The inhabitants incorporated the genes of birds into their bodies, and now you have as well. Your arms have become a pair of wings, maintaining their original function while allowing you to fly to low altitudes. You may optionally replace your legs with a pair of cybernetics resembling bird feet.

divert_the_waters_break_the_rocks.name: Divert the Waters, Break the Rocks
divert_the_waters_break_the_rocks.description: It takes no small amount of work to eke out a living from the soil, even in a place as ‘blessed’ as Peach Blossom Village, but you could do so. You have a strong body, and all the skills of a subsistence farmer. You can tend animals and crops, clear fields for use, build houses from wood, straw and bamboo, and more.

eight_pillars.name: [八柱] Eight Pillars
eight_pillars.description: Grand problems require grand solutions - and not only to draw from one discipline or area. You could lead or inspire such massive projects as New Kunlun or the Haotian Sphere, or create world-changing movements like the Fangshi Guild, thanks to a combination of tremendous administrative skill, a strange affinity for attracting or finding just the right people, and a knack for noticing synergies between existing technologies that others might miss. In the spirit of this, you’ve come to understand the greatest achievement of Solarian technology: the Warp Drive. It would be a colossal undertaking and megaproject, but it’d allow you to generate wormholes for FTL travel if successful. With the right support, you could propel your world into a new era—for better, and worse.

forged_in_agony.name: [善变] Forged in Agony
forged_in_agony.description: Though a wasteland, the Jie Kingdom had great mineral wealth, and would have conquered Penglai if not foiled by the Fangshi Guild. One of their greatest technological advances, however, was the field of Transmutation - a science with which you are intimately familiar. Endowed with an astounding capability to endure and accept biological modification of all kinds, you have been subjected to the Crucibles many times and emerged… better, than you were before. You boast physical strength and resilience far above the normal limits for your kind. Furthermore, your ordeals have made pain a familiar companion, to be embraced rather than avoided. Instead of debilitating you, pain only invigorates you, sharpening your perceptions and waking your passion for the fight.

huangdi.name: [皇帝] Huangdi
huangdi.description: Like Shuanshuan, you’re something of a polymath. You can learn new skills with exceptional speed - even if you’re not all that good at first, you’ll still advance rapidly. Moreover, you are excellent at finding synergies and combinations between various skills, making something more than the sum of its parts - and at teaching others what you know, individually or on a grand scale. And like Shennong, you have all the qualities needed to lead a people to prosperity. The charisma to have them gather around you, the wisdom to see through the lies that others would believe, and all in all, you could lead your people to a point where they will never need to pray to false gods for help again. Perhaps one day, you might be acclaimed as the originator of a whole culture.

i-ching.name: [易經] I-Ching
i-ching.description: The Tao that can be spoken is not the eternal Tao. Yet, one can still achieve some limited comprehension. Through ancient mystic techniques, you have learned how to read prophecies from the Tao, making use of various divinatory techniques to glimpse truths of the future, the present or the past. You cannot always gain information about a specific event or point, but when you can you will always be able to tell such divinations for truth, though they may be less than entirely clear or specific. Furthermore, by harmonising with and harnessing the limitless energies of the Tao, you can exhibit miraculous telekinetic powers, whether moving yourself through the air, or manipulating weapons at a distance, or perform subtler feats, such as calming the ripples of a pool with a precise touch at just the right point, or balancing upon the thinnest branch.

kanghui_regeneration_gene.name: Kanghui Regeneration Gene
kanghui_regeneration_gene.description: Though it brought him only misfortune, the Solarian Kanghui was possessed of remarkable vitality, aging very slowly, and able to regenerate his body at great speed. You now share in this power, able to recover from wounds at great speed, and resist the onset of diseases like the Tianhuo - but this grants you no additional strength to escape imprisonment. This regeneration does have a limit, though; if your head is cut off or your brain destroyed, you will not be able to recover

leaps_and_bounds.name: Leaps and Bounds
leaps_and_bounds.description: Many of the Sols are skilled scientists in their own right, and their duties as administrators of the island often relate to their field of specialty. You have such a specialty as well; an expert level of knowledge in one of the following fields, and the skill to find new applications or develop new techniques as well: ● Engineering: Like Kuafu, you are an excellent engineer, capable of creating new devices based on advanced Solarian technology with amazing speed, such as rhizomatic columns. You can also modify equipment, outfitting Solarian bows with specialized ammunition or granting additional effects to Talisman strikes. ● Transmutation: Like Jiequan, you are skilled in the techniques of transmutation, able to combine cybernetics and mutagenic technologies to forge powerful war-machines and genoguards. You specialize in using biological or chemical factors to induce desired genetic changes in an organism, and can use it to strengthen or heal yourself or others. ● Agriculture: Like Goumang, you are familiar with all the technologies and techniques required to feed great numbers of people with little arable land, as well as to develop new crops for the purpose. Botany is your primary field, followed by knowledge of irrigation, nutrition, and ecology. ● Medicine: Like Eigong, your specialty is in medical science and the manipulation of genetics, allowing you to synthesize cures for most diseases, identify and isolate useful genetic sequences, or even hybridise them into new beings. You’ve even taken steps into regenerative medicine and longevity, but that’s a slippery slope… ● Soulscapes: Like Lady Ethereal, you are an expert on the intricate neuroscience and computing technologies of the Solarians, as well as the ways they can interact with living minds. You are also familiar with the applications of cryotechnology, and know how to preserve a nervous system for various purposes, such as wetware computers. This perk may be taken once per specialization.

limitless_sage.name: [无极] Limitless Sage
limitless_sage.description: Through meditation, you can enter a strange and limitless realm, very close to the Tao. While within this realm you need no nourishment, time passes strangely, and you may encounter phantoms of times long past, visions of sages in their youth, or speak with spirits who have not yet quite passed on. This realm is peaceful, conducive to meditation and contemplation, and can serve as an excellent training ground, considering its mutable nature. While within it, you may also reach out to others and draw them in, to teach or communicate with them across time and space, so long as they are willing - the process is slow enough that they can draw away if need be. Be cautious, however; if you or others spend too long here, you may fade into a spirit, unable to leave and inevitably destined to join the Tao.

listen_follow_believe.name: Listen, Follow, Believe
listen_follow_believe.description: What may seem to one person as meek submission, may be to another the necessary performance needed to keep people together. You know how to walk this fine line, and would be capable of acting as a leader to keep a community together in hard times or bewildering circumstances, whether inspiring them to work together, or weaving or believing what lies might be necessary to keep - no matter the cost

martial_discipline.name: Martial Discipline
martial_discipline.description: While you’re far from the great warriors of Penglai, you can more than hold your own and rise to those heights with effort. Years of training have given you a strong, fit body and familiarity with various weapons such as swords, polearms, bows, throwing knives, and more. This training has made you quite spry and light on your feet, granting you the agility to leap, climb, dodge, and dash all over New Kunlun.

myriad_antidote_body.name: Myriad Antidote Body
myriad_antidote_body.description: Among the apemen is one with an unique constitution, one who would be known to later generations as the great Shennong. His constitution is yours to share, now. Any poison or venom that would otherwise harm you, doesn’t. In fact, they’re now rather enjoyable meals to you. When you ingest these toxins, your body will neutralize their negative effects, and you can even expel (read: puke up) an antidote for that poison, which can be used to cure someone else. With enough poison, you can also create a special medicinal brew that will increase the bodily resilience of anyone who drinks it - assuming they’re alright with drinking alcohol brewed using your spit. Unlike Shennong, you will not be at risk of dying if you go too long without consuming poison.

peach_blossom.name: Peach Blossom
peach_blossom.description: Beauty is ephemeral, like the peach blossom on the tree, overtaken by time or violence - but that makes it no less precious or meaningful. You are an example of such beauty; whether masculine, feminine or androgynous, whether ethereal, regal or cute, your looks are enough to turn heads and open hearts to you - and to get fans, in and out-of-universe, raving over you.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.description: The souls of Solarians, their dreams, and the remnants of stars all become one within Fusang. The roots sing an anthem of them, of tales gone by and tales yet to come. You hold an innate connection with the Primordial Roots, able to hear their song, and to receive impressions from them - to understand if something is wrong with them, or if they have some intent. Whatever force animates the Roots looks upon you as a favored child, and will aid you as they can in moments of powerful emotion. In future worlds, this perk will manifest as a connection to nature, and to similarly-encompassing powers or metaphysical structures, such as the Force in Star Wars, or Yggdrasil in a world inspired by Norse Myth.

sage.name: Sage
sage.description: You have memorized the classical canon of Taoist texts, and are able to recite them from memory. It may still be a struggle to truly feel them, but these liturgies can still be a source of strength in hard times - and can contain surprising insights, if you take the time to truly investigate them. Contemplation of the wise words of the past, might help reveal new paths to the future

stillness_overcome_motion.name: Stillness, Overcome Motion
stillness_overcome_motion.description: A duel is like the Solarian game of Qiankun. Both are contests of figuring out your opponent’s moves and strategy before they figure out yours. It’s here where you excel, as you’re a natural at reading the attack patterns and fighting styles of those you observe, and precisely timing your strikes and parries to best fight against them. While you may not win the first duel, you’ll certainly win the last if you’re intelligent about it. Coincidentally, this doesn’t just apply to physical combat, but games of strategy as well.

the_root_of_all_things.name: [扶桑] The Root of All Things
the_root_of_all_things.description: From time immemorial, the Primordial Roots of Fusang have nurtured Solarians across the ages. They connected all lands, providing food and shelter, and civilizations were sure to flourish wherever the roots spread. In you, this symbiosis has perhaps reached its apex, as the Fusang Roots entwine your very heart. So long as your heart is not utterly destroyed, and the Roots survive somewhere, upon death you will be reborn from the Roots, your body reconstituted, while your corpse rapidly decays. The amount of time this takes will vary depending upon the degree of your injuries. As a side effect of this symbiosis, your aging process is slowed significantly, and you do not age at all while being reborn. Just as you may be reborn from the Roots, so they may be reborn from you. Through meditation, you can cause Fusang to grow from within you, taking root in new soil. This perk gives you no special control of how they grow from this point on, however.

the_way.name: The Way
the_way.description: In another world, you could be a very successful preacher, or perhaps a cult leader. You have the skill to convince others of your beliefs, and to adopt them themselves - even if doing so would require making significant sacrifices, so long as you can provide some reasonable cause. The ideology of Lear, encoded in Taoism, caused many to give up great power in advanced technology. This perk also works with beliefs that you don’t hold, or don’t consider true, but not as effectively

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.description: The Turbulent Era was known for its wartime leaders, as the armies of the Fangshi Guild and the Jie Kingdom clashed. You’re a strategist and tactician who wouldn’t be out of place in that bloody time. You’re as well-versed in conventional, set-piece engagements as you are in the first key point of the Fangshi Art of War: all warfare is based on deception. You’ve got a wealth of experience in leading soldiers into battle and outmaneuvering foes on a strategic or personal level, from goading them into acting unwisely to luring them into well-concealed traps.

source_odyssey_of_a_mage_jumpchain.description: Perks from Odyssey of a Mage Jumpchain.

a_second_chance.name: A Second Chance
a_second_chance.description: After dealing with the Raven, Atticus offered him a second chance. In the end he didn’t want to take it due to the cost. It however, was an interesting option as it would’ve allowed Raven’s soul to reincarnate. Somehow you have figured out how to replicate this feat. You can capture the soul of your target and safely reincarnate them. This will allow you to create a new being who retains their previous talents. As you are facilitating this process you may design the new being's personality and appearance if you wish. Otherwise they will likely resemble their previous self to a degree with some new aesthetics.

false_sight.name: False Sight
false_sight.description: Battles between Seers are complex as each party will actively be altering their plans based on what they see. To deal with this issue powerful Seers have learned how to hide their actions and in some cases even falsify them. You are one of the rare talents that can do this. Your presence will be hidden and blend in with fate naturally hiding you from any attempting to monitor you. Should you actually be a Seer or have your own similar methods then you may instead also misdirect others.

familiar_bonds.name: Familiar Bonds
familiar_bonds.description: Familiar bonds are a special bond that forms between a magic user and creatures they are close to. This bond enhances the creature allowing them to become significantly larger, more intelligent, and overall powerful than other members of their species. The bond also creates a telepathic link between the user and their familiar. This link cannot be severed by distance or any barriers. This perk grants you the ability to create familiar bonds with other beings. The amount of bonds you can create depends on the strength of your soul. The effects of the bond are most beneficial if done with a young or newborn creature, but it is still effective on adult beings. Though it will likely take years for the full effects of the bond to shine.

fluidic_transfiguration.name: Fluidic Transfiguration
fluidic_transfiguration.description: Fluidic Transfiguration is an extremely high level skill only usable by true masters of the field. These spells are constantly in motion never ceasing. This allows them to remain intact regardless of damage, effectively become sentient, and it allows them to absorb many forms of magic. For example, fluidic transfiguration is practically immune to dark magic as any spells will merely strengthen the transfigured object. You are one of the few individuals capable of using this level of magic and can be considered a one man army as a result. You could focus on high quality constructs or simply create an endless tide against your foes.

law_of_permanence.name: Law of Permanence
law_of_permanence.description: The Law of Permanence is a rule of Transfiguration that Atticus discovered. It is a revolutionary law that allows the user to create an endless supply of any material as long as you know its basic composition. He decided to bury it before it could accidentally destroy the world’s economy, but that’s not a concern for you. You have learned how to apply this law allowing you to create a limitless supply of materials for your use. You have the knowledge to do this yourself or to instead set up an automated conversion system. At this point it's merely a matter of how large your workplace is.

legacy_of_death.name: Legacy of Death
legacy_of_death.description: As befitting their legacy the Peverell family was known for producing powerful Necromancers. This made them some of the most powerful wizards as each Peverell would be an army unto themselves. Perhaps you are a Peverell yourself or an inheritor of their legacy. These spells allow you to create undead servants, cast obscure curses, and potentially even perform true resurrection. Once they have been created none of your undead will require any upkeep. You can create these servants directly through magic, but it is far more efficient to use corpses.

life_debts.name: Life Debts
life_debts.description: When you personally save someone’s life even if unwillingly this process will allow the formation of a life debt. This debt creates an intrinsic connection between you and the debt-owed individual. It makes it impossible for the debt holder to harm the owner. Additionally, it allows the debt owner to claim one favor which cannot be denied unless paid. For example, many Wizarding families will pay a life debt with a marriage proposal or something else of immense value. Lastly, you will gain an instinctual mental tally of who owes you a debt and how many they owe.

magical_prowess.name: Magical Prowess
magical_prowess.description: While hard work is important the overall potential of most magicals is determined by their innate potential. This perk will boost your talent, your innate magical potential and initial magical capacity. The default option is average. This level represents the general population of the Wizarding World. If you lack Witch/Wizard trait, buying this perk gives you potential to become Wizard of the level you bought given time and hard work. You can spend more CP to boost your potential: Warlock - 100 CP: Warlocks is the second tier of magic users that makes up about 18% of the population. These individuals are more powerful magically and have noticeably greater ease when using magic. Sorcerer - 100 CP: Sorcerers are the upper tier of magic users that make up 1-2% of the population. These Wizards and Witches often are often born from ancient families granting them an innate connection to a magical field. Archmage - 200 CP: Archmage is a term used to refer to the most powerful and talented amongst the Wizarding World. This is the level that Albus Dumbledore, Aurelius Dumbledore, and Xavier Charleston are considered to be at. Herald of Magic - 400 CP: The Archmages are incredibly rare, but amongst their ranks are some who can rise even further. These individuals are said to have inspired the legends of the gods like Thor and Zeus.

magical_travel_for_dummies.name: Magical Travel for Dummies
magical_travel_for_dummies.description: The magical world has developed a surprising amount of methods to quickly travel vast distances. Some of the most well known include the Floo Network, Vanishing Cabinets, Portkeys, Apportation, and later on the Gate Networks. You are a master in this field with a comprehensive understanding of virtually every method of magical transportation. This knowledge allows you to instinctively see the best way to design and hasten a transport system efficiently. Under your guidance a nation could develop a highly efficient and most importantly quick network. Given access to new information you may also identify the best ways to improve their movement or otherwise use them for your purposes.

man_of_the_community.name: Man of the Community
man_of_the_community.description: Atticus’s father in his first life was a bastard that abused his wife and son. Despite this he was a widely beloved individual due to how he acted in public and his ability to conceal his secrets. Like the man himself, you are able to perfectly conceal your darker side. Be it through misdirection, your victims shame, or another reason entirely nothing will see the light of day as long as you aren’t caught in the act. This effect is further amplified by your own charming demeanor. Virtually everyone you encounter will gain a positive impression of you which can be developed further.

my_blood_is_my_own.name: My Blood is My Own
my_blood_is_my_own.description: Magic is imbued within every individual making pieces of an individual in question powerful catalysts. On one hand they’re useful for empowering rituals and binding the effects to you alone. On the opposite end this makes them excellent tools for harming you. To resolve this issue you have isolated your very being making it unusable for anyone else. For example, if someone stole your blood it would be useless in any rituals meant to affect you negatively. This has the added benefit of empowering your own body when used as a reagent as you have limited its purpose. This way you can still use aspects of yourself for your own purposes without concern of others doing the same.

offensive_aura.name: Offensive Aura
offensive_aura.description: A rare trait usable by some darker wizards is the ability to weaponize their auras. This is typically performed through dark rituals or other obscure magic. An example of this would be the poisonous aura used by Cullaica. While using this power his magical power tripled in strength and incredibly toxic fumes poured from his body. He became an embodiment of pestilence and disease. Each time you purchase this perk you may choose a type of power or concept to imbue within your aura. The majority of these are elemental effects, but you may choose different abilities as well.

personal_focus.name: Personal Focus
personal_focus.description: Wands are the most common method used to channel their power particularly within the British Isles. As a Wizard you obviously need a Wand and that is what you shall receive. This is a wand perfectly suited to you. Alternatively if you dislike Wands you may choose another channel such as a staff, ring, or even a sword. There are pros and cons to each magical device. Additionally, unlike other Wands this one is built to handle your maximum power at the moment of purchase. That way you don’t have to worry about overloading it. If you do not posses magic, you can re-roll this perk for free. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

right_of_conquest.name: Right of Conquest
right_of_conquest.description: Magic works in mysterious ways and has a variety of effects in specific situations. One of the most interesting examples is the Right of Conquest. This right allows an individual to claim everything that belongs to their opponent if they defeat them. For example, beating or killing a Head of House would allow you to claim the house. In this situation this would include the other family members, the properties, and anything else they possessed. Should you claim any markets or individuals this will also grant you their loyalty.

ritual_synergy.name: Ritual Synergy
ritual_synergy.description: Rituals are some of the more dangerous and beneficial forms of magic in the world. They however, have to be done in a careful fashion as excessive use can overwhelm the user. Somehow though you are an exception to this rule. Your body seems naturally compatible with rituals and their effects. Rather than being overwhelmed your body seems to stabilize their effects allowing you to undergo as many rituals as you wish without issue. Additionally, this perk extends to any external alteration that is done removing their negative effects.

runes_and_glyphs.name: Runes and Glyphs
runes_and_glyphs.description: Runes are one of the most extensive magical fields. Given time you can replicate nearly every other type of magic with a proper runic sequence. You simply need a proper runic language to work with. Luckily for you, it appears that you are a master of Runes, Glyphs, and Enchanting. You have a comprehensive understanding of every runic language that has ever been used including the new Illosian runic language made by Atticus. Your most useful skill however, is the ability to construct three dimensional runes. You can fit far more runes and those of much greater complexity onto your creations. All together this culminates in your runes being stronger, longer lasting, and more effective than the average runes.

swindlers_potion.name: Swindler’s Potion
swindlers_potion.description: The Swindler’s Potion is a potion invented by Albus Dumbledore. The potion is made using the ground up seeds of a flower exclusively grown in Columbia. This potion destroys the user’s free will temporarily, even surpassing the Imperius Curse. While affected the target will be unable to recall any events that occur and grant the user absolute control over the target’s psyche. Purchasing this will give you a cauldron full of the potion and recipe of the potion. Should you use the potion up it will be refilled a few days later.

talismans_and_amulets.name: Talismans and Amulets
talismans_and_amulets.description: India is host to a number of unique magics exclusive to their country. The most prominent of these magics are Talismans and Amulets. Talismans allow the user to store magical spells that can be deployed in large numbers. Additionally, these Talismans can be used to channel symbolic power. For example, godly power and symbolic interpretations related to animals can be used with these Talismans. Amulets on the other hand function similar to Totems empowering the user’s magic. They generally lack the preciseness of finer channels, but they make up for it in manipulating raw magic. You have been extensively tutored in these arts making you a master of these fields.

the_warder.name: The Warder
the_warder.description: You are a master of the versatile art of warding. This craft is primarily used to protect and secure locations. Your expertise covers an extensive array of wards, from alarm and death wards to the latest nuclear-proof wards and various types of detection wards. Trained as a consummate Wardsmith, you possess intimate knowledge and skill in creating, breaking, and utilizing warding systems. Your experience covers ancient Egyptian, Goblin wards, as well as the newer Illosian wards, making you adept in both traditional and cutting-edge warding techniques. Additionally, your talents extend to barriers and other protective systems that function similarly to wards. Whether defending a fortress, safeguarding a secret location, or setting intricate traps, you’ll be capable of doing so with ease.

uplifting_civilization.name: Uplifting Civilization
uplifting_civilization.description: A problem that can arise when vastly increasing the technology prowess of a species is that they will not be ready. Other fields will not keep up, infrastructure won’t be developed, and people may go “mad” with power. You have figured out the best way to peacefully uplift civilizations without causing issues. These methods would allow you to transition a species stuck in the Iron Age to the Space Age in a single generation. You will be able to identify the best way to educate the populations while helping the infrastructure grow.

wand_smith.name: Wand Smith
wand_smith.description: You possess the rare and esteemed skill of crafting magical implements, akin to the Ollivander family. Your expertise extends to the creation of wands, staffs, swords, and other tools designed to channel and amplify magical energy. This craft requires not only technical skill but also a deep understanding of the magical properties of various materials and the unique needs of each individual. You have an encyclopedic knowledge of magical materials, including woods, cores, and other reagents. This allows you to select the perfect combination for each tool, ensuring optimal performance and compatibility. Lastly, your skill set isn't limited to traditional magical energies. If you encounter other forms of energy, such as psionics or elemental forces, you can easily adapt your techniques to create effective catalysts for those as well. Given your nature as a Jumper it's only a matter of time till this becomes effective.

wonder_teacher.name: Wonder Teacher
wonder_teacher.description: Atticus ended up becoming the favorite teacher within Hogwarts and arguably their most successful due to his innovative methods. You are an exceptionally talented teacher capable of becoming just as impressive. Your expertise in pedagogy is unparalleled, allowing you to approach complex topics with clarity and present them in an engaging and relatable manner. Your teaching style is not only effective but also charming, making you highly sought after by institutions and adored by your students. Most importantly is how well and how fast your students learn. Your students will practically race ahead of others mastering subjects in a fraction of the time it would typically take. For instance, you could guide a struggling first-year student to excel in advanced subjects while enjoying the process.

youre_a_wizard_jumper.name: You’re a Wizard Jumper
youre_a_wizard_jumper.description: Magic also known as Neurophysical Energy is a mysterious energy generated by the universe. Little is truly known about the source of this energy as the only race to truly master it were the Precursors. Sadly this knowledge was lost after they were wiped out by the Forerunners. This perk gives you a magical core and allows you to function as a Wizard. You will be able to use Neurophysical Energy, the various magic systems, and potentially replicate the feats of the Precursors given time. Post-Jump you will retain the ability to use magic even if other settings lack it.

swarm_of_primordial_dearth.name: Swarm of Primordial Dearth
swarm_of_primordial_dearth.description: You gain a hundred creatures Swarm of Primordial Dearth - rat-sized insectoid creatures with wasp bodies, dragonfly wings, and seemingly endless appetite. They eat almost any physical matter, then split into two copies. Each copy inherits traits based on what it consumed in previous generation: appearance, food preferences, and environmental tolerances shift with each meal, always adapting toward usefulness in their current circumstances. The swarm grows smarter, more precise, and more coordinated as its numbers increase within one swarm. Different swarms may conflict, consuming each other to produce ever more twisted and nightmarish forms - for Dearth are what they eat. >Behavior: They can consume metals, soil, wood, flesh (nearly anything) though individuals develop preferences. Only the First of the Kin, which spawned without prior consumption, retains true omnivorous capability. They will eat inedible matter when hungry without preferred options accessible, when defending against aggression, or simply when bored of their current diet. >Limitations: The swarm is semi-sapient at best: cunning but not negotiable, driven by absolute instinct rather than ethics or philosophy, even when become smarter. Individual members may be kept as pets by the sufficiently mad, but caution is essential: control feeding, vary their diet, prevent overconsumption, and isolate them from other swarms.

your_envy.name: Your Envy
your_envy.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Envy. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or looking more like someone you wish you looked like) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Envy possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the jealous resent deeper and the content see where they're lacking. Second, by indulging their own Envy (coveting what others have, whether traits, possessions, or status) they gain unique boosts, including the ability to temporarily shapeshift both body and mind to mirror someone they envy, granting them a facsimile of that person's appearance, mannerisms, and surface-level capabilities simultaneously. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Aspiration. When others feel trapped by who they are, Envy reminds them that growth begins by seeing potential in others and striving to reach it. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_gluttony.name: Your Gluttony
your_gluttony.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Gluttony. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or details like a more thin build, sharpened teeth) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Gluttony possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the indulgent over-consume and the overly reserved to fulfill their needs. Second, by indulging their own Gluttony (consuming food, drink, experiences) they gain unique boosts, such as ability to imbue buffs into their cooking, the ability to derive sustenance and power from anything consumable, and ability to sense nature and direction of unfulfilled needs of others. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Appreciation. When others take things for granted, Gluttony reminds them to savor every moment and pleasure life offers. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_greed.name: Your Greed
your_greed.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Greed. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or details like jewelry or gilded markings) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Greed possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the greedy hoard tighter and the spendthrift slow their spree. Second, by indulging their own Greed (acquiring wealth, knowledge, or valuable things) they gain unique boosts, such as the ability to sense value, find lost treasures, and temporarily empower themselves based on what they currently possess. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Generosity. When others hoard their resources, Greed reminds them that true wealth is found in sharing with those in need. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_lust.name: Your Lust
your_lust.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Lust. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or details like alluring features or subtle smell) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Lust possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the passionate more fervent and the cold to feel want. Second, by indulging their own Lust (pursuing desire, connection, or beauty) they gain unique boosts, such as heightened charisma, empathic insight into what others crave, and the ability to rapidly heal people they care about. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Love. When others see only surface beauty, Lust reminds them to appreciate the profound beauty in all things and connections. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_pride.name: Your Pride
your_pride.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Pride. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own default template (altered gender, features, or details like tattoos) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enchantments Perks: Pride possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others, making the proud grow more arrogant and the shy more confident with their words and actions. Second, by indulging their own Pride, they gain unique boosts, such as a towering presence, unshakeable will, and the ability to partially ignore defense and attacks of theie foes. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Dignity. When all hope is lost, Pride reminds others of their inherent worth. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_sloth.name: Your Sloth
your_sloth.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Sloth. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or details like more relaxed posture and flat voice) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Sloth possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the diligent procrastinate and the restless grow still. Second, by indulging their own Sloth (resting, avoiding unnecessary effort, or being purposefully apathetic) they gain unique boosts, such as slowed perception of time when still, the ability to recover stamina and heal rapidly while at rest, and a preternatural patience and timing that allows them to wait indefinitely for the perfect moment to act. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Peace. When others exhaust themselves in frantic motion, Sloth reminds them that stillness brings clarity and that not every problem requires immediate action. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

your_wrath.name: Your Wrath
your_wrath.description: A clone drawn from your own being, reshaped to embody the Deadly Sin of Wrath. They share your memories and core personality at the moment of creation, but their character is a twisted reflection, amplifying this one facet of your nature into an alter-ego. They are aligned with you and incapable of true purposeful betrayal, yet possess free will, flaws, and tendencies true to their sin. Their physical form is modified from your own template (altered gender, features, or details like scars, hardened expressions, or muscular build) to better reflect their nature. They are peak human, but do not gain any of your special physical enhancements. Perks: Wrath possesses a twofold power. First, they excel at inciting their namesake sin in others with words and actions, making the angry see red and the passive rise up in righteous fury. Second, by indulging their own Wrath (channeling anger, confronting injustice, or fighting) they gain unique boosts, such as heightened combat reflexes, strength that grows with opposition, and the ability to rapidly heal their wounds. Beneath this flaw lies a hidden virtue: Courage. When others flee or falter, Wrath reminds them that some things are worth fighting for. Special: By building a positive connection with this entity and better understanding them (and the inner part of yourself they reflect) you gain the ability to grant them copies of a few perks you currently hold. They may decline your gift, however, and there is a limit of no more than seven perks with a total value not exceeding 700 CP that they can hold.

3d_printing.name: 3D Printing
3d_printing.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation and utilization of 3D printing technology in all its forms. Your specialty lies in designing and building diverse printing setups - from microscopic precision printers to large-scale construction systems - capable of producing components and even fully fledged devices. This ability excels as a force multiplier, providing manufacturing support for your other skills and tinker powers. Your printers can work in plastics, metals, ceramics, and more exotic materials, but require time and prepared feedstock to operate. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

alignment_and_orientation.name: Alignment & Orientation
alignment_and_orientation.description: You are a tinker who sets things straight. Your levels and plumb lines reveal true vertical and horizontal anywhere in the universe. Your gimbals keep platforms perfectly stable regardless of external motion. Your guidance systems track targets with nigh-absolute precision. You can align mechanical components so perfectly that friction nearly vanishes between them, or align forces so precisely that they reinforce rather than cancel. Everything has a proper orientation, and you can find it. Due to the fundamental nature of your specialty, the usual tinker limitations regarding maintenance, iteration, and replication almost do not apply to your power.

apiarist_tinker.name: Apiarist Tinker
apiarist_tinker.description: You are a Tinker who specializes in bees, not merely biological bees, but the concept of bees: swarms, hives, honey, and the intricate social machinery of collective industry. Your technology revolves around breeding, modifying, and directing insectoid creations toward any goal you can imagine. Your limitations as a tinker are slightly lifted. Examples: >Custom Breeds: Engineer bees with specific behaviors: pollution eaters, target markers, programmable wax producers, or venom/healing deliverers. >Hive Structures: Construct living hives that function as autonomous factories, refineries, or laboratories: processing ore, synthesizing pharmaceuticals, or generating alloys. >Swarm Control: Direct thousands of individuals as a single coordinated intelligence for reconnaissance, construction, defense, or attack. >Honey & Wax: Produce honey with programmable properties (supernutrients, preservatives, traps) and wax for self-repairing seals, programmable materials, or living memory storage.

aspects_and_essences.name: Aspects and Essences
aspects_and_essences.description: This Tinker ability is all about working with the Essence and Aspects of physical objects and energy. You can build tools to decipher what conceptual components the targeted phenomenon contains, then create a device or method to extract a few highly expressed aspects from the object in the form of essences, and eventually figure out how to apply this essence to other objects. It is very research-intensive and requires one to focus on specific objects, aspects, and use cases each time. However, it allows you to create objects with bizarre properties using relatively mundane items as a source of essence. You can detect, isolate, extract, and eventually apply something like the 'toxicity' aspect from radiation to another device or material. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

below_zero.name: Below Zero
below_zero.description: You can construct devices that breach the thermodynamic floor, reaching into “negative heat” - a regime below absolute zero where entropy inverts, particles exhibit negative mass behavior, and energy flows paradoxically. This enables the fabrication of exotic matter (e.g., negative-temperature superfluids, time-reversed crystals), sub-absolute refrigerators that “heat” by cooling, and transmutation engines that restructure matter through inverted phase transitions. Your creations violate conventional conservation laws in localized, repeatable ways, but tend to self-destruct if they ever return to positive Kelvin ranges. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

bite_down.name: Bite Down
bite_down.description: You are a Tinker specializing in dentistry, oral biomechanics, and bio-mineralization. You can modify teeth, jaws, saliva, and cranial nerves: but crucially, you can also grow teeth outside your mouth or even detached from your body. These external “living tools” retain biological properties: razor-sharp enamel blades, gripping “tongue-hooks” for grapnel guns, crushing molars used as press-jaws, or self-repairing drill-burrs. Your implants deliver venom, sense chemicals, generate vibrations, or interface with your trigeminal nerve. Your spit transforms into adhesives, corrosives, or smoke via custom oral bacteria. Extracted teeth become disposable trackers or small explosives from your tinker work. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

blackbox_principles.name: Blackbox Principles
blackbox_principles.description: You can apply principles of tinkertech blackboxing to mundane devices and your other creations. You have full control over the degree of blackboxing used and its nature. It can involve simple methods to make your creations resistant to reverse engineering and research by others, or a complete tinkertech-tier blackbox, making the inner workings of the machine practically incomprehensible and impossible for outside observers. However, you need to have some sort of target to apply this tinker power. It can work with a broad variety of creations, but a heavily blackboxed device might affect long-term performance and the ability of others to maintain it in a detrimental way. Different types of targets might also introduce some side-effects to the process. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

bottled_superpowers_for_sale.name: Bottled Superpowers for Sale
bottled_superpowers_for_sale.description: You are a tinker specializing in the creation of Bottled Superpowers. You can create various serums, elixirs, mutagens, and fantastic concoctions to grant supernatural, scientific, eldritch, or any other type of superpower to other people. They can have vastly different sources, methods of operation, and ways of integration. However, all Bottled Superpowers are somewhat random; it's hard to create powerful ones, and some methodologies might cause usual tinker problems in the created powers (such as the need for special maintenance, instability over time, etc.). Your tinker restrictions are partly lifted, depending on the kind of Bottled Superpowers you are making and how or to whom you want to apply them. Advice: don't mix too many powers in one subject; use extensive human trials to get rid of some problematic kinks of your product.

carbon_era.name: Carbon Era
carbon_era.description: You can build things out of carbon extremely well. This is your main material. For instance, you can figure out a way to create a fully functional smartphone, which is made of 98% carbon. Carbon metamaterials, nanostructures, and other exotic applications of the element are your bread and butter. However, you are still limited by what is hypothetically possible, and you need to find inspiration for devices in the outside world and the technology around you. This is a methodology type of tinker power. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

cardiotech_tinker.name: Cardiotech Tinker
cardiotech_tinker.description: Your technology is keyed to the rhythm of life itself. You build devices that are powered by and react to biological signals: heartbeat, pulse, and circulatory flow. This allows for creations with intimate user linkages: a weapon that only fires for someone with a specific cardiac rhythm, armor that hardens when the wearer's heartbeat steadies, or a diagnostic tool that can predict a target's actions by reading their blood pressure spikes. Your tech is incredibly secure and responsive, but utterly dependent on the life force of its user. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

clockwork_mechanist.name: Clockwork Mechanist
clockwork_mechanist.description: This tinker power specializes in clockwork and focuses on designing, building, and manipulating intricate mechanical devices and automata. This expertise allows you to create advanced clockwork machines, precision gears, and complex gear-driven systems. You can craft autonomous clockwork robots, intricate locks and traps, or elaborate timekeeping devices. This focus is really great at working with mechanical energy and its transformations. Methodology and possible devices to create are limited by clockwork theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

common_appliances.name: Common Appliances
common_appliances.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation of 'mundane' devices, such as microwaves, freezers, toasters, and similar items. The things you make have the same functionality as their usual non-tinkertech variants, but extended, more efficient and more powerful. You can also attach some exaggerated upgrades to these basic functions if they are thematic - for example, a freezer that can keep perishable items in stasis, or a vacuum capable of absurd levels of suction. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

counter-tinker.name: Counter-Tinker
counter-tinker.description: You are a Tinker focused on countering the works of other Tinkers. You excel at in-depth analysis of the functions and workings of other Tinker-made devices, along with creating the necessary tools to do so. However, your main focus is on creating devices to counter other Tinkertech. You can also create counters to your own creations, but doing so has 'inbreeding' effects - making the counters worse and more dangerous with each generation if you use your own work as inspiration. Unfortunately, you need to observe and research the works of other Tinkers to create anything, though you can still produce most basic tools and sensors within your specialization. Fortunately, you are still free to use counter-devices in any way you want; even if using them for purposes to different than their primary function is less efficient and, in some cases, can complicate maintenance. You can use this power to counter mundane tech, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to your understanding of the targeted technology, and it generally works less well on non-Tinkertech. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted. Advice: target eldritch and alien technology.

cozy_solarpunk.name: Cozy Solarpunk
cozy_solarpunk.description: This tinker power specializes in solarpunk and excels at designing sustainable, eco-friendly machinery and innovative devices that harmonize with nature. All equipment within this focus relies on renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and bioenergy, combined with eco-conscious materials. The development of new devices and techniques is guided by principles of sustainability and ecological balance.
