Your methodology and creations are limited by the optimistic and environmentally conscious spirit of the solarpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

crazy_edison.name: Crazy Edison
crazy_edison.description: As Tinker specialized in Bulbs and Light Sources, you can create exotic illumination devices that produce mesmerizing and unusual effects, such as cooling, color-shifting, X-ray vision, projecting illusions, literal black light, etc. Think of Bakuda, but with bulbs, less destructive and energy intensive effects. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

cutlery_maker.name: Cutlery Maker
cutlery_maker.description: You are a tinker capable of creating cutlery and dining implements of such exceptional quality they border on the supernatural. Your knives, forks, and spoons are perfectly balanced and can be crafted from innovative materials to perform specific and unorthodox tasks. While appearing mundane, a spoon from you can cool soup to the perfect temperature, and a fork can test for toxins. For combat, your creations are surprisingly effective: your throwing knives are able to return to your hand, fork tines can extend into fine-point grappling hooks, and a well-thrown dinner plate can be as accurate as a shuriken. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

daily_hyperfixation.name: Daily Hyperfixation
daily_hyperfixation.description: For 24 hours, you gain a random tinkertech blueprint to work on. After 24 hours pass, the new blueprint you can build appears, and the old one disappears. You need to finish your current fixation project to save the blueprint and be able to build it again. If you cannot finish your current blueprint, all completed parts will be converted into inspiration to modify your previously saved blueprints, thematically related to the unfinished creation. You can finish a blueprint by cutting corners, but the saved blueprint will always be of a device you actually completed at the end of the current 24-hour cycle. So if you build crappy version - you get crappy blueprint. Your state of mind, levels of stress and living situation slightly affect what kind of blueprints you gain. Usually you gain blueprints, which are technically possible for your to finish in 24 hours, but not always. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

dakka.name: Dakka!
dakka.description: You are a tinker focused on Firearms and Bullets. You can create guns and ammunition with ridiculous functions and effects, as long as they stay within the concept of 'firearm.' You cannot make pure laser weapons or plasma cannons, for instance. But a machine gun with homing rocket bullets? That is possible! Think of Bakuda, but with bullets and guns instead of bombs. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

darts_and_blowguns.name: Darts and Blowguns
darts_and_blowguns.description: Your tinker power is about the creation of 'poison' darts and pneumatic delivery systems. You can make darts of bizarre designs and imbued with interesting effects. They can be lethal or non-lethal, positive or negative, or serve some other utility (like tracking). But all these effects are chemically based. The other part is delivery systems - blowguns and similiar devices of various designs and levels of sophistication. However, they all use pneumatics to shoot the darts. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

diesel_industry.name: Diesel Industry
diesel_industry.description: This tinker power specializes in dieselpunk and excels at crafting rugged, retro-futuristic machinery and industrial devices. All machinery within this focus utilizes advanced variations of chemical fuel and highly sophisticated combustion engines to achieve its goals. The use of chemical fuel and combustion is a main component of practically all your designs. Your methodology and the devices you create are limited by the dieselpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

dose_response.name: Dose Response
dose_response.description: You are a Tinker specializing in pharmaceuticals: drug design, delivery systems, and biological interactions. You create pills, patches, aerosols, implants, and injectables that produce effects ranging from subtle (pain suppression, sensory enhancement, metabolic acceleration) to extreme (instant paralysis, targeted cell death, temporary brain rewiring). Your signature is precision delivery: timed-release cascades, pH-triggered activation, or compounds that only activate in specific organs. You can produce antidotes on the fly, designer psychoactives for interrogation or control, and regeneration cocktails that close wounds in minutes. Your standard tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

elastic_potential.name: Elastic Potential
elastic_potential.description: You are a tinker specialized in the creation of unnaturally efficient and versatile springs. Your genius lies in using tension and release to contain and unleash energy: not just kinetic, as you can adapt the principle to channel electrical, thermal, or even more exotic forces through carefully crafted coils and wound mechanisms. However, all your devices, no matter their function, must operate on spring-based principles and retain the general aesthetic of wound metal and tension-release systems. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

filter_and_flush.name: Filter & Flush
filter_and_flush.description: You are a Tinker specializing in liver and kidney biology: filtration, metabolism, and toxin processing. You build organic devices modeled on these organs: implants that scrub poisons from your own blood, external filter-glands that harvest or concentrate chemicals from any liquid, and hybrid liver-kidney growths that turn waste into weapons. Your “renal launcher” fires hyper-concentrated urea crystals; your “bile cutter” sprays digestive enzymes that liquefy steel. You survive any toxin by shunting it through wearable filter-bags. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

furry_science.name: Furry Science
furry_science.description: This tinker ability draws inspiration from the furry subculture and its fictional works. You create devices connected to this theme, ranging from mundane advanced fursuits with integrated technology to complex cloned bodies hosting anthropomorphic animal designs of your own creation. Any device must maintain a clear connection to the fandom and its aesthetics. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

garbage-in_garbage-out.name: Garbage-In/Garbage-Out
garbage-in_garbage-out.description: You are a tinker who transforms refuse into remarkable technology. Your specialty thrives on the worthless, broken, and discarded - the more complete the junk, the more potent the final creation. A powerful energy rifle could be built from shattered glass, used coffee grounds, and scrapped circuit boards. However, the resulting device will always inherit the "character" of its components, possessing a tendency to malfunction, break down, or produce unexpected side effects in a manner befitting its shoddy origins. You suffer all usual Tinker limitations.

grain_boundary.name: Grain Boundary
grain_boundary.description: You are a tinker focused on crystallography - specifically, the microscopic gaps between crystals in metals, ceramics, and even biological minerals (teeth, shells, kidney stones). You build “boundary probes” that slip between grains to weaken or reinforce structures at the atomic level. Your devices can embrittle a steel beam until it powders, or calcify a target’s joints into solid stone from the inside out. You excel at “seam bursting” - using fluid pressure or electrical charge to split materials cleanly along their natural grain lines. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

heartwood_carpenter.name: Heartwood Carpenter
heartwood_carpenter.description: You are a Tinker specializing in wood material: its growth, treatment, and anomalous modification. You create devices and controlled conditions to cultivate wood with impossible properties: planks as durable as steel, splinters that detonate on impact, fibers that remember their shape and snap back into place. Through "alchemical" infusions and growth rituals, you can “enchant” wooden objects with one-use effects: a carved statue that screams when broken, an arrow that seeks the nearest heartbeat, a walking stick that Roots anyone it touches. Your focus is not flashy or powerful by tinker standards, but it requires only wood to function: common, accessible, and everywhere. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

high_energy.name: High Energy
high_energy.description: You are a tinker specializing in high-energy phenomena and machinery. Your creations are universally power-hungry, energy-intense, and anything but subtle: a plasma pistol becomes a cannon, a bomb becomes a mini-nuke, and you simply cannot produce devices that operate below a certain threshold of energy output. You possess the full breadth of a tinker's capabilities, including the accompanying limitations.

hormonal_alchemy.name: Hormonal Alchemy
hormonal_alchemy.description: You are a tinker specializing in the creation and application of designer hormones capable of manipulating physical appearance, physiology, and psychology with precision that borders on the supernatural. Any effect theoretically achievable through advanced targeted hormonal therapy is within your reach, but amplified far beyond natural extremes: reshaping bodies, rewriting metabolic processes, or recalibrating emotional responses with a single tailored dose. Your tinker limitations are slightly eased.

hysteresis.name: Hysteresis
hysteresis.description: You are a tinker specializing in systems that remember their past states: magnetic hysteresis, elastic hysteresis, even thermal or chemical lag. You build devices that exploit this memory to create “delayed effect traps” and “feedback loops.” A magnetic strip you create can be demagnetized but “remember” its orientation, snapping back violently hours later. A rubber cord you treat will stretch normally, then lock rigid when jerked. Your specialty is making materials lie about their present state, then punish anyone who trusts the lie. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

kinetic_harnessing.name: Kinetic Harnessing
kinetic_harnessing.description: Your tinker power makes you into are a master of energy redirection. You build gear designed to absorb kinetic energy from impacts, motion, or vibration and release it in a controlled, amplified burst. This could manifest as a suit that grows stronger with every blow it takes, or a gauntlet that stores the energy from a long fall to power a devastating single punch. Your technology is cyclical and self-sustaining in combat, but requires careful management to avoid catastrophic overload. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

low-scale_production.name: Low-Scale Production
low-scale_production.description: You can create specialized machines and devices for the refinement of materials and the creation of simple components. They are easy to automate but are very focused on a single task or narrow application. For example, a small furnace that is extremely good at refining copper from scraps and ore, turning it into high-purity ingots, but it doesn't work on any other metal. You need different machine for doing something else. They are also designed to be low-scale, producing small batches of product. You don't really scale up. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

macro-dynamics.name: Macro-Dynamics
macro-dynamics.description: Your tinker specialty is defying the square-cube law. You build singular pieces of equipment of immense scale: a cannon the size of a car, a building-mounted pneumatic fist, or a jetpack better suited for a mech than a man. The power output is directly proportional to their colossal size. However, these devices are inherently cumbersome to move or wear, require an equally massive power supply to function. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

magnum_opus.name: Magnum Opus
magnum_opus.description: You can only build one thing. Ever. But that one thing is the most absurdly over-engineered, hyper-specialized, and powerful device conceivable within your chosen specialty. You do not build tools - you build your Magnum Opus, then spend the rest of your career refining, upgrading, and expanding it, never dividing its focus. Your power physically prevents you from conceptualizing or constructing any device that isn't an iteration or component of your Primary. Attempts to sketch a separate tool result in a blank mind. Your Primary becomes an extension of yourself, and you can instinctively modify it for new situations, but only by permanently reconfiguring existing parts. Every choice carries sacrifice. Example: A single suit of power armor refined over centuries. It flies, fights, stealths, and hacks, but only because function has been layered upon function. You cannot build a separate drone or weapon; everything must integrate into the suit. This limitation applies only when using this specific tinker power for creation. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

major_arcana_artificer.name: Major Arcana Artificer
major_arcana_artificer.description: You are a tinker whose technology embodies the 22 Major Arcana of the Tarot. Each device you build is themed around a specific card's essence - you don't create a generic weapon, but a "Judgment" device that reveals hidden truths, a "Tower" device designed for catastrophic destruction, or a "Sun" device radiating pure vitality. Your creations are as symbolic as they are functional. You may temporarily attune any of your devices to a different Major Arcana, overwriting its native theme for a short burst of that card's power. Attuning your "Chariot" boots (willpower and control) to "The Sun" might grant a sudden surge of speed and confidence. This alignment is temporary, and the device returns to its original card after use and will break down faster. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

mind_the_gap.name: Mind the Gap
mind_the_gap.description: You are a Tinker specializing in psychiatry: neural interfaces, psychopharmacology, and behavioral conditioning. You build devices that read, influence, or rewrite mental states: headsets that suppress phobias, implants that block intrusive thoughts, wands that deliver targeted electromagnetic pulses to disrupt panic attacks or trigger euphoria. Your “mood regulators” release precisely timed neurotransmitter cocktails. Your “dream editors” record and rescript nightmares during sleep. Your most invasive work uses conditioned response loops: a small wearable that pairs a specific tone with painless micro-shocks until the target flinches at any trigger sound you choose. You cannot read minds in any literal sense, but you can map emotional patterns, install compulsions, and erase memories with enough time and contact. Your standard tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

mirrors_and_mirrors.name: Mirrors and Mirrors!
mirrors_and_mirrors.description: You are a Tinker specializing in Mirrors and Reflection. You can create devices to reflect and mirror various effects. For example, you can create a shield capable of nearly perfect reflection of kinetic energy attempting to break through it, or a hologram projector capable of producing a temporarily physical simulacrum of another person under your control. You have all the usual limitations of a Tinker.

molds_and_forms.name: Molds & Forms
molds_and_forms.description: You are a tinker who shapes matter by casting process. Your molds are perfect negatives, capturing every detail at the molecular level and reproducing it with flawless fidelity. You begin by casting reletavely mundane solids from liquids with impossible efficiency, but at the peak of your focus, more exotic transitions become possible: trapping light within crystal, freezing sound into solid form, or containing a moment of pure heat inside ceramic. Whatever you pour into your forms emerges shaped and can be used for creation of other exotic components and devices using your other skills or powers. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

neural_networks.name: Neural Networks
neural_networks.description: You are a tinker who specializes in the programming and training of hyper-efficient neural networks, each one laser-focused on a narrow field of responsibility. Your expertise extends to creating custom hardware to run these networks, including wetware - organic computing systems. You can even repurpose existing living neural matter as hardware, a method that produces superior results across your entire specialty. Whether silicon or synapse, your creations excel at their singular tasks but struggle to adapt beyond their intended purpose. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

noble_cause.name: Noble Cause
noble_cause.description: You are a Tinker specializing in precious metals: gold, silver, platinum, palladium, rhodium, and ruthenium. You can build almost any sci-fi or fantasy inspired device imaginable, but every creation must consist of at least 30% precious metals by composition. Each metal grants unique properties beyond their basic characteristics, when used for your tinkering. Now you just need to obtain these metals in needed amounts. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

olfaction_tinker.name: Olfaction Tinker
olfaction_tinker.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation and utilization of odorous substances. Your specialty encompasses perfumes that can affect the minds of living creatures when inhaled: inducing calm, fear, attraction, confusion, or obedience. Beyond mental effects, you create chemical sensors that detect and identify scents with supernatural acuity, analytical tools that break down complex odor profiles, and devices that capture, preserve, and project scents across distances. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

oracle_engines.name: Oracle Engines
oracle_engines.description: You can build a limited class of hypercomputational devices: super-Turing machines that solve non-algorithmic problems. Each device is narrowly specialized (e.g., predicting a single chaotic system, deciding a specific undecidable proposition, or perfectly compressing one type of data). These machines are fragile, power-hungry, and cannot run general software, but they seamlessly interface with your other tech, accelerating research, optimizing designs, or bypassing impossible calculations. Your own creativity remains essential - the oracles answer only what you specifically ask, in ways you must learn to interpret. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

origami_master.name: Origami Master
origami_master.description: Your tinker ability is all about producing and folding paper to achieve your goals. It contains three narrow subcategories of things you are good at: Origami, Papermaking, and Scribbling. Origami is all about folding paper into efficient, useful shapes, and it can be used on other materials as well, but it becomes less effective the further the targeted matter is from the type of paper. Papermaking is focused on creating specialized papers for your work: bulletproof paper, hydrophobic paper, fire-resistant paper, etc. Scribbling is a more exotic craft involving inscribing patterns and text on paper to infuse it with unique added properties or to program it to do something (like folding in a specific way with a trigger condition attached). You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

perpetual_motion.name: Perpetual Motion
perpetual_motion.description: You are a tinker capable of creating various perpetual motion machines. Starting from basic classic designs that actually work to produce mechanical energy, and finishing with more esoteric and fundamental approaches made functional. Although, it is generally easier for you to create machines that can generate a relatively small amount of mechanical energy for an unlimited amount of time (not counting maintenance and other tinkertech-related problems). However, if you have a device on hand, it would be easy to adapt your design to power this specific machine. You have a relatively high upper scaling limit. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

phreak.name: pHreak
phreak.description: You are a Tinker specializing in acid-base chemistry, able to construct devices that manipulate pH across any medium: from pocket sprayers that instantly corrode alloys to handheld gel projectors that neutralize toxins mid-air. While you can craft battlefield-grade acids and bases, your true mastery lies in “pH-shifting”: tweaking the effective pH of materials and biological systems to force unexpected reactions: catalyzing explosions from inert compounds, paralyzing muscles via alkalosis, or dissolving non-metals with superacids (pH far below 0) and igniting organics with superbases (pH above 14). Your devices are precise, potent, and terrible when mixed carelessly. Your standard tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Your tinker focus is on plasma generation, containment, and projection. You can build reactors, conduits, and emission arrays that harness superheated ionized matter: ranging from cutting tools and sustained energy arcs to short-range plasma bursts with exotic effects. Defensive applications include containment fields and heat-flare shrouds. You have all the usual tinker limitations.

predictive_sociotech.name: Predictive Sociotech
predictive_sociotech.description: You can build predictive psycho-social technologies that measure and forecast human intent, emotional state, and criminal probability. Your devices include cymatic scanners, stress-reactive drones, distributed social-hue monitors, and algorithmic judgment cores capable of flagging threats before they act. While highly effective at pacification and control, your tech is vulnerable to anomalous mental states or unpredictable outliers. But these always can captured and fed back into the system to include similiar cases and predict them better in the future. Your standard tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

preservation_tinker.name: Preservation Tinker
preservation_tinker.description: You are a tinker who specializes in the preservation of perishable targets through an advanced form of "canning." At the peak of your ability, this extends far beyond food: you can capture and store physical phenomena themselves within sealed containers. A laser blast, a stream of fire, a kinetic impact, or even another parahuman's ongoing power effect can be caught, canned, and preserved for later release or utilization. Your workshop is filled with vacuum sealers, pressure vessels, and cryo-storage units of your own design. However, each container is single-use, and the captured phenomenon will eventually degrade if stored too long. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

probabilistic_mechanics.name: Probabilistic Mechanics
probabilistic_mechanics.description: Your tinker specialty is manufacturing misfortune or simply out 'bad luck'. You build devices that manipulate probability within a localized area, subtly skewing chance to favor chaos and failure. Your inventions don't directly attack so much as they cause things to go terribly wrong: enemy weapons jam at the worst moment, seemingly solid ground develops a treacherous slick patch, or a crucial support beam just happens to be rotted through. It's a very subtle, Thinker-y kind of Tinkering. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

projection_crafting.name: Projection Crafting
projection_crafting.description: This unique tinker focus lets you create 'projections' of existing objects via usage of special custom devices. They function like copies of the original device or item, possessing most of its properties and functions (while not being truly material or permanent). For example, you can create a device to project several copies of a lightsaber to use, while keeping the original one safe. Or use something like an addon for the gun to essentially have infinite bullets, using projected matter to refill the gun. However, all projections created this way are connected to the original and cannot exist without it. At higher levels, you might store 'memory' of the original to partially sidestep this issue, but ultimately, any projection will wear out, warp in shape and function, and eventually collapse without an intact and accessible original to pull from. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

pseudoscience_enjoyer.name: Pseudoscience Enjoyer
pseudoscience_enjoyer.description: Your theme and specialty are rather odd - Pseudoscience. Your creations are inspired by and function like various pseudoscientific devices, using the logic and 'knowledge' of different forms of pseudoscience. These devices are perfectly functional for what you create them for, but they are rather weird and make even less sense than usual Tinketech. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

psi_tradeoff.name: Psi Tradeoff
psi_tradeoff.description: You are a tinker able to create devices that reproduce and simulate various 'psychic' effects. Drawing inspiration from fiction, as well as actual supernatural and magical effects, will help you a lot. However, there is always some tradeoff in using these devices - some kind of mental cost. You can create a small device to achieve telekinetic flight, but at the cost of 4% of your maximum focus while the device is equipped. Or maybe you want to set things on fire with your gaze, but at the cost of permanently burning your own memories in quantities proportional to the complexity and power of the spontaneous combustion you are trying to achieve. Or you might literally spend your 'social battery' to fuel people-targeting psychometry. There is always a tradeoff - always a cost. At least, these devices are much less dangerous when used by you. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

reactive_adaptation.name: Reactive Adaptation
reactive_adaptation.description: You build machines that learn by breaking and being damaged. Your devices are designed to reactively adapt to stimuli within a limited field of purpose, growing more resistant and effective the more they are challenged. They are robust and possess impressive self-repair capabilities. However, your methodology demands destruction: you must test your creations to their limits in practical situations, allowing them to be damaged or destroyed to collect crucial combat data. This data alone allows you to upgrade and refine the adaptation protocols for the next generation. True growth requires sacrifice. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

recursion_and_loops.name: Recursion & Loops
recursion_and_loops.description: You are a tinker who specializes in technology built upon loops, self-reference, and recursive systems: holograms within holograms, fractal antennae, and feedback cycles that compound upon themselves. Your devices grow more powerful through repeated, patterned use: a shield that strengthens with each impact it absorbs, or a scanner that gains fidelity the more times it examines the same target from varied angles. Your signature creation is the Seed: a device that, when provided with raw materials and a suitable environment, can slowly build a copy of itself or construct more advanced pieces of your technology. Given time and resources, this allows for exponential growth of your workshop and capabilities. Your limitations as a tinker are slightly lifted.

relativistic_movement.name: Relativistic Movement
relativistic_movement.description: You can construct devices that safely accelerate objects to near-light speeds and harness the exotic phenomena of relativistic motion. Examples include relativistic drive engines, solar-charged kinetic launchers (e.g., relativistic projectiles launchers), and systems that exploit time dilation or mass-energy effects. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

revival_tinker.name: Revival Tinker
revival_tinker.description: You are a tinker focused on bringing dead things back and making them useful (basically your minions). Given sufficient traces, you can revive an entity through cloning, repair, or stranger means like summoning its "spirit" as a projection. The quality and longevity of your creation depend on three factors: how many times you've already revived it (diminishing returns with each iteration), the quantity and condition of its remains, and how much data you possess about the original. Your specialty defines "creature" broadly - a destroyed robot qualifies as readily as a corpse. As a sub-specialty, you excel at creating single-use devices that allow you or others to avoid or shrug off death in various ways. Your limitations as a tinker are slightly lifted.

rot-tech.name: Rot-Tech
rot-tech.description: You are a tinker who specializes in the decomposition of materials. Your devices can achieve things like: speeding up or slowing down the rotting process dramatically, guiding decomposition to achieve limited transmutation, or causing specific materials to decay while leaving adjacent matter untouched. Your focus works best on chemically organic materials (living or dead) allowing you to wither plants, compromise wooden structures, or age biological matter and plastics to dust. Against purely inorganic substances like refined metals, stone, or ceramics, your abilities are practically useless. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

selective_evolution.name: Selective Evolution
selective_evolution.description: You are a tinker who specializes in the accelerated breeding of organisms to produce unnatural and powerful results. Your true genius lies with animals, shaping generations of creatures into living tools, weapons, or mounts with terrifying speed and efficiency. You can stretch this specialty to fungi and plants, though with diminished results. All your technology is focused on facilitating this process - incubators, genetic sequencers, growth accelerators - and your methodology demands patience, as your creations must be bred, not built, over successive generations. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

selective_permeability.name: Selective Permeability
selective_permeability.description: You are a tinker who works with barriers that let some things through while stopping others. Your membranes can filter any mixture to perfect purity, separating compounds that shouldn't be separable. Your cell walls can maintain internal pressure against vacuum or ocean depths, keeping occupants alive in hostile environments. You design systems that breathe selectively, that feed based on need, that gradually release medicine or poison when triggered by specific environmental conditions. Your limitations as a tinker are slightly lifted.

shizotech_fugue.name: Shizotech Fugue
shizotech_fugue.description: On normal days, your tinker power is very good at making simple and robust (by tinkertech standards) tools and stockpiling special materials. But you accumulate charge in this state (which has an upper limit), which you can spend to enter a special kind of fugue. In this state, you turn temporarily schizophrenic and experience heavy hallucinations. What you experience in this state determines what you will build using the materials and tools around you. This fugue is extremely efficient at making you build things, even from subpar materials. It can last up to 48 hours (maximum charge) or until you lose consciousness due to stress and fatigue. In the end, you have some useful and bizarre tinkertech device (or several) with a general idea of what it does, but you need to actually research and test it to figure out the details of maintenance and any special quirks of the created item. The state of your psyche greatly affects the products. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

sonotech_tinker.name: Sonotech Tinker
sonotech_tinker.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation of devices that utilize mechanical wave propagation (sound and vibration) to achieve your goals. Your specialty includes things like: focused sonic projectiles analogous to lasers, listening devices of impossible sensitivity, and resonance weapons that cause targeted materials to shake themselves apart upon impact, etc. You are limited to effects theoretically achievable through mechanical waves in matter, though your solutions are unnaturally efficient at pushing those boundaries. Every creation harnesses vibration as its core principle. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

spider_tinker.name: Spider Tinker
spider_tinker.description: Your tinker focus is all about spiders and their derivative products. You can separate this specialty into three subcategories: Spiders, Products, and Traits. The first is about affecting the actual category of creatures labeled as 'spiders': modifying them, breeding and creating new ones, controlling them, and using them as helpers with tinkertech. The second is all about derivatives: production of various silks, custom toxins, and other spider-related physical materials. The third involves applying the properties of spiders to other things: building primitive spider-bots, creating serums to grant discount Spider-Man powers, etc. This specialty heavily relies on your conceptualization, creativity and knowledge of the theme. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

stone_age_tinker.name: Stone Age Tinker
stone_age_tinker.description: You specialize in the creation of devices, tools, and items from the Neolithic Age and inspired by it. Your material requirements are relatively low and contain a lot of natural, raw materials. Your creations are unusually high quality; they are much more efficient and functional than expected from such seemingly primitive objects. You are capable of creation of non-tinkertech Neolithic items of high quality, but they just very good mundane things. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

stress_fracture.name: Stress Fracture
stress_fracture.description: You are a tinker specializing in material fatigue, residual stress, and structural failure points. You can build devices that apply precisely tuned vibrational loads, thermal shocks, or micro-impacts to make practically any solid material (from steel to bone to even tinkertech alloys) crack, shatter, or deform along invisible fault lines. Your signature tech includes “pre-stress injectors” that leave materials seemingly intact but doomed to fail under the slightest pressure hours or days later. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

sub-planckian_phenomena.name: Sub-Planckian Phenomena
sub-planckian_phenomena.description: You perceive and manipulate reality below the Planck length, where space, time, and distance dissolve into continuous quantum foam. Where others see discrete components, you see flowing fields and transformations. You are terrible at counting or sorting, but unmatched at tracking and rewriting continuous processes. For example, you can build device to impose exotic spacetime metrics, like asymptotic barriers that make distance technically infinite. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

surface_finishing.name: Surface Finishing
surface_finishing.description: You treat the outermost layer of things. Your coatings can make a surface harder than diamond, slicker than ice, or more absorbent than any sponge. You apply finishes that hide objects from detection, that change color or texture in response to stimuli, or that slowly release embedded compounds over centuries. You believe the soul of an object resides at its skin, and you have mastered the art of perfecting that boundary between a thing and the world. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

sweet-tooth_tinker.name: Sweet-tooth Tinker
sweet-tooth_tinker.description: Your tinker ability is focused on the creation of various sweets to achieve your goals. It contains three broad subcategories of things you are good at: Shaping, Boost and Minions. The first is candy-material science, used to create tools, mechanisms, and devices from sweets with exotic properties. Boost is all about creating sweets that bestow positive or negative effects - temporarily (or permanently, if you try really hard) - on a target. Minions is all about creating sweets golems, animated and life-like creatures to help you with work or fighting. All your creations are technically edible. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

symmetry_methodology.name: Symmetry Methodology
symmetry_methodology.description: You understand the deepest secret of physics: symmetry is not a law, but a preference. Your specialty lies in instilling or breaking symmetries within physical systems to produce impossible phenomena. For instance, weaponization of magnetic monopoles is one of the practical application of this specialisation. You suffer from standard tinker limitations.

synergy-locked.name: Synergy-Locked
synergy-locked.description: You are a tinker who builds technology in harmonized sets. Individual components are weak or non-functional in isolation, but when combined with their intended partners, they create effects far beyond the sum of their parts. However, these sets are locked - you cannot mix components from different harmonies. Your power forces thematic commitment. If you build a fire set, everything you create for the foreseeable future must harmonize with fire. Changing sets means abandoning your previous work and starting anew. Each set forms a complete technological ecosystem. You suffer all usual Tinker limitations.

tacticool_attachments.name: Tacticool Attachments
tacticool_attachments.description: You are a tinker specialized in the creation of attachments for other devices. You should research and focus on a specific technological item to start building, testing and improving various add-ons for it, which can extend, deepen, or otherwise upgrade the main or secondary functions of the object. Things like an unusually efficient silencer for your pistol or perhaps a battery attachment to extend your force field charge. However, everything you create must be attached to and be a derivative of another device. Your understanding of the functions of the targeted item is very helpful. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

taxidermy_enthusiast.name: Taxidermy Enthusiast
taxidermy_enthusiast.description: As Taxidermy Tinker you can create strange, animated hybrid creatures and eerie sculptures using preserved animals, bones, and mechanical parts. Your works are often bizarre and unsettling, but not alive. You require organic materials and simple mechanisms, but your creations are short-lived and dependent on available resources. You have problems working with human bodies, or any other materials too distant from 'animal' definition. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

tempering_tinker.name: Tempering Tinker
tempering_tinker.description: You make things tough. Your heat treatments, quenching processes, and work-hardening techniques render metals and other materials nearly indestructible. Your case-hardening penetrates deep into structural members, your tempering eliminates brittleness without sacrificing strength, and your work-hardening can make a simple paperclip strong enough to hold up a house. You do not build new devices (not counting your tools) - you take what others have built and make it unbreakable. Your limitations as a tinker are slightly lifted.

the_art_of_retrofitting.name: The Art of Retrofitting
the_art_of_retrofitting.description: Your tinker ability is uniquely centered around the concept of retrofitting - transforming and upgrading existing devices, structures, and systems into new, more advanced forms. You excel at taking old, outdated, or broken technology and infusing it with innovative modifications, turning it into something far more capable than its original design. Whether it's retrofitting a simple machine to handle complex tasks, upgrading a worn-out device with cutting-edge components, or repurposing old technology for modern use, you thrive on creatively reimagining the potential of what already exists. Your expertise lies in customizing and enhancing rather than inventing from scratch. However, your retrofitting process often results in devices that are unpredictable or temperamental - sometimes working flawlessly, other times malfunctioning in unexpected ways. This can lead to surprising outcomes. The more outdated and old the technology you are working with, the more efficient this ability is. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

think-tanks.name: Think-Tanks
think-tanks.description: Your tinker power is focused on the creation of cloned brains in boxes. You can create copies of brains (yours or other people's), download knowledge, personality, and data into them, then put these brains into jars and force them to think up ideas and solutions for you using various mastering techniques, brainwashing and various similar methods. Completely unethical, and you must ensure from time to time that these brains won't try to betray you by booby-trapping some of their ideas. However, it is really efficient for offloading solution searching and brute-forcing creativity. This specialty doesn't let you create anything else but think-tanks and will oppose you if you try to use it to create something else (like fully functional clones). Although, it includes methods of quickly and efficiently coping results from think-tanks and implanting these ideas into your head. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

tinker_analyst.name: Tinker Analyst
tinker_analyst.description: You are a tinker with an atypical focus: rather than building from your own specialty, your power lets you research and reverse-engineer other tinkertech devices, blueprints, or even incomprehensible alien technology, producing weaker, simpler, but mass-producible and fully understandable versions. These reproductions operate on principles that conventional science can grasp, making them reliable, maintainable, and replicable by mundane manufacturing. You suffer almost none of the usual tinker limitations - your only constraints involve the specialized tools and diagnostic devices required to properly analyze and deconstruct other tinkertech projects in the first place.

tinker_of_escalation.name: Tinker of Escalation
tinker_of_escalation.description: Your tinker power revolves around the concept of Escalation. It allows you to push existing devices and systems beyond their original limits, increasing their power, complexity, and unpredictability. While you can turn simple gadgets into formidable or unstoppable creations, your escalations often cause unpredictable ripple effects in the environment, making your inventions prone to instability or chaos (you are less affected personally). The more pressure is applied from outside, the faster and more effectively your Escalation potential grows and quicker it can be turned into upgrades. However, if you suddenly stop escalating the acceleration 'counter' resets, and all devices built by you begin to malfunction more often, requiring more maintenance and quickly losing their power, potential and danger. This is a methodology-type of tinker power - you need outside inspiration or devices to use as a starting point for the process. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

tolerance_tinker.name: Tolerance Tinker
tolerance_tinker.description: You are a tinker who operates at the very limits of physical possibility. Your specialty is creating components with impossible tolerances and surface finishes, machining parts so perfectly that they fundamentally alter how mechanisms behave. Friction nearly vanishes between moving parts, energy transfers with zero loss, and assembled systems operate with ghost-like silence and efficiency. This allows for a range of devastating applications: monofilament edges that slice through matter at the molecular level, armor that distributes kinetic force across its entire surface, and projectile weapons that fire rounds with zero deviation or drop. Your devices contain no exotic energy - they are simply the most perfectly made objects that have ever existed. However, each component takes considerable time to machine, and replacing a destroyed piece means starting from raw stock again. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

tribology_tinker.name: Tribology Tinker
tribology_tinker.description: You are a tinker who specializes in the manipulation and creative utilization of friction. Your devices exploit the principle of surfaces rubbing against one another to produce extraordinary results. This can manifest as super-lubricants that eliminate all traction, projector fields of negative friction that send objects sliding uncontrollably, surfaces with impossible grip, or weapons that generate deadly spark projectiles through rapid abrasion. Whether calming motion or catalyzing it, your tech always comes back to the art of the drag. You suffer all usual tinker limitations.

weft_and_warp.name: Weft & Warp
weft_and_warp.description: Your specialty is Textiles - not mere clothing, but the engineering of fabric as a dynamic medium. You build looms, spindles, and thread-laying rigs capable of producing super-textiles with properties like extreme tensile strength, energy diffusion, or reactive shaping. Designing fashionable attire comes naturally as a side effect, but your true art lies in treating any cloth-like material as a structural and functional technology. Your tinker limitations are partially lifted.

wondrous_metals.name: Wondrous Metals
wondrous_metals.description: As a tinker specialized in fictional metals, you can synthesize such wondrous materials and produce simple objects made from them. You can create tools to actually work with these materials. It is possible for you to create a specific type of mithril, for instance. However, you must draw your inspiration from a particular work of fiction. Some materials are harder to make and use than others, some are more powerful, and some are closer to the original source of inspiration. The intangible value and theme of the fictional work greatly affect the results of your tinkering, as well as depth and quantity of information given about the metal. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

chain_casting.name: Chain Casting
chain_casting.description: This perk grants you the knowledge, skill, and ability to prepare multiple spells for execution and then cast them all at once. You can begin preparing the first spell while keeping it from actually executing, then add another, and another... How many spells you can chain together depends on the nature of the spells, your focus, skill, and talent. Maintaining spells in suspension carries a cost and cannot be done forever - only for a few tens of minutes at most. The overall cost when executing the chain is slightly higher than casting them separately. You can also withdraw and break the chain before execution, which removes all suspended spells at once with no significant cost. When the chain is ready, you execute the spells in order, almost simultaneously.

cosmetic_calibration.name: Cosmetic Calibration
cosmetic_calibration.description: You can change the cosmetic effects of your spells, if they have any. You can make them sound or look different, but not in a way that alters their general behavior. Not all spells can be affected, though most can accept some aesthetic adjustments. It costs you virtually nothing to make a charm's ray pink instead of red. This does not affect more esoteric or detailed methods of observing spells.

crafting_ritual_amber_glass_casting.name: Crafting Ritual: Amber Glass Casting
crafting_ritual_amber_glass_casting.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Amber Glass Casting Aspect: 2 Wood + 1 Light Description: This small ritual allows one to transform wood into an amber-like substance that can be used like glass. The ritual works best on sawdust. Different types of wood produce different hues of "amber glass," and some types are objectively better to use for the ritual.

crafting_ritual_blightinite_forging.name: Crafting Ritual: Blightinite Forging
crafting_ritual_blightinite_forging.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Blightinite Forging Aspect: 9 Metal + 3 Transformation + 2 Essence + 2 Aether + 1 Taint + 1 Curse Description: This is a complex alchemical ritual that processes raw cesium into a stable, magical metal known as blightinite. The resulting metal is darker than its mundane counterpart and significantly less radioactive. However, the first time a curse strikes the metal, it permanently remembers the effect. The metal subtly shifts shade to match the magic's "color" and begins to slowly emit radiation infused with that dark spell's essence, causing a lesser version of the effect to occur in the area.

crafting_ritual_cold_iron_forging.name: Crafting Ritual: Cold Iron Forging
crafting_ritual_cold_iron_forging.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Cold Iron Forging Aspect: 5 Metal + 2 Essence + 1 Transformation + 1 Death + 2 Order Description: This is a crafting ritual to produce cold iron. It is a magical metal that slowly "freezes" the magic (or at least "cools" it down) of a living creature in the area of contact, making it harder to use spells utilizing the affected body part or even harming magical creatures that rely on magic to maintain their physiological functions. Works better or worse on certain magics.

crafting_ritual_hide_lantern.name: Crafting Ritual: Hide Lantern
crafting_ritual_hide_lantern.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Hide Lantern Aspect: 3 Transformation + 1 Light + 1 Order Description: Inscribe a specific sigil on a piece of raw animal skin and add a drop of blood (any). The skin folds and transforms into a leathery, slightly bouncy sphere. Squeeze it to turn the light on; squeeze again to turn it off. The light is relatively dim. While squeezed and held, you can cycle through colors: cold white (brightest), warm white, orange, yellow, and red (dimmest). The lantern lasts for a few months of continuous use. Larger pieces of skin produce larger spheres (up to 15 cm in diameter) that last longer.

crafting_ritual_iron_wood_production.name: Crafting Ritual: Iron Wood Production
crafting_ritual_iron_wood_production.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Iron Wood Production Aspect: 4 Wood + 2 Iron + 1 Transformation + 1 Essence Description: This is a crafting ritual. You need a piece of hard wood and a tiny amount of iron. This work infuses the essence of iron into the piece of wood, making it much more durable, noticeably harder, and resistant to fire. However, it also makes the wood slightly heavier and more susceptible to rot in humid environments.

crafting_ritual_ruinite_transmutation.name: Crafting Ritual: Ruinite Transmutation
crafting_ritual_ruinite_transmutation.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Ruinite Transmutation Aspect: 4 Earth + 3 Chaos + 2 Transformation + 2 Death + 1 Essence Description: This is an alchemical transmutation that permanently converts a carefully prepared rust mixture (composed of specific metal oxides in precise ratios) into ruinite. The resulting substance is ugly, brittle, and emits a pungent, acrid stench. Ruinite accelerates certain natural processes on contact: erosion in rocks, corrosion in metals, and rotting in dead organic materials. It is highly carcinogenic and allergenic to living beings, causing severe skin reactions and long-term health deterioration with prolonged exposure.

crafting_ritual_spell-arrester_copper_fo.name: Crafting Ritual: Spell-Arrester Copper Forging
crafting_ritual_spell-arrester_copper_fo.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Spell-Arrester Copper Forging Aspect: 5 Metal + 2 Essence + 1 Transformation + 1 Air + 2 Lighting Description: This is a crafting ritual to produce spell-arrester copper. It is a magical metal that slightly attracts spells flying nearby and "grounds" them. It works mostly on charms with clear shape, attracting their projectile trajectories toward the metal. It acts like a lightning rod, but for spells that use intermediate stages such as rays, projectiles, or similar carriers. Some spells or too many at once can mess up the metal: warp, break, melt or even rust it.

crafting_ritual_wood_treatment.name: Crafting Ritual: Wood Treatment
crafting_ritual_wood_treatment.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Wood Treatment Aspect: 5 Wood + 2 Plastic + 2 Earth Description: This is a crafting ritual. It requires a piece of wood as a target and a pile of coal dust (charcoal will do). In the process, the dust turns into a kind of resin, soaks into the wood structure, permeates it, and sets. The resulting wood is much more resistant to natural rot and decay, slightly more durable and harder, and waterproof. It burns with thick, stinky smoke.

crafting_ritual_wooden_glue.name: Crafting Ritual: Wooden Glue
crafting_ritual_wooden_glue.description: You've learned a new crafting ritual! Name: Wooden Glue Aspect: 3 Wood + 1 Water + 1 Earth Description: This little ritual allows one to turn wood into a liquid resin-like substance, which hardens over time or at the user's will into a hard amber-like form (not as hard or clear as amber glass). It is very sticky and makes great glue while fluid.

dual_casting.name: Dual Casting
dual_casting.description: You gain the ability, knowledge, and skill to cast two spells at the same time. You can run them in parallel - whether the same spell or two different ones. This makes the overall cost slightly higher, but it can be quite useful. This perk only affects active casting; sustained effects can run in parallel on their own.

efficient_interruption.name: Efficient Interruption
efficient_interruption.description: This perk grants you the skill, knowledge, and ability to interrupt spells mid-execution while recovering part of their cost. It also allows you to un-conjure certain things from the Transformation chapter and regain some of the cost, as well as stop a ritual before completion while retaining some of the cost not yet used in the effect. It never gives you back the whole cost, but even third is great in certain situations and sometimes there is a need to stop magic suddenly.

emotional_resonance.name: Emotional Resonance
emotional_resonance.description: Entering a specific state of mind or experiencing certain emotions can affect spells whose nature resonates with that feeling. This works especially well for many spells from the Curses and Blessings chapters, for instance. Using certain tricks and techniques, you can forcefully enter a specific state of mind or evoke a particular emotion, then use that state to influence your magical work: enhancing it, slightly warping its effect, or in some cases causing it to fail or rarely even miscast. This skill is not easy to execute and carries certain psychological risks.

enchantment_cooling_surface_charm.name: Enchantment: Cooling Surface Charm
enchantment_cooling_surface_charm.description: You've learned a new enchantment! Name: Cooling Surface Charm Aspect: 3 Air + 1 Order + 1 Water Description: This enchantment can be applied to a small surface. It persists for a few years, but gradually deteriorates over time and can be broken by severely damaging the enchanted object. When the surface bearing this charm moves through air, it causes the gas in contact with it to cool down by one or two degrees Celsius. The charm cannot bring temperatures lower than 19 degrees Celsius, but it is quite good to have cast on fan blades on a hot day.

esoteric_flames_of_cooking.name: Esoteric Flames of Cooking
esoteric_flames_of_cooking.description: You can generate and control small amounts of Cooking Fire: orbs, wisps, and sparks of warm yellow-brown flame that faintly smells of fresh bread, caramel, and roasted meat. You also possess the skill to craft small magitech devices and enchanted trinkets that can produce this flame autonomously using appropriate fuel or energy sources. The flame naturally exists between 250–600°C. Below that, it extinguishes; above, it collapses into mundane fire. The fire does not physically alter composition. Instead, it infuses materials with conceptual traits of Flavor and Nourishment. It even works on non-edible items, but usually not much. The effect depends on application: 1. Catalyzing (best): Cooking, brewing, or baking imparts rich, lasting flavor and enhanced nutritional value to the finished product. 2. Burning (worst): Complete combustion yields ash and smoke with faint nourishing properties - slightly better fertilizer for plants, but little else. 3. State-changing (nonfunctional): Melting or boiling produces no meaningful effect.

esoteric_flames_of_metal.name: Esoteric Flames of Metal
esoteric_flames_of_metal.description: You can generate and control small amounts of Metallic Fire: orbs, wisps, and sparks of heavy, glinting flame colored gray, copper and patina. You also possess the skill to craft small magitech devices and enchanted trinkets that can produce this flame autonomously using appropriate fuel or energy source. The flame naturally exists between 800-1600°C. Below that, it extinguishes; above, it collapses into mundane fire. The fire does not physically turn things to metal. Instead, it infuses materials with conceptual metallic traits while they interact with it. The effect depends on application: 1. Burning (best): Ash and smoke retain strong, permanent metallic properties - excellent for reagents or crafting. 2. Catalyzing (decent): Cooking, brewing, or firing clay imparts lasting but lesser metallic traits to the finished product. 3. State-changing (worst): Melting or boiling creates dramatic effects only while the material remains in that state; upon cooling, only faint, barely-detectible traces remain.

fluid_execution.name: Fluid Execution
fluid_execution.description: This perk grants you the skill, knowledge, and ability to fluidly and continuously transition from one spell into another without interrupting the overall process, assuming the spells are similar enough in nature. For example, transitioning from a spell that produces a cone of flame into one that creates a ray of fire is quite easy, with almost no increase in cost. This allows you to gradually morph one spell into another in the process of continuous execution.

hidden_spellwork.name: Hidden Spellwork
hidden_spellwork.description: This is the near-perfected methodology of Subtle Spellwork and Cosmetic Calibration. It allows you to conceal or almost completely remove any visible effects of a magical work: no light rays, visible projectiles, odd smells... Almost nothing. The spell can still be detected by more specialized observation and sensing methods, and the "carry" of the spell remains - it's just harder to perceive. There is still a ray, but it's invisible. Some spells cannot be hidden this way due to their inherent nature. >Requires Subtle Spellwork

litany.name: Litany
litany.description: By incorporating ritualistic aspects into your works of magic (such as specific gestures and signs, words, or even entire poems) you can increase the scale, intensity, and longevity of magical works to varying degrees. The kind of ritualistic aspects you use will slightly affect the spell and even change how it interacts with other metamagic options (for better or worse). Multiple ritualistic elements can be combined on a single spell to enhance it further. One spell can be affected using different ritualistic parts for various degrees of effect.With this, you can effectively pay with execution time and ritual performance to improve a spell without side effects. However, this approach may be unwieldy in certain situations.

martial_technique_armor_piercing.name: Martial Technique: Armor Piercing
martial_technique_armor_piercing.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Armor Piercing Aspect: 2 Metal + 1 Force + 1 Transformation Description: This technique is channeled through the tip of a weapon. At the moment of impact, the tip briefly becomes harder and more pointed, allowing it to pierce through armor that would otherwise deflect it. The effect is momentary - just long enough to penetrate.

martial_technique_blood_echo.name: Martial Technique: Blood Echo
martial_technique_blood_echo.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Blood Echo Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Mind + 1 Semblance Description: This technique causes a lingering imprint of your spilled blood to remain in the area. Anyone who steps into the blood later experiences a brief but intense phantom pain - as if they have stepped into a memory of violence or shard of glass.

martial_technique_bloody_feast.name: Martial Technique: Bloody Feast
martial_technique_bloody_feast.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Bloody Feast Aspect: 3 Hurt + 2 Healing Description: This technique causes spilled blood from the enemy that lands on and stains you to be consumed and transformed into a slight burst of healing and invigoration for the user.

martial_technique_bone_snapping.name: Martial Technique: Bone Snapping
martial_technique_bone_snapping.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Bone Snapping Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Earth Description: At the moment of attack, infuse your hit with magic, making most of the force of your attack transfer directly into the nearby bones in the area, instead of being diffused through surrounding tissues.

martial_technique_burning_blood.name: Martial Technique: Burning Blood
martial_technique_burning_blood.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Burning Blood Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Fire + 1 Life Description: This technique causes your own spilled blood, which lands on and sticks to the enemy, to suddenly become boiling hot and catch fire. It evaporates in the process, leaving burns on the enemy's body.

martial_technique_butchery.name: Martial Technique: Butchery
martial_technique_butchery.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Butchery Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Metal Description: This technique is channeled through the sharp edge of a weapon or tool. It makes it unusually efficient at cutting soft, unprotected tissues of the target. Even a relatively dulled edge can be dangerous with this technique. Doesn’t affect bones.

martial_technique_internal_trauma.name: Martial Technique: Internal Trauma
martial_technique_internal_trauma.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Internal Trauma Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Water Description: At the moment of attack, infuse your hit with magic, making most of the force of your attack transfer as vibrations and spikes of pressure in blood vessels in the area where the attack lands.

martial_technique_lunge.name: Martial Technique: Lunge
martial_technique_lunge.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Lunge Aspect: 1 Transformation Description: This sword technique allows the user to lengthen their blade for a moment in a burst of motion when performing a lunging attack (up to 4 inches). It gives an unexpected burst of reach for the attack.

martial_technique_pain_transfer.name: Martial Technique: Pain Transfer
martial_technique_pain_transfer.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Pain Transfer Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Life Description: Transfer part of your current sensation of pain with each landed strike. It causes a sudden spike of pain and discomfort in the hit area of the target briefly, at the same time slightly reducing the pain of the user for a moment.

martial_technique_red_echo.name: Martial Technique: Red Echo
martial_technique_red_echo.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Red Echo Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Air Description: Channel Hurt through your breath and voice. When you shout or exhale sharply, the sound carries a minor Hurt effect - causing brief, sharp pain in the ears and sinuses of anyone within close range. The effect is disorienting but not damaging.

martial_technique_red_mist.name: Martial Technique: Red Mist
martial_technique_red_mist.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Red Mist Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Mind Description: This technique makes your sweat evaporate and linger around your body as a barely visible red-tinted aura of steam. When opponents touch the steam, the area touched gets amplified pain sensations. If they feel pain in the place of contact, it becomes worse.

martial_technique_red_shadow.name: Martial Technique: Red Shadow
martial_technique_red_shadow.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Red Shadow Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Semblance Description: Channel Hurt through your movements. Afterimages of your attacks linger in the air for a moment - a faint red glow that pulses with violet. Anyone struck by the afterimage, which then fades quickly, experiences a brief but intense burst of pain, as if they had been hit. More advanced usage can create these afterimages for a multitude of attacks at once.

martial_technique_red_skin.name: Martial Technique: Red Skin
martial_technique_red_skin.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Red Skin Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Protection Description: Channel magic through your skin in a specific way. Your skin will appear slightly redder. When a creature attacks you using their body parts, those body parts will suffer twice as much of natural blowback, making it more painful to punch or kick, or otherwise attack you without a weapon.

martial_technique_red_strikes.name: Martial Technique: Red Strikes
martial_technique_red_strikes.description: You've learned two new martial techniques! Name: Red Punch Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: Channel the Hurt aspect in a specific way through your fists, forearms, and elbows to make your punches twice as efficient and damaging against creatures. Name: Red Kick Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: Channel the Hurt aspect in a specific way through your feet, shins, and knees to make your kicks twice as efficient and damaging against creatures.

martial_technique_shield_breaking.name: Martial Technique: Shield Breaking
martial_technique_shield_breaking.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Shield Breaking Aspect: 3 Metal + 1 Destruction Description: This simple sword technique, used at the moment of attack, makes the blade more efficient at deforming and cutting metal.

martial_technique_shrug_it_off.name: Martial Technique: Shrug It Off
martial_technique_shrug_it_off.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Shrug It Off Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Hurt + 1 Aether Description: A more unorthodox technique, usually used in bursts. It temporarily turns off the feeling of pain and reduces damage to half, but only if the user takes the hit on purpose. Perfect for moments, when one wants to trade the hits.

martial_technique_solar_prominence.name: Martial Technique: Solar Prominence
martial_technique_solar_prominence.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Solar Prominence Aspect: 1 Fire + 1 Light Description: This martial technique allows the user to create and partially control the shape of bright loops of plasma extending from their body. Good for melee attacks or to evaporate incoming projectiles.

martial_technique_swift_and_heavy.name: Martial Technique: Swift and Heavy
martial_technique_swift_and_heavy.description: You've learned a martial technique! Name: Swift and Heavy Aspect: 1 Space + 1 Force Description: This martial technique targets a tool or weapon wielded by the user. While infused, the user can change the object's effective inertia and mass at will: making it up to ten times lighter or heavier, and doing so almost instantly. Doesn't make target more or less durable.

martial_technique_vulnerability.name: Martial Technique: Vulnerability
martial_technique_vulnerability.description: You've learned a new martial technique! Name: Vulnerability Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Destruction Description: Push some of the magic into your target while attacking. The place you push it into will be temporarily weakened and more vulnerable against subsequent attacks to this area, especially if you are using the Hurt aspect as part of the attack.

multi_casting.name: Multi Casting
multi_casting.description: This is nigh perfected methodology, natural talent, and skill derived from Dual and Triple Casting. You can juggle multiple magical works at once in parallel with only a slight increase in overall cost. How many you can cast simultaneously, and how safe and depended it is, depends on the nature of the spells in question. >Requires Triple Casting

mystic_craft_catch-curse_talisman.name: Mystic Craft: Catch-Curse Talisman
mystic_craft_catch-curse_talisman.description: You've learned a new mystic craft! Name: Catch-Curse Talisman Aspect: 3 Creation + 2 Protection Description: This magical craft allows you to create special amulets (ofuda) that intercept and absorb curses, burning away instead of allowing the curse to affect the wielder, but only if the curse strikes the amulet or lands close to it. These talismans can also be used to temporarily weaken and slow an existing curse's active effect, consuming the amulet in the process.

mystic_craft_ward_from_evil.name: Mystic Craft: Ward from Evil
mystic_craft_ward_from_evil.description: You've learned a new mystic craft! Name: Ward from Evil Aspect: 3 Protection + 1 Creation Description: This is the art of creating a protective mark on a body that prevents curses from sticking and weakens their initial effects. The closer a curse strikes to the mark, the more effective the protection. With each curse blocked or weakened, the mark diminishes until it eventually vanishes. This mark can also be placed on an object to prevent it from being cursed.

overcharge.name: Overcharge
overcharge.description: You gain the ability, knowledge, and skill to overcharge your spells. This allows you to put more "power" into any work of magic to intensify its effect or increase its scale (within certain limits). Limitations and unique interactions vary between spells. Some spells may even offer multiple ways to overcharge them. However, overcharged spells are usually less stable and more prone to miscasting, as well as harder to wield with accuracy.

quick_execution.name: Quick Execution
quick_execution.description: This methodology lets you "rush" spells and some other works of magic to execute them faster by skipping certain steps, using mnemonic tricks, and performing several parts of a single magical work at once. How much you can rush a spell depends on its nature: some spells cannot be quick-executed at all. Spells cast this way are riskier and more prone to miscasting. Their intensity may also be either reduced or increased unpredictably. The main drawback is the inconsistency of these side effects, though the general nature of the spell is always preserved.

ritual_alloy_separation.name: Ritual: Alloy Separation
ritual_alloy_separation.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Alloy Separation Aspect: 3 Metal + 3 Transformation + 2 Chaos + 1 Order Description: This is a small ritual that separates a targeted volume of metal alloy into its component elements. For example, it can separate brass into copper and zinc, or steel into iron and carbon. The process is slow and requires precision. It is less effective and slower on alloys with many components.

ritual_bring_helping_hands.name: Ritual: Bring Helping Hands
ritual_bring_helping_hands.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Bring Helping Hands Aspect: 2 Alien + 1 Semblance + 1 Mind + 1 Force Description: Use a ritual to obtain or discard this capability. You can summon ghost-like hands from the realm of palms. They can perform simple tasks requiring dexterity. They are much better at their job if you know how to do what you ask of them using your own hands - they partially draw on your understanding and skills. They cannot stay too far from you for too long, or the summoning will break (after about half an hour, give or take). You can summon two, four, six, eight, ten, or a dozen hands, and assign and reassign tasks to and between individual hands.

ritual_candy_golem.name: Ritual: Candy Golem
ritual_candy_golem.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Candy Golem Aspect: 6 Sweet + 3 Earth + 2 Life + 1 Semblance Description: This ritual animates a large quantity of sugar-based confections (hard candy, taffy, caramel, etc.) into a temporary, golem-like servant. The golem is surprisingly strong and can be shaped into a crude humanoid form. It moves with a sticky, cracking sound. However, it is vulnerable to water (which dissolves it), heat (which melts it), and anything that likes to eat sugar. The golem lasts for a few hours before crumbling into inert, stale candy.

ritual_cleansing_pyre.name: Ritual: Cleansing Pyre
ritual_cleansing_pyre.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Cleansing Pyre Aspect: 4 Fire + 3 Order + 2 Aether + 1 Death + 1 Purity Description: This ritual is designed to separate a curse from its target (land, object, or creature) and burn it in purifying flames. The cost and complexity scale with the nature, intensity, and scale of the curse. Full success: The curse is erased (without reversing its physical effects) and yields purified remnants (white ash, milky water, etc.) which can be used in future Cleansing Pyre rituals against the same or similar curses, greatly reducing cost and complexity. Partial success: The curse may be separated and latched onto something else nearby (warping it in the process), or weakened enough to fade on its own over time. Failure: The curse is unaffected, or at most temporarily weakened.

ritual_forest_awakening.name: Ritual: Forest Awakening
ritual_forest_awakening.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Forest Awakening Aspect: 4 Wood + 3 Life + 2 Creation + 1 Transformation + 1 Earth Description: A large ritual that can sprout an entire grove from fallen wood. It requires a piece of wood from each tree and a decent amount of time and energy to perform. The result is a new forest, growing from the remnants of the old.

ritual_induction_forge.name: Ritual: Induction Forge
ritual_induction_forge.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Induction Forge Aspect: 5 Fire + 3 Metal + 2 Lightning + 1 Light + 1 Transformation Description: An advanced variant of Induction in the form of a ritual. This ritual creates a contained field that rapidly heats metal placed within it, reaching temperatures up to 2,599°C - more than enough to melt iron and steel. The field is stable and can be maintained for extended periods, and controlled, making it ideal for foundry work and advanced metalworking.

ritual_inevitability.name: Ritual: Inevitability
ritual_inevitability.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Inevitability Aspect: 1 Chaos + 1 Destruction + 1 Order + 1 Time + 1 Space + 5 Essence Description: This complicated ritual lets one catch and make physical the entropy that surrounds us everywhere in the universe. It plucks this principle from all around and turns it into a gray, ever-burning flame. This fire can be moved; it is imperishable by normal means and causes anything intersecting its volume to reach its end. If part of a metal rod intersects the flame, it will appear as though its time accelerates faster and faster, until it reaches the end state of its existence.

ritual_lesser_flame_summoning.name: Ritual:  Lesser Flame Summoning
ritual_lesser_flame_summoning.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Lesser Flame Summoning Aspect: 2 Alien + 2 Flame + 1 Aether Description: Summon a lesser spirit of fire to perform a task or bind it to your service. They do not have a mind of their own beyond what the summoner gives them. They have a strange way of thinking. Such a spirit might be used to power a large lantern or be settled into a furnace. In certain circumstances, it is possible for a lesser spirit to grow or become unstable, but this usually does not happen.

ritual_quicklime_transmutation.name: Ritual: Quicklime Transmutation
ritual_quicklime_transmutation.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Quicklime Transmutation Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Fire + 1 Transformation Description: This small ritual transforms limestone or shells into quicklime, a key ingredient for mortar, plaster, and tanning. The process is quick and efficient, producing usable quicklime in minutes rather than days.

ritual_stone_liquefaction.name: Ritual: Stone Liquefaction
ritual_stone_liquefaction.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Stone Liquefaction Aspect: 3 Earth + 2 Water + 1 Transformation Description: This ritual targets a volume of stone (up to 54.3 cubic meters) and turns it into a liquid similar to cement, but textured like the targeted stone. Different liquefied stones cannot mix. This "cement" will set over time and turn back into the original stone. Denser kinds of rock create heavier, less fluid "cement" and harden back more quickly.

ritual_summon_imp.name: Ritual: Summon Imp
ritual_summon_imp.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Summon Imp Aspect: 2 Alien + 1 Fire + 1 Hurt Description: Summon and trap a weak creature from some hellish dimension to bind it to serve you in exchange for something or by force. They are varied, and an experienced practitioner might find a specific kind of imp they desire for the job. Dead imps leave behind almost no physical traces. They are as smart as a human toddler, but cunning in certain areas, and different imps have different talents.

ritual_summon_the_dead.name: Ritual: Summon the Dead
ritual_summon_the_dead.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Summon the Dead Aspect: 6 Aether + 4 Lore + 4 Death + 1 Alien + 1 Chaos Description: This unique and unusual work of magic allows you to summon echoes of the dead - something like ghosts. It works best on the recently dead or preserved corpses, and using it repeatedly on the same place makes the spell work less effectively. Unfortunately, you probably won't be able to interrogate anything useful from the echo of the dead. They are happy, blissful, and usually talk about good things, or simply sing. They are incapable of suffering. Weird.

ritual_the_sun_calling.name: Ritual: The Sun Calling
ritual_the_sun_calling.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: The Sun Calling Aspect: 1 Light + 3 Fire + 2 Air + 1 Space Description: This is a complicated ritual that usually takes a few days to complete and requires rare materials to be consumed. The end result of a successful ritual is a dark, obsidian-like shape that resembles an egg. When the object is accelerated, it produces a dim warm glow. When broken or activated by magic, the object begins to glow: red → yellow → white → blue... and then it transforms into a miniature sun, emulating fusion processes within, causing a massive explosion (approximately one-tenth of a kiloton). If the ritual is disturbed, it either fails and fizzles out, or it causes a much smaller explosion without the "phoenix egg" being formed.

ritual_transition_ice.name: Ritual: Transition Ice
ritual_transition_ice.description: You've learned a new ritual! Name: Transition Ice Aspect: 4 Water + 3 Transformation Description: This is a specialized ritual that targets water ice.
