It allows an experienced practitioner to transition the ice into a different crystalline phase (types that normally exist only under extreme pressure or temperature conditions) and keep it stable for a limited time. Some are easier to make and do persist for longer. The ritual depends heavily on the user's knowledge.

rutial_the_moon_calling.name: Rutial: The Moon Calling
rutial_the_moon_calling.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: The Moon Calling Aspect: 1 Water + 3 Aether + 2 Mind + 1 Space Description: This is a complicated ritual that usually takes a few days to complete and requires rare materials to be consumed. The end result of a successful ritual is a pearl-like shape with a blueish iridescent tint. When the object is accelerated, it becomes dimmer and darker. When broken or activated by magic, the pearl plants a vivid vision and experience into the minds of everyone caught in the produced wave of silver light (approximately 100 meters radius). The nature of the mental add-on is decided when the ritual is performed, and the effect irreversibly alters the personality and beliefs of those caught in it. If the ritual is disturbed, it either fails and fizzles out, or it causes a much smaller and less predictable "wave of madness" to be released.

slot_preparation.name: Slot Preparation
slot_preparation.description: You can spend time to convert a work of magic into a matrix of sorts and create a temporary slot for it in your soul. The process has an associated cost, but it mostly just takes a lot of time (from several minutes to a full day). A spell placed in a slot is suspended at no ongoing cost and can be instantly executed by you at any time. However, it cannot be modified in any way. The only way to free the slot is either to cast the spell or to take just as long to unravel it from the slot. You can prepare several slots this way. How many depends on the nature of the spells you place in them, but typically you can maintain between one and seven slots at once. >Requires Chain Casting

spell_absorption_nudge.name: Spell: Absorption Nudge
spell_absorption_nudge.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Absorption Nudge Aspect: 1 Life + 1 Transformation + 1 Water Description: This spell can be cast on medicine, on the patient, or on both simultaneously. It helps the drug to be absorbed more quickly and to take effect sooner. A skilled medic can even use this spell to nudge the drug toward specific areas of the body first, or to reduce its presence in others, making treatment more efficient and lowering side effects.

spell_adaptive_shell.name: Spell: Adaptive Shell
spell_adaptive_shell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Adaptive Shell Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Lore + 1 Transformation Description: This spell creates a protective shell around the caster that adapts to the type of attack it faces. When struck by fire, the shell becomes fire-resistant. When struck by a blade, it hardens. When struck by a curse, it becomes resistant to magic. The adaptation is not instant (it takes a few hits to fully adjust) and the shell can only adapt to one or two damage types at a time. The effect lasts for 17 minutes.

spell_air_hammer.name: Spell: Air Hammer
spell_air_hammer.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Air Hammer Aspect: 2 Force + 1 Air + 1 Semblance Description: The caster makes a hammering motion with their fist. A ghostly, translucent hammer head appears at the point of impact, delivering a precise, controlled strike. The force can be tuned from a gentle tap to a solid blow (but never more than a strong man could deliver with a real hammer). The spell does not damage the caster's hand.

spell_anesthetic_touch.name: Spell: Anesthetic Touch
spell_anesthetic_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Anesthetic Touch Aspect: 2 Healing + 1 Mind + 1 Life Description: This spell numbs a targeted area of the patient's body, blocking pain signals without affecting consciousness or motor function. The effect lasts for up to an hour, depending on the area and the patient's constitution. Useful for surgery or treating painful injuries without general anesthesia.

spell_antibody_focus.name: Spell: Antibody Focus
spell_antibody_focus.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Antibody Focus Aspect: 5 Life + 2 Order + 1 Healing + 1 Mind + 1 Protection Description: This spell is a variant of Immune Fortification that allows the healer to direct the patient's immune system toward a specific threat: a particular pathogen, a known allergen, or a recognized cancer marker. The spell requires the healer to understand the target and provides no protection against other threats. The effect lasts for several hours. Less risk of auto-immune symptoms due to the focused nature of the spell. >Requires Spell: Immune Fortification

spell_banishment.name: Spell: Banishment
spell_banishment.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Banishment Aspect: 2 Destruction + 1 Chaos + 1 Order Description: This spell causes all matter and energy in a small targeted radius (up to six inches) to vanish without a trace. The spell has a unique sound and the effect of a black orb appearing in the targeted area for just a moment, leaving behind a cleanly cut-out volume. It requires a second to target, and if miscast, the sphere of annihilation will appear somewhere within the caster's body.

spell_become_entropy.name: Spell: Become Entropy
spell_become_entropy.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Become Entropy Aspect: 1 Chaos Description: Choose a point on your body from which the spell will be cast. From this point, everything within a few meters in a direction of your choice will suddenly have its entropy heightened: things will break down, mix, and reach thermal equilibrium over a few seconds. In practical terms: things disintegrate. However, you are inevitably caught at the edge of the spell's volume of effect. If you cast it from your fingertips in a forward direction, your hand will also succumb to entropy. The spell is more effective against targets of lesser density, and certain materials or composites are more resistant to it than others.

spell_bleed.name: Spell: Bleed!
spell_bleed.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bleed! Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Water + 1 Life Description: This spell is channeled through a weapon or through the caster themselves. Wounds left by weapons with Bleed! channeled cause blood to stop coagulating and become thinner near the puncture temporarily, causing them to bleed profusely for a few minutes. Even blunt wounds are affected, but to a lesser degree - this spell works best for cuts and punctures.

spell_blemish_erase.name: Spell: Blemish Erase
spell_blemish_erase.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Blemish Erasure Aspect: 1 Destruction + 1 Water + 1 Order Description: This spell targets stains and spots on surfaces, breaking them down molecule by molecule until they vanish. Unlike Dust Banishment, it can handle stuck-on stains, but it requires the caster to understand the nature of the stain (oil, wine, blood, etc.) and takes longer to work. Cannot be used on living tissue.

spell_blood_clotting.name: Spell: Blood Clotting
spell_blood_clotting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Blood Clotting Aspect: 2 Healing + 1 Water + 1 Life Description: This spell accelerates the body's natural clotting process, rapidly sealing wounds and stopping internal bleeding. The effect is localized to the wound and does not affect the rest of the circulatory system. Useful for deep wounds or internal injuries.

spell_bloodletting.name: Spell: Bloodletting
spell_bloodletting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bloodletting Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Water Description: The carrier of this spell resembles liquid crimson lightning. When Bloodletting strikes, it causes nearby blood vessels to burst and temporarily prevents blood from coagulating. This typically results in severe internal bleeding.

spell_bloody_steam.name: Spell: Bloody Steam
spell_bloody_steam.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bloody Steam Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Fire + 1 Water Description: This spell is used on touch or via a short-lived, misty red orb that flies toward the target. The spell causes blood (up to 7.2 liters) to instantly reach its boiling point and go beyond, turning into hot, pressurized steam. This usually causes blood vessels and organs to violently burst. Be careful - the steam can scorch you too!

spell_bludgeoning_spell.name: Spell: Bludgeoning Spell
spell_bludgeoning_spell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bludgeoning Spell Aspect: 1 Force Description: This spell manifests as a semi-transparent, light-orange projectile shaped like a fuzzy disc or slab. When it strikes a target, it applies high force across the area of contact, pushing and shattering whatever it hits. It is strong enough to easily knock down a door or overturn a car. The spell can be tuned to be more or less powerful as needed.

spell_bone_breaker.name: Spell: Bone Breaker
spell_bone_breaker.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bone Breaker Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Life Description: The carrier of this spell is a projectile that can pass through low-density obstacles and living tissue, though it gradually loses power and can eventually be stopped. When it strikes bone, it interacts like fast-moving metallic material, typically fracturing or breaking it.

spell_bone_mending.name: Spell: Bone Mending
spell_bone_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bone Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation + 1 Order Description: This spell is a specialized variation of Organic Mending, focused specifically on repairing mechanical damage to bone. It can also regenerate small amounts of lost bone tissue. The spell can be guided with high accuracy and precision by the practitioner, allowing even complex fractures to be fully repaired. >Requires Spell: Organic Mending

spell_bone-whisper.name: Spell: Bone-Whisper
spell_bone-whisper.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bone-Whisper Aspect: 1 Death + 1 Mind + 1 Aether Description: This spell allows the caster to receive vague impressions from a corpse or skeleton: fragments of memory, emotion, or sensation from the moment of death. The older the corpse, the fainter the impressions.

spell_bubble_telekinesis.name: Spell: Bubble Telekinesis
spell_bubble_telekinesis.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bubble Telekinesis Aspect: 2 Force + 1 Air Description: This spell creates a barely visible bubble that can be used to envelop and lift objects. Things moved this way become buoyant inside the bubble and will follow it as it moves. This spell can lift and move very heavy objects, but it does so slowly. Trying to push it to move more quickly might separate the object from the bubble enveloping it. This spell can move loose materials like sand, gravel, or even liquids, but it may lose some small pieces while moving such materials.

spell_bug-zapper.name: Spell: Bug-Zapper
spell_bug-zapper.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Bug-Zapper Aspect: 1 Lightning Description: This spell can be cast on oneself or infused into a small object. It creates a temporary field (up to 0.55 meter radius) around the target that "zaps" any flying or fast-moving insect with a small shock, killing it instantly. Can be briefly overwhelmed by obscene amount of bugs!

spell_burning_sphere.name: Spell: Burning Sphere
spell_burning_sphere.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Burning Sphere Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This spell creates a small, bubble-like projectile as small as a fist, filled with orange fire. Many bubbles can be created quickly. The projectile is heavy and very hot; it rams into and melts things on contact, getting smaller over time or from burning through things.

spell_butchers_punishment.name: Spell: Butcher's Punishment
spell_butchers_punishment.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Butcher's Punishment Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Curse + 1 Space Description: This spell is channeled through a sharp edge, giving it a slight crimson-brown tint. When it strikes a part of the body, the wound grows until it separates that part from the body. However, the severed areas remain connected to each other - the cut itself acts as a kind of portal, linking the separated parts across space. A head chopped off with this spell remains attached to the body through this spatial connection, and no viscera is lost. Unfortunately, the victim still feels the sensation of having that body part cut off: constantly, without relief.

spell_cancer_killing_array.name: Spell: Cancer Killing Array
spell_cancer_killing_array.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Cancer Killing Array Aspect: 5 Healing + 2 Life + 1 Death + 3 Order + 2 Transformation Description: This complex, modular spell is designed to counter malignant tumors. It operates through several vectors: detecting problematic tissue, killing or reverting cancerous cells, and temporarily training the immune system to accurately recognize that specific cancer type. With repeated use, this immune training can become semi-permanent for this specific kind of cancer. The spell requires significant time and focus to execute. Multiple applications are usually needed to fully eliminate a tumor, and it may miss isolated rogue cells. The lengthy process is due to the vast diversity of cancer types, even within a single tissue. The spell cannot harm healthy tissues.

spell_caramel_shell.name: Spell: Caramel Shell
spell_caramel_shell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Caramel Shell Aspect: 3 Protection + 2 Sweet Description: This spell coats the caster or a target in a thin, glossy layer of hardened caramel. The layer is surprisingly durable (it can deflect minor blows and resist heat) but it's brittle against cold or repeated impacts. It also makes the target smell delicious, which is a liability against hungry beasts. Caramel is not permanent and most of it disappear afterwards.

spell_carnage.name: Spell: Carnage
spell_carnage.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Carnage Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Chaos Description: This is a bolt-quick streak of yellow-crimson color. When it hits a creature, it causes tissues around the zone of impact to explode like a bloody, gory balloon. It can be blocked by thick enough physical barriers and it simply punches them instead. The volume it explodes can be tuned within certain limits (from exploding a finger, to popping half the torso of tissue).

spell_carve_wood.name: Spell: Carve Wood
spell_carve_wood.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Carve Wood Aspect: 3 Wood + 1 Force Description: This spell infuses a piece of wood with a touch and produces a cutting surface that intersects the volume of the material. The cut can be made rough or smooth, and the geometry of the surface can vary: a simple plane passing through the volume, a cut that does not go all the way through, a wavy surface, or even one with holes. It cannot, however, produce a completely closed surface. After the cutting surface is placed inside the volume of the wood, the caster activates it, causing the cut to follow the surface's geometry through the material they are touching. It works quicker and easier on less dense types of wood.

spell_cauterize_wounds.name: Spell: Cauterize Wounds
spell_cauterize_wounds.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Cauterize Wounds Aspect: 1 Healing + 1 Fire Description: This spell allows the user to efficiently and quickly cauterize wounds with just a touch, stopping bleeding and sealing the wound closed. The process is painful and leaves burns and scars, but it is highly effective in emergencies where proper treatment is unavailable.

spell_cease.name: Spell: Cease!
spell_cease.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Cease! Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Air + 1 Aether Description: This spell is transmitted by voice: whoever hears the caster's voice while their throat is infused with the spell will be affected. It has a maximum radius of five meters, and the effect slowly becomes weaker over distance. A louder voice makes the effect stronger in the radius. It works in short bursts (such as the next word spoken). The spell causes the target to experience a sudden but short-lived headache (like a severe migraine) and slight muscle cramps in random parts of their body. Not hearing the voice prevents the effect from working.

spell_cellular_resuscitation.name: Spell: Cellular Resuscitation
spell_cellular_resuscitation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Cellular Resuscitation Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Aether + 1 Order + 1 Time Description: This spell reverses the death of recently deceased cells and repairs cellular-level damage in targeted tissues. It is highly effective against necrosis and radiation damage. While the spell cannot fully repair DNA, it can reliably address recent and severe DNA damage. It does not affect genetic disorders - only damage incurred relatively recently and that is unnatural for the body's usual state.

spell_choke.name: Spell: Choke!
spell_choke.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Choke! Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Aether + 1 Air Description: This spell is channeled through the user's body and transmitted by their scent (such as blood and sweat). When a target smells the caster while the spell is active, they suddenly choke - their airways contract. The spell's effect works like a poison; it lingers after being applied and can even damage the airways. However, it lasts only for a limited time. The strength of the effect depends on the olfactory acuity of the target, and its duration depends on how long they perceive the smell (up to nine minutes of active choking).

spell_chord_of_true_level.name: Spell: Chord of True Level
spell_chord_of_true_level.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Chord of True Level Aspect: 2 Space + 1 Order Description: The caster snaps a length of ordinary twine or rope taut between two stakes. They then whisper the spell and flick the twine. A barely-visible ripple of blue-white light travels along the cord, and the twine goes unnaturally rigid. For the next hour, the twine is magically anchored to the planet's gravitational core, making it a perfectly horizontal and vibration-less reference line. This is the surveyor's best friend, used to lay perfectly straight aqueduct channels, set door frames, and pour flawless floors. The twine can be moved and re-anchored, but each re-setting requires a new casting.

spell_coal_making.name: Spell:  Coal Making
spell_coal_making.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Coal Making Aspect: 2 Transformation + 1 Wood + 1 Fire Description: This spell is used on a volume of wood to gradually turn it into charcoal of that type of wood. It works more quickly on many smaller chunks of wood than on one large piece. The larger the volume, the longer it takes. There is a maximum volume of a target (around 1.72 cubic meters).

spell_compression.name: Spell Compression
spell_compression.description: This method lets you shorten the duration of a spell's effect while increasing its intensity in the moment. It interacts with the spell's carrier in various ways - details you'll need to discover on your own. This technique is applied to the spell's effect, but the carrier is always affected as well. Some spell's carrier may become quicker but more short-lived, losing their maximum range. For continuous works of magic, the intensified effect may become less stable over time. However, in the moment, intensity increases significantly while the cost rises only slightly to moderately.

spell_concrete_setting.name: Spell: Concrete Setting
spell_concrete_setting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Concrete Setting Aspect: 1 Earth + 1 Order Description: This spell targets mortar, cement, or similar binding materials. It accelerates and refines the setting process, meaning the material turns solid more quickly and with fewer internal imperfections than it would naturally. When the spell takes effect, it produces a small burst of infrared light and a modest amount of waste heat.

spell_confects_touch.name: Spell: Confect's Touch
spell_confects_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Confect's Touch Aspect: 2 Sweet + 1 Fire + 1 Transformation Description: This spell lets you heat up and melt sugar, then control it telekinetically to some extent. It gives a bit of feedback info about movements of the substance being controlled. Good for shaping candies.

spell_convection_wave.name: Spell: Convection Wave
spell_convection_wave.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Convection Wave Aspect: 1 Fire + 2 Air + 1 Force Description: This spell creates a visible wave of shimmering heat that blasts outward from the user, pushing targets away while searing them with hot air. The wave is brief but intense, enough to knock down and painfully burn anyone within its path.

spell_create_salt.name: Spell: Create Salt
spell_create_salt.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Create Salt Aspect: 1 Creation + 1 Earth Description: This spell allows the caster to create a piece of pure, permanent salt (either as one chunk or as several smaller pieces) in a simple shape, which soon after creation is affected by gravity and falls. It can create a maximum of 0.314 kilograms of salt per casting.

spell_create_sugar.name: Spell: Create Sugar
spell_create_sugar.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Create Sugar Aspect: 3 Sweet + 2 Creation Description: This spell creates up to 122 grams of sugar. It can do so in various forms: a simple shape (like a cube), sand or dust sugar, or hardened caramel. The created sugar is permanent and, aside from glucose, contains some other edible sugars in smaller quantities.

spell_create_water.name: Spell: Create Water
spell_create_water.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Create Water Aspect: 1 Water + 1 Creation Description: This spell allows the caster to create a small amount of pure water per casting. It can produce up to 0.909 liters of water at a time, in the form of a simple shape, which is soon after creation affected by gravity. This water contains no impurities - it is perfectly distilled and permanent. The temperature of the water can vary between 4 and 66 degrees Celsius, and this can be tuned by the caster.

spell_crimson_flame.name: Spell: Crimson Flame
spell_crimson_flame.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Crimson Flame Aspect: 3 Fire + 1 Hurt Description: The spell produces streams, bursts or small projectiles of special flame. This crimson fire is not very hot (around 100 degrees Celsius), produces a sound of rubbing needles, and sticks to living tissues. Damage from this flame mostly comes from the small cuts and pinpricks it causes to living tissues while it is stuck, turning the material it "burns" into mincemeat. This fire consumes blood as fuel - as if it were gas for the flame.

spell_crystallization.name: Spell: Crystallization
spell_crystallization.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Crystallization Aspect: 1 Water + 1 Order + 1 Transformation Description: This spell rapidly causes a targeted liquid to crystallize and become solid. It does not require contact, but proximity is needed, and crystallization starts from the closest point to the caster. The spell does not lower the temperature of the liquid - it merely makes it solid and keeps it that way for a time, or while the spell is sustained by the caster. For example, it can turn boiling water into ice and keep it in that state for a few hours (or while actively sustained), while preserving its boiling hot temperature. Different kinds of liquids require different fine-tuning of the spell; some liquids are easier to affect than others. When the spell duration ends, the targeted substance returns to its normal state.

spell_death_ray.name: Spell: Death Ray
spell_death_ray.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Death Ray Aspect: 1 Light + 2 Death + 1 Hurt Description: This spell produces a ray of light that flies at supersonic speed and possesses penetrative properties similar to an X-ray beam. When it strikes living tissue, it causes death and decomposition from the point of contact. At full power, a single good hit from this spell is enough to kill a quarter of the cells in an average human by volume, and causing a sixth to decompose into simple organic sludge.

spell_decapitation.name: Spell: Decapitation
spell_decapitation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Decapitation Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Force + 1 Semblance Description: Make a chopping gesture with your hand. Around your palm and extending some distance away from it (approximately five inches from the fingertips), a burning-like crimson aura will appear, which sounds like a knife being sharpened when moved through the air. If the aura touches the neck of another living creature, it leaves a small cut, which quickly grows into a clean decapitation. It can be temporarily disrupted or blocked by physical objects (as if it was a physical flame).

spell_defibrillation.name: Spell: Defibrillation
spell_defibrillation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Defibrillation Aspect: 1 Healing + 1 Lightning Description: This spell functions like a finely tuned defibrillator. The user lays their palms on the patient's chest and channels the spell through them. It does not work on other parts of the body and cannot be used to produce a shock on demand - it is specifically calibrated to restore proper heart rhythm.

spell_deflection_field.name: Spell: Deflection Field
spell_deflection_field.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Deflection Field Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Air Description: This spell creates a subtle, invisible field around the caster that gently deflects incoming projectiles (arrows, bolts, and small thrown objects) slightly off course. The deflection is not perfect; it causes the projectile to miss by a few inches rather than stopping it entirely. Fast-moving or extremely heavy projectiles are less affected. The field lasts for several minutes or until the caster is struck by a hit that exceeds its capacity.

spell_deformation_curse.name: Spell: Deformation Curse
spell_deformation_curse.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Deformation Curse Aspect: 2 Curse + 2 Hurt + 1 Transformation Description: This curse manifests as a continuous, fluid-like ray of energy with a faint scent of rotten blood. When it strikes a living creature, it begins to slowly and painfully deform their bone and muscle structure. The effect is not deadly and leaves almost no actual tissue or organ damage, but it is severely crippling and distorting. The point of impact is affected the most, and the user can decide the general direction of the deformation. Like all curses, it resists being reversed.

spell_disarming_spell.name: Spell: Disarming Spell
spell_disarming_spell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Disarming Spell Aspect: 1 Mind + 1 Force + 1 Air Description: This spell produces a quick red carrier ray that forces the target to unclench their hands (or similar appendages) and release whatever they are wielding, while simultaneously propelling the item away from them.

spell_disinfection.name: Spell: Disinfection
spell_disinfection.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Disinfection Aspect: 9 Spirit + 1 Death + 1 Purity Description: This spell produces a small amount of temporary liquid with a slightly gelatinous consistency that smells like alcohol. It is a great disinfectant and good at loosing the stains to be removed.

spell_draft-ward_seal.name: Spell: Draft-Ward Seal
spell_draft-ward_seal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Draft-Ward Seal Aspect: 2 Air + 1 Order Description: The caster traces the outline of a door, window, or city-gate with their finger, leaving a faint silver tracing. The spell doesn't stop airflow completely, but it equalizes air pressure and temperature between the inside and outside by "slowing" the chaotic movement of air particles to a gentle, laminar flow. Ward deteriorates over a few weeks and can be disrupted.

spell_drubbing.name: Spell: Drubbing
spell_drubbing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Drubbing Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: This spell produces a swarm (12 to 43) of small orbs, which look like semi-transparent ball bearings filled with red and violet swirls. They flow together like a swarm of flies and can be sustained by the caster as a relentless wave of newly produced orbs, and even slightly controlled. Each one creates a small impact on contact with inanimate things and punches like a fist on contact with a creature. They pop on impact.

spell_dry_bones.name: Spell: Dry Bones
spell_dry_bones.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Dry Bones Aspect: 2 Death + 1 Fire + 1 Earth Description: This spell targets a dead body (or parts of one) and rapidly draws out all remaining moisture, leaving the tissue dried and preserved. It works best on bones, but can also dry flesh, sinew, and organs. Used for preparing anatomical specimens, creating bone tools, or preserving trophies. The process takes about half an hour and leaves the remains brittle but stable.

spell_dust_banishment.name: Spell: Dust Banishment
spell_dust_banishment.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Dust Banishment Aspect: 1 Destruction + 2 Earth Description: This spell targets dust and small debris on surfaces, making them instantly vanish without a trace and leaving a clean surface behind. It cannot target stains that are strongly stuck to the surface, and it may require several castings if there is a significant amount of dust. If the amount is too great, the spell will not work at all - it cannot be used to vanish a pile of dust. The spell works better on some types of dust and worse on others.

spell_edge-sharpening.name: Spell: Edge-Sharpening
spell_edge-sharpening.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Edge-Sharpening Aspect: 2 Transformation + 1 Order + 1 Force Description: This spell allows the caster to sharpen the edge of a blade or tool with their thumb. The user can control the angle and fineness of the edge with each pass of their thumb along the blade. Harder materials take more passes and it cannot affect things harder than glass. The spell cannot create an edge from a dull surface - it only refines an existing edge. It works worse, if the edge is less defined.

spell_enrich_soil.name: Spell: Enrich Soil
spell_enrich_soil.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Enrich Soil Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Creation + 1 Life Description: This spell targets a volume of soil (no more than five cubic meters at a time) and, over the course of ten minutes, enriches it with beneficial elements, making it more fertile. However, it uses substances already present in the soil and duplicates them in small quantities. It is possible for the soil to be too diminished in one or all aspects for the spell to work effectively or not at all.

spell_entropic_flames.name: Spell: Entropic Flames
spell_entropic_flames.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Entropic Flames Aspect: 2 Chaos + 1 Fire Description: This spell produces extremely cold, cyan-blue-white fire that does not burn. Upon contact with a material, the flame is partially drawn into it, causing the material's entropy to gradually increase from the point of contact inward, while the flame is still fed into it or persists. This effect causes sudden heat redistribution, chaotic mingling of different materials and elements within the composition (including with surrounding air), and typically results in the target crumbling into dust from the points of contact. The spell works best on composite materials made of many different substances, but is less effective against homogeneous materials.

spell_entropic_shattering.name: Spell: Entropic Shattering
spell_entropic_shattering.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Entropic Shattering Aspect: 3 Chaos + 1 Destruction Description: This spell can be applied on hit or through a relatively slow, flame-like carrier. When it strikes a target, a few faintly glowing, illusionary cracks appear on its surface, radiating from the point of impact. These cracks fade over time. While the cracks are still visible, any sufficiently strong hit may shatter the object along these imaginary lines, making them real. The more faded the cracks, the less effective the effect. The spell practically ignores conventional durability. It works best on homogeneous materials and is less effective on composite or uneven substances.

spell_epinephrine_charm.name: Spell: Epinephrine Charm
spell_epinephrine_charm.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Epinephrine Charm Aspect: 1 Semblance + 1 Healing + 1 Life Description: This spell functions much like an EpiPen. It stops and reverses severe allergic reactions and prevents anaphylactic shock from occurring. The spell can also be used preemptively, providing protection for one to two hours.

spell_evaporation.name: Spell: Evaporation
spell_evaporation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Evaporation Aspect: 1 Water + 1 Chaos + 1 Transformation Description: This spell rapidly causes a targeted liquid to evaporate and become a gas. It does not require contact, but proximity is needed, and evaporation starts from the closest point to the caster. The spell does not change the temperature of the liquid - it merely makes it gaseous and keeps it that way for a time, or while the spell is sustained by the caster. For example, it can turn cold water into vapor and keep it in that state for a few hours (or while actively sustained), while preserving its freezing cold temperature. Different kinds of liquids require different fine-tuning of the spell; some liquids are easier to affect than others. When the spell duration ends, the targeted substance returns to its normal state.

spell_exhumation.name: Spell: Exhumation
spell_exhumation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Exhumation Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Death Description: This spell causes all dead bodies within a targeted volume of earth to be pushed upward and reach the surface. It separates dead bodies from the earth, like wood floating to the surface of water. The caster does not need to know a body is present - simply target a volume of earth beneath you and watch as all carcasses are pushed to the surface without leaving any holes (only some slightly disturbed soil).

spell_explosivo.name: Spell: Explosivo
spell_explosivo.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Explosivo Aspect: 2 Fire + 2 Air + 1 Order Description: This spell produces a fast-moving, metallic-looking sphere that is extremely sticky. Upon impact, it begins to grow in size over the course of one second, then explodes. You can create spheres as small as a pea or as large as a soccer ball, with explosive power scaling proportionally. The projectile feels lightweight and hollow. If the sphere is broken before detonation, the explosion may be prevented entirely or triggered early with reduced force, depending on how and when it is damaged. It won't explode before sticking though.

spell_exsanguinate_catch.name: Spell: Exsanguinate Catch
spell_exsanguinate_catch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Exsanguinate Catch Aspect: 1 Death + 2 Water Description: This spell targets a dead body, producing rope-like patterns on its surface with knots near punctures. This spell makes the blood inside the body less thick and sticky, and forces it to leave the carcass through wounds, practically leaving the blood vessels dry afterward. The patterns vanish when the spell is stopped.

spell_fall.name: Spell: Fall!
spell_fall.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Fall! Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Space + 1 Aether Description: This spell is channeled through a gesture - a downward pointing of the finger. A target within ten meters who sees the gesture and is of roughly human size or smaller feels a sudden, crushing weight on their body, as if gravity had intensified tenfold for an instant. They are forced to the ground and may be briefly stunned or winded, or even get their legs broken. Larger targets or those with exceptional strength may resist or ignore the effect.

spell_far_vision.name: Spell: Far Vision
spell_far_vision.description: You've learned three new spells! Name: Far Vision Aspect: 1 Lore Description: This spell can be cast on oneself or sustained. It does one simple thing - it allows the caster to zoom in their vision, seeing distant objects as if they were close. Each eye can be adjusted separately. Name: Near Vision Aspect: 1 Lore Description: This spell can be cast on oneself or sustained. It does one simple thing - it allows the caster to perceive the smallest details and objects nearby, functioning like a built-in weak microscope or magnifying glass. Each eye can be adjusted separately. Name: Depth Sight Aspect: 1 Lore + 1 Water Description: This spell can be cast on oneself, another person, or sustained. It alters the target's vision to be better suited for underwater environments, allowing them to see clearly beneath the surface, much like a fish.

spell_festering_mark.name: Spell: Festering Mark
spell_festering_mark.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Festering Mark Aspect: 2 Curse + 1 Death Description: This curse appears as a small, fast-moving blob of brown slime. Upon striking a target, it enters the body and causes all wounds near the point of impact to become inflamed and rotten. Even after those wounds are finally cleared and healed, any new injury dealt to the same area will spontaneously become infected and rot again, because the curse still lingers in the flesh.

spell_field_injection.name: Spell: Field Injection
spell_field_injection.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Field Injection Aspect: 2 Semblance + 1 Metal + 1 Healing + 1 Transformation Description: This spell is used on a finger by the caster. It temporarily transforms the finger into a metallic but organically shaped syringe. It can be used to store and inject medicine into a patient. The needle part can be controlled: made thicker or thinner, or bent to a degree. This spell does not leave puncture holes; they are healed on the needle's way out.

spell_film_telekinesis.name: Spell: Film Telekinesis
spell_film_telekinesis.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Film Telekinesis Aspect: 2 Force + 1 Earth Description: This spell creates a barely visible, glinting film on the surface of an object, which envelops and presses slightly on it. Objects follow the movement of the film that envelops them. The caster must be close to apply the film, but once applied, they can move the object further away, fix it relative to certain places, or even move several independently. It can move objects rather quickly and in a decently precise manner. However, it cannot handle very heavy objects; overly complicated surfaces make the spell weaker; and it works only on solid items.

spell_fire_ball.name: Spell: Fire Ball
spell_fire_ball.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Fire Ball Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This spell creates a ball of flame and shoots it. The orb is around 30 cm in diameter and suddenly expands into a cloud of flame on impact, like burning gas exploding. Classic.

spell_fire_orb.name: Spell: Fire Orb
spell_fire_orb.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Fire Orb Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This creates a smooth projectile of yellow, swirling flame. It is like a smooth marble, almost looking solid. On impact, it turns into a great number of extremely hot and quick white sparks flying in all directions, which slightly penetrate and burn things on contact.

spell_fire_shield.name: Spell: Fire Shield
spell_fire_shield.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Fire Shield Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Fire Description: This spell can be cast on the self, another creature, or an object. It creates an invisible aura that becomes more visible proportionally to how much heat is trying to breach it. The aura blocks excessive heat, preventing it from reaching the target. However, if too much heat affects it at once, or if it is strained for too long, the shield may "pop" and leave the target defenseless.

spell_flaming_armor.name: Spell: Flaming Armor
spell_flaming_armor.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Flaming Armor Aspect: 1 Protection + 2 Flame Description: This spell can be cast on the self or another creature. It produces a barely visible effect that resembles a heat wave in the air. It will produce bursts of flame and heat when something violently tries to pierce it, or at the user's will. This will scorch the attacker, parry and burn projectiles, and more. This armor can be weakened and turned off by too much offense, but it will return if given a breathing room. As a side effect, it keeps the user comfortably warm even in an intense cold and provides resistance against effects that impose cold or steal heat.

spell_flaming_droplet.name: Spell: Flaming Droplet
spell_flaming_droplet.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Flaming Droplet Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This spell creates and throws a ball-like projectile made of fire. It is round, up to 44 cm in size, and really bouncy. Each bounce leaves behind a flaming puddle, like burning napalm. Each bounce makes the projectile smaller.

spell_flashfire.name: Spell: Flashfire
spell_flashfire.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Flashfire Aspect: 1 Fire + 2 Light Description: This spell creates a blinding flash of white light accompanied by a wave of intense heat. The flash temporarily (or not) blinds anyone within 10 meters who is looking in the direction of the spell. The heat is enough to ignite flammable materials and cause first-degree burns on exposed skin. The effect is brief: a single, directional burst.

spell_flay_carcass.name: Spell: Flay Carcass
spell_flay_carcass.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Flay Carcass Aspect: 1 Death + 2 Order Description: This spell targets a dead body, producing tattoo-like, pretty symbols on its surface. It then causes the skin to be separated from other tissues and carefully removed from the carcass. It can be used to target only parts of the dead body, separating and cutting only portions of the skin. The symbols vanish after the spell is used.

spell_food_duplication.name: Spell: Food Duplication
spell_food_duplication.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Food Duplication Aspect: 3 Creation + 2 Semblance + 1 Transformation Description: This spell allows the caster to target a portion of food no larger than 1.344 liters in volume and no heavier than 3.5 kilograms. The spell creates a duplicate of the targeted dish nearby, but the duplicate has only 50% of the nutritional value of the original.

spell_force_shield.name: Spell: Force Shield
spell_force_shield.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Force Shield Aspect: 2 Semblance + 1 Protection + 1 Force Description: This spell creates a semi-transparent, orange-tinted force field that acts as a handheld shield, with an incredible ability to partially negate, absorb, and deflect force used against it. Can be turned off/on without dispelling.

spell_fresh_scent.name: Spell: Fresh Scent
spell_fresh_scent.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Fresh Scent Aspect: 1 Air + 1 Semblance + 1 Mind Description: This spell creates a pleasant, clean scent in a targeted area - subtle and refreshing rather than perfumed. The scent fades after a few hours. Often used in conjunction with Dust Banishment to create a feeling of cleanliness. The exact scent can vary based on the caster's intention (fresh linen, mountain air, citrus, etc.).

spell_gamma_laser.name: Spell: Gamma Laser
spell_gamma_laser.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Gamma Laser Aspect: 1 Light Description: This spell produces a thin ray of gamma radiation in an extremely short burst. The beam is incredibly quick, energy-efficient, and possesses exceptional penetration power, cutting through most mundane materials with ease. However, the ray is narrow and highly focused. Unless it strikes something vital (a brain, heart, or critical component), the results are often debilitating rather than immediately fatal. Tissue along the beam's path suffers severe radiation damage, but the wound channel itself is tiny.

spell_gather_moisture.name: Spell: Gather Moisture
spell_gather_moisture.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Gather Moisture Aspect: 2 Water + 1 Air Description: This spell is used to gather and concentrate moisture from the volume of air around the caster (up to a maximum radius of around four meters). It does not work through walls. The spell condenses water vapor into liquid form and produces a ball of water at the focus center of the spell. It cannot lower the humidity of the air around further than 7.2%.

spell_glass_staining.name: Spell: Glass Staining
spell_glass_staining.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Glass Staining Aspect: 1 Earth + 1 Light Description: This spell affects a targeted piece or volume of glass. It alters the internal crystalline structure of the glass to permanently change its color by introducing specific tendencies toward the refraction and absorption of light within the material. It can be used to make a piece of glass red, green, or any relatively simple shade the caster desires. It can also make glass frosted, more opaque, or even produce simple multicolored patterns. However, this spell depends heavily on the skill of the caster. It is easy to simply make glass redder, but much harder to achieve a specific hue or introduce a precise pattern. It takes considerable practice to master.

spell_grain_percolation.name: Spell: Grain Percolation
spell_grain_percolation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Grain Percolation Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Order Description: This spell targets loose granular material (sand, dust, fine gravel) and vibrates it to separate larger pieces from smaller ones. It creates a gradient ranging from fine particles at one end to coarse aggregates at the other. The caster can use it to stratify a mixture into several distinct layers, each with a similar grain size.

spell_grave-seal.name: Spell: Grave-Seal
spell_grave-seal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Grave-Seal Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Death + 1 Order Description: This spell is cast upon a burial site to prevent Exhumation from working. It binds the dead to their resting place, making them "heavier" than the earth around them. Corpses under Grave-Seal cannot be raised, floated, or disturbed by magical means. Used by temples, families, and governments to protect the sanctity of graves. Need to be reapplied every few months.

spell_hand_projection.name: Spell: Hand Projection
spell_hand_projection.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Hand Projection Aspect: 1 Force + 1 Air + 1 Semblance + 1 Mind Description: This spell creates projections (resembling ghosts or holograms) of the user's hands, which they can move around and use to hold, catch, or manipulate objects. The spell provides feedback, feeling like moving your own hands and touching something. These hands are not very strong, and it is difficult to have more than two doing anything complex at a time. However, they can be used to hold things, perform simple repetitive movements, or similar tasks. This spell depends heavily on the user's skill and dexterity: if the user cannot write neatly, the hands they create will not write neatly either.

spell_healing_touch.name: Spell: Healing Touch
spell_healing_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Healing Touch Aspect: 3 Healing + 1 Life Description: This spell allows the caster to accelerate scabbing on a touched wound and stop mild bleeding. It requires more time to deal with deeper and larger wounds. It aids natural healing but does not cause regeneration or rapid tissue repair - it merely makes the wound more protected and ready to heal, while preventing the immediate danger of bleeding out.

spell_heart_sight.name: Spell: Heart Sight
spell_heart_sight.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Heart Sight Aspect: 1 Air + 1 Mind + 1 Lore Description: This spell alters your perception, allowing you to see nearby heartbeats as an overlay on your vision combined with an intuitive sense. It works through walls, but effective sound isolation will block it. The spell captures sounds, identifies those matching the noise of heartbeats, and lets you see them. You can perceive how loud or fast each heartbeat is. If too many heartbeats are present, they tune out and turn into a vague fog, causing no negative effects on you.

spell_heat_metal.name: Spell: Heat Metal
spell_heat_metal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Heat Metal Aspect: 3 Fire + 1 Metal Description: This spell produces a short cone of red light. When this light strikes a targeted piece of metal, it heats the metal quickly and evenly throughout its entire volume. The spell can heat metal up to 1,344 degrees Celsius. However, different metals, alloys, and compositions require fine-tuning of the spell. Heating iron and copper requires very different compositions of the spell, while heating one type of steel versus another introduces small changes that must be accounted for. Mastering this spell requires extensive practice and experimentation with different metals. If tuned wrong it doesn’t work or works only partially.

spell_heat_stroke.name: Spell: Heat Stroke
spell_heat_stroke.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Heat Stroke Aspect: 2 Fire + 1 Light + 1 Air Description: This spell creates a small area around the user where other creatures get heated up more quickly. Basically, it feels hot as hell: like standing in front of an open oven. The spell can be reshaped to create a cone instead, making the effect more contained and more intense, causing heat stroke in a few seconds of exposure. It works somewhat like a microwave.

spell_hurting.name: Spell: Hurting
spell_hurting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Hurting Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: Creates a semi-transparent, head-sized orb of flowing red and violet swirls. It moves as quickly as a stone thrown from a sling. When the orb hits, it creates a heavy impact and pushes the target away. The effect is much stronger against living things - dramatically so. It can leave literal cylindrical holes in a target, like a cannonball. However, it pops soon after impact.

spell_hydras_blessing.name: Spell: Hydra's Blessing
spell_hydras_blessing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Hydra's Blessing Aspect: 4 Healing + 2 Life + 1 Semblance + 2 Creation Description: This spell grants a short-lived but extreme healing factor focused on regenerating lost limbs and organs. For organs, at least some remaining tissue (such as a portion of a kidney) is required for the spell to function. The blessing works best on fresh, mechanical wounds. The user can guide the regeneration for improved results. However, the spell places strain on the body (even while producing tissue ex nihilo) and may cause complications for those who are famished, ill, or otherwise exhausted. Note: Slightly ages regenerated tissues and slightly increases the risk of cancer in the long run.

spell_hypercalculia.name: Spell: Hypercalculia
spell_hypercalculia.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Hypercalculia Aspect: 2 Mind + 1 Order + 1 Lore Description: This spell temporarily enhances and optimizes the part of the user's mind that handles calculations. Working with numbers becomes much more intuitive and quick, while comprehension of numerical and calculation-related knowledge and skills is slightly improved. The spell can be cast on others, but at a higher cost and with a shorter duration (unless continuously sustained). It can also counter the effects of dyscalculia, bringing the target at least to an average level for the duration.

spell_immune_fortification.name: Spell: Immune Fortification
spell_immune_fortification.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Immune Fortification Aspect: 3 Life + 2 Order + 1 Healing + 1 Protection Description: This spell temporarily bolsters the patient's immune system, enhancing its ability to identify and eliminate threats - including infections, abnormal cells, and even some types of cancer. The effect lasts for several days. Overuse might cause acute auto-immune symptoms.

spell_induction.name: Spell: Induction
spell_induction.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Induction Aspect: 4 Fire + 2 Light + 1 Metal + 1 Lightning Description: This spell produces a small aura or a cone of effect that slowly heats up metal caught in the area. Metals with higher electrical resistance heat up faster, but it still takes minutes, and the spell cannot heat metal above 1,440 degrees Celsius.

spell_internal_abacus.name: Spell: Internal Abacus
spell_internal_abacus.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Internal Abacus Aspect: 2 Mind + 1 Order + 1 Semblance Description: This spell creates a temporary partition in the caster's mind that functions like a calculator. The user can enter various mathematical operations they understand how to perform, and the Internal Abacus will quickly provide the solution.

spell_iron_destressing.name: Spell: Iron Destressing
spell_iron_destressing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Iron Destressing Aspect: 3 Metal + 1 Fire + 1 Order Description: This spell is used on a volume of metal (or part of it) and lessens its mechanical fatigue, dealing with microscopic damage to the structure of the metal. It specializes in iron alloys, but can be tuned to work on some other metals.

spell_jelly_prison.name: Spell: Jelly Prison
spell_jelly_prison.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Jelly Prison Aspect: 5 Sweet + 1 Air + 1 Creation Description: This spell conjures a stream of liquid jelly, which quickly hardens and turns into kind of really flexible blobs, trapping things inside. It's possible to breathe inside one. The thing vanishes after a few hours, leaving behind only a few pieces of jelly. The user can control the taste and color of created jelly, but not separately.

spell_karmic_retribution.name: Spell: Karmic Retribution
spell_karmic_retribution.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Karmic Retribution Aspect: 4 Aether + 2 Hurt + 1 Lore + 1 Destruction Description: This spell is a kind of aura that can be channeled into your weapons or even some solid magical projectiles. It causes a poisoning-like effect and great suffering to the target on contact, but proportional to how much they have hurt others. It essentially turns the pain they dealt to others against themselves, converting it into "soul decay" damage, which affects the shape of the soul and causes the body to take damage as well. The spell sees the older caused pain worse, not counting it completely.

spell_kitty_bites.name: Spell: Kitty Bites
spell_kitty_bites.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Kitty Bites Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Semblance + 1 Transformation Description: This spell can be channeled, sustained, or cast for a duration (up to 71 minutes). It affects the user's mouth and teeth, making the latter much more durable and sharper when used against other living creatures. It also grants enhanced biting strength and the ability to open the jaws wider. However, the main effect of the spell is the ability to project the bite slightly outside the reach of the mouth: red and ghostly outlines of chomping teeth appear for a moment when the user performs a biting action, and they will bite things up to four inches away from the mouth. When the spell ends, the teeth return to their normal state.

spell_kitty_bristles.name: Spell: Kitty Bristles
spell_kitty_bristles.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Kitty Bristles Aspect: 1 Hurt + 2 Protection + 1 Transformation + 1 Semblance Description: This spell can be channeled, sustained, or cast for a duration (up to 33 minutes). It affects all of the user's hair, turning it into a ginger-colored reactive shield. When the user feels a threat from a certain direction or something tries to strike them, the hairs stand on end, working like durable needles that are especially good at piercing living and dead tissues. When the spell ends, the hair returns to its normal state.

spell_kitty_claws.name: Spell: Kitty Claws
spell_kitty_claws.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Kitty Claws Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Transformation + 1 Semblance Description: This spell slightly elongates the user's nails, making them sharp like claws and distinctly red. It can be channeled, sustained, or cast for a duration (up to three minutes). It can target both toenails and fingernails. These claws are durable and unusually sharp, especially when cutting living or dead tissues. When the spell ends, the nails return to their normal state.

spell_know_thy_tongues.name: Spell: Know Thy Tongues
spell_know_thy_tongues.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Know Thy Tongues Aspect: 4 Mind + 2 Order + 1 Lore Description: This spell lets you teach a willing or unconscious target any language you know, provided they are capable of learning it. The spell works in two stages. First, you isolate and create a small mind-space containing a copy of your knowledge of a specific language. You can even teach an incomplete version if you wish. Then, that knowledge is removed from your mind, placed into a wisp-like carrier, and transferred to the recipient through touch or close proximity. The spell teaches the language as you speak it: including word meanings, accent, and reading and writing specifics. It is possible for someone to learn the same language from two different people and still gain something useful from each, because everyone's linguistic knowledge is slightly different.

spell_licorice_ropes.name: Spell: Licorice Ropes
spell_licorice_ropes.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Licorice Ropes Aspect: 4 Sweet + 1 Semblance Description: This spell creates a few ropes made of unusually durable licorice and allows the caster to move them at will. They attempt to ensnare and wrap around targets. They vanish after two hours without the caster sustaining them.

spell_light_telekinesis.name: Spell: Light Telekinesis
spell_light_telekinesis.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Light Telekinesis Aspect: 1 Light + 2 Force + 1 Order Description: This spell produces a ray of light effect (although not as fast as actual light). When this ray strikes a separate object, it causes the target to glow faintly in outline and allows the caster to move the object by manipulating the beam of light connecting them. The spell can be used to rotate objects, drag them closer, or push them further away, or generally move them around. However, the ray connecting the caster and the target can be disrupted by other objects passing between them. The beam will attempt to bend and evade obstacles intersecting its path, but it has limitations: too many obstacles, rapidly moving objects, or solid barriers can break the connection entirely. Intersecting objects will become a new target or disrupt the spell completely. The beam also has a maximum effective range of about thirty meters, beyond which it dissipates.

spell_lingering_ward.name: Spell: Lingering Ward
spell_lingering_ward.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Lingering Ward Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Time + 1 Order Description: This spell is cast on a location or object (a door, a chest, or a perimeter) rather than on a person. It creates a protective field that lasts for hours or days, absorbing or deflecting attacks against the warded object. The ward is not as strong as a personal shield, but it persists without the caster's attention. It can be set to trigger on specific conditions (e.g., "only if touched by a living creature"). The ward fades when its stored energy is depleted.

spell_lumicrete_mixture.name: Spell: Lumicrete Mixture
spell_lumicrete_mixture.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Lumicrete Mixture Aspect: 3 Light + 1 Earth Description: A dry mortar or concrete powder is piled up and the caster speaks a sustained, resonant word over it. The powder glows faintly for a few moments and then goes dark. When mixed with water and poured, the setting process is accelerated to completion in under an hour (instead of days). More importantly, the crystalline structure of the cured material aligns in such a way that it "stores" ambient light. During the day, the surface absorbs sunlight; at night, it emits a soft, moon-like glow equivalent to a well-lit corridor for up to eight hours. It does not produce heat.

spell_markers_trace.name: Spell: Marker's Trace
spell_markers_trace.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Marker's Trace Aspect: 1 Order + 1 Semblance + 1 Light Description: The caster traces a finger along a surface, leaving a faint glowing line that marks a specific measurement or cut line. The line persists for a few minutes (without sustaining) before fading, allowing the caster to mark multiple points or cut lines without needing chalk, pencil, or string.

spell_measuring_eye.name: Spell: Measuring Eye
spell_measuring_eye.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Measuring Eye Aspect: 1 Order + 1 Light + 2 Lore Description: The caster can gauge the exact dimensions (length, width, depth) of any object within their line of sight, up to a distance of fifty meters. The information appears in their mind as precise measurements. However, the caster must already understand what they are measuring and how to measure it, as well as the units they are using. If you do not know how to measure something by hand, or what you are measuring, the spell will not work, or will only work partially. Used by surveyors, architects, carpenters, and tailors.

spell_mercy_kill.name: Spell: Mercy Kill
spell_mercy_kill.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Mercy Kill Aspect: 1 Aether + 2 Death + 1 Destruction Description: This spell targets a living creature. It creates a thin, barely visible tether between the caster and the target, and sends a request into the target's soul. If the target can understand the request and answers positively, they quickly and painlessly die. If they decline, the tether snaps and nothing happens. Death begins with the rapid death of neurons in the brain and the unraveling of connections, but other tissues follow shortly after. The spell does not require the target to be conscious, aware, or physically capable of response. Even a target in a coma, paralyzed, or otherwise unable to communicate can be reached through their soul, which receives the request and can accept or decline it based on its understanding. Some animals are also capable of giving their consent, provided their souls can grasp the nature of the choice being offered.

spell_metal_purity_testing.name: Spell: Metal Purity Testing
spell_metal_purity_testing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Metal Purity Testing Aspect: 1 Metal + 2 Lore + 1 Light Description: A divination spell that reveals the purity and composition of a metal sample. The caster perceives the metal as a color or pattern that indicates its components and any impurities. However, the information depends on the user's knowledge. If the alloy contains substances unknown to the user, they will be marked as unknown.

spell_mind_mapping.name: Spell: Mind Mapping
spell_mind_mapping.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Mind Mapping Aspect: 2 Lore + 1 Mind + 1 Aether Description: This spell lets you take a snapshot of a person's general neural structure or mind via eye contact or touch. It provides only the "shape" of their mind: no thoughts, moods, or memories, no specific contents. Think of it as an intuitive magic MRI. The longer you focus on a target, the clearer the image becomes. The spell can reveal abnormalities, unique mental traits, which temperaments are more or less expressed in the psyche, and so on. However, interpreting what unfamiliar "mind map" features actually mean is entirely up to you.

spell_miniature_sun.name: Spell: Miniature Sun
spell_miniature_sun.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Miniature Sun Aspect: 1 Fire + 1 Light Description: This spell creates a small, glowing orb of white light and shoots it at extreme speed. On impact, it destabilizes over a few moments (enough time for it to melt through many things) and then violently explodes, practically evaporating everything in a small radius.

spell_miracle_of_healing.name: Spell: Miracle of Healing
spell_miracle_of_healing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Miracle of Healing (Impure Regeneration) Aspect: 1 Light + 1 Healing + 1 Life Description: This spell produces a small amount of healing light, which can be infused into a living target or projected in a direction to cause rapid regeneration. The spell takes biomass from various tissues in the body in such a way as to cause the least amount of damage, and uses this biomass to heal a variety of wounds. It can even restore eyesight lost due to injury, regenerate parts of damaged organs, and even grow new limbs. However, more intensive effects require prolonged use of the spell or repeated applications. It takes a full week of uninterrupted healing light to grow a new arm - though this time can be broken down into shorter sessions. Historical Note: This spell was discovered and used by priests of an ancient eastern civilization, who believed it was a revelation from their god of healing. It was used extensively after its discovery, causing the early empire to become a powerful regional force, conquer many neighbors, and elevate the social status of the healing god's priests to great heights. Unfortunately (unknown to anyone at the time) the spell carried a terrible hidden cost. Using the Miracle of Healing increased the chances of cancer in subsequent years, and also increased the likelihood of genetic disorders in the offspring of those affected by the healing light. The effect was cumulative: those who bathed in the light more frequently suffered worse consequences later. This caused the civilization to collapse after a few generations. That said, the spell can still be used safely in moderation. A single application to save a friend from blood loss (transforming a small amount of fat into blood) carries only a tiny increase in cancer risk, far outweighed by the immediate benefit. The danger lies in repeated exposure, especially to the intense regeneration required for major wounds, limbs, or organs.

spell_mud_brick_shaping.name: Spell: Mud Brick Shaping
spell_mud_brick_shaping.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Mud Brick Shaping Aspect: 4 Earth + 1 Order Description: This spell is cast on loose soil, mud, or clay. It quickly shapes a small volume of material into robust mud bricks (or several). The caster can tune the size and proportions of the bricks a bit.

spell_multiplication.name: Spell Multiplication
spell_multiplication.description: You have the skill, knowledge, and ability to sacrifice some of a spell's intensity or prolong its execution time in exchange for producing multiple copies of the same effect at once. For example, firing four rays of a curse instead of one, but each is weaker or taking longer to execute them together. Not all spells can be used this way, and there is a limit to how many copies you can create. The more copies you attempt, the faster the cost grows.

spell_muscle_mending.name: Spell: Muscle Mending
spell_muscle_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Muscle Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation + 1 Order Description: A specialized variation of Organic Mending focused on muscles, tendons, and similar tissues. The spell reverses mechanical damage, reconnecting torn fibers and restoring tensile strength. It can regenerate lost tissue to a degree, but mostly fuses existing material back into a coherent, functional whole. >Requires Spell: Organic Mending

spell_muscle_relaxant.name: Spell: Muscle Relaxant
spell_muscle_relaxant.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Muscle Relaxant Aspect: 2 Life + 1 Water + 1 Healing Description: A gentler variant of Paralytic Touch that reduces muscle tension without causing full paralysis. The target remains mobile but feels relaxed and loose, with reduced strength and reflexes. Useful for treating spasms, anxiety, or preparing a patient for physical therapy.

spell_muscle_snap.name: Spell: Muscle Snap
spell_muscle_snap.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Muscle Snap Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: This spell produces a thin, barely visible streak of red. When it strikes a living creature, it causes muscle tissue near the point of impact to suddenly and violently stretch for a moment, damaging the muscle or even tearing it completely.

spell_needle_finger.name: Spell: Needle Finger
spell_needle_finger.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Needle Finger Aspect: 2 Force + 1 Semblance Description: This spell is cast and sustained on your fingertip. Make a pointing gesture with one finger and cast the spell. It will create a thin metallic glint extending a few millimeters from the tip of your finger. You can now use this gesture as an actual sharp needle point, allowing you to make holes in soft materials like thin leather, paper, fabric, cardboard, and similar items. You can control the diameter and depth of the puncture within certain limits (up to four millimeters deep and two millimeters wide). It takes more force and time to puncture harder or denser materials, or to make a larger hole. This spell does not affect living tissues.

spell_neural_mending.name: Spell: Neural Mending
spell_neural_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Neural Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation + 1 Order Description: A specialized variation of Organic Mending focused on nerves, neural tissues, and their supporting structures. The spell repairs mechanical damage, reconnecting severed or compressed neural pathways. It can regenerate small amounts of lost tissue, but mostly fuses existing material back into a functional state. Results may vary depending on the complexity of the injury. The spell does not restore memories or skills - it only repairs the hardware. >Requires Spell: Organic Mending

spell_orb_of_annihilation.name: Spell: Orb of Annihilation
spell_orb_of_annihilation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Orb of Annihilation Aspect: 1 Chaos + 1 Destruction Description: This spell forms an orb of darkness that seems to suck in the surrounding air and light. It floats between palms of the user. After a few moments, it is launched in a direction of caster's choice. When it hits something, the orb expands for a moment (to 2.2 meters in diameter), consumes everything it intersects, and then vanishes with a slight flash of white light. If something (such as an impact) catches the orb while it is forming or in flight, it activates prematurely. It takes about 1.5 seconds to prepare for launch. It flies as fast professional pitcher throw

spell_organic_mending.name: Spell: Organic Mending
spell_organic_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Organic Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation Description: This spell reverses mechanical damage in a variety of tissues. It does not leave scars, but it is not perfect - the effect cannot regenerate lost tissue. Instead, it takes what is present and fuses it back together into a coherent, functional whole. The spell works on practically any tissue, though its effectiveness varies by tissue type.

spell_pain.name: Spell: Pain
spell_pain.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Pain Aspect: 1 Hurt Description: This spell produces a continuous burst or a crackling flash of crimson, lightning-like energy. The area it strikes experiences intense pain: the spell forces the nerves in that area to fire "hurt" signals to the brain. The caster can modulate the effect, making it weaker or stronger as desired. Prolonged and high intensity use may permanently damage nerves.

spell_paralysis_needle.name: Spell: Paralysis Needle
spell_paralysis_needle.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Paralysis Needle Aspect: 1 Life + 1 Mind Description: This spell launches needles of dim green light that easily penetrate living tissue and some thin non-living materials. The needles do not cause physical damage - they partially phase into the target and can be removed without trauma. However, each needle induces numbness and paralysis around the struck area. This effect lasts until the needles naturally vanish, are dispelled, or are removed. The spell is clearly non-lethal, but highly restrictive.

spell_paralytic_touch.name: Spell: Paralytic Touch
spell_paralytic_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Paralytic Touch Aspect: 2 Life + 1 Lightning Description: This spell produces a barely visible blue aura around the caster's hand. This aura can be used to force muscles to relax and prevent movement in the area by touch. Alternatively, the spell can be channeled into the target for more general paralysis and relaxation, or to make the effect stick for a time (up to an hour).

spell_penance.name: Spell: Penance
spell_penance.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Penance Aspect: 1 Hurt + 1 Healing Description: This spell causes the caster themselves to receive painful, but temporary and mostly illusory, wounds. The caster can control how much pain they experience and for how long - up to around an hour or until they lose consciousness.

spell_perish.name: Spell: Perish!
spell_perish.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Perish! Aspect: 2 Hurt + 2 Death + 1 Transformation Description: The user infuses a hair with this spell, allowing it to be flung like a needle-projectile as fast as a dart and extremely difficult to see due to its thin nature. When this hair sinks into living flesh, the effect of the spell takes hold. It works like a venom, causing severe, hot pain at the site of impact, necrosis spreading from the point of contact, and gradually worsening paralysis. A single hair can kill an adult male if it remains embedded in their body for half a minute. Removing the hair quickly lessens the effect of the spell.

spell_phalanx_ward.name: Spell: Phalanx Ward
spell_phalanx_ward.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Phalanx Ward Aspect: 3 Protection + 1 Force + 1 Order Description: This spell creates a large, semi-transparent shield in front of the caster that can cover multiple people. The shield is rectangular and about the size of a tower shield. It blocks physical projectiles and absorbs kinetic force, but it must be actively maintained - the caster must hold the shield in place. It can withstand a significant amount of force before breaking, but it does not protect against attacks from the sides or rear.

spell_piercing_spell.name: Spell: Piercing Spell
spell_piercing_spell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Piercing Spell Aspect: 1 Force Description: This spell manifests as a semi-transparent, light-blue projectile shaped like an arrowhead. When it strikes something, it applies high force over a small area and pierces through the obstacle. It is strong enough to pierce glass with almost no shattering. It can be tuned to be more or less powerful.

spell_pins_and_needles.name: Spell: Pins and Needles
spell_pins_and_needles.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Pins and Needles Aspect: 1 Curse + 1 Mind + 2 Hurt Description: This curse manifests as a thin needle of dark-red light accompanied by the sound of a nail dragged across glass. Upon impact, the victim experiences a sudden, brief sensation of many tiny needles pricking random parts of their skin - then it vanishes. From that moment on, several times a day at random intervals, the sensation of one or more needles piercing the skin will flare up again and then abruptly stop. This continues for the rest of the victim's life unless the curse is lifted or countered somehow.

spell_plastic-bond.name: Spell: Plastic-Bond
spell_plastic-bond.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Plastic-Bond Aspect: 2 Plastic + 1 Earth Description: This spell fuses two pieces of plastic together at their contact surfaces, effectively "welding" them into a single piece. The fusion is as strong as the surrounding plastic. Used for repairing broken items, joining pieces, or creating larger structures from smaller components.

spell_polishing_touch.name: Spell: Polishing Touch
spell_polishing_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Polishing Touch Aspect: 3 Transformation + 1 Order + 1 Earth Description: This spell allows the caster to polish solid surfaces with their palms. The user can control how smooth they want the surface to be with each movement of their palm along the surface. Harder and denser surfaces require more time and more passes to polish. This spell can polish materials as hard as certain cast iron alloys, though doing so takes a long time and a great deal of "scrubbing."

spell_polyploidy_transformation.name: Spell: Polyploidy Transformation
spell_polyploidy_transformation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Polyploidy Transformation Aspect: 4 Life + 1 Order + 1 Transformation Description: This spell targets two or more seeds from the same plant species (ideally from genetically identical individuals) and fuses them together into a single or several, viable seed(s). The resulting seed exhibits polyploidy - possessing multiple complete sets of chromosomes. This can be beneficial, detrimental, or neutral depending on the plant species and the intended application.

spell_press_plastic.name: Spell: Press Plastic
spell_press_plastic.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Press Plastic Aspect: 4 Plastic + 1 Transformation Description: This spell allows the caster to target a piece of plastic they are touching and infuse it with the spell over the course of a few seconds. The caster then chooses a shape and activates the spell, causing the plastic to reshape itself into the desired form with a slight pop, as if it had been pressed into its new shape. It can produce some details and relatively complex shapes, but not overly so. The spell requires attuning to different kinds of plastics and works more easily on some than on others.

spell_protection.name: Spell: Protection
spell_protection.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Protection Aspect: 1 Protection Description: This spell creates an invisible force field that briefly flickers silver when hit. When something connects with this field, 98.7% of its force is perfectly reflected back. However, if the field is hit with force above a certain limit, or too often within a period of time, it will pop - deflecting things in the process but going on cooldown. The cooldown is proportional to the attack that broke it (from a few seconds to a minute). It can only be cast on the caster. An experienced user can layer up to three fields. It is bad at protecting against things like heat, poison gas, or electrical discharge (although it still protects a bit).

spell_psychokinesis.name: Spell: Psychokinesis
spell_psychokinesis.description: You've learned a new spell!
