Name: Psychokinesis Aspect: 1 Mind + 2 Force + 1 Aether Description: This spell targets the soul of a living being and moves it, causing the body to follow. It allows the caster to hold, reposition, or move living targets. A target who is awake and in full possession of their will can resist the spell's effect or even assist it, making the spell easier to cast on willing subjects. The spell can move the target evenly - with or without the acceleration-induced G-load that would normally accompany such movement. The spell can be sustained, allowing the caster to hold a target in place, suspend them mid-air, or slowly lower them to safety. However, maintaining the spell on an unwilling target is exhausting and requires constant mental effort. So its easier to just suddenly push.

spell_purifying_embers.name: Spell: Purifying Embers
spell_purifying_embers.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Purifying Embers Aspect: 2 Fire + 1 Order + 1 Healing + 2 Purity Description: A smaller, less dramatic version of Cleansing Pyre. This spell produces a small flame that can be applied directly to a cursed wound or object. It weakens the curse rather than removing it entirely, buying time for a proper Cleansing Pyre ritual. The flames do not harm living tissue.

spell_push_telekinesis.name: Spell: Push Telekinesis
spell_push_telekinesis.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Push Telekinesis Aspect: 1 Force + 1 Space Description: This spell makes objects float (as if without gravity) and can apply a vector of acceleration to the center of mass of the affected item. It has a maximum speed it can accelerate an object toward, but on the other hand, it can be used to slow down already moving objects (if one can focus on them). This spell is more powerful and more precise the closer it is to the caster (maximum radius of ten meters). Heavier objects accelerate more slowly with this spell. It can be used to make loose materials and liquids float, but it cannot apply vector acceleration to them.

spell_radiant_grasp.name: Spell: Radiant Grasp
spell_radiant_grasp.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Radiant Grasp Aspect: 1 Light + 1 Force + 1 Air Description: Instead of a single beam, this spell produces a diffuse cone of glowing light. Everything within the cone is lightly grasped, allowing the caster to push or pull multiple objects at once. Though with less individual control and strength than Light Telekinesis. Useful for clearing debris, scattering projectiles, or moving a group of small objects. The cone loses strength with distance and is easily blocked.

spell_reactive_plating.name: Spell: Reactive Plating
spell_reactive_plating.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Reactive Plating Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Metal + 1 Force Description: This spell coats the caster's skin or armor in a barely visible metallic sheen. When struck, the coating momentarily hardens and disperses the force of the blow across a wider area, reducing the damage significantly. The coating is most effective against blunt force and slashing attacks, but offers little protection against piercing attacks or energy-based damage. The effect lasts up to 11 minutes.

spell_reinforcement.name: Spell: Reinforcement
spell_reinforcement.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Reinforcement Aspect: 1 Protection Description: This spell is channeled through the caster or items in contact with them, making targets more resistant to damage and physical effects, but only slightly (1 to 30% more). It works against a great variety of mundane phenomena, better against some and worse against others.

spell_root-weave_compaction.name: Spell: Root-Weave Compaction
spell_root-weave_compaction.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Root-Weave Compaction Aspect: 2 Earth + 2 Life + 1 Water Description: The caster places their palms flat on bare soil and hums at a low frequency. Over the course of a minute, the spell encourages the dormant seeds and fungal mycelium within the soil to grow at an accelerated, controlled rate. The roots intertwine into a dense, living mat while simultaneously absorbing ambient moisture to swell and fill every void. The result is a section of ground that becomes as hard and load-bearing as packed gravel, but remains permeable to water. The effect is permanent, as the root-mat continues to live and self-repair, though it requires annual "re-tuning" to prevent overgrowth or death.

spell_rope_weave.name: Spell: Rope Weave
spell_rope_weave.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Rope Weave Aspect: 2 Wood + 1 Force + 1 Semblance Description: This spell transforms plant fibers (grass, bark, or reeds) into strong, flexible rope. The rope can be made in any length up to 9.8 meters at a time (although, you can continue from where you finished last time) and can be tuned for thickness and strength. Some fibers are obviously better than others to use.

spell_roughening_touch.name: Spell: Roughening Touch
spell_roughening_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Roughening Touch Aspect: 3 Transformation + 1 Chaos + 1 Earth Description: This spell is the opposite of Polishing Touch. It allows the caster to roughen solid surfaces with their palms. The user can control how rough they want the surface to be with each movement of their palm along the surface. Harder and denser surfaces require more time and more passes to roughen. This spell can roughen materials as hard as certain cast iron alloys, though doing so takes a very long time and a great deal of "scrubbing." The resulting texture can range from a fine, matte finish (barely different from polished) to a coarse, abrasive surface like sandpaper, depending on the caster's intent and effort.

spell_rust_removal.name: Spell: Rust Removal
spell_rust_removal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Rust Removal Aspect: 3 Metal + 1 Air + 1 Chaos Description: This spell produces a cone or ray area of effect (which feels and looks like wind) that separates and grinds rust away, leaving behind a clear metallic surface. It specializes in iron alloys, but can be tuned to work on some other metals.

spell_scissors_fingers.name: Spell: Scissors Fingers
spell_scissors_fingers.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Scissors Fingers Aspect: 2 Force + 1 Order + 1 Semblance Description: This spell is cast and sustained on your fingers. Make a scissors gesture and activate the spell. It will create a thin metallic glint on the inner sides of your fingers. You can now use this gesture as actual sharp scissors to cut soft materials such as paper, thin leather, cardboard, fabric, and similar items. This spell does not affect living tissues.

spell_screw_spell.name: Spell: Screw Spell
spell_screw_spell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Screw Spell Aspect: 3 Force + 1 Order Description: This spell targets small objects. It can apply rotation and push/pull to them. Basically, it works as a great substitute for a screwdriver - great for screwing in or unscrewing bolts\ and other fasteners.

spell_seed_duplication.name: Spell: Seed Duplication
spell_seed_duplication.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Seed Duplication Aspect: 2 Life + 2 Creation + 1 Transformation Description: This spell targets a single or a few plant seeds. The target goes through a process that visibly resembles cell division, creating two seeds of the same type. However, the created seeds are not clones of the original, but rather the same species with a bit of genetic variation.

spell_seed_of_renewal.name: Spell: Seed of Renewal
spell_seed_of_renewal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Seed of Renewal Aspect: 2 Wood + 2 Life + 1 Creation Description: A simpler variant of Tree Birth that can be cast on a single living seed, causing it to sprout and grow into a healthy sapling over the course of a few hours. It does not require wood - only a viable seed.

spell_severance.name: Spell: Severance
spell_severance.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Severance Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Force + 1 Semblance Description: A less theatrical but more versatile variant of Decapitation. The same chopping gesture produces a faint, almost invisible cutting edge that can sever any limb or body part, not just the neck. It can be blocked by sufficiently thick material or partially disrupted. >Requires Spell: Decapitation

spell_shock_absorber.name: Spell: Shock Absorber
spell_shock_absorber.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Shock Absorber Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Force Description: This spell creates a subtle, invisible cushion around the caster that absorbs the force of impacts: falls, blunt strikes, and explosive shockwaves. The cushion reduces the effective force of any impact by half, but each absorbed impact weakens the spell. After absorbing a certain amount of total force, the spell dissipates and must be recast. Can be overwhelmed.

spell_shovel.name: Spell: Shovel
spell_shovel.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Shovel Aspect: 1 Earth Description: This spell cuts a simple shape from dirt, soil, or similar soft material, then lifts this shape and tosses it aside. The spell can be used to dig up to one cubic meter of soil per use.

spell_shroud_from_flame.name: Spell: Shroud from Flame
spell_shroud_from_flame.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Shroud from Flame Aspect: 1 Protection + 1 Fire Description: This spell can be cast on the self, another creature, or an object. It creates a kind of field that penetrates the target's volume, reducing how much excess heat it receives from external sources and making it more resistant to the effects of heat. However, it does not block it completely - it just severely reduces the detrimental effects. For example, instead of receiving third-degree burns in two seconds, one will receive first-degree burns over the course of twenty seconds.

spell_silver_scales.name: Spell: Silver Scales
spell_silver_scales.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Silver Scales Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Transformation + 1 Beast Description: This spell temporarily transforms part or all of the target's skin into silvery scales temporarily. It can be cast on oneself or on another. The scales cause attacks to slide off unusually easily, to ricochet, and generally make the affected areas harder and more resistant to damage.

spell_skill_implantation.name: Spell: Skill Implantation
spell_skill_implantation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Skill Implantation Aspect: 4 Mind + 2 Order + 2 Life Description: This spell lets you copy a motor skill you possess into an isolated, temporary part of your mind, then remove it as a spell carrier and implant it into a willing or unconscious target. The spell automatically remaps the skill to the recipient's neural structure. The recipient needs time to practice and fully integrate the new skill. The thing includes any bad skill-related habits or quirks from the original owner. Taking a skill directly from another person's head is possible, but they must perform the first step (isolating the data package) themselves. This method costs significantly more.

spell_skin_mending.name: Spell: Skin Mending
spell_skin_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Skin Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation + 1 Order Description: A specialized variation of Organic Mending focused on skin, mucous membranes, and related tissues. The spell reverses mechanical damage, sealing cuts, tears, and abrasions without scarring. It can regenerate lost tissue in small amounts, but mostly fuses existing material back into a coherent, functional whole. >Requires Spell: Organic Mending

spell_slicing_curse.name: Spell: Slicing Curse
spell_slicing_curse.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Slicing Curse Aspect: 2 Hurt + 1 Curse + 1 Force Description: A sibling of the Slicing Spell. This curse manifests as a semi-transparent, dark greenish-yellow projectile shaped like a thin crescent with a jagged edge. When it strikes a creature, it leaves an ugly cut and causes temporary severe bleeding. It can penetrate thin armor, but its intended target is living flesh. Wounds left by this curse heal several times slower, bleed more profusely, and leave ugly scars that tend to ache, reopen, and even bleed again on occasion. Like all curses, it resists being reversed. >Requires Spell: Slicing Spell

spell_slicing_spell.name: Spell: Slicing Spell
spell_slicing_spell.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Slicing Spell Aspect: 1 Force Description: This spell manifests as a semi-transparent, light-green projectile shaped like a thin crescent. When it strikes a target, it applies high force along a narrow edge, cutting and shearing through the material. It is strong enough to slice through rope, leather, or even thin metal cables with ease. The spell can be tuned to deliver a shallow cut or a deep gash as needed.

spell_slippery_soul.name: Spell: Slippery Soul
spell_slippery_soul.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Slippery Soul Aspect: 2 Aether + 2 Order + 1 Life + 1 Protection Description: This blessing grants temporary resistance to curses. It rarely prevents a curse's effect entirely, but ensures the curse does not stick and generally weakens its impact. The blessing can be overwhelmed by enough curses layered together. Focusing on a specific curse or a few similar ones during the casting improves resistance against those specifically while weakening effect against others. Slippery Soul can also be cast immediately after being struck by a curse, causing it to "slip" off the target - though this is harder and less reliable.

spell_slow-glass_annealing.name: Spell: Slow-Glass Annealing
spell_slow-glass_annealing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Slow-Glass Annealing Aspect: 2 Fire + 2 Earth + 1 Time Description: This spell is cast over a kiln or a sand-smelter right as the molten silica is poured into its molds. Instead of flash-cooling, the spell extends the cooling process over a period of several days, but does so internally, eliminating all thermal stress and micro-fractures. The resulting glass panes are cheap to produce (no fuel for slow cooling ovens) and have the tensile strength of wrought iron. Used to create massive, flawless windows for public buildings, greenhouse panels, and translucent floor-tiles for upper-story walkways.

spell_smoldering_touch.name: Spell: Smoldering Touch
spell_smoldering_touch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Smoldering Touch Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This spell causes the caster's hands to become hot enough to ignite flammable materials on contact. The heat is contained to the hands and does not harm the caster. Useful for starting fires, lighting torches, or leaving burning handprints.

spell_snap_and_seal.name: Spell: Snap & Seal
spell_snap_and_seal.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Snap & Seal Aspect: 1 Curse + 1 Hurt + 1 Force + 1 Heal Description: This curse appears as a barely visible slab of black and white, accompanied by a wet snapping sound - similar to the Bone Breaker spell. It is a projectile that can pass through low-density obstacles and living tissue, gradually losing power until stopped. When it strikes bone, it interacts like fast-moving metallic material, typically fracturing or breaking it. The bone then instantly heals, but in the wrong, fractured state. The curse actively resists any attempt to correct the mishealed bone. >Requires Spell: Bone Breaker

spell_solar_blade.name: Spell: Solar Blade
spell_solar_blade.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Solar Blade Aspect: 2 Fire + 1 Light + 1 Sembalance Description: This spell creates a blade of condensed plasma and light extending from the caster's hand - a sword made of solar energy. The blade is incredibly hot and can cut through most materials. It lasts for a few minutes and can be dismissed at will. The blade sheds bright light, illuminating the area around the caster.

spell_spark_burst.name: Spell: Spark Burst
spell_spark_burst.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Spark Burst Aspect: 1 Fire Description: This spell creates a small burst of short-lived but hot sparks in one direction. Ideal for starting a fire. That's it.

spell_spit.name: Spell: Spit!
spell_spit.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Spit! Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Aether + 1 Water Description: This spell is cast once to linger on the caster's body for some time (up to 44 minutes). It is transmitted through the caster's taste (their saliva, sweat, blood, etc.) When a target comes into contact with the caster's taste (such as through a spit, a kiss, or bite), they are affected by the spell. The target experiences severe nausea and vertigo, which can be debilitating and disorienting. The effect lasts for a limited time (up to 12 minutes), and its severity depends on the acuity of the target's sense of taste and duration for how long they experienced taste.

spell_steady_hand.name: Spell: Steady Hand
spell_steady_hand.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Steady Hand Aspect: 2 Order + 1 Semblance + 1 Lore Description: This spell creates a temporary visual guide (a faint glowing line or grid) that overlays the caster's field of vision, helping them cut, draw, or place objects with perfect alignment. It lasts as long as the caster maintains concentration. Used by masons, carpenters, scribes, and artists.

spell_steam_burst.name: Spell: Steam Burst
spell_steam_burst.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Steam Burst Aspect: 1 Fire + 1 Water Description: Produces a high-pressure stream of hot steam from the caster's mouth or hands in a chosen direction. It is not immediately dangerous to the caster, but poses a significant threat to others and the surrounding environment. Leaves behind only a bit of humidity.

spell_sterile_field.name: Spell: Sterile Field
spell_sterile_field.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sterile Field Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Life + 1 Air +1 Earth Description: This spell creates a temporary, invisible barrier around a targeted area (such as a wound, a surgical site, or a medical instrument) that repels bacteria, viruses, and other contaminants. The field lasts for several hours or until deliberately dismissed. Used in field medicine to prevent infection when sterile conditions cannot be guaranteed. It is highly efficient, but not perfect.

spell_sticky_jam.name: Spell: Sticky Jam
spell_sticky_jam.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sticky Jam Aspect: 3 Sweet + 1 Water Description: This spell coats the ground in front of the caster with jam that is unusually heavy and sticky. The caster can control the color and taste of the created jam, but not separately. The jam vanishes after a few hours, leaving nothing but sweet smell behind. It is edible, but has no nutritional value and is far too sticky to eat comfortably.

spell_stone_flow.name: Spell: Stone Flow
spell_stone_flow.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Stone Flow Aspect: 3 Earth + 1 Water Description: This spell infuses targeted piece/volume of rock in a few seconds of focus. Infused pieces of stone can be shaped like clay by the user's hand or even be made flow akin to a liquid small distance away by user's will. When a spell stops working after some time or when it is dispelled, the stone turns back solid and keeps its new shape. This spell works better at softer rocks: harder the rock - more time it takes to infuse and harder it is to mold.

spell_stone_fur.name: Spell: Stone Fur
spell_stone_fur.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Stone Fur Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Transformation + 1 Beast + 2 Earth Description: This spell grows thick, brown fur over part or all of the target's skin temporarily. It can be cast on oneself or on others. The fur is a superb thermal insulator (comparable to asbestos but safe), thick and durable like mineral wool, yet soft and comfortable to the touch.

spell_stone_fusion.name: Spell: Stone Fusion
spell_stone_fusion.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Stone Fusion Aspect: 3 Earth + 1 Fire + 1 Order Description: A spell that fuses two pieces of stone together at their contact surfaces, creating a seamless bond. The stone at the interface briefly softens, then hardens into a continuous mass. Used for joining stone elements without mortar.

spell_stone_molding.name: Spell: Stone Molding
spell_stone_molding.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Stone Molding Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Water + 1 Order Description: A less powerful variant of Stone Liquefaction turned into a spell form that softens stone to a clay-like consistency without fully liquefying it. The stone can be shaped by hand or with tools, then hardens back to its original density. Useful for detailed carving and repair work.

spell_stone-bond_welding.name: Spell: Stone-Bond Welding
spell_stone-bond_welding.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Stone-Bond Welding Aspect: 2 Earth + 1 Fire + 1 Order Description: This spell fuses two pieces of stone or ceramics together at their contact surfaces, effectively "welding" them into a single continuous mass. The caster presses the two pieces together and channels the spell through the joint, causing the stone at the interface to soften, flow, and re-crystallize as a seamless bond. The resulting joint is as strong as the surrounding stone, with no visible seam. The spell works best on similar stone types and requires careful preparation of the surfaces: they must be clean, dry, and closely matched.

spell_stretching.name: Spell Stretching
spell_stretching.description: This method lets you "stretch" a spell, extending its duration while sacrificing some of its intensity. This can be applied in two ways. To the effect: the spell's effect becomes weaker, but lasts longer. To the carrier: A short-lived ray becomes a continuous one by reducing the intensity of the effect per unit of time. Overall cost increased only slightly. Not all spells can be stretched this way.

spell_suffer.name: Spell: Suffer!
spell_suffer.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Suffer! Aspect: 3 Hurt + 1 Mind + 1 Aether Description: This spell produces a small, sickly-looking orb that flies as quickly as an arrow and can penetrate solid objects with force, though not much (it can pierce a thin steel barrier). When it strikes a living creature, it triggers a sensation of pain and disgust. This sensation is the most painful thing the target has ever experienced, but with a slight edge to it (about 1.5% more intense). This information is taken from their soul and projected onto their body. The relative nature of the sensation means the spell always creates a new peak of suffering for the target, meaning subsequent hits will be slightly worse than the last.

spell_sugar_rush.name: Spell: Sugar Rush
spell_sugar_rush.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sugar Rush Aspect: 4 Sweet + 2 Life + 1 Creation Description: This spell is cast on the self or another creature. It floods the target's bloodstream with pure, magically-conjured glucose, causing a massive burst of energy, heightened reflexes, and reduced perception of pain. The effect lasts for a few minutes, after which the target crashes: experiencing lethargy, tremors, and an overwhelming need to eat something substantial. Overuse can cause pancreatic damage.

spell_sun-reading.name: Spell: Sun-Reading
spell_sun-reading.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sun-Reading Aspect: 1 Light + 1 Time + 2 Lore Description: This spell tells the caster the current time of day based on the position of the sun (or stars, at night). The information appears in their mind as a precise time, but only if they have a clear view of the sky and understand the local timekeeping system. In overcast conditions the spell less accurate, and indoors - the spell fails. Effectively a magical sundial that works even without a physical sundial.

spell_sweating_sickness.name: Spell: Sweating Sickness
spell_sweating_sickness.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sweating Sickness Aspect: 2 Life + 1 Fire + 1 Curse Description: This curse appears as a streak of ugly flame and carries a faint scent of sweat. When it strikes a target, it induces a high (but not deadly) fever that lasts for several hours. From that point on, the fever will return and subside periodically. Sometimes it lasts a few hours, sometimes a full day. It may strike once a month or several times a week. In the long run, this will surely wear down the victim's body and spirit unless the curse is lifted or countered somehow.

spell_sweet_rot.name: Spell: Sweet Rot
spell_sweet_rot.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sweet Rot Aspect: 8 Sweet + 2 Curse Description: This curse creates a pretty burst of sweet dust, which quickly turns bitter after getting into one's mouths. If someone gets enough of it in their body, they will be cursed with having magically induced diabetes (or random type). Dust doesn’t exist for long.

spell_sweet_sting.name: Spell: Sweet Sting
spell_sweet_sting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Sweet Sting Aspect: 2 Sweet + 1 Earth Description: This spell shapes targeted sugar into thin needles and launches them in the direction of caster's choice. These needles are reinforced by the effect of the spell, but barely enough to qualify as glass. It is still sugar though.

spell_taffy_tether.name: Spell: Taffy Tether
spell_taffy_tether.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Taffy Tether Aspect: 1 Sweet Description: This spell creates a stretchy, adhesive strand of magical taffy that extends from the caster's hand to a target. The tether is surprisingly strong and elastic, allowing the caster to pull objects closer, swing from anchor points, or even bind a creature's limbs together. The tether dissolves into harmless sugar after a few minutes and mostly vanishes. It is not strong enough to hold a struggling adult for long.

spell_tension_gauge.name: Spell: Tension Gauge
spell_tension_gauge.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Tension Gauge Aspect: 2 Lore + 1 Semblance + 1 Force Description: The caster touches a rope, chain, cable, or beam and focuses. They receive an intuitive sense of how much tension or stress the object is under: whether it's near breaking point, properly tensioned, or too loose. The information appears as a vague feeling: "safe," "strained," "danger." Useful for engineers, riggers, and anyone working with loads. Requires understanding of tension to work better.

spell_thermal_insulation.name: Spell: Thermal Insulation
spell_thermal_insulation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Thermal Insulation Aspect: 2 Protection + 1 Fire + 1 Water Description: This spell creates a protective layer around the caster that resists extreme temperatures - both heat and cold. It does not block damage entirely, but significantly reduces the effects of environmental temperature extremes and temperature-based attacks. A person wearing this spell could walk through a burning building or a freezing blizzard with only minor discomfort. The effect lasts for up to an hour.

spell_thread-finger.name: Spell: Thread-Finger
spell_thread-finger.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Thread-Finger Aspect: 1 Semblance + 1 Force Description: The caster's fingertip extrudes a thin, temporary filament of magical force that acts like thread. It can be used to sew, stitch, or bind materials together, or to tie small knots. The thread has the tensile strength of strong cotton and lasts for several hours before dissolving harmlessly. Useful for field repairs or any situation where needle and thread are unavailable.

spell_time_keeping.name: Spell: Time Keeping
spell_time_keeping.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Time Keeping Aspect: 1 Order + 1 Time + 2 Lore Description: This spell functions the same as Measuring Eye, but for measuring how much time has passed since the spell was activated. The caster activates the spell and, upon focusing on it later, receives a precise measurement of the elapsed duration. The information appears in their mind as a clear sense of time passed - down to the second. However, as with Measuring Eye, the caster must already understand the units they are measuring in and have a conceptual grasp of timekeeping. If you do not understand hours, minutes, or seconds, the spell will not work - or will only work partially, perhaps giving you a vague sense of "long" or "short" rather than precise numbers.

spell_torch.name: Spell: Torch
spell_torch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Torch Aspect: 2 Fire + 1 Wood Description: This spell produces flame on one end of a stick or small piece of wood the caster wields. The flame keeps burning on the top and is very hard to put out while the spell is working. The stick itself slowly turns into burnt wood, consumed in the process of sustaining the flame at the top. The user can turn the flame on or off at any moment, or control the intensity of the fire.

spell_tree_birth.name: Spell: Tree Birth
spell_tree_birth.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Tree Birth Aspect: 3 Wood + 3 Creation + 2 Life + 1 Transformation Description: This spell requires a piece of wood (at least acorn-sized) to infuse. After this is done, the piece of wood will transform and sprout into a healthy sapling of the tree from which the wood was taken.

spell_tree_grafting.name: Spell: Tree Grafting
spell_tree_grafting.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Tree Grafting Aspect: 3 Wood + 1 Healing + 1 Life Description: This spell allows the caster to graft one type of wood to another. It causes quick fusion and integration of a new branch at the point of contact and slightly accelerates natural growth. It can only target trees and woody plants.

spell_true_healing.name: Spell: True Healing
spell_true_healing.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: True Healing Aspect: 6 Healing + 3 Order + 3 Life + 3 Creation + 1 Aether Description: This spell heals mechanical wounds and corrects alignment issues (such as misaligned bones, partial organ loss, or paralysis) without drawing energy or biomass from the recipient. It cannot handle complex problems like vision loss from brain damage or completely missing eyes, but resolves anything less severe. The spell does not affect poisons or illnesses, though it can heal the damage they caused. True Healing is costly and works in an unfocused manner: healing everything at once, it cannot be focused or prioritized. Cost increases proportionally with the number and complexity of issues addressed per unit of time.

spell_vascular_mending.name: Spell: Vascular Mending
spell_vascular_mending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Vascular Mending Aspect: 3 Healing + 2 Transformation + 1 Order Description: A specialized variation of Organic Mending focused on blood vessels, the heart, and related tissues. The spell repairs mechanical damage such as tears, punctures, and ruptures, restoring circulatory integrity. It can regenerate lost tissue to a degree, but mostly fuses existing material back into a functional state. >Requires Spell: Organic Mending

spell_vitality_ward.name: Spell: Vitality Ward
spell_vitality_ward.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Vitality Ward Aspect: 3 Life + 1 Protection + 1 Light Description: This spell creates a faint shimmering barrier around the caster that absorbs incoming attacks specifically targeting life force or ones using death magic. It protects against spells like Death Ray by dissipating their Death and Hurt aspects before they reach the caster's tissue. The ward is fragile, capable of absorbing only one or two powerful attacks before collapsing. It glows with a warm, golden light when hit and that dims as it weakens.

spell_ward_of_negation.name: Spell: Ward of Negation
spell_ward_of_negation.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Ward of Negation Aspect: 4 Protection + 2 Order + 1 Aether + 1 Essence Description: This spell creates a shimmering, silvery bubble-like field around the caster that actively negates magical effects that target them. A curse aimed at the caster will be weakened or dispelled entirely. A scrying spell will fail to penetrate the ward. A direct magical attack will be reduced in power or slightly thrown off course. The ward is not perfect (powerful, cunning or specialized magic can overwhelm it) but it provides a significant defense against hostile magic. The effect has to be actively sustained. Stationary.

spell_water_probe.name: Spell: Water Probe
spell_water_probe.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Water Probe Aspect: 9 Water + 1 Lore Description: This spell targets a volume of water. It gives the caster general information about how much the liquid is contaminated, indicated on a scale from blue to red. It does not reveal the specific nature of the contamination - only how far it is from the purity of distilled water.

spell_water_soap.name: Spell: Water Soap
spell_water_soap.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Water Soap Aspect: 7 Water + 1 Purity Description: This spell makes a small amount of targeted water act soapy: it produces foam and bubbles and is good at cleaning things. After the spell is stopped, or after some time has passed, the water returns to its normal state.

spell_wave_of_erosion.name: Spell: Wave of Erosion
spell_wave_of_erosion.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wave of Erosion Aspect: 3 Earth + 1 Chaos Description: This spell produces a "wave" that travels through stone or other minerals of a similar nature from the point of contact. Each wave loosens the integrity of the material, breaks it down, and eventually turns it into fine dust of evenly redistributed mineral components. The finer the end result, the longer and more difficult it is to achieve. It is relatively easy to break down a stone into smaller shards (taking only a few seconds), but much harder and more time-consuming to turn sand into dust (taking around an hour). The spell works best on smaller volumes; the wave has limited capacity to travel through material and becomes weaker the further it gets from the point of contact. Denser materials with more complex compositions are more resistant to the spell. It does not affect metals.

spell_weight_sense.name: Spell: Weight Sense
spell_weight_sense.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Weight Sense Aspect: 1 Space + 2 Lore + 1 Earth Description: This spell allows the caster to gauge the exact weight or mass of an object they are touching or can see within a short distance. The information appears in their mind as a precise weight in the units they understand. Used by merchants, alchemists, cooks, and anyone who needs to measure quantities.

spell_wet_stench.name: Spell: Wet Stench
spell_wet_stench.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wet Stench Aspect: 1 Taint + 1 Curse Description: This curse is cast on a piece of food or drink, remaining infused for several hours. Anyone who consumes the affected food becomes cursed: their sweat turns brown-black in color, becomes sticky, and reeks of rot and stagnant water.

spell_wood_bending.name: Spell: Wood Bending
spell_wood_bending.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wood Bending Aspect: 2 Wood + 1 Water Description: This spell is used on a volume of wood to make it bend as if it had been steamed, and then harden it into its new, changed shape. The larger the volume, the longer it takes. There is a maximum volume of a target (around 0.345 cubic meters).

spell_wood_drying.name: Spell: Wood Drying
spell_wood_drying.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wood Drying Aspect: 3 Wood + 1 Air + 1 Water Description: This spell is used on a volume of wood to gradually and quickly dry it, making the material ready for construction uses. The process doesn’t damage wood. The larger the volume, the longer it takes. There is a maximum volume of a target (around 2.33 cubic meters).

spell_wood_fusion.name: Spell: Wood Fusion
spell_wood_fusion.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wood Glue Aspect: 2 Wood + 1 Water + 1 Order Description: This spell fuses two pieces of wood together at their contact surfaces, creating a bond as strong as the surrounding wood. The wood must be clean and dry, and the pieces must be held together during the process. Useful for joinery and repair.

spell_wood_hardening.name: Spell: Wood Hardening
spell_wood_hardening.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wood Hardening Aspect: 2 Transformation + 1 Wood + 1 Force Description: A spell inspired by Wood Petrification that hardens wood without turning it to stone. The wood becomes denser, more durable, and resistant to damage, but retains its organic nature. Useful for tools, weapons, and structural elements. Beware, it becomes heavier and might sink.

spell_wood_petrification.name: Spell: Wood Petrification
spell_wood_petrification.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wood Petrification Aspect: 2 Transformation + 1 Wood + 1 Earth Description: This spell is used on a volume of wood to gradually turn it into petrified wood. The larger the volume, the longer it takes. There is a maximum volume of a target (around 17 cubic meters). Allows the caster to petrify only specific parts of a wooden object - such as the outer layer, or a decorative pattern.

spell_wound_patch.name: Spell: Wound Patch
spell_wound_patch.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Wound Patch Aspect: 2 Semblance + 1 Healing Description: Creates a temporary, semi-transparent film over a wound. The film prevents the wound from widening, keeps out dirt and debris, and stops minor bleeding. It lasts for several hours. The spell does not heal the wound - it only stabilizes and protects it. Larger or deeper wounds may require multiple applications or a stronger, different spell.

spell_write_in.name: Spell: Write In
spell_write_in.description: You've learned a new spell! Name: Write In Aspect: 1 Lore + 1 Mind + 1 Order Description: This spell lets you perfectly memorize what you are currently reading. It creates something like a file somewhere in your neural architecture, which is very easy to access and recall later. However, you must actually read and comprehend what you are looking at while sustaining the spell, as it uses the text-recognition part of your mind to function. Being tired or lacking focus and reading skills may prevent the spell from working, or cause it to stop while you are reading - resulting in an incomplete recording or missing sections.

spell-slinging.name: Spell-Slinging
spell-slinging.description: This perk grants you the skill and knowledge to pre-program certain simple changes to a spell's carrier trajectory before casting, or to give it a slight nudge while it is already active with some focus. It increases accuracy and allows techniques such as curving spells or changing their speed mid-flight. It cannot be too complicated and the cost grows proportionally to degree and complexity of changes, depending partially on the nature of the work too.

subtle_spellwork.name: Subtle Spellwork
subtle_spellwork.description: This is an upgrade to Cosmetic Calibration. It lets you make your spells less noticeable - including reducing their "loudness" for magic detection and analysis. You can also introduce noise or more profound changes to a spell's perceptible effects to confuse and mislead observers. However, you still cannot change the general nature of the work. An observer may still tell that you are casting some sort of curse, but it will be much harder to identify the specifics. It introduces cost growth proportional to degree and complexety of changes. >Requires Cosmetic Calibration

triple_casting.name: Triple Casting
triple_casting.description: This is an upgrade to Dual Casting, refining your methodology and multitasking abilities when working with magic. It lets you execute three spells in parallel with only a slight increase in overall cost. >Requires Dual Casting

undercharge.name: Undercharge
undercharge.description: You gain the ability, knowledge, and skill to undercharge your spells. This allows you to still use a spell while spending fewer resources on it (reducing its cost). In exchange, the spell becomes proportionally less intense, scales down, or loses some of its properties. There are limits to how far a spell can be undercharged, and certain spells react differently than others to this trick. Sometimes undercharging may be impossible or even dangerous for specific types of magic. However, it can be a good way to save resources in a moment of need.

administrator_engine.name: Administrator Engine
administrator_engine.description: This metaperk automatically connects to all other perks and powers you have and updates when you acquire new ones. Its primary goal is the management and control of the various effects that powers give you. It grants you the ability to tune and even turn powers on or off, even for ones which usually don't have any means of control. You can preprogram various quick changes to tweak the operation of many abilities at once, giving you more precise control over the abilities you possess and making it easier to monitor what they do and when. Of course, it works a bit differently with different perks and tries to adapt to them. Basically, it just gives a control panel to better monitor and manage your powers.

albedo_flame.name: Albedo Flame
albedo_flame.description: You can shroud your body in a cool, silvery-white flame that purifies and separates rather than destroys. Upon contact, this flame strips away impurities, taints, curses, poisons, and unwanted secondary properties, leaving behind a neutral or inert state. Alloys are split into pure metals; polluted water becomes clean; a berserk foe loses their rage; an enchanted blade becomes a mundane one via separation of property and material. On living beings, it removes diseases, toxins, and even some forms of mind control, but prolonged exposure will also extract memories, emotions, or even pain responses - leaving a blank slate and separated traits in form of substantial essences. The flame works fastest on complex things with many distinct properties and cannot meaningfully affect already-pure singular substances (e.g., distilled water, elemental gold). The Albedo Flame cannot be extinguished by normal means, but you may dismiss it at will and it cannot exist without your input (too far away). This perk synergizes with other Alchemical Flames, amplifying their effects when used in sequence and produces combinational effects.

alchemical_art.name: Alchemical Art
alchemical_art.description: You derive your power from consumed elixirs and alchemical creations, brewed through a rigid system of rules and philosophy. These concoctions provide the necessary fuel to cast, with effects determined by the precision of your art. Potions can be prepared in advance, allowing for tactical flexibility, but your capabilities are limited by your stock, supplies and preparation. The strict formulae required mean innovation is slow and methodical (trial and error has real consequences) and some things just cannot be done withing the system you use. It's not all-encompassing.

arcane_secrecy.name: Arcane Secrecy
arcane_secrecy.description: Your magic is fueled not by energy, but by revelation - you must offer secrets to power your spells. Every casting consumes a piece of hidden knowledge: a personal shame, a confidential plan, the true name of a distant star, or the location of a buried treasure. The greater the secret's worth (its intimacy, its potential to harm if revealed, its significance to the world) the more powerful the effect you can conjure. This allows you to work magic far beyond conventional limits, trading information for miracles. Unfortunetly, secrets spent are truly gone, ripped from your memory and sometimes even from reality nearby, made harder for you to rediscover and remeber. Those who once trusted you may sense something missing, diviners can detect the gaps where knowledge used to be, and beings who hoard secrets (librarians of forbidden lore, elder gods, or simply the very paranoid) will take great interest in someone who burns information as fuel.

aspect_loom.name: Aspect Loom
aspect_loom.description: You can unravel matter and energy into thick, colorful threads and wind them into balls that represent aspects of an object. Simply touching your target starts the process. These threads can be stored in a special pocket dimension and accessed at any time. If you haven't altered the threads, you can turn them back into the original objects. The mass, volume, and complexity of the target determine how many threads you obtain and how easy/hard it is to do, but it will always be lesser in mass and volume than the original unraveled object. You can split these threads into more, unraveling the nature of the object into simpler aspects. Using different threads, you can create patterns so that when they are reassembled, the resulting object will be different - made of aspects of your original target and inspired by the new shape. You are an expert in working with threads and possess an unnatural intuition for manipulating aspect threads specifically. Others can also work with these threads and even restore them into objects using the right supernatural energies or abilities, but without your unnatural intuition, it is difficult for them to find effective or useful patterns.

bargained_protection.name: Bargained Protection
bargained_protection.description: Your wards are living guardians: spirits and beings bound by pact to protect your territory. The nature of their protection depends entirely on the bargains struck, offerings made, and bindings established. You gain innate talent in negotiating with otherworldly entities and securing their service. Guardians require ongoing payment or appeasement; neglected bargains lead to withdrawn protection or active betrayal. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

blessing_enchanter.name: Blessing Enchanter
blessing_enchanter.description: Your items absorb power through sustained use in religious ceremonies: rituals, offerings, and devotions gradually imbuing them with properties tied to those beliefs and practices. The longer an item is employed in worship, the stronger and more refined its enchantment becomes. You gain innate talent in conducting ceremonies and guiding an item's spiritual saturation. Items removed from their religious context may slowly fade or require renewal. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

celestial_authority_of_repulsion.name: Celestial Authority of Repulsion
celestial_authority_of_repulsion.description: You are protected by a perfect, automatic conceptual Repulsion. This passive defence constantly repels anything that would harm you, from physical attacks and poison to exhaustion and even starvation. You can instinctively sense what is being repulsed and how at any given moment. You can slightly modulate this passive defence, but cannot turn off or fully control it. Furthermore, you can learn to actively wield this power. By perceiving a target and performing the right "mental gymnastics," you can actively repulse specific things (matter, energy, fatigue, or even curses) in controlled bursts. However, active use requires intense focus, is difficult to maintain, and is always weaker than your perfect passive defence (meaning you can never use it to harm yourself) and you must learn from passive Repulsion effect first to achieve anything. Remember, repulsed things don't vanish; they are simply pushed somewhere else. A repulsed poison might be forced into the ground. There are also many ways to use Repulsion on any given target. For example, pushing space can produce different results, depending on your way of thinking and the situation. Only few divine, deeply eldritch or conceptual effects might pierce your Repulsion.

celestial_authority_of_voyages.name: Celestial Authority of Voyages
celestial_authority_of_voyages.description: You possess the ability to traverse dimensions beyond the merely physical. You can open, close, and navigate paths through space and time, but also through realms not associated with them. Enter mental planes, the dimension of pure mathematics, or specific afterlives, and even bring things back from one dimension to another. However, your ability to find and reach a destination depends on your understanding and conceptualization of the target. This power also grants a passive effect: perfect evasion. When something is about to strike you, this defense will shift part of your existence (body, soul, mind, or whatever) into another dimension, safely and efficiently dodging the incoming doom. These moments of evasion also offer rare opportunities to grasp tiny specks of enlightenment, deepening your understanding for future active use of this Authority. But at the beginning you can be sure: you being would never be in the path of the incoming attack. Only few divine, deeply eldritch or conceptual effects might counter your passive evasion.

ceremonial_warding.name: Ceremonial Warding
ceremonial_warding.description: Your wards are maintained through repeated ritual performance: each ceremony reinforcing, adjusting, or re-powering the protective barriers. The ritual's form directly shapes the ward's properties, allowing you to easily alter workings to change functionality. You gain innate talent in designing and conducting these warding rituals. Neglecting the required ceremonies causes wards to gradually weaken and eventually fail. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

citrinitas_flame.name: Citrinitas Flame
citrinitas_flame.description: You can wreathe yourself in a shimmering golden-yellow flame that catalyzes transmutation and awakening. Instead of destruction or purification, this flame rearranges matter into higher-energy or more complex forms. Lead becomes tin or copper; insulators become semiconductors; inert powders become mild explosives; dull edges become razor-sharp. On living beings, it temporarily heightens intellect, senses, and reflexes, though overuse causes manic overdrive, hallucinations of “enlightenment,” or uncontrolled mutation. The flame cannot create something from nothing - it only transforms what is already present into a more active or potent state. Objects already at their peak are unaffected. The Citrinitas Flame cannot be extinguished by normal means, but you may dismiss it at will and it cannot exist without your input (too far away). This perk synergizes with other Alchemical Flames, amplifying their effects when used in sequence and produces combinational effects.

consumption_mage.name: Consumption Mage
consumption_mage.description: Your magic is activated and shaped by consuming specific substances: potions, rare metals, alchemical herbs, or similar (choose some focused category). These consumables act as both fuel and focus, allowing you to draw out and enhance your abilities. Your magic is perfectly adapted to this practice, granting you innate talent in preparing and utilizing your chosen materials. Without your consumables, your power is severely limited. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

deed-bound_enchanter.name: Deed-Bound Enchanter
deed-bound_enchanter.description: Your items grow in power through legendary use - great deeds performed with them shape and strengthen their enchantments. Before an item can accumulate power, you must first imbue it with a specific purpose, attuning it to certain actions while disattuning it from others. Power builds gradually with each significant deed, eventually reaching a peak where the enchantment stabilizes and ceases to grow. You gain innate talent in setting purposes and guiding an item's legend. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

diagrams_of_warding.name: Diagrams of Warding
diagrams_of_warding.description: Your wards are anchored to a single large diagram or magic circle, which dictates the ward's properties, boundaries, and behavior. The precision and complexity of the diagram determine the ward's sophistication and power. You gain innate talent in designing, inscribing, and activating these ward circles. Damaging the diagram disrupts or collapses the ward entirely until repaired. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

dimensional_tapping.name: Dimensional Tapping
dimensional_tapping.description: Your magic reaches beyond reality, drawing power from alternate dimensions to fuel your spells. Each type of effect (fire, shadow, time, force) can be sourced from a different reality, granting you incredible versatility and access to energies no single world could provide. By pulling from dimensions with exotic physical laws, your magic can achieve effects that seem impossible by local standards. However, every spell opens a temporary bridge, and attention flows both ways. Prolonged casting, reckless draws, or using the same dimension too frequently can attract the notice of things that dwell within - hunger entities, conceptual predators, or entire ecologies that view your magic as an invasion. Worse, if a connection is forced or held too long, something may follow the current back.

dionysus_ultimate_blessing.name: Dionysus Ultimate Blessing
dionysus_ultimate_blessing.description: You cannot die from overdrinking; at some point, it will stop worsening. Any damage caused by drinking will be healed by a short hangover afterward. You do not suffer from the usual side effects of alcoholism, such as developing a tolerance to alcohol. While you are at least a little bit drunk, you cannot be poisoned by other substances. Your luck slightly increases with how drunk you are at the moment, though there is a limit. You are extremely knowledgeable about cocktails, alcoholic beverages, and how to drink them correctly. You can consume methanol or similar "alcoholic" substances without dying, going blind, or experiencing other severe consequences, but the hangover will be longer and much worse. You can still get drunk, even if other powers prohibit or make it impossible. You can experience degrees of drunkenness beyond what an unmodified human brain can normally comprehend. If you want to get intoxicated from drinking at the moment - you will!

effluvium_wizard.name: Effluvium Wizard
effluvium_wizard.description: You are a genius of toxicity and a pioneer of chemical warfare. You possess an innate resistance to harmful agents, able to build total immunity through exposure, and the expertise to design, deploy, and counter modern Earth chemical weapons. Your talent borders on the supernatural, allowing you to invent new poisons with ease. This path has also granted you mastery over a unique necromancy, letting you animate organic chemical weapons - such as giving sentience to clouds of poison gas that can puppet the corpses of the fallen. Through alchemical sigils and artifacts, you can extract and command toxins with precision. Furthermore, you may initiate students into this art through ritual and tutelage, though their mastery will depend on their own aptitude and your guidance.

eldritch_insight.name: Eldritch Insight
eldritch_insight.description: Your magic operates on verifiable principles. By studying the universe as a logical system of natural laws, you derive spellcraft from formula rather than faith or bloodline. This grants you exceptional stability - your workings are rooted in reality, making them difficult to disrupt or counterspell. You gain a natural talent for learning and reverse-engineering any supernatural phenomenon you encounter. However, this framework is a model, not a window. Encountering truly alien or paradoxical phenomena that contradict your established understanding can cause your magic to falter or produce unexpected results until you painstakingly update your theories and system of thought.

emulsion_sovereign.name: Emulsion Sovereign
emulsion_sovereign.description: You touch a container or puddle of two or more liquids and can control whether they mix or separate. Turn a shaken oil-vinegar dressing into perfect, stable emulsion - or instantly separate blood into plasma and cells (lethal). Force water and gasoline to mix into a flammable sludge that won't separate again. Remove alcohol from a drink by separating it to the surface where you can skim it off. Range: touch only, up to 50 liters per second.

enperked_item_creation.name: Enperked Item Creation
enperked_item_creation.description: With this meta-perk you can infuse items with the effects of your own perks, granting them enchantment-like properties. Crafting an item from scratch yields the best results, though personally modifying or rebuilding an existing item also works. Effects may be unpredictable at first, but experimentation and experience will improve your control, consistency, and ability to tailor the outcome. Your understanding of the perk, your crafting skill, and your conceptualization all influence the final result, as does the type of item used. Higher-cost perks are more difficult to infuse, while lower-cost perks are easier. This perk does not affect other meta-perks.

escalating_harm.name: Escalating Harm
escalating_harm.description: Once you land an initial strike on an opponent, your subsequent attacks against the same target grow increasingly devastating. Each successive blow deals twice the damage of the previous one. For example, if your first hit causes a minor abrasion, the second strike will be twice as severe, and the third strike will be four times as severe as the first. This escalation resets if you switch targets and rapidly decays, if you pause between attacks for too long. The ability only functions if your first attack deals meaningful damage. It doesn't work if your first attack didn't deal enough damage and can the effect can be interrupted by other exotic effects.

etiquette.name: Etiquette
etiquette.description: You possess an impeccable understanding of social conduct. You instinctively know the basic rules, customs, and protocols required for polite and respectful behavior in practically any culture you encounter, from street gangs to high society, warrior clans to merchant guilds, allowing you to navigate any interaction without embarrassing yourself or committing a social faux pas. This perk functions on two levels. First, it provides you with practical knowledge of common and historical etiquette systems for most situations and groups on Earth. Second, it grants you an enhanced intuition that allows you to decipher and adapt to entirely new systems of etiquette with minimal exposure, simply by observing and interacting with the group in question.

event_horizon.name: Event Horizon
event_horizon.description: You project and manipulate shapes of absolute blackness - each one a shaped event horizon. Any matter or energy touching their surface is deleted from existence. They cannot exist independently; moving too far away or dropping concentration makes them vanish. You telepathically move them within a limited radius around you, or hold them weightlessly in your hands. Getting very close to a surface produces a mild gravitational pull. Your own body is immune. Projecting more than three at a time or shaping one larger than a door causes rapid mental fatigue.

fabrication_enchanter.name: Fabrication Enchanter
fabrication_enchanter.description: Your enchantments are woven into items during their mundane creation: forging, carving, weaving, or similar craft processes. The final enchantment's quality depends on both your magical skill and the physical craftsmanship of the object itself. You gain innate talent in integrating spellwork seamlessly into traditional making. Post-creation attempts to enchant are significantly more difficult. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

faith_forged_miracles.name: Faith Forged Miracles
faith_forged_miracles.description: Belief itself becomes fuel for your magic. The convictions of others (whether organized religion, local superstitions, cultural myths, or simple misunderstandings) generate power that you can channel into supernatural effects. A town's fervent belief in a local saint lets you work healing; widespread terror of a monster allows you to summon shadows; a misconception about haunted ground grants you power over the dead. The stronger and more widespread the belief, the mightier the miracle you can perform. Of course, you are bound by the content of that belief. You cannot easily contradict the source of your power - a miracle drawn from fear will feel terrible, one drawn from love will feel gentle, and attempting to use belief against its nature may cause the magic to fail or twist unexpectedly. Moreover, those who shape belief (priests, tyrants, memetic threats) can starve or poison your fuel source, and you may find yourself unconsciously reinforcing the very misconceptions you rely upon to maintain your power.

filter_enchanter.name: Filter Enchanter
filter_enchanter.description: Your enchanting requires channeling power through a physical filter (a crystal, lens, or similar medium) which shapes and refines raw magic into stable enchantments. The filter's quality and properties influence the resulting enchantment's characteristics. You gain innate talent in selecting and utilizing appropriate filters for your purposes. Without a suitable filter, your ability to enchant is severely hampered. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

fire_fiends_creation.name: Fire Fiends Creation
fire_fiends_creation.description: You can create free fire spirits or infuse items with them using living things you have burned down yourself as the source - either from their ashes or by literally dragging specks of "inner fire" from the corpses of your foes. These "fiends" need to eat fire or highly flammable materials to survive, but even then, they have limited and usually short lifespans because they age relatively quickly. They are generally aligned with you, listen to your orders, and are loyal, but tend to be mischievous and "fiery" in character due to their nature. They live longer when infused into objects, but their effects are less powerful in that form. Depending on exotic and unqiue properties of things you burnt to create them, friends might possess some traces of traits and characteristics of the burnt object.

fluid_light.name: Fluid Light
fluid_light.description: You are capable of absorbing light with the surface of your body, turning it into a transparent fluid and excreting it from any point on your body. Disturbing this substance causes it to partly revert back into light (for example, by suddenly heating it or punching it hard). This liquid is practically weightless and has very low viscosity. However, you can concentrate more light into the same volume of liquid. Doing so will make it heavier and more viscous, the more light you pack into it. Additionally, disturbing it will produce brighter light with a shorter wavelength. You are good at absorbing visible light but terrible at absorbing non-visible light. There is a limit to how much you can absorb, store, and recycle per unit of time.

focal_point.name: Focal Point
focal_point.description: Your enchanting centers around a dedicated power source (a gemstone, crystal, or similar focus) that is set into an object to grant it magical properties. The focus determines the enchantment's capacity and nature, while the object shapes its application. You gain innate talent in preparing, cutting, and setting these focal points. Without a suitable focus, your ability to create enchanted items is severely limited. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

glass_world.name: Glass World
glass_world.description: You gain the intuitive ability to interact with all matter as if it were glass. This versatile power lets you: shatter the strongest stones like fragile glass; walk on water as if it were a solid floor; see through walls as if they were clear windows; reflect light with a piece of wood as if it were a perfect mirror; filter or focus light using a pebble as a lens; and cut flesh with a plastic knife as if its edge were razor-sharp volcanic glass. Mastery of this ability requires time, practice, and imagination to discover its full range of applications.

hardness_control.name: Hardness Control
hardness_control.description: You generate semi-solid light-constructs (blades, tendrils, orbs, filaments) that alter the hardness of whatever they touch, but they cannot damage anything by themselves. Works best on solids, but brief contact with liquids or gases can harden them into temporary unstable structures - walk on water or shatter a pocket of air like glass. Hardness change slows down the more you deviate from the target's original state (near-original is instant; diamond-soft or foam-hard takes seconds). Effect can be momentary (tied to the construct's presence) or lasting up to one hour at your choice.

heat_leech.name: Heat Leech
heat_leech.description: You touch an object or surface and change its thermal conductivity. Make a metal rod conduct heat so poorly that one end can be red-hot while you hold the other safely. Or make a stone wall conduct so perfectly that touching it transfers your body heat away in seconds, freezing you - or vice versa, dumping heat into an enemy through a handshake. Can last up to 10 minutes, requires touch to apply.

hole_manipulation.name: Hole Manipulation
hole_manipulation.description: You gain the ability to psychically manipulate holes. By touching the tangible edge of any opening, you can stretch or compress it temporarily, though you cannot permanently change its size. You can also pluck a hole from its location and fling it as a projectile; upon impact, it re-opens to its original dimensions. Crucially, when you remove a hole, you can preserve its "destination," allowing you to relocate an entrance while keeping it connected to its original exit. By touching the edges in sequence, you can link multiple holes to create a portal network, which you can dismiss as long as you are near one terminus. Passing objects through a chain of linked holes of different sizes/shapes will resize or deform them accordingly (process doesn't create/destroy matter). Finally, you can turn a removed hole inside out to create an unstable "anti-hole." This substance acts as a perfect, repulsive barrier, but it will explosively expand and disappear unless you are nearby to stabilize it.

implement_mage.name: Implement Mage
implement_mage.description: Your magic is channeled through a specific tool: a wand, blade, crystal, or other focused implement (choose one; cannot be overly broad definition). This focus grants you inherent talent and refined skill in casting through your chosen instrument, with your magic adapted to utilize it effectively by the perk. Loss or destruction of your implement leaves you severely hampered until it is recovered or replaced. Should you find yourself without any magic to channel currently, you may re-roll this perk for free.

infusion_enchanter.name: Infusion Enchanter
infusion_enchanter.description: Your enchanting works through gradual saturation - slowly infusing magic into an existing object until it becomes permanently enchanted. The process takes time proportional to the desired power and the object's resistance to accepting magic. You gain innate talent in sensing an object's capacity and guiding the infusion safely. Interrupting the process can damage or destabilize the object. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

just_pop_it.name: Just Pop It
just_pop_it.description: You can cause almost any physical object or part of it to pop, as if it were a balloon - simply by applying enough pressure or using something like a needle. Larger and more massive objects explode with greater power. After performing the 'pop' action, you have a short window of invulnerability to protect you from the explosion itself and some of the shards it produces, but nothing beyond that. You have perfect control over when this ability is active.

leyline_attunement.name: Leyline Attunement
leyline_attunement.description: Your magic draws on natural wellsprings like leylines to fuel itself, granting you tremendous power when connected to such sources, but only situationally. This principle transcends the existence of magic itself. Even in worlds without ambient enchantment, dead zones, or technological realities, you can still draw power from natural features that approximate leylines: continental fault lines, river confluences, ancient migration paths, or geomagnetic anomalies. Any place where the world itself holds concentrated natural energy becomes a wellspring for your magic. However, you remain bound by geography and vulnerability - away from such sites your power fades, and those attuned to the land (druids, earth spirits, or even geologists with supernatural sensitivity) can sense your tapping and may object to your presence.

loot_box_enchantments.name: Loot Box Enchantments
loot_box_enchantments.description: You possess a pool of energy that gradually recharges over 12 hours, which you can spend to apply game-like magical effects to items. Think of Diablo or MMO-style kinds of effects. The enchantments produced are mostly random, though you can slightly steer the result or invest more energy for greater predictability. You don't know possible effects from the start - you need to use the power and see them for yourself. Be warned: enchanting an item multiple times is difficult. Stacking too many effects risks erasing previous enchantments, corrupting the item, or warping it entirely. It is much easier and more efficient to apply this effect to small items or equipment, and much harder to focus it on consumables, architecture or generally big thing. Your energy pool slowly grows over time, but only if you regularly and completely exhaust it.

mad_insight.name: Mad Insight
mad_insight.description: Your capacity for invention and research scales directly with your mental instability and psychological suffering. The greater your madness, the greater your scientific genius. Your madness also mildly enhances your ability to avoid danger, improvise, and commit violence. Different mental conditions grant different boons: psychosis might fuel impossible mad scientist contraptions, while other issues aid different pursuits. Your psyche possesses an uncanny resilience, slowly healing over time to its baseline state when you took this perk, though this does not erase memories. You can even recover from eldritch truths, though it will be neither pleasant nor quick. Your creations vary in nature; some are blackboxed and impossible to replicate, while others are fully reproducible, albeit with complications.

mandate_of_condensation.name: Mandate of Condensation
mandate_of_condensation.description: You can condense almost anything within a small radius around you, including more abstract thingd like light, vacuum, or even fear. If it exists in your radius, you can target it. Before condensing, you gain a vague sense of how dangerous the process might be, though this offers no protection against your own foolishness. The resulting condensates form unique types of matter with special properties, effects, and varying stability. You can steer the condensation process with your will, allowing the same source material to yield slightly different results depending on your intentions. It's a case by case thing. Although, there is a limit of how much you can condense at a time, until you find some suitable sources of magic to power this ability in more reliably way, rather than fiat backing.

mandate_of_crystallization.name: Mandate of Crystallization
mandate_of_crystallization.description: You can crystallize almost anything within a small radius around you, including more abstract targets like smell, mana, or coldness. If it exists in your radius, you can target it. The resulting crystals form unique types of matter with special properties and varying stability. Before crystallizing, you gain a vague sense of potential dangers, though this offers no protection against your own foolishness. You can steer the process with your will, allowing the same source material to yield slightly different crystalline results depending on your intent. Although, there is a limit of how much you can crystallize at a time, until you find some suitable sources of magic to power this ability in more reliably way, rather than fiat backing.

marginalia_of_the_absolute.name: Marginalia of the Absolute
marginalia_of_the_absolute.description: Once per 24 hours of subjective time, you may manifest a true, verifiable scientific paper on a research question of your choice. The paper is 100 pages long maximum, decently written, and accurate as of the moment of creation, but it is never complete, never revolutionary, and often cites nonexistent sources from other realities. To use this perk, you must possess basic understanding of the subject and formulate a clear thesis. It cannot produce tactical data, simple facts, prophecies, or non-scientific information. The paper is a powerful research assistant, not an answer engine: use it to bypass dead ends, validate hypotheses, or generate new directions, but be prepared to reconstruct missing knowledge through conventional study or additional papers.

mechanical_enchanter.name: Mechanical Enchanter
mechanical_enchanter.description: Your enchanted creations take the form of intricate mechanical devices: systems of gears, pistons, and housings that appear purely technological but are fundamentally magical in operation. This aesthetic is intrinsic to your craft; attempts to create enchantments with a different appearance prove difficult or unstable. You gain innate talent in designing and constructing these magical machines. If you currently lack any magical ability, you may re-roll this perk for free.

metaphorical_flames.name: Metaphorical Flames
metaphorical_flames.description: You can use metaphorical sources of flame inside and around you to fuel your magic. For example, you can draw upon your own flaming rage or fires of will to produce mystical effects. Doing so will make these inner fires burn brighter for a time, but they will also turn to cold ash more quickly. This means that if you use something like rage or willpower as fuel, they will temporarily intensify, only to burn out afterward - leaving behind disinterest, apathy, or similar emotional numbness. You will need to restore them before they can be used again. As such, it is often wiser to use something like the potential flames trapped inside gunpowder on your person as fuel, even if such sources may be less effective or nearly impossible to utilize for certain tasks. Sourcing metaphorical flames requires creativity and careful thought. Some sources are easier or better suited for particular magical tasks than others, and the type of flame you use may influence the resulting magic. For instance, you cannot directly use the flames of another person's rage, but if you bait them into focusing their anger on you, it becomes easier to draw upon. Similarly, using flames of rage is well-suited for violent tasks, though the magic may take on side-effects associated with anger: effects that become much more pronounced if the task already aligns closely with the concept of rage. Not everything can serve as a source; it must be some form of metaphorical flame, or at the very least, fuel for one.

mortis_essence_accumulation.name: Mortis Essence Accumulation
mortis_essence_accumulation.description: You have a metaphorical vessel of 'mortis essence' inside your soul. You can replenish this magic by killing or witnessing death personally. You become stronger and can restore powers in places drenched in death or strongly associated with the dead, as recognized by the local population or creatures in the area. You gain more from killing or witnessing the death of someone who resists death or being killed. You also gain more from sleeping or meditating in places associated with the dead. Different creatures, types of death, and locations influence your replenishment. You cannot accumulate too much mortis essence, as it makes you more vulnerable to death: stopping bleeding takes longer, severe wounds are more likely to cause death, you get ill more easily, etc. So, you need to find a way to get rid of the excess or figure out how to block/control automatic replenishment of the essence before it kills you. Mortis essence is strongly aligned with arts related to death and the dead, such as necromancy or burial arts, but is not limited to them.

nigredo_flame.name: Nigredo Flame
nigredo_flame.description: You can produce a crackling black flame from any surface of your body. This flame does not burn with heat in the conventional sense. Instead, it accelerates putrefaction and decomposition on contact. Complex organic matter (flesh, wood, oil) breaks down into simple chemicals within milliseconds, which break further into pure elements withing seconds elements. Pure chemical elements resist longer, taking minutes to hours to decay into subatomic particles. The flame will not harm you or anything you consciously exclude, and you can control what it targets per touch. It also causes radioactive materials to decay catastrophically fast, releasing their energy all at once. The Nigredo Flame cannot be extinguished by normal means, but you may dismiss it at will and it cannot exist without your input (too far away). This perk synergizes with other Alchemical Flames, amplifying their effects when used in sequence and produces combinational effects.

oathbound_authority.name: Oathbound Authority
oathbound_authority.description: Your magic is powered not by external forces, but by the weight of your own sworn word. By placing binding restrictions upon yourself (vows of poverty, silence, non-violence, or any self-imposed limitation) you generate power proportional to the difficulty and sincerity of the oath. The greater the sacrifice of freedom, the mightier the magic you can fuel. This allows you to achieve remarkable effects simply by denying yourself options that others take for granted. Of course, oaths are not to be broken lightly. Violating a sworn restriction doesn't just cost you power - it can shatter your connection for a long period of time, inflict backlash upon your mind or body, and you never know true consequences beforehand. Moreover, those who can detect or manipulate promises (celestial scribes, devilish contractors, or feigned lords) may attempt to exploit your bonds, and every vow you take creates a thread others might one day pull.

ocean_of_bouillon.name: Ocean of Bouillon
ocean_of_bouillon.description: You can instantly conjure great quantities of fresh, boiling-hot (or cold, depending on the dish), and delicious soup, broth or stew in any targeted empty vessel. It must be some kind of mundane soup, broth or stew, and you should be somewhat familiar with specific dish to actually summon it.
