blinding_the_brillian.description: If it were to come down to earth you could blind the sun itself. You possess the absolutely incredible ability to turn people's intelligence and mental faculties against them, turning their own brilliance into a tool for your own clever schemes. Fooling those with incredible minds and mental abilities is easy for you, negating any advantage they might have on you from such abilities. Not to say that you are infallible, but anyone who relies on simple genius to thwart your machinations will be sorely surprised.

brilliant.name: Brilliant
brilliant.description: You have an extraordinary mind by anyone’s standards. You think faster, process information far better, and learn quicker. All with an impressive clarity of thought. In general you’re roughly at peak human capacity mentally. Not truly superhuman, although depending on the company you keep you can expect to be at least one of the smartest people in the room. Let's be honest though, most of the time you'll probably be THE smartest. Most people are rather dim after all.

charm_and_a_smile.name: Charm and a Smile
charm_and_a_smile.description: You are attractive. The kind of attractive that knocks the feet out from under people’s ability to think clearly with nothing more than a brief moment of eye contact, let alone a smile. More deviously you always know exactly how to use your looks to your advantage. Just the right angle to glance over your shoulder, the perfect timing on that slow grin, to catch the light just right to...sorry, can’t remember what I was saying.

cruel_genius.name: Cruel Genius
cruel_genius.description: There is a reason you are somebody to be feared. You possess a calculating and ruthless mind that inevitably conjures up ideas and schemes as effective as they are chilling. Even against the outright brilliant you are nearly unmatched, seeing things in ways that more opinionated or idealistic men simply refuse to fathom. This doesn’t actually effect your morality in any way, but at any time you can intuit the most brutally effective route to take towards your goals.

elementary_my_dear.name: Elementary My Dear
elementary_my_dear.description: It’s only simple logic after all. Your ability to infer and deduce is positively astounding, and with a little effort it’s not to hard to leave people wondering if you somehow aren’t pulling information out of thin air. If you take A into account, and how it relates to B, then C, D, E, and F are the only rational conclusion. It’s a simple if incredibly useful skill. The only reason they think it’s practically magic is because they just don’t pay attention.

flash_of_brilliance.name: Flash of Brilliance
flash_of_brilliance.description: Sometimes, you just don’t have time to gather the evidence. This perk will immediately let you know a fact or facts that are extremely helpful to your current goals and/or questions. This won’t instantly give you the solution to the problem, instead giving you what you need to figure it out yourself. You can learn up to five facts from this perk per month, and this information will be accurate at the time you receive it

how_on_earth.name: How on Earth
how_on_earth.description: Funny how having someone to explain things to sharpens the mind eh? By asking questions and essentially baiting people into playing the exposition fairy, you give them a large boost to their abilities related to the subject. You always seem to ask just the right questions and in just the right way to give them an epiphany and a monologue about the current mystery will leave them with several new ideas to follow up on.

i_see_everything.name: I See Everything
i_see_everything.description: Surely you didn't miss the slight whiff of perfume in the air? Your mind is constantly watching and cataloging all the little details around you, comparing them to what you know, and storing them away for future reference. This is effectively reflexive for you, requiring no effort on your part to do what most people would need intense scrutiny for in a passing moment. Missing that crucial detail or piece of information is much harder for you now. In addition, you’ll find it very hard to forget a detail you’ve noticed, no matter how minor.

in_the_shadow_of_giants.name: In the Shadow of Giants
in_the_shadow_of_giants.description: It’s truly funny just how easily people write you off as just some bumbling sidekick, of no real importance whatsoever. This perk allows you to casually let attention slide off of you in favor of those you associate with, rendering you more of a footnote in the eyes of others. Opposition will focus their attention on your associates, not registering the threat you pose and the skills you possess. Play your cards right, and take advantage of this, and it very well might be their fatal mistake. Even when not dealing with enemies it might be useful to let others take the spotlight at times. You choose when and where this perk takes effect.

like_a_fish_to_water.name: Like a Fish to Water
like_a_fish_to_water.description: From the back alleys, to the mason’s workshop, to the halls of Buckingham Palace itself, you know it all like the back of your hand, or at least it feels that way. No matter where you go you possess a familiarity with your surroundings and circumstances that normally would only belong to those who’ve been there their entire life. This doesn’t grant you any skills or knowledge that you otherwise wouldn’t possess, but you’ll never be off-balance or confused due to where you are or what you’re doing. Things just seem to click for you.

like_an_open_book.name: Like an Open Book
like_an_open_book.description: he only real difference is that reading a book might take a minute. You have a preternatural awareness and understanding of body language, tells, and social cues. It’s trivial to pick out the various social nuances of those around you, and telling just who would be the perfect mark is as simple as a few moments to scan the room. You’re also a master of the reverse, manipulating your tells and cues to give just the right impression at the right time.

like_minded_fellows.name: Like Minded Fellows
like_minded_fellows.description: ow curious. Seems like no matter where you go you always possess a very accurate hunch on how to find people of a similar mind as yourself. Whether you’re looking to make connections, or need to hunt down some blokes to assist you with a job you had in mind, locating such people seems preternaturally easy. Birds of a feather and all that.

master_of_disguise.name: Master of Disguise
master_of_disguise.description: You are incredible with disguises. Even improvising with what you can find in a hurry tends to be extremely effective, and with actual time to prepare you can fool nearly anybody. You're not perfect, but anybody with any skill in disguise knows that ninety percent of the time people believe what they think they see.

mental_reference.name: Mental Reference
mental_reference.description: Whenever you’d be stymied due to a lack of information, you’ll have bursts of knowledge that fill in the blanks that would otherwise leave you clueless. This knowledge isn’t anything that would be hidden, secret, or unknown, but rather the kind of information that you would find in a highly detailed encyclopedia. Knowing that those tea cups are actually extremely valuable collectibles highly sought after among the upper class of Europe might just be the detail you needed to crack the case after all.

more_than_a_pretty_face.name: More Than a Pretty Face
more_than_a_pretty_face.description: While some might scoff and say that you’re reliant on your looks to get your way, you’re actually rather cunning. Out witting others is a natural talent of yours, and you possess all the social skills and tricks of a professional con-man. While there are people out there who can claim to be smarter than you, you’re certainly almost always the most clever person in the room.

pieces_of_a_puzzle.name: Pieces of a Puzzle
pieces_of_a_puzzle.description: Just like with a puzzle, you just have to be able to see how the clues fit together. In your mind you can arrange all the information you know as a sort of mental mosaic, showing you which details are connected and how, the spaces in between them where you need more information, and even an idea of where to find those missing pieces. To you, it's literally just a puzzle.

the_sherlock_scan.name: The Sherlock Scan
the_sherlock_scan.description: They call you brilliant, amazing, incredible, and they don't even know the half of it. By focusing your mind you can hyper-accelerate and optimize your mental faculties, condensing vast amounts of thought, consideration, and processing into a single instant. In this state your ability to put together details and come to the proper and accurate conclusions is absolutely insane, even by your no doubt high standards. You start out able to use this perk once a day without leaving yourself so mentally drained you need to sleep, although with time and practice you can get better at this. Yes, this includes RDJ style combat, for those of you who are curious.

tidying_up.name: Tidying Up
tidying_up.description: Only a fool would leave a trail that would lead somebody right to their front door. At all times you have an exceptional awareness and intuition regarding anything that could lead others to you, whether that is witnesses or clues. You’re brilliant at figuring out how to remove these loose ends, ensuring that more often then not there won’t be any trail to follow at all.

two_can_play_that_game.name: Two Can Play That Game
two_can_play_that_game.description: Your intellect is fearsome enough on it's own, but when pitted against the brilliant minds of others you are the very definition of dangerous. Whenever you are opposing geniuses, whether of the normal or superhuman variety, your mental abilities are boosted in whatever ways are most suited towards coming out victorious. A brilliant con-woman with a penchant for getting away will find that you're already waiting for her on the train. Impossibly gifted detectives will find that you'd steered them astray, and potentially more. This is a boost to the mental faculties you already possess, and it doesn't automatically scale you up to the level of beings who absolutely dwarf you mentally. But you can be rest assured that your mind will always be a weapon that only the foolish would ignore

wrapped_around_my_finger.name: Wrapped Around My Finger
wrapped_around_my_finger.description: It's always about having just the right context. With interaction you can shift and manipulate the emotional bonds people have with you, either changing their context or amplifying the existing one. Each use of this perk requires a single setting of interaction with the target, but over time you can maneuver their feelings into whatever you find preferable, or simply more useful. Given even a short time frame you'd have people tripping over themselves to fulfill your every wish.

defect.name: Defect
defect.description: You gain the companionship of the Defect - a combat automaton that awoke to self-awareness in the shadow of the Spire, its ancient programming struggling to comprehend balance as it was greeted by the entity Neow. At the peak of the Spire, dying to the Heart, it was offered a choice: death, or service as your companion. It chose you. It retains all its formidable capabilities: its array of channeled Orbs (Lightning, Frost, Plasma, and Darkness), its capacity to evoke or focus their power, and the eerie, logical precision of a mind that was never meant to dream. The Defect retains its free will and may leave your service if it chooses. However, the fiat-backed contract binding it prevents it from ever working against you, ensuring its loyalty never turns to betrayal.

ironclad.name: Ironclad
ironclad.description: You gain the companionship of the Ironclad - the last soldier of a fallen tribe, a warrior who sold his soul to harness demonic energies and now carries the weight of that bargain in every scarred breath. At the peak of the Spire, dying to the Heart, he was offered a choice: death, or service as your companion. He chose you. He retains all his martial prowess: his massive blade, his demon-forged armor, and the burning powers drawn from his cursed pact. He is a master of exhaustion tactics, demonic strength, and relentless combat. The Ironclad retains his free will and may leave your service if he chooses. However, the fiat-backed contract binding him prevents him from ever working against you, ensuring his loyalty never turns to betrayal.

silent.name: Silent
silent.description: You gain the companionship of the Silent - a deadly huntress from the foglands, raised among sisters who place the skulls of their slain foes as ceremonial crowns upon her head. At the peak of the Spire, dying to the Heart, she was offered a choice: death, or service as your companion. She chose you. She retains all her lethal prowess: her twin daggers, her mastery of poisons, her deck of tricks and tactics that erode enemies from within before finishing them in silence. She is a phantom on the battlefield, striking from shadow and leaving only corpses behind. The Silent retains her free will and may leave your service if she chooses. However, the fiat-backed contract binding her prevents her from ever working against you, ensuring her loyalty never turns to betrayal.

watcher.name: Watcher
watcher.description: You gain the companionship of the Watcher - a blind ascetic sent to observe and evaluate the Spire, trained to watch, remember, and live without emotion interfering with her sacred mission. At the peak of the Spire, dying to the Heart, she was offered a choice: death, or service as your companion. She chose you. She retains all her formidable prowess: her mastery of divine stances, and the serene, detached precision of one who has transcended mortal limitations. The Watcher retains her free will and may leave your service if she chooses. However, the fiat-backed contract binding her prevents her from ever working against you, ensuring her loyalty never turns to betrayal.

angler_slime_enclosure.name: Angler Slime Enclosure
angler_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Angler Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Inhabitants of the deepest Slime Sea now found near tidepools, drawn perhaps by the taste of sun-kissed sea hens. Despite their adorable fishy exterior, they are chicken-chomping predators. Their hypnotic lantern-lure creates a powerful radiant flash that stuns chickens and other slimes. Production: They produce Angler Plorts, which maintain form at incredible depths - ideal for deep sea diving technology. Holding one provides oddly encouraging comfort: knowing something so small withstands such pressure may inspire courage to take on the impossible.

batty_slime_enclosure.name: Batty Slime Enclosure
batty_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Batty Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Nocturnal slimes that prefer cold, dark places and will swoop from ceilings, using glowing red eyes to see in the dark. They grow hungrier and eat more frequently in darkness, but sunlight increases their agitation over time. Despite the aesthetic, they are not vampires. They eat fruit and merely dislike garlic. Production: They produce Batty Plorts, ideal for navigation and sonar technology. Each plort emits a perfect "ping" for echolocation, allowing you to navigate even the most devious labyrinths with ease, should you ever find yourself needing to do such a thing.

boom_slime_enclosure.name: Boom Slime Enclosure
boom_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Boom Slimes: volatile creatures whose cells constantly vibrate, crackling with energy until they inevitably explode. Found most frequently in the Indigo Quarry and Moss Blanket, they are heard long before they are seen. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your slime colony: blast-proof enclosure design, explosion timing prediction, and safe harvesting protocols using remote equipment. Behavior: Boom Slimes periodically detonate with considerable force, yet emerge from each explosion completely unscathed - if slightly dazed. Their explosions cause bodily harm to nearby creatures and send all surrounding slimes flying through the air, making them challenging to corral and hazardous to approach without precautions. Production: Their plorts are highly volatile with immense practical value. They power rocket thrusters, enable advanced demolition work, and are prized by military organizations across known space for "medical technology and other research." Their destructive applications are matched only by their energy output.

cotton_slimes_enclosure.name: Cotton Slimes Enclosure
cotton_slimes_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Cotton Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Easily identified by their yellow color and fluffy tails, Cotton Slimes are defined by their incredible leaps. They possess a natural spring that lets them bound far higher than other slimes, often to escape enclosures, reach preferred food (water lettuce), or for reasons known only to them. Ranchers must stay vigilant, as your line of sight will not be enough to reach them. Production: They produce Cotton Plorts, prized for their inexplicably "fluffy" quality. An ideal substitute for non-native terrestrial cotton, they ensure an endless supply for soft pillows, warm sweaters, and dry socks, should you desire a quiet, comfortable life.

crystal_slime_enclosure.name: Crystal Slime Enclosure
crystal_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Crystal Slimes - shimmering cousins of the Rock Slime, crowned with crystalline spikes formed by generating tremendous internal heat that warps surrounding minerals. They are found naturally in the Indigo Quarry. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your slime colony: heat management protocols, crystal patch dispersion techniques, and safe harvesting practices using water applications. Behavior: Crystal Slimes routinely create large patches of ultra-hot, dangerous crystals in their environment as a means of expelling internal heat. These crystal patches persist for roughly a minute and can be shattered with water. Their crystalline crowns cause significant harm on contact. Production: Their plorts enable slime scientists to engineer entirely transparent metals of tremendous strength. This innovation has transformed metropolitan architecture across countless worlds, allowing light to reach streets while maintaining structural integrity - described by architects as "so totally cooler than normal, boring metals."

dervish_slime_enclosure.name: Dervish Slime Enclosure
dervish_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Dervish Slimes, swirling bundles of kinetic energy found in the Glass Desert. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including how to manage their turbulent tendencies. Behavior: Dervish Slimes constantly ride atop small whirlwinds, moving at high speeds and collecting objects in their path. When highly agitated, they generate massive cyclones that vacuum up and toss anything nearby. These storms can cause total ranch chaos if not anticipated and soothed. Production: They produce Dervish Plorts, a fantastic source of clean energy that gives turbines and generators an extra boost. The plorts are in constant demand, as each contains a finite number of spins - once those spins are expended, the plort becomes inert.

fire_slime_enclosure.name: Fire Slime Enclosure
fire_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Fire Slimes, rare ash-dwelling slimes that appear during solar anomalies. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including ash management and safety protocols. Behavior: Fire Slimes require a bed of ash to survive. They will quickly "snuff out" if left on any other surface. Their naturally burning state makes them poor companions for other slimes, as their fiery touch sends nearby slimes flying. A splash of fresh water can temporarily extinguish them for safe handling. Production: They produce Fire Plorts, used in the developing world on Earth to keep stoves and fireplaces burning. While a rancher won't get rich selling them, each plort helps provide warm hands and hot food to millions who would otherwise lack such luxuries. A small, noble return for a dangerous endeavor.

flutter_slime_enclosure.name: Flutter Slime Enclosure
flutter_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Flutter Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Aesthetically stunning slimes with powerful flight capabilities and innate curiosity, causing them to fly towards any nearby object or creature. They possess a restrictive diet, consuming only moondew nectar. A well-fed Flutter Slime rewards you with a soothing, sparkling aura that reduces agitation in all nearby slimes. Production: They produce Flutter Plorts, which possess a near-imperceptible weightlessness. Holding enough allows you to float just enough to slip a coin beneath your feet - a tiny but profound escape from the weight of the world.

gold_slime_enclosure.name: Gold Slime Enclosure
gold_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Gold Slimes, the rarest and most valuable species on the Far, Far Range. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, though their care remains inherently challenging. Behavior: Gold Slimes are notoriously difficult to manage: they are quick as a flash and instinctively flee from ranchers on sight. They produce no direct risks, but their appearance often induces panic, leading to costly mistakes. To obtain plorts, you must strike them with any spare resource, which also scatters additional items across the area, creating unintended Largos and chaos. Production: They produce Gold Plorts, the most valuable of all plorts. They have little practical use; they are prized simply for being impossibly shiny and rare. On Earth, the elite adorn themselves in jewelry made from them, with values far exceeding any terrestrial precious metal.

honey_slime_enclosure.name: Honey Slime Enclosure
honey_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure filled with a few dozens golden-brown Honey Slimes. You also receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your slime colony. Behavior: Docile and odorless, but their plorts are hyper-sweet and intensely fragrant to other slimes. You must manage your enclosure carefully: if other slimes catch the scent, they will stop at nothing to break in and create dangerous "Largo" hybrids. Production: They produce Honey Plorts, which score an 867 on the saccharine scale. Highly prized by food manufacturers, they can be sold for a considerable profit or refined into a sweetener so potent it borders on "not fit for human consumption."

hunter_slime_enclosure.name: Hunter Slime Enclosure
hunter_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens of Hunter Slimes, the elusive wild cousins of the Tabby Slime. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including diet management and handling their unique temperament. Behavior: Pure Hunter Slimes are docile but possess a natural cloaking ability, rendering them almost invisible: only their giant, almond eyes give them away. However, any Largo created from their plorts is born feral and must be carefully tamed with offerings of chickens, lest they revert to a wild state when agitated. Production: They produce Hunter Plorts. When refined, these plorts create a serum that renders the user completely invisible for approximately 24 hours. The serum is popular among those who wish to disappear for a while. Though users often find that while invisibility is soothing, being unseen by others can be unexpectedly lonely.

mosaic_slime_enclosure.name: Mosaic Slime Enclosure
mosaic_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Mosaic Slimes, beautiful but dangerous slimes covered in glittering glass tiles. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including managing their solar anomalies. Behavior: Their shimmering glass tiles attract other slimes. Leading theories suggest simply that "sparkly things are super cool." When agitated, Mosaic Slimes generate ultra-hot solar "glints" that drift through the air before bursting into flames. These can be snuffed with water, but a well-fed slime produces far fewer. Production: They produce Mosaic Plorts, desired for researching the Glass Desert's mysterious structures. Unlike native glass samples, Mosaic Plorts remain stable outside the Far, Far Range. Scientists insist they are studying the plorts because they are "really pretty," and absolutely not because of their potential to cause devastating solar anomalies.

phosphor_slime_enclosure.name: Phosphor Slime Enclosure
phosphor_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Phosphor Slimes - nocturnal, violet-hued creatures with translucent wings and a softly pulsing, luminescent core. They emerge only under moonlit skies, their gentle glow earning them the name "low stars" among ranchers. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony: light-proofing enclosures, nocturnal feeding schedules, and safe harvesting practices. Behavior: True to their nocturnal nature, Phosphor Slimes and their plorts vanish instantly if exposed to direct sunlight. They require perpetual darkness (a cave, a sealed enclosure, or careful vacuuming before dawn) to thrive. They are docile fliers, drifting gracefully through the air. Production: Their plorts contain a luminescent compound that produces light for over a century, making them the most eco-friendly illumination source known. Cities across countless worlds have converted to phosphor lighting, saving trillions of gigawatts daily. Additionally, rubbing phosphor plort dust into hair creates a spectacular, long-lasting glow that remains fashionable across cultures.

pink_slime_enclosure.name: Pink Slime Enclosure
pink_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Pink Slimes - the most common and cheerful inhabitants of the Far, Far Range. These docile, squishy creatures are easily identified by their pink coloration and perpetually happy demeanor. You receive basic skills and knowledge for caring for your colony: feeding schedules, enclosure maintenance, and plort harvesting. Biology: Pink Slimes are omnivorous, capable of eating all three main food types (Fruit, Meat, and Veggies), making them exceptionally easy to maintain. They have no favorite food and display no negative behaviors when agitated - they simply bounce happily through life. Production: Their plorts (crystalline excretions) have the lowest monetary value of all slime varieties but possess remarkable versatility. Pink Plorts serve as a "multipurpose generic substance" used in manufacturing everything from food products to household cleaners across entire star systems.

puddle_slime_enclosure.name: Puddle Slime Enclosure
puddle_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated pond enclosure containing a few dozen Puddle Slimes: rare aquatic creatures that float serenely on fresh water surfaces. Unlike most slimes, they absorb water directly into their bodies rather than eating fruits, veggies, or meat. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your slime colony: water quality management, population density monitoring, and gentle harvesting techniques that respect their shy nature. Behavior: Puddle Slimes require fresh water to survive and will evaporate completely if left on dry land too long. They are exceptionally shy, refusing to produce plorts if more than three other slimes are nearby. Their delicate nature makes them better suited for experienced caretakers - they are not for those still "wet behind the ears." Production: Their plorts contain H2Ohhhhh - an incredible hydro compound sought by galactic elites. Processed into absurdly expensive bottled water, it is prized by those with refined palates who "seriously get it," despite skeptics who claim it tastes like tap water.

quantum_slime_enclosure.name: Quantum Slime Enclosure
quantum_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Quantum Slimes: reality-warping slimes from the Ancient Ruins. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including how to manage their unique spatial anomalies. Behavior: Quantum Slimes constantly emit "ghosts" - projections of themselves from alternate realities. When agitated, they will align with a ghost's reality and teleport to its location, making containment exceptionally difficult. A vigilant rancher must learn to spot when they are primed to shift and quickly intervene with food or water to stabilize them. Production: They produce Quantum Plorts, believed by researchers to hold the secret to infinite resources. The theory suggests that unlocking their potential would allow for the cloning of any object (energy, chickens, or otherwise) by converging alternate realities into our own. Scientists assure the public there are probably no harmful side effects.

quicksilver_slime_enclosure.name: Quicksilver Slime Enclosure
quicksilver_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a specialized, semi-automated racetrack enclosure, containing a dozen Quicksilver Slimes. These slimes cannot be vacuumed or caged conventionally - they must be managed through speed and precision. You receive the skills to maintain their unique habitat and feeding requirements. Quicksilver Slimes are lightning-fast creatures that feed on electricity, accumulating static charge through constant movement. They are not normally harmful, but when overcharged (such as through direct feeding) their current becomes dangerous. A mob of well-fed Quicksilvers can leave an careless rancher thoroughly zapped.

rad_slime_enclosure.name: Rad Slime Enclosure
rad_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Rad Slimes - glowing green globs of gamma goo that emit a potent radioactive aura. Found exclusively in the Indigo Quarry, these "raddies" pulse with enough energy to illuminate darkness. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your slime colony: radiation shielding protocols, exposure monitoring systems, and safe remote harvesting techniques. Behavior: Rad Slimes do not attack directly, but their radioactive aura causes cumulative harm to anyone remaining within it too long. Extended exposure induces rad poisoning, serious bodily harm or worse. They glow constantly from their internal radiation, whether naturally occurring or environment-derived remains unknown. Production: Their plorts are essentially mobile batteries of incredible energy-producing capability. Corporations across known space process them into "plortonium," which powers everything from the latest holophones to radwave microcook systems. Rad plorts represent clean, portable energy at its most versatile.

ringtail_slime_enclosure.name: Ringtail Slime Enclosure
ringtail_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Ringtail Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Omnivorous troublemakers who commit moonlight theft as a hobby. Sunlight transforms them into stone - whether this is an ancient curse or not, they're certainly the type. Once they start eating, they never stop; a single Ringtail can wipe out an entire farm, and they stop producing plorts when full. Watch for their mischievous expression. Production: They produce Ringtail Plorts, which are extremely resilient and harden when exposed to UV rays. Highly malleable like Pink Plorts, they can be crafted into anything from sturdy shelter on a faraway island to family photos that survive a scorching desert trek.

rock_slime_enclosure.name: Rock Slime Enclosure
rock_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Rock Slimes: sturdy, mineral-crowned creatures distinguished by the sharp spikes atop their slimy bodies. Second only to Pink Slimes in commonality, these vegetarians prefer the satisfying crunch of heart beets above all other foods. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony: feeding schedules, spike-trimming, and safe harvesting practices. Behavior: Rock Slimes are generally docile but demand respect. Their rocky crowns can pierce through boots on contact, and when agitated, they curl into spiked balls and roll in straight lines. A tumbling Rock Slime is best avoided entirely. Production: Their plorts are prized throughout known space as the key component in "blue metal" - an astonishing alloy stronger than titanium yet lighter than plastic. Blue metal forms the hulls of light-speed starships, synthetic appendages, and even protective cases for delicate technology.

saber_slime_enclosure.name: Saber Slime Enclosure
saber_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Saber Slime Largos, living relics from the Jellassic Period of the Far, Far Range. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including handling their feral instincts. Behavior: Though pure Sabers are extinct, these Largos retain their fierce predator lineage. They are carnivorous, incredibly agile, and capable of powerful jumps that let them bound off surfaces to flank prey. Most are born feral and require careful taming - an agitated Saber Largo will actively hunt anything in sight. Production: They produce Saber Plorts, collected for their historical value and ancient slime DNA. Scientists have tried (and failed) to extract viable genetic material to resurrect the species. Most agree this is for the best, as success would inevitably lead to someone building a theme park, with predictable consequences.

tabby_slime_enclosure.name: Tabby Slime Enclosure
tabby_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Tabby Slimes: adorable, cat-like creatures with perky ears, striped backs, and swaying tails. Made entirely of gooey slime yet unmistakably feline in behavior, they are among the most common slimes on the Range and strict carnivores requiring meat. You receive basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony: feeding schedules, enrichment activities to discourage thievery, and safe harvesting practices. Behavior: Tabby Slimes mean no harm but cause endless chaos. Like their Earth cat cousins, they love to steal things they don't eat (fruits, veggies, shiny objects) often hiding them in inconvenient places. This hoarding tendency frequently leads to unintended largo transformations if they get into other plorts. Production: Their plorts are a key ingredient in performance-enhancing products, granting consumers a surge of tabby energy and exuberance. Athletes across the galaxy prize them for competitive edge, though prolonged use results in "uncontrollable butt wiggles" - a less desirable but harmless side effect.

tangle_slime_enclosure.name: Tangle Slime Enclosure
tangle_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozens Tangle Slimes, deceptively innocent-looking slimes with flowers atop their heads. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony, including managing their predatory instincts. Behavior: Despite their cheerful appearance, Tangle Slimes are fearsome predators with a big appetite for meat. They can send vines underground to snatch food (or plorts) from outside their enclosure. When agitated, the flowers on their heads release a noxious pollen cloud that causes nearby slimes to sneeze violently, rapidly increasing agitation across your entire ranch. Production: They produce Tangle Plorts, which have incredibly beneficial agricultural applications. Fertilizers and growth formulas made from them are used by farms across Earth to greatly enhance crop production, thanks to the plorts' unusually high nutrient count.

twin_slime_enclosure.name: Twin Slime Enclosure
twin_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Twin Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: A bizarre byproduct of the Prismacore's effects: two slimes occupying the same space at different intervals, shifting between cerulean blue and pink. They create reality-defying portals that snag things from the environment and drop them elsewhere, sometimes for food, sometimes for mischief. Unclear which half is more troublemaking. Production: They produce Twin Plorts - two plorts occupying the same space in opposing polarities. Inherently unstable: in construction, they'd generate both the strongest and weakest substance simultaneously. On the market, they're simultaneously the most valuable and so undervalued selling costs you money. Averages out to standard value.

yolky_slime_enclosure.name: Yolky Slime Enclosure
yolky_slime_enclosure.description: You gain a small, semi-automated enclosure containing a few dozen Yolky Slimes. You receive the basic skills and knowledge for maintaining your colony. Behavior: Strange, elusive slimes found near wild chickens, harboring an enduring love for them rather than predatory intent. Their glowing golden affection inspires nearby hens to occasionally produce giant eggs containing five Chickadoos and, when fresh (indicated by glowing yolk), Yolky Plorts. Eggs spoil after three hours. Requires uncrowded chickens capable of reproduction. Production: They produce Yolky Plorts, highly valued for concentrated nutrients containing potent vitamin D. Allows reduction of sunlight intake for long periods: popular with cosmic pioneers, deep sea explorers, and gamers. Though they replace physical need for sunlight, they cannot replace its warmth, or the hope found in its rising.

artisan_goods.name: Artisan Goods
artisan_goods.description: You gain extreme talent and above-average skill in creating various artisan goods inspired by Stardew Valley, along with the knowledge to create all the tools and goods you need. You also have a supernatural edge when crafting items similar to Stardew Valley artisan goods. The supernatural advantage is toggleable.

bag_of_amaranth_seeds.name: Bag of Amaranth Seeds

You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to this Amaranth plant, it starts to grow abnormally fast (maximum speed of 7 days to fully grow in perfect conditions). It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest Amaranth every week. It is a fall crop - its supernatural effect is most effective in autumn. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

Animals from this perk are unusually obedient to you, and when someone actively takes care of them, they become supernaturally productive. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

rabbit_coop.name: Rabbit Coop
rabbit_coop.description: These are wooly rabbits! They shed precious wool every few days. Lives in the coop. This perk provides a coop full of rabbits. You can delay releasing this into the world for as long as you want. Animals from this perk are unusually obedient to you, and when someone actively takes care of them, they become supernaturally productive. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

sheep_barn.name: Sheep Barn
sheep_barn.description: This perk provides a barn full of sheep. You can delay releasing this into the world for as long as you want. Animals from this perk are unusually obedient to you, and when someone actively takes care of them, they become supernaturally productive. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

void_chicken_coop.name: Void Chicken Coop
void_chicken_coop.description: Well cared-for adult chickens lay eggs every day. Lives in the coop. This perk provides a coop full of void chickens variant from Stardew Valley. You can delay releasing this into the world for as long as you want. Animals from this perk are unusually obedient to you, and when someone actively takes care of them, they become supernaturally productive. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

wild_fall_seeds.name: Wild Fall Seeds
wild_fall_seeds.description: An assortment of wild fall seeds. You gain a full bag of Fall seeds of random quality from the Stardew Valley game. You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to plants grown from this assortment of seeds, they start to grow abnormally fast. It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest these too often. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

wild_spring_seeds.name: Wild Spring Seeds
wild_spring_seeds.description: An assortment of wild spring seeds. You gain a full bag of Spring seeds of random quality from the Stardew Valley game. You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to plants grown from this assortment of seeds, they start to grow abnormally fast. It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest these too often. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

wild_summer_seeds.name: Wild Summer Seeds
wild_summer_seeds.description: An assortment of wild summer seeds. You gain a full bag of Summer seeds of random quality from the Stardew Valley game. You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to plants grown from this assortment of seeds, they start to grow abnormally fast. It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest these too often. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

wild_winter_seed.name: Wild Winter Seed
wild_winter_seed.description: An assortment of wild winter seeds. You gain a full bag of Winter seeds of random quality from the Stardew Valley game. You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to plants grown from this assortment of seeds, they start to grow abnormally fast. It still exhausts the soil just as much as normal plants do. So it's probably a bad idea to harvest these too often. This perk can be purchased multiple times.

blood_sweat_and_tears.name: Blood, Sweat and Tears
blood_sweat_and_tears.description: When crafting an item, you may use parts of your body of the same sort of form as needed for a resource as a substitute. Metal might call for bone, meshes might call for skin, wires hair, etc.

botanical_solution.name: Botanical Solution
botanical_solution.description: You can create "material seeds" from nothing. A given seed is keyed to a specific material of your choice, and will grow into some sort of plant which produces that material if cared for correctly. The time needed and difficulty of care will depend on how rare the material is in its original universe, but it will always be possible to successfully grow it somewhere within the universe you're currently in.

bypass.name: Bypass
bypass.description: You may create tech without materials it requires, simply not adding anything within that stage, and it will continue to function as if the necessary components were added. However, if used by anyone other than you, or examined such that it'd be obvious components are missing by someone other than you, it will begin acting as it would normally: as a piece of tech without the components you chose to bypass. You may choose to have an object begin acting normally at will, as well, but that cannot be undone.

item_drops.name: Item Drops
item_drops.description: Whenever you knock out or kill another animate being in a fight, they'll drop an item or items. The items will be thematically linked to them, and be more valuable the more powerful the being was. You may toggle this off if you wish.

production_line.name: Production Line
production_line.description: For every form of resource which cannot be found on your current world, you know of multiple ways to create a duplicate of it using what does exist in your current world. Depending on rarity of the original material this can be quite difficult, but there will always be a method.

punk_tactics.name: Punk Tactics
punk_tactics.description: Choose a category of "punk", such as solarpunk, steampunk, or clockpunk. The techbases you chose are all altered to fall under this chosen category, altering the way they function and are built to better suit it. A steampunk blaster would still fire lasers, but do so through various exchanges of boiled water, while a clockpunk one would require gears and mechanisms for the same. As a result of this change, any specialty materials your chosen techbases call for which falls outside of the punk type you picked are reworked to better fit the theme. Rare energy-storing crystals would not be needed to power the laser blaster, but particularly high-temperature steam or increasingly precise gearwork would be needed in its place.

replicator.name: Replicator
replicator.description: You have access to a replicator situated in a pocket dimension you may open at will. The replicator's main function is to intake matter, and output different matter as requested. Starting out it is extremely low quality, highly inefficient, and hard to operate. It can, however, be upgraded and improved with work, and the pocket dimension will always be big enough to contain it, no matter how much you expand it.

resource_bar.name: [Resource] Bar
resource_bar.description: You can convert any resource you have into [Resource], a special substance which can function as any material in sufficient quantities. You may freely convert [Resource] into any material, however the more difficult to acquire the material is, the more [Resource] it costs (and the more it would give if converted). Additionally, [Resource] conversions operate at half efficiency overall, meaning it requires twice as much of a material converted into [Resource] to produce an equal amount through conversion. All [Resource] is stored in hyperdimensional storage within yourself, which has no limit to how much you can have on hand at a time.

tech_base_eclipse_phase.name: Tech Base: Eclipse Phase
tech_base_eclipse_phase.description: Unless otherwise mentioned, selecting the base option provides entry-level understanding of the world's entire tech base, while the sub-options provide advanced understanding within their listed field. Can be purchased multiple times, until all sub-options obtained. Taking place in the Accelerated Future after The Fall, Eclipse Phase is a game of Transhuman conspiracy and horror. Spurred on by a slow-burn Singularity and their own recent near extinction, Transhumanity has created incredibly technological wonders that might seem like magic to a modern human. This option specifically refers to Transhumanity's understanding of science and technology. >Argonaut (+200 CP) - Technology related to habitat construction, reactor design, spaceships, and general infrastructure. Includes wireless power transmission, fusion reactor design, anti-matter factories, and seed ships. >Armourer (+200 CP) - Infantry-scale technology and equipment, particularly armor and weapons like plasma rifles and portable automatic railguns. >Programming (+200 CP) - Coding technology, sufficient for AI, seed intelligences, and expert systems, as well as the technology used to create the 3D optical processors and quantum computers running them. Additionally includes Basilisk Hacks understood by Transhumanity. >Transhumanities (+200 CP) - Technology related to medicine and augmentations, such as Cortical Stacks, Biomods, and Cyberbrains; it further includes technology necessary to support them, such as Ego Bridges and stasis vats. Finally, it provides information on esoteric processes like MeatHab, Psychosurgery, xenobiology, and Uplifts.

tech_base_fallout.name: Tech Base: Fallout
tech_base_fallout.description: Unless otherwise mentioned, selecting the base option provides entry-level understanding of the world's entire tech base, while the sub-options provide advanced understanding within their listed field. Can be purchased multiple times, until all sub-options obtained. Fallout is a post-apocalyptic world, where tech is either remnants of a lost age or what can be scrounged together despite the wasteland's scarcity. Those remnants that remain, however, are often quite powerful. Sub-options: >Medicine (+150 CP) - Knowledge of biology, surgery, and the proper application of various pharmaceuticals, both in regards to standard humans and in regards to mutants. Also includes knowledge of medical psychology, although to a lesser degree. This includes FEV, medical technology, and cloning. >Repair (+150 CP) - Mechanical knowledge, engineering, and methods for efficient recycling or repair, as well as ways to make new things from what you scavenge. This includes power armor, weaponry, vertibirds, and robotics. >Science (+150 CP) - Esoteric knowledge of high-concept science, such as chemistry, physics, and thermodynamics, as well as how to apply those things to devices you design. This includes mini nukes, energy weapons, microfusion cells, and fusion cells. >Survival (+150 CP) - Knowledge of the wilderness in various environments, how to survive within said environments, behavior of animals and important plants, and how to cook said animals and plants. Further includes pipe weaponry, scrap armor, and settlement building. >Computer Whiz (+150 CP) - You gain knowledge of computer systems and code. You know how to program and how to properly apply this in practical applications. This includes the platinum chip, pip-boys, AI, and operating systems.

tech_base_shadowrun.name: Tech Base: Shadowrun
tech_base_shadowrun.description: Unless otherwise mentioned, selecting the base option provides entry-level understanding of the world's entire tech base, while the sub-options provide advanced understanding within their listed field. Can be purchased multiple times, until all sub-options obtained. Shadowrun would be a stereotypical cyberpunk setting, but the appearance of magic in 2012 disrupted that somewhat. It still maintains many of the trappings and, more importantly, tech developments, however. Sub-options: >Street Samurai (+100 CP) - Tech related to personal weapons, armors, and combat-oriented cyberware and bioware. Comes with tech relevant to personal infiltration as well. >Decker (+100 CP)- The Matrix is Shadowrun's name for the internet, advanced to the point "internet" is no longer a sufficient term. This option contains tech pertaining to the Matrix: how to create it, maintain it, utilize it, and sabotage it, as well as systems like it or related to it. Includes relevant cyberware and bioware. >Rigger (+100 CP) - Tech centered around vehicles, drones and robots, both in and of themselves and technology designed to control, repair, or subvert them. Connected cyberware and bioware is included, as is tactical weapons that don't fall under Street Samurai.

tech_base_star_trek.name: Tech Base: Star Trek
tech_base_star_trek.description: Unless otherwise mentioned, selecting the base option provides entry-level understanding of the world's entire tech base, while the sub-options provide advanced understanding within their listed field. Can be purchased multiple times, until all sub-options obtained. Star Trek's tech base is one from a post-scarcity society, whose tech has solved so many societal problems that the only way to find adventure is to venture out into deep space, where no man has gone before. Sub-options: >Travel (+250 CP) - Technology based on travel, such as the transporters capable of full-blown teleportation, or the spaceships capable of easy lightspeed travel. >Battle (+250 CP) - Technology designed for combat, such as the phasers able to disintegrate matter at their highest settings, or cloaking devices able to hide entire spaceships from most forms of scanner detection. >Information (+250 CP) - Technology for information gathering and processing, from powerful full-range scanners such as the tricorder, to the computers needed to parse all of the data an entire spaceship's scanner array collects. >Luxury (+250 CP) - Technology for convenience and luxury, such as the replicator able to duplicate nearly anything it has a blueprint for, or the holodeck able to simulate nearly any situation using hardlight.

tech_base_sufficiently_advanced.name: Tech Base: Sufficiently Advanced
tech_base_sufficiently_advanced.description: Unless otherwise mentioned, selecting the base option provides entry-level understanding of the world's entire tech base, while the sub-options provide advanced understanding within their listed field. Can be purchased multiple times, until all sub-options obtained. Sufficiently Advanced is a setting which has 6 different technological disciplines with 6 levels of technology within those disciplines. At their highest level, all 6 types are capable of the sorts of things that would be within the realms of magic in many other settings. Sub-options: >Biotech (+250 CP) - Technology designed to manipulate, alter, and otherwise affect living things. Examples include medically-induced biofeedback, or biosensors which can non-invasively detect medical problems overnight. >Cognitech (+250 CP) - Technology based on computation and intelligence, both artificial and natural. Examples include computers the size of a finger which outclass modern tech easily, or implants which can allow the user to intentionally forget things they wish to. >Metatech (+250 CP) - Technology based on social sciences, on affecting society in all its forms. Examples include techniques to understand basic communication through language and cultural barriers, or methods of conducting body language which massively amplify its effects. >Nanotech (+250 CP) - Nanotechnology as a whole, especially as it relates to material sciences. Examples include swift-expanding foam able to seal leaks or contain people, or methods of providing invisibility or inaudibility through nanobot interference. >Stringtech (+250 CP) - Technology based on String Theory, designed to manipulate energies and particles. Examples include straightforward laser weaponry, or generators which convert energy to different types. >Chronotech (+250 CP) - Technology based on time, particularly in regards to getting information from the future. Examples include tech to predict the content of conversations and thus skip them in real time, or armor which prepares countermeasures for attacks that will happen.

the_most_dangerous_game.name: The Most Dangerous Game
the_most_dangerous_game.description: You may summon monsters made of any material you desire, with them simply popping into existence near you. They'll be hostile to you and your allies by default, but their intelligence, physique, and abilities will depend on what material they're made of. Rarer and more powerful materials will produce stronger monsters, and the monster's capabilities will line up thematically with the nature of the material. You may decide how big the monster is when you summon it.

tinkertechnician.name: Tinkertechnician
tinkertechnician.description: You are a Tinker, of an unusual sort. You may, at will, go into a fugue state where you have control over what you build, but not how. You will automatically circumvent material issues by substituting with what you have available when necessary, and the finished product will be of a higher quality than would be normally possible with your current available tools. However, anything made this way will break down far faster than normal, and does not follow real scientific principles, meaning it cannot be easily reverse engineered or replicated. You may choose if your Tinker ability is Shard-based or not.

gene_bank.name: Gene Bank
gene_bank.description: The preserved sample and data bank containing a perfect 100% copy of the DNA of all creatures or plants found on earth, with all the variations for diversity and avoiding genetic decay, along with the facilities to clone and create them to be released into the wild, this includes microscopic life.

innate_ecologist.name: Innate Ecologist
innate_ecologist.description: A 10-year course to be a professional ecologist was downloaded straight into your brain, along an inner sense so sharp that you detect the percentages of a region pollution, along with temperature, humidity and all the factors you saw in game.

replicator_drones.name: Replicator Drones
replicator_drones.description: Drones with fabrication functions installed, smart and durable, powered by small, almost handheld a solar station to function for an entire day, these eight little drones will use the available resources gifted to them to build whatever device you give the blueprint, comes with scanner and computer to download new models. Already have the instructions for all the machines found written in TERRA NIL.

resources.name: Resources
resources.description: Copper, zinc, steel… all the recyclable materials to build your needed machines, is the equivalent of 3000 points in the game. Can be bought multiple time, and regenerate every jump, or every year.

terra_nil.name: TERRA NIL
terra_nil.description: A Handmade book, written with love for nature and the hope of a better world, everything you might need for this mission is here. comes with a detachable and repurposes able gyrocopter.

source_the_binding_of_isaac.description: Perks from The Binding of Isaac.

a_dollar.name: A Dollar
a_dollar.description: "$$$" - This perk gives you 100 Pennies. In this case, Pennies are imaginary and immaterial unspecified currency, which you can materialize into actual money at any moment. It works only one way - Pennies into material currency, but be sure - now you have some sizable sum in your metaphorical (and soon literal) pocket!

a_pony.name: A Pony
a_pony.description: "Flight + Dash Attack." - This stick horse grants the ability to fly and passively increases your speed. When activated, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, gaining a degree of invulnerability during the dash and dealing damage to enemies in your path. The active ability has a cooldown. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

anarchist_cookbook.name: Anarchist Cookbook
anarchist_cookbook.description: "Summon bombs." - This is an actual Anarchist Cookbook and can be read like any normal text. It is more in-depth and factual than a standard copy, and provides a slight passive boost to learning and using the knowledge contained within. Its active effect spawns seven primed explosive devices of reasonable power at random points nearby, which detonate after a few seconds. The book has a cooldown and grants the wielder general knowledge of its effects and usage upon equipping it.

best_friend.name: Best Friend
best_friend.description: "Friends 'till the end." - This small doll, when activated, spawns a decoy that explodes after five seconds. Enemies are attracted to the decoy and lose track of the user. The effect has a cooldown. The decoy resembles a person lying on the ground, but can take on different appearances and illusory details to better draw enemies' attention.

blood_rights.name: Blood Rights
blood_rights.description: "Mass Enemy Damage at a Cost." - You gain a straight razor artifact with special properties, along with basic knowledge of how to use it. When you cut yourself with this razor (an action that deals consistent damage but causes no bleeding) it inflicts burst of damage on everyone you perceive as an enemy in your immediate vicinity, primarily in the form of internal trauma and spontaneous cuts. Used on others, the razor is simply an exceptionally durable and always-sharp blade. The main effect has a cooldown, and the razor provides feedback to its current user about when it can be used again.

bloody_gust.name: Bloody Gust
bloody_gust.description: “May your rage bring haste.” - Each time you take damage in combat, your speed and agility receive a temporary boost. This effect can stack up to six stages, increasing with each hit. The boost decays rapidly once you are no longer fighting.

book_of_revelations.name: Book of Revelations
book_of_revelations.description: "Reusable soul protection." - This item, upon use, grants one soul heart. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts. There is a small chance of encountering the Harbinger boss attacking you shortly after using the book. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a relatively long cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

book_of_shadows.name: Book of Shadows
book_of_shadows.description: "Temporary invincibility." - This item creates a protective shield, nullifying almost all types of damage for 10 seconds upon activation. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.description: "Blood laser barrage." - This perk lets you shoot blood laser beam from your mouth that pierces through enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period. This perk can be purchased twice to get upgraded version.

candy_heart.name: Candy Heart
candy_heart.description: "Power of Love." This perk grants you incremental upgrades to a few randomly chosen physical stats after healing from wounds. It only works if the healed wound was severe enough and the healing process was fast enough (like regeneration). The upgrades are tiny but permanent.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: "Outbreak!" - The first enemy killed in a battle releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies in small radius. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect. This gas is not permanent, existing only for a short moment.

cracked_orb.name: Cracked Orb
cracked_orb.description: “Shards of Knowledge”. - Each time you take damage exceeding a certain threshold, you gain one of the following boons: useful insight about your surroundings; the opening of nearby closed or blocked passages; or useful items from the surrounding area being uncovered and brought to your attention. The effect is mostly random, but is influenced by your environment and current situation.

dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
dead_eye.description: "Accuracy Bbrings power!" - This perk increases damage each time an enemy is hit by your attack. The damage bonus resets when you miss a shot. This effect has a certain bonus limit and does not work for some types of attacks (like lasers). You can toggle the effect on and off.

empty_heart.name: Empty Heart
empty_heart.description: “It multiplies”. - This perk allows you to fully recover from grievous injuries and any negative side effects of wounds or ailments once your health drops below a certain threshold. The healing occurs at your normal recovery speed. For example, it could mend a poorly healed bone fracture, though minor scars or traces may remain. It may even restore a lost eye (fully or partially) depending on your current state of health. With each full recovery, you grow a little hardier, capable of surviving greater trauma before succumbing to your wounds.

epiphora.name: Epiphora
epiphora.description: "Intensifying tears." - Shooting in one direction increases your rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as you change direction or stop shooting, the rate of fire resets to its normal amount. The effectiveness of the effect depends on the type of attack used. You can toggle this ability.

forget_me_now.name: Forget Me Now
forget_me_now.description: "I don't remember..." - This perk grants you a special pill that allows you to "reset" your day once. Immediately after taking it, you travel back 24 hours. You retain all items on your person, your memories, and your other perks, as well as your current physical state. For example, if you are wounded at the moment of activation, you will remain wounded after the reset. This perk may be purchased multiple times. Note that traveling back does not guarantee events will unfold the same way. The perk itself provides general knowledge of the pill's effect to you.

glowing_hourglass.name: Glowing Hourglass
glowing_hourglass.description: "Turn back time." - Upon active use, this item rewinds time to the last major branching point in your timeline - a moment where small choices can lead to significant changes. This typically sends you back a few minutes, but can sometimes rewind up to an hour or even a full day. Only your mind travels back; your body, items, and surroundings remain as they were. The hourglass holds three charges and can be used three times. Repeated use cannot take you further back than 24 hours from the moment of the previous activation, meaning you cannot rewind twice in quick succession to exceed that limit. The only way to recharge it is to purchase this perk again (at half price - 400 CP), though the hourglass can never store more than three charges. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

guppys_collar.name: Guppy's Collar
guppys_collar.description: "Eternal life?" - This perk grants a permanent 50% chance to respawn with a highly diminished state of health after death. You are not wounded after respawning, just fragile.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: "Holy death shot." -This perk allows you to either: add a chance to fire a 'holy shot' - a modification of your ranged attack that creates a damaging light beam in the area if it hits an enemy; or apply this effect to your attack intentionally, but with a specific cooldown between each application. You can toggle the effect of this perk, or even turn it off.

holy_mantle.name: Holy Mantle
holy_mantle.description: "Holy shield." - This perk grants an invisible shield/barrier that negates the first instance of damage taken. It takes some time to recharge and cooldown is lower when outside immediate danger or battle. It works against most types of damage, but not all of them.

incubus.name: Incubus
incubus.description: "Dark Friend." - This perk allows you to spawn and dismiss a demonic familiar that floats nearby you and shoots ranged attacks identical to your current ones in terms of damage, rate of fire and special effects. For example, if you are using a Tommy gun with tungsten bullets, the Incubus will mimic this ranged attack.

keepers_sack.name: Keeper's Sack
keepers_sack.description: "Balls." - Each time you purchase something from a willing trader, you receive a random permanent physical stat upgrade proportional to your spending. The effect works best for large, one-time, in-person expenditures where actual goods are exchanged and the sum spent is significant enough to trigger it. The perk is highly particular about what qualifies as a "purchase" and cannot be easily cheated.

monstrance.name: Monstrance
monstrance.description: "Purifying light." - This perk gives you the ability to turn on an aura, which deals damage to enemies inside it. The closer they are, the more damage is dealt. Effect looks like a brightened area around you and a dim light. It is not perfect at telling apart enemies from friends and can be deceived. It deals damage in a form of sunburns.

petrified_poop.name: Petrified Poop
petrified_poop.description: One man's filth is another man's fortune. You have a small, reliable chance (~10%) of finding something useful when you interact with genuinely repulsive organic waste - from latrines and gutters to compost heaps and morgue sluices. Whether it's a few coins, a medicinal herb, or a preserved ritual scroll used as a rag, the find is never powerful, but can be a lifeline in desperate situations. This perk only functions with waste that has been truly discarded.

pjs.name: PJs
pjs.description: "You feel cozy." - This perk grants you 4 'soul hearts' and fully restores your health. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts.

playdough_cookie.name: Playdough Cookie
playdough_cookie.description: "Tasty rainbow." - This perk let's you turn your shots multicolored. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect applied to the shot. Colours and effects for each projectile is random, when active.

pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
pyromaniac.description: "It hurts so good +5 bombs." - This perk grants immunity to explosion damage and fire damage. It also causes explosions to heal you. More exotic flame/explosion effects might still affect you negatively or interact weirdly with this power.

red_candle.name: Red Candle
red_candle.description: "Flame on." - This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of strangely persistent fire. It will burn in the targeted location for some time, scorching the surrounding area, and can be moved by strong enough wind or force while it lasts.

restock.name: Restock
restock.description: "Never ending stores!" - This is a metaperk that allows you to purchase subsequently rolled perks multiple times for one roll. Each additional copy costs 200 CP more than the last. Perks bought this way will stack or fuse to increase their quality or quantity. You may also choose to buy the perk repeatedly as separate "copies" to give away later. For example, if your next roll is a free perk, you could purchase it again for 200 CP, then again for 400 CP, and so on - either stacking the effects with what you already have or holding them to distribute later. Restock does not affect other metaperks, nor does it function if the rolled perk can already be purchased multiple times as part of its normal function.

rock_bottom.name: Rock Bottom
rock_bottom.description: "It's only up from there." - This perk revents your physical attributes from falling below their highest values reached. Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use your current stats, items and effects will impact the same way they would as if you did not have Rock Bottom. Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off. Basically, stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.

spoon_bender.name: Spoon Bender
spoon_bender.description: "Homing shots." - This perk grants you the ability to apply a homing effect to your ranged/projectile-based attacks, inspired by The Binding of Isaac. Projectiles/attacks naturally curve toward the nearest enemy in the vicinity. You have no manual control over the targeting; instead, you must position yourself strategically to influence where the shots go. The effect adapts slightly depending on the type of ranged attack you use and has some in-build synergies for specific types of attacks.

steam_sale.name: Steam Sale
steam_sale.description: "50% off". - This is a metaperk. Your next perk roll will have its price automatically cut in half. For example, reducing a 100 CP perk to 50 CP. Perks that cost 50 CP or less become free. If your next roll results in a free perk, Steam Sale does not apply this way. Afterward, there is a 10% chance that all perks purchased following Steam Sale first trigger will also be 50% off by the same rules as the first one was.

stop_watch.name: Stop Watch
stop_watch.description: "Let's slow this fown a bit..." - This perk slightly increases your movement and reaction speed. It alters perception to make things move only at 80% of their speed from your point of view, without losing any understanding of events happening around you. It takes some time for the brain to adapt to this new reality. This power can be toggled.

the_candle.name: The Candle
the_candle.description: "Reusable flames." - This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of blue fire, which disintegrates things on contact and diminishes quickly. It works better against living and organic matter. A wisp of blue fire is hard to move after it has been thrown.

the_compass.name: The Compass
the_compass.description: "The end is near." - This perk gives you a mental compass in the back of your mind, which points you toward places of interest nearby in your current location. It might take some time to figure out what the Compass is showing you, but behind all the symbols it uses, there is logic and system. It cannot reveal places, which are hidden too well and intentionally.

the_hourglass.name: The Hourglass
the_hourglass.description: "Temporary enemy slowdown." - You gain an hourglass that can slow down everyone you perceive as enemies within your vicinity for eight seconds. It has a cooldown between uses. The item provides feedback on its recharge status and imparts knowledge of its use to the holder. The effect is not temporal in nature, but inertial/kinetic: it does not slow the perception of time.

the_wafer.name: The Wafer
the_wafer.description: "Damage resistance." - Most sources of harm that would cause more damage than a certain threshold will only deal a fraction of it: a deep bruise, a cracked rib, or similar injury depending on the strike's location. This protection has limits. It is less effective, or may not function at all, against certain forms of damage.

white_pony.name: White Pony
white_pony.description: "Flight + holy death." - This stick horse grants flight and passively increases your speed. When activated, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, gaining a degree of invulnerability during the dash, dealing damage to enemies struck, and creating damaging beams of light trailing behind you. The active ability has a cooldown. Upon equipping the item, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

yum_heart.name: Yum Heart
yum_heart.description: "Reusable regeneration." - This soft, heart-shaped object is edible. Taking a bite instantly restores a significant amount of health, though it does not heal status effects. It is highly effective against wounds and the physical consequences of things like toxins. It has limited effect on cancer, genetic damage, or similar conditions, but can address more physical forms of harm such as brain or radiation damage. After each use, the item enters a cooldown period before it can be bitten again. Upon equipping it, you gain basic knowledge of its usage and functionality.

urn_of_monster_dust.name: Urn of Monster Dust
urn_of_monster_dust.description: A small highly enchanted container filled with the gray dust of a fallen monster from the Underground. You may choose which monster this dust came from, or have it be random. Can be purchased multiple times. Effects: The essence of the monster's being is preserved within this dust. It may have alchemical, magical, or scientific applications, particularly in the creation of new life or the modification of souls. After all, this substance was part of the process that created Flowey. Note: The properties of monster dust originate from a world with very specific rules regarding souls, magic and mortality. How this substance will interact with the metaphysical laws of other worlds remains a mystery.

vial_of_de-termination.name: Vial of De-termination
vial_of_de-termination.description: A small highly enchanted vial made from some semi-transparent material filled with a slightly glowing fluid - this is De-termination, freshly extracted and condensed from human souls. Can be purchased multiple times. Effects: The use of this liquid is uncertain and potentially dangerous. Drinking it may temporarily grant immense willpower and the power to defy fate, but it could also have unforeseen side effects on one’s soul, identity, or very existence. Note: The nature of souls varies between worlds. It is unknown if this substance will react the same way with the souls of your current reality, or if the inhabitants of that world even possess souls at all. Experiment at your own risk.

a_face_in_the_crowd.name: A Face in the Crowd
a_face_in_the_crowd.description: You? You’re not the main character. You’re not even an important NPC. Whenever something important is happening that you’d rather not be part of, you’ll find that you’re left out of it unless you do something to make yourself a target. Serial killer on the loose? They’ll find more tempting victims. Is there a military draft? You never received a letter. This won’t work in extenuating circumstances- e.g. a person seeking revenge against you in particular, you being the only human in the Underground, etc. Eventually fate runs out of other people to screw over.

advanced_robotics.name: Advanced Robotics
advanced_robotics.description: You gain an understanding of A.I. that dwarfs anything known by humans- packing a fully-sapient intelligence onto half a gigabyte of hard drive space is barely an effort for you, and you’re able to drive computers to run supercomputer-level calculations on even the oldest, cheapest hardware. Furthermore, your understanding of mechanical engineering and robotics allows for you to create durable, motile robotic chassis with nothing but scrap metal. With the addition of Circuitmancy, this perk allows for the creation of intelligent security robots of a similar calibre to Axis Model 014. Robots created in this way are fanatically loyal by default, gain the appropriate Robot background freebies, and may be taken as companions should you (and they) wish it. Robots created without Circuitmancy may still be intelligent, but they will lack the essential “spark” of emotion and personhood.

basic_patterns.name: Basic Patterns
